questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The good chance the child had looked forward to _______ at last.
questions.explanation: the child had looked forward to 是省略了关系词的定语从句，修饰 chance，主句缺少谓语动词，coming 是分词不能作谓语；at last 表明动作发生在过去，故用一般过去时 came。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I really don’t know _______ I kept the secret papers.
questions.explanation: know 后接宾语从句，从句必须用陈述语序，排除 A、D；从句本身是强调句 it was...that I kept the secret papers（强调地点），连接副词 where 提前构成 where it was that...，故选 C。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There are three reading-rooms in our new library, _________about four hundred students in all.
questions.explanation: seat 是及物动词，意为“（场所）可容纳”，逻辑主语 reading-rooms 与之是主动关系，用现在分词 seating 作定语（相当于 which can seat about four hundred students）；sit 不及物，seated/sitting 不能直接接宾语表容纳。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It must have rained last light, ________ the ground is wet here and there.
questions.explanation: must have rained 是对过去的推测，“地面各处是湿的”只是推断的依据而非直接原因，应用并列连词 for 引导补充理由的分句；because/since/as 表直接原因，不合此推断语境。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: _________ no knowledge what may happen in one hundred years’ time.
questions.explanation: 表示“存在”要用 there be 句型，There is no knowledge（of）what may happen 意为“无从知晓百年后会发生什么”；it is/this is/that's 后接 no knowledge 不构成存在句，语义不通。整句：无从知道一百年后会发生什么。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They won’t go back to work unless their demands are _________.
questions.explanation: meet one's demands 为固定搭配，意为“满足要求”，被动式即 are met；permit 允许、give 给、reply 回答均不与 demands 搭配。整句：除非他们的要求得到满足，否则他们不会复工。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
options: Can I use your pen for a while
questions.explanation: Go ahead 意为“请便，用吧”，用于同意对方的请求，故问句应是请求允许的 Can I use your pen for a while?；Shall I help you（要我帮忙吗）、Will you start now、Would you like some coffee 均不能以 Go ahead 作答。整句：——我能用一下你的钢笔吗？——请用吧。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: What a poor memory I’ve got! I remember _________ the letter but forgot _________ it.
questions.explanation: remember doing 表示“记得做过某事”（信已经寄了），forget to do 表示“忘记去做某事”（贴邮票这一动作没做）；remember/forget to do 均指还没做的动作。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: __________ arriving in Tibet, the soldiers at once joined them __________ their work.
questions.explanation: “On + 动名词”表示“一……就……”（On arriving 一到达）；join sb in sth 为固定搭配，意为“和某人一起做某事”。整句：一到达西藏，战士们立即加入他们一起工作。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ----Who told you about Dad’s illness? ----The doctor in ________.
questions.explanation: in charge 意为“负责、主管”，the doctor in charge 即“主治医生”；in connection with 与……有关，in turn 轮流，in public 当众。整句：——谁告诉你爸爸生病的事？——主治医生。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Is __________ you want to say?
questions.explanation: 句子即 Is that all (that) you want to say?，先行词 all 是不定代词，定语从句只能用 that 引导且可省略；what 不能引导定语从句，故 all what 错误，which all 语序错误。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: From this hill top, you can see many islands ________ the coast.
questions.explanation: off the coast 为固定搭配，意为“在离海岸不远的近海海面上”，岛屿在海里而非海岸线上（on the coast 在海岸上）。整句：从这个山顶望去，你能看到近海处的许多岛屿。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I’ve got to _________ up now. Someone is waiting to use the phone.
questions.explanation: hang up 意为“挂断电话”，由 Someone is waiting to use the phone 可知；give up 放弃，put up 张贴/搭建，look up 查阅。整句：我得挂电话了，有人在等着用电话。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The river is so dirty that the water ___________.
options: is not fit to be drunk
questions.explanation: fit 是形容词，意为“适合”，须与 be 连用即 be fit to do sth；“be + 形容词 + 不定式”结构中不定式用主动形式表被动含义，故 is not fit to drink 正确；B、D 缺系动词，C 被动形式多余。整句：河水太脏，不适合饮用。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ----Why are your group so happy? ----Our group _________ theirs in the oral English competition.
questions.explanation: beat/defeat 后接对手（人、团体），win 后接比赛、奖项；theirs 指对方小组（对手），用 beat；group 此处视为整体，谓语用单数 has。整句：——你们组为什么这么高兴？——我们小组在英语口语比赛中赢了他们小组。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The furniture here looks more beautiful than _______ in our room
questions.explanation: furniture 是不可数名词，比较结构中用 that 替代上文出现的不可数名词以避免重复；one/the one 替代可数名词单数，those 替代复数名词。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The area is _________ Wales.
questions.explanation: 倍数表达把倍数放最前面：“倍数 + the size/length/width of + 比较对象”；area（面积）对应 the size of，the length of 指“长度”不合。整句：这个地区的面积是威尔士的两倍。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ----How ________ will he come here? ---- __________ two days.
questions.explanation: how soon 问“还要多久（多快）”，答语用“in + 时间段”（in two days 两天后）；how long 问持续多久（答 for + 时间段），how often 问频率（答 every + 时间）。整句：——他多久以后来这儿？——两天后。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The clock _______ nine and we realized that it was already late.
questions.explanation: 表示“钟敲响几点”用 strike（The clock struck nine）；knock 敲（门），beat（心）跳/击败，hit 击打。整句：钟敲了九下，我们才意识到已经晚了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ----How did you like the food here? ----Oh, excellent! We _______ a better hotel.
questions.explanation: couldn't have done 表示对过去的否定推测（虚拟），意为“不可能已经……”，即“我们不可能找到比这更好的旅馆了”；must 表推测只用于肯定句，mustn't have found 搭配错误。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I like _______ history; by studying it , I can gain ______ knowledge of the past events.
questions.explanation: history 是学科名词，前面不用冠词；knowledge 表示“……方面的知识”时习惯加不定冠词 a，即 gain a knowledge of the past events。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________ leaves the house last ought to turn off the lights.
questions.explanation: 空格处需引导一个主语从句并在从句中作主语，whoever（= anyone who）兼具这两重功能；anyone/the person 只能作先行词，后面还需接 who 引导的定语从句。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ----Is she going to school? ----No, _________.
questions.explanation: 回答承前省略了 she is going，即 No, (she is going) to the shops；A 时态不符（问句是进行时），B 答非所问，D 语义不完整。整句：——她是要去上学吗？——不，去商店。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The roof of our lab was damaged by a _______ tree in the great storm last night.
questions.explanation: 现在分词 falling 作定语表示“正在倒下的”，树是在倒下的过程中砸坏屋顶；过去分词 fallen 表示“已经倒在地上的”（a fallen tree），不合语境；felled 意为“被砍倒的”。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Having made up his mind, he _________ to carry out his plan.
questions.explanation: set out to do sth 意为“着手/开始做某事”，后接不定式；set about 后须接 doing，set off 出发/引爆，set up 建立。整句：下定决心之后，他着手实施自己的计划。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We should invite Jenny to the party. ________ , she is fond of dancing and singing.
questions.explanation: for one thing 意为“首先，一则”，用于陈述理由（与 for another 相呼应）；first 单独使用不表列举理由，The first thing 后需接 is。整句：我们应该邀请珍妮参加晚会，首先她喜欢唱歌跳舞。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The girl seldom, if ________, turned to her brother for protection.
questions.explanation: “seldom, if ever”为固定表达，意为“难得，几乎从不”（如果发生过的话也极少）；其余选项不与 if 构成此搭配。整句：这个女孩几乎从不向她哥哥寻求保护。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I won’t think _______ of him because of his shortcomings. He is a good boy after all.
questions.explanation: think much of 意为“对……评价高”，think less of 意为“看轻、低估”；won't think any less of him 表示“不会因为他的缺点而看轻他”，与后文 He is a good boy after all 呼应。整句：我不会因为他的缺点就看轻他，毕竟他是个好孩子。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ----- You were tired after the sports meet, weren’t you? ----- Yes, ________ . I could hardly stand.
questions.explanation: not a little 意为“非常，很”（= very much），not a bit 意为“一点也不”；由 I could hardly stand（我几乎站不住）可知累得厉害，故用 not a little。整句：——运动会后你很累吧？——是的，累极了，我几乎站不住。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He didn’t go into detail on the subject. He spoke __________.
questions.explanation: in general 意为“大体上，概括地说”，与前句 didn't go into detail（未细谈）呼应；in particular 尤其，in short 简言之，in common 共同。整句：他没有详谈这个话题，只是泛泛而谈。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Through the window I breathed fresh air _________ with the late night smell of grass.
questions.explanation: mixed with 意为“混合着，掺杂着”，过去分词短语作后置定语，即“新鲜空气中掺杂着深夜青草的气味”；filled with 多指容器被充满，covered with 被覆盖，taken 拿走，语义不合。整句：透过窗户，我呼吸着掺有深夜青草气味的清新空气。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Popular music is liked by many people, but it is not to everyone’s _________.
questions.explanation: to one's taste 为固定搭配，意为“合某人的口味/喜好”，音乐喜好用 taste；hearing 听力，sound 声音，smell 气味。整句：流行音乐受到许多人的喜爱，但并非合每个人的口味。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: As a writer, he succeeded in calling _________ to many of the terrible wrongs that existed at that time.
questions.explanation: call/draw attention to 为固定搭配，意为“引起对……的注意”；“注意到”是 take notice of，无 call notice to 的搭配，call interest/mind to 均不成立。整句：作为作家，他成功地唤起了人们对当时存在的许多黑暗弊端的注意。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It was freezing cold. I put on my overcoat, but it didn’t seem to _________ .
questions.explanation: help 此处意为“起作用，管用”，it didn't seem to help 即“似乎不管用”；heat/warm 作动词意为“加热/使暖和”，主语是 overcoat，语义不当。整句：天冷极了，我穿上大衣，可似乎不管用。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ------ Would you like to join us? ------ Sorry, I’m not _________ as any one of you.
questions.explanation: “so/as/too/how + 形容词 + a/an + 单数可数名词”是固定语序，即 so good a player；比较对象用 as 引出：not so good a player as any one of you（不如你们任何一个人）。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is quite warm these days ________ November.
questions.explanation: for + 时间名词表示“就……而言，考虑到”，for November 意为“就十一月份来说”；at/on 表具体时间点。整句：就十一月来说，这些天相当暖和了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The size of this kind of shoes is larger than ________ .
questions.explanation: 比较对象须同类：主语是 the size（尺码），比较对象应是“我脚的尺码”，that 替代 the size，即 that of my feet；A、B 拿脚、鞋与尺码相比，不对等。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The car ________ on the way and we had to walk.
questions.explanation: break down 意为“（车辆等）出故障，抛锚”；break up 解散/分解，break out 爆发，break away 挣脱。整句：汽车半路抛锚了，我们只好步行。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They disagreed with one another and the meeting _________ without any result.
questions.explanation: break up 意为“（会议、集会）解散，结束”；break down 出故障，break out 爆发，break away 脱离。整句：他们彼此意见不一，会议没有任何结果就散了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Our school will _________ at the end of June and the students are ready to leave.
questions.explanation: break up 意为“（学校）放假，（学期）结束”，由 students are ready to leave 可知；break into 闯入，break away 挣脱，break forth 迸发。整句：我们学校六月底放假，学生们准备离校。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The colour TV set __________ that factory ___________ well.
questions.explanation: 电视机与“生产”是被动关系，用过去分词短语 turned out by that factory 作后置定语；sell well 表示“畅销”，习惯用主动形式表被动含义，不用 is sold；C 项 sell 缺三单形式，D 项 produced from 与 is sold 均不合。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ------I’m afraid no one will agree with you. ------ I don’t think it _________ .
questions.explanation: matter 作不及物动词意为“要紧，有关系”，I don't think it matters 意为“我认为这不要紧”；is matter 结构错误（名词用法是 What's the matter），mind 意为“介意”不合句意。整句：——恐怕没人会同意你的看法。——我认为这无关紧要。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: -----I have two tickets for the film, will you go with me？ -----Yes, ___________ .
questions.explanation: 回答别人的邀请并接受时说 Yes, thanks；with pleasure 用于答应别人的请求（帮忙类），it's a pleasure 用于回应对方的感谢，均不合此语境。整句：——我有两张电影票，你和我一起去好吗？——好啊，谢谢。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He studied very hard and in the end turned _________ .
questions.explanation: turn 表示“变成”时，后接表示职业、身份的单数可数名词不加冠词，turn scientist = become a scientist；turn out 意为“结果是”，此处句式需要的是 turn + 职业名词。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We would have our party in the hall _________ in the garden.
questions.explanation: rather than 意为“而不是”，可连接两个并列的介词短语 in the hall 与 in the garden；instead 表“代替”须用 instead of 才能接宾语，单独的 instead 放句中不合。整句：我们宁愿在礼堂里而不在花园里举行晚会。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They move to another house to make _________ the new comers.
questions.explanation: make room for 为固定短语，意为“给……腾出地方”，room 表示“空间”时不可数，不加冠词也不用复数。整句：他们搬到另一所房子，好给新来的人腾出地方。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I’ve visited a lot of different places and stayed in a lot of different hotels, but nothing else _________ this one.
questions.explanation: match 作动词意为“与……相配，比得上”，nothing else matches this one 即没有别家比得上这家；win 赢得，make 制作，take 拿走。整句：我去过很多地方、住过很多旅馆，但没有哪家比得上这一家。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Poisons should be kept out of the __________ of children.
questions.explanation: out of the reach of sb 为固定搭配，意为“在某人够不着的地方”；catch 抓住，grasp 抓紧，hold 握住，均无此介词搭配。整句：毒物应放在孩子们够不到的地方。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: While playing in the garden, _________ .
options: a stone fell down upon my shoulder
my leg was heavily hit by a stone
I was hit by a stone
questions.explanation: while playing 的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致，“玩”的人是 I，故选 I was hit by a stone；A、B、C 的主语是 a stone/my leg，与 playing 的逻辑主语不一致（悬垂分词错误）。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: What he said at the meeting is _________ worth _________ .
questions.explanation: be well worth doing 为固定搭配，意为“很值得做”，worth 前用 well 修饰而不用 very；worth 后的动名词用主动形式表被动含义，listen 是不及物动词，须加 to 才能接 what he said。整句：他在会上说的话很值得一听。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: What the young man said sounds strange, _________ it is true.
questions.explanation: 前后是转折关系，and yet 相当于 but，意为“然而”，两个连词连用表强调；but and、yet and、and but 均非正确搭配。整句：这个年轻人说的话听起来奇怪，然而是真的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: -------David has made great progress recently. ------- __________ , and _________ .
options: So he has … so have you
So has he … so have you
So has he … so you have
questions.explanation: “So + 主语 + 助动词”（不倒装）表示对上文加以肯定，意为“确实如此”，即 So he has（他确实进步了）；“So + 助动词 + 主语”（倒装）表示另一人也如此，即 so have you（你也一样）。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There was one listener in the lecture hall and only ten minutes later did I see ________ .
questions.explanation: another 表示泛指的“又一个，再一个”，十分钟后（又）看见另一个听众；the other 特指两者中的另一个，与语境不符。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: -------Would you do me a favor and give me a ride? ------- ___________ .
questions.explanation: 应答别人的请求帮助用 With pleasure（乐意效劳）；Never mind 用于回应道歉，Yes, that's right 用于确认事实，No trouble at all 用于回应感谢。整句：——能帮个忙让我搭个车吗？——乐意效劳。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I shouldn’t have left Jimmy __________ I the room.
questions.explanation: leave sb alone 为固定表达，意为“把某人单独留下，不打扰某人”；single 单身的，lonely 孤独的（多作定语或表语），himself 反身代词，均不能构成此搭配。整句：我本不该把吉米一个人留在房间里。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The footsteps __________ his return.
questions.explanation: announce 此处意为“预示，宣告……的来临”，脚步声预示他回来了；tell 须接人作宾语，express 用于表达思想感情，indicate 多指迹象表明某种情况。整句：脚步声预示着他回来了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: __________ all her efforts, she failed to reach her aim.
questions.explanation: In spite of 意为“尽管”，后接名词短语 all her efforts；Because of 因为（与 failed 逻辑相反），Together with 连同，Instead of 而不是。整句：尽管作了种种努力，她还是没能达到目的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It won’t _________ a hero just to do one good deed.
questions.explanation: make 表示“使成为，造就”，It won't make a hero 即“不会使人成为英雄”；build 建造，bring 带来，be 语义平淡，不合“造就”之义。整句：只做一件好事并不能使人成为英雄。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After three days, our food _________ , and we had to return to our camp.
questions.explanation: give out 意为“（食物、供应品等）用尽，耗尽”；give away 赠送/泄露，give off 发出（气味、光），give up 放弃。整句：三天后我们的食物吃完了，只好返回营地。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: --------Is __________ here? --------No, Bob and Tom have asked for leave.
questions.explanation: Is everybody here? 意为“人都到齐了吗”；由答语 Bob and Tom have asked for leave（两人缺席）可知问的是“全部”，若用 anybody（有人吗）则答语应说明没有人来。整句：——人都到齐了吗？——没有，鲍勃和汤姆请假了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I’m sorry for what I’ve said. I __________ .
questions.explanation: take back 意为“收回（说过的话）”；hold back 抑制（情感）/阻止，keep back 隐瞒/保留，get back 取回。整句：我为说过的话道歉，我收回那些话。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The highway is about __________ .
questions.explanation: 表示长度用“数词 + 复数单位 + long”，即 three thousand miles long；连字符复合形容词 three-thousand-mile 只能作定语，C 项形式冗余。整句：这条公路大约三千英里长。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ------- Can he carry the heavy bag alone? ------ ___________ . He is too old to do it.
questions.explanation: 由 He is too old to do it 可知回答是否定的，Afraid not（恐怕不行）是 I'm afraid not 的省略形式；Yes, of course/Certainly 与后文矛盾，I don't think it 缺少谓语成分。整句：——他能独自搬动这个重袋子吗？——恐怕不行，他年纪太大干不了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A dozen years ________ , but the pretty woman remains __________ .
questions.explanation: a dozen years 作主语表时间段，视为整体，谓语用单数；句末 remains 是一般现在时，说明过去十二年一直延续到现在，应用现在完成时 has gone by；remain 后接形容词 unchanged（依然未变），A 项 passed 为一般过去时，与 remains 时态不呼应。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Huck _______ me staying there a little longer.
questions.explanation: insist on 后可接动名词复合结构（宾格 + doing），insisted on me staying 意为“坚持要我在……”；keep on 后只接 doing，stick to 后接名词，remain 无此用法。整句：哈克坚持要我在那里再多待一会儿。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Anyone who has __________ the magazine please give it back immediately.
questions.explanation: take 意为“拿走”，凡拿了这本杂志的人请立即归还；receive/accept 指“收到/接受”（别人给的），brought 意为“带来”，均不合语境。整句：凡拿了这本杂志的，请立即归还。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Professor Smith lives _______ the second storey, this is _________ the second floor.
questions.explanation: 英国英语说“住在第几层”用 in（live in the second storey），美国英语用 on（on the second floor）；storey 为英式拼写，floor 为美式说法。整句：史密斯教授住在第二层，这就是二楼。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The song sounds _________ , doesn’t it?
questions.explanation: sound 是系动词，后接形容词作表语；well 作形容词仅表示“身体好”，moved（感动的）多修饰人，beautifully 是副词不能作表语，故 sweet（动听的）正确。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: _________ it is to swim in rivers or lakes.
questions.explanation: fun 是不可数名词，感叹名词短语用 What 且不加 a/an，即 What fun it is to swim...；How 后接形容词或副词，不能直接接 fun。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Don’t get ________ to the dog. It is dangerous.
questions.explanation: get 此处是系动词，后接形容词 close，get close to 意为“靠近”；closely 是副词，意为“密切地、仔细地”，不表空间上的靠近；nearly 几乎，nearby 附近的。整句：别靠近那条狗，它很危险。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Every means __________ prevent the water from ___________ .
questions.explanation: means 是单复同形名词，被 every 修饰时视为单数，谓语用 is used to；prevent...from 后接动名词，水是“被污染”的对象，应用被动式 being polluted（注：D 项原文 being polluting 疑为 being polluted 之笔误，四个选项中只有 D 的主谓一致与被动结构方向均正确）。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Let’s cut the apple __________ and share it.
questions.explanation: cut...into halves 为固定搭配，意为“把……切成两半”，halves 复数对应“两半”；into half/by half/in halves 均非正确搭配。整句：咱们把苹果切成两半分着吃。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He stole the money and was put __________ .
questions.explanation: put/throw sb in prison 为固定短语，意为“把某人关进监狱”，prison 表示“监禁”这一抽象意义时不加冠词；in the prison 仅指“在监狱这座建筑物里”。整句：他偷了钱，被关进了监狱。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He started early ___________ he could get there before nine.
questions.explanation: 空后是完整从句 he could get there before nine，应用 in order that 引导目的状语从句；so as to/in order to 后只能接动词原形，because 表原因不合句意。整句：他很早就出发了，以便九点前赶到那里。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When you do fine, close work, such as reading or drawing, raise your eyes __________ and look into the distance.
questions.explanation: once in a while 为固定短语，意为“偶尔，时不时”；其余三项介词搭配错误。整句：做阅读、绘画这类精细的近距离工作时，要偶尔抬起眼睛远眺。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It was __________ that he couldn’t finish it alone.
questions.explanation: “so + 形容词 + a/an + 单数可数名词”为固定语序，即 so difficult a job；work 是不可数名词，不能说 a work 或 such a difficult work；a so difficult job 语序错误。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Everybody has to spend _________ in bed.
questions.explanation: some time 意为“一段时间”，spend some time in bed 即卧床休养一段时间；sometimes 有时，sometime 某个时候，some times 几次。整句：每个人都得卧床休养一段时间。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Never waste anything, but __________ never waste time.
questions.explanation: above all 意为“最重要的是，尤其”，与 never waste time 呼应；after all 毕竟，for all 尽管，all above 无此搭配。整句：什么都不要浪费，尤其是时间。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The boy stared at his book, ___________ .
questions.explanation: pen in hand 是“名词 + 介词短语”构成的独立主格结构作伴随状语，习惯上省略冠词；若用 with 复合结构须说 with a pen in his hand，A、B、C 均不合习惯用法。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.explanation: have a gift for sth 为固定搭配，意为“在某方面有天赋”，gift 此处指“天赋”而非“礼物”；a gift in/cleverness to 均非正确搭配。整句：她在语言方面很有天赋。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.explanation: here/there/now/then 等副词开头且谓语是 come/go 等不及物动词时，用“副词 + 谓语 + 主语”的完全倒装，主语是名词 the bus，即 here comes the bus；主语为人称代词时不倒装。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.explanation: “数词-名词-形容词”构成复合形容词作定语时，连字符内名词用单数，即 a ten-year-old daughter；A 项 ten-years-old 复数错误，D 项连字符把 daughter 也连入不合法。整句：他有一个十岁的女儿。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She must have arrived, _________ she?
questions.explanation: must have arrived 表示对过去动作已完成的推测，句子无明确过去时间，附加问句用 hasn't she；若有 yesterday 等明确过去时间才用 didn't she。整句：她一定已经到了，是不是？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: No one enjoys __________ at.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后接动名词作宾语；no one 与 laugh at 是被动关系（被嘲笑），须用被动式动名词 being laughed at，介词 at 不能省。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ------What do you suppose made her worried? ------ a gold ring.
questions.explanation: 问句问的是“什么使她担忧”，答语须作主语，用动名词短语 Losing a gold ring（丢了金戒指这件事）；Because of losing 是介词短语不能作主语，Lose 动词原形、loss 名词均不能作主语表示“丢失”这一行为。整句：——你认为是什么使她担忧？——丢了金戒指。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He has no interests, _________ his work.
questions.explanation: apart from 意为“除……之外”，肯定句、否定句中均可；besides 多用于肯定句表示“除……之外还有”，beside 意为“在旁边”，accept 意为“接受”（与 except 形近易混）。整句：除了工作，他没有什么别的兴趣爱好。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Our teacher gives lessons in ___________ .
questions.explanation: composition 表示“写作（科目、技能）”时是不可数名词，不加冠词也不用复数；compositions 指一篇篇作文，the composition/a composition 特指或泛指某篇作文。整句：我们的老师教写作课。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Yesterday we called at ________ .
questions.explanation: call at 后须接地点，Mary's sister's 是名词所有格，其后省略了 house（＝玛丽的姐姐家）；a friend of my uncle's 指人，拜访人应用 call on；my aunts 漏了所有格's。整句：昨天我们拜访了玛丽的姐姐家。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She has __________ Robert for a year.
questions.explanation: for a year 表持续一段时间，须用延续性状态 be married to；marry 是瞬间（终止性）动词，不能与 for a year 连用，且搭配用 to 不用 with。整句：她与罗伯特结婚已经一年了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His house is easily __________ from the rest. It has a large blue door.
questions.explanation: pick out 意为“辨认出，分辨出”，房子是“被辨认出”的，用被动语态 is easily picked out；pick up 捡起/接人，picking out/picking 主动形式与语态不符。整句：他的房子很容易从其余的房子中辨认出来，它有一扇蓝色的大门。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It was about 600 years ago ________ the first clock with a face and an hour hand was made.
questions.explanation: 去掉 It was...that 后句子依然完整（The first clock...was made about 600 years ago），说明是强调句型，强调时间状语用 that（不用 when）。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He has been here for __________ .
questions.explanation: “two and a half + 复数名词”或“two months and a half”均可，month 须用复数 months；A 缺复数，B、C 结构错误。整句：他在这里已经两个半月了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Shortly after the accident, two _______ police were sent to the spot to keep order.
questions.explanation: dozen 前有具体数词时不加 s（two dozen）；当后面接 the 特指一批警察时，用“数词 + dozen + of the + 复数名词”结构，即 two dozen of the police；dozens of 前不能再加 two。整句：事故发生后不久，二十四名警察被派往现场维持秩序。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Your advice that she _________ more exercise is reasonable.
questions.explanation: advice（建议）后的同位语从句用虚拟语气“（should +）动词原形”，should 省略后即 take；take exercise 意为“进行体育锻炼”。整句：你建议她多锻炼是合理的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ___________ of the students in our class are from the north.
questions.explanation: 分数表达：分子用基数词，分母用序数词，分子大于 1 时分母用复数，two ninths（九分之二）；nine 变序数词去 e 加 th（ninth），无 nineth 的拼法。整句：我们班有九分之二的学生来自北方。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I wasn’t _________ the decision until too late.
questions.explanation: inform sb of sth 意为“告知某人某事”，被动式 be informed of the decision 即“被告知这个决定”；form 意为“形成”，informed for 搭配错误。整句：直到太晚了我才被告知这个决定。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The wounded soldier _________ to find himself in the hospital.
questions.explanation: come to 意为“苏醒，恢复知觉”，to find himself in the hospital 为不定式作结果状语（醒来后发现自己在医院里）；come in 进来，come up 走近/被提出，come out 出来/出版。整句：伤员苏醒过来，发现自己在医院里。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I demand that one of you ________ there at once.
questions.explanation: demand（要求）后的宾语从句用虚拟语气“（should +）动词原形”，should 省略后即 go；will go/must go/has to go 均为陈述语气，不合。整句：我要求你们当中有一个人马上去那里。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The next afternoon he went to ___________ Mr. Smith again.
questions.explanation: call on sb 意为“拜访某人”；call off 取消，call forth 唤起，call by 顺路停留。整句：第二天下午他又去拜访了史密斯先生。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The vitamins necessary for a healthy body are normally supplied by a ________ of fruit and green vegetables.
questions.explanation: a variety of 意为“各种各样的”，a variety of fruit and green vegetables 即各式水果和绿叶蔬菜；a series of 一系列（强调先后连续），section 部分，fraction 小部分。整句：健康身体所需的维生素通常由各种各样的水果和绿叶蔬菜提供。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He was said to be very formal, rigid and _________ conventional.
questions.explanation: desperately 在此作程度副词，意为“极度地，非常”，desperately conventional 指非常因循守旧，与 very formal, rigid 并列加强语气；hopelessly 多与明显负面且难以改变的词连用，carelessly 粗心地，splendidly 壮丽地。整句：据说他非常拘谨、刻板，而且极端守旧。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Peter felt lonely at first, but after a time he got ________ alone and even enjoyed it.
questions.explanation: get used to doing sth 意为“习惯于做某事”，to 是介词，后接动名词 living；used to do 意为“过去常常做某事”。整句：彼得起初感到孤独，但过一段时间后他就习惯了一个人的生活，甚至乐在其中。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His sitting room is lined with all kinds of books, __________ he has ever read.
questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，先行词 books 指物，“none of + which”表示“其中没有一本”在从句中作 read 的宾语；介词 of 后只能用 which 不能用 that，none of 单独用无法连接从句。整句：他的起居室摆满了各种各样的书，但没有一本是他读过的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The number of registered participants in this year’s marathon was only half __________ .
questions.explanation: 比较对象须一致：主语是 the number（单数概念），用 that 替代 last year's number，即 that of last year's；those 替代复数名词，of last year's 缺替代词。整句：今年马拉松的报名人数只有去年的一半。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Only the people concerned have access _________ the foreign teacher’s class.
questions.explanation: have access to 为固定搭配，意为“有权使用，可以进入/参加”；access 不与 into/with/about 搭配。整句：只有相关人员才有资格听外教的课。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I’m not sure whether he __________ the meeting or not, as he has not been here lately.
questions.explanation: 他最近一直没来，“是否参加这次会议”是尚未发生的将来动作，whether 引导的从句用一般将来时 will attend。整句：我不确定他会不会来参加会议，因为他最近一直不在这儿。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The weather in China is different from __________ .
questions.explanation: 比较对象须同类：weather 用 that 替代，that in America = the weather in America；one 替代可数名词单数，America/in America 缺替代词，比较不对等。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Jack was so drunk that he fell off the bike and ________ by the roadside until the next morning.
questions.explanation: “躺”（lie–lay–lain）的过去式是 lay，与并列谓语 fell 呼应用过去时；laid 是 lay（放置、产卵）的过去式，lied 是 lie（说谎）的过去式，lying 是现在分词不能单独作谓语。整句：杰克醉得太厉害，从自行车上摔下来，在路边一直躺到第二天早上。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The professor needs an assistant that he can ________ to take care of problems in his absence.
questions.explanation: count on sb 意为“依靠，指望”；count in 把……算在内，count up 合计，count out 逐一数出/不包括。整句：教授需要一位助手，以便他不在时可以依靠这位助手处理问题。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I am not sure whether I can get any profit from the business, so I can’t make a(n) _________ decision about what to do next.
questions.explanation: definite 意为“明确的，确定的”，a definite decision 即明确的决定；exact 精确的（多指数值、尺寸），denied 被否定的，assured 确信的、有保证的（多指人的心态）。整句：我不确定这笔生意能否获利，所以无法就下一步做什么作出明确决定。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The photos on the wall _________ grandma of those happy old days when a large family lived together.
questions.explanation: remind sb of sth 为固定搭配，意为“使某人想起……”；recall/remember 的主语应是人（某人想起），retain 意为“保留”。整句：墙上的照片使奶奶想起一大家人生活在一起的美好往昔。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The launching of China’s first manned-spaceship was televised ________ by CCTV.
questions.explanation: live 此处是副词，意为“以现场直播方式”，televise the event live 即现场直播；alive 活着的（形容词），life 生命，lively 活泼生动的（形容词）。整句：中国首次载人飞船的发射由中央电视台现场直播。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Work hard, _________ you will pass the final examination.
questions.explanation: “祈使句 + and + 陈述句”表示“（做某事）就会……”（好结果）；or 连接则表示“否则”（坏结果），so/thus 表因果不合此句型。整句：努力学习，你就会通过期末考试。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It was _________ Christmas Eve that he came back to his home town.
questions.explanation: It was not until + 时间 + that... 是强调句型强调 not until 结构，意为“直到……才……”，that 从句须用肯定式（不强调时说 He didn't come back until Christmas Eve）。整句：直到平安夜他才回到家乡。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He’s far ________ of the others in mathematics.
questions.explanation: ahead of 为固定搭配，意为“在……前面，领先于”，far ahead of the others 即远远领先于其他人；advanced 通常作定语或说 advanced in，不与 of 搭配。整句：他的数学远远领先于其他人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I watched the English speaking _________ on TV last night.
questions.explanation: 英语演讲比赛用 contest（contest 指演讲、作文等技能性竞赛），an English speaking contest；match 多指球类等体育对抗赛。整句：昨晚我在电视上看了一场英语演讲比赛。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: As preparations were not completed in time, the conference had to be ________ till the next Tuesday.
questions.explanation: postpone 意为“推迟”，可与 till/until 连用表示“推迟到某时”；cancel 取消则不与 till 搭配，put away 收好，put aside 搁置一边。整句：由于准备工作未能按时完成，会议只好推迟到下周二。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When she heard the bad news, she completely __________ .
questions.explanation: break down 意为“（身体、精神）垮掉，崩溃”；break away 挣脱，break out 爆发，break through 突破。整句：听到这个坏消息，她的精神完全垮了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Packing all the goods will take __________ days.
questions.explanation: “another + 数词 + 复数名词”表示“再（多少）……”，another ten days = ten more days 还要十天；other 前须有 the/some 等限定词，the other ten 指特定范围内的另十个（语境无此所指）。整句：打包所有货物还需要十天。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________ the salary meets my expectation, I will accept the job offered.
questions.explanation: Provided that 意为“只要，假如”，引导条件状语从句；Unless 除非（逻辑相反），Even if 即使（表让步），Due to 由于（介词短语，不能接从句）。整句：只要薪水符合我的期望，我就接受提供给我的这份工作。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________ of books on how to prepare for the entrance examination are compiled by him.
questions.explanation: 句中谓语动词 are 为复数。按规则：the number of+名词（……的数量）谓语用单数，a number of+复数名词（许多）谓语用复数；amount 与 deal 只用于不可数名词，books 为可数复数，故选 A number。译：他编写了许多关于如何准备入学考试的书。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The two passengers, as well as the driver, __________ in the traffic accident.
questions.explanation: as well as 连接的是附加成分，按就远原则谓语与真正主语 the two passengers 保持一致，用复数 were；事故中受伤用 injure，wound 指刀枪伤，damage 用于物体，harm 指伤害。译：这两名乘客以及司机都在交通事故中受了伤。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He stood waving until the train was out of .
questions.explanation: out of sight 在视线之外、看不见，固定搭配；glimpse 与 a glimpse of 连用表一瞥，out of reach 够不着，scene 与 out of 不构成此义。译：他站在那里挥手，直到火车从视线中消失。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The desks and chairs can be to the height of each child.
questions.explanation: adjust 调整（adjust...to...），桌椅可以调整到适合每个孩子的高度；adopt 采纳，measure 测量，object 反对。译：这些桌椅可以调整到适合每个孩子的高度。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I took the medicine but it didn’t have any .
questions.explanation: have an effect（on）有效果、起作用，固定搭配；effort（努力）是 effect 的形近干扰词，response 反应，relation 关系。译：我吃了药，但没有任何效果。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I didn’t you carrying a pack when you came in.
questions.explanation: notice sb doing sth 注意到某人在做某事；watch 观看，regard 认为，vision 是名词（视力），不能作谓语动词。译：你进来时我没注意到你拿着一个包。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I watched the wrestling on TV last night.
questions.explanation: contest 泛指各类竞赛项目（含摔跤、演讲等）；match 多用于球类比赛，fight 指打斗，sport 指体育运动本身。译：昨晚我在电视上看了摔跤比赛。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: This rough life to injure his health.
questions.explanation: threaten to do 威胁着要、眼看会……；这种艰苦的生活眼看要损害他的健康；expect 期待，promise 有望、答应，enforce 强制执行。译：这种艰苦的生活眼看要损害他的健康。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You ought to take every of improving your English.
questions.explanation: take every chance of doing sth 抓住每一个……的机会，固定搭配；take one's time 意为不慌不忙，与句意不符。译：你应当抓住每一个提高英语的机会。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: As preparations were not completed in time, the conference had to be till the next Tuesday.
questions.explanation: postpone 推迟（后接 till/until 表推迟到某时）；cancel 取消（会议已开不成），put away 收好，put aside 搁置、留出。译：由于准备工作未能及时完成，会议不得不推迟到下周二。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I began to iron the white dress that my daughter had from the wardrobe.
questions.explanation: bring 指从别处拿来，裙子是女儿从衣柜里拿出来的；take 拿走（方向相反），obtain 获得，collect 收集。译：我开始熨那条女儿从衣柜里拿出来的白裙子。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I my things to a hotel in Green Street.
questions.explanation: move...to... 把……搬（迁）到某处，行李搬到旅馆；gather 收集，get 得到，pick 挑选（pick up 才有拿走义）。译：我把行李搬到了格林街的一家旅馆。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Is that film still ?
questions.explanation: be still running（电影）还在上映，固定用法；working 运转、工作，performing 表演，均不用于电影的上映。译：那部电影还在上映吗？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They only five tractors two years ago.
questions.explanation: possess 拥有，指长期占有财物，两年前他们只有五台拖拉机；gain/obtain 指经过努力获得，accept 接受。译：两年前他们只有五台拖拉机。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The newspapers reported yesterday several on the boundaries of these two countries.
questions.explanation: incident 指突发的政治性、边境事件（boundary incidents 边境事件）；happening 泛指发生的事情，event 重大事件，accident 事故。译：报纸昨天报道了几起发生在这两国边境的事件。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Some of the students in his class seem to do their assignments.
questions.explanation: be unwilling to do 不愿意做……；boring/tiring/interesting 均修饰事物（令人厌烦的/累人的/有趣的），不能说明学生不愿做作业的状态。译：他班上有些学生似乎不愿意做作业。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Let’s work hard to find to the problem.
questions.explanation: a solution to the problem 问题的解决办法，固定搭配；answer 虽也可接 to，但 find a solution to（找出解决办法）是本题惯用表达；way/method 不与 to the problem 如此搭配。译：让我们努力找出解决这个问题的办法。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They have developed techniques which are to those used in most factories.
questions.explanation: be superior to 比……优越，固定搭配（superior 是拉丁比较级，不与 than 连用）；simpler/better/greater 后均须接 than。译：他们研发的技术比大多数工厂所使用的更为先进。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: At the beginning of this term, our English teacher a list of books for us to read.
questions.explanation: make out 开列、写出（make out a list 列出清单）；turn out 生产、结果是，hand in 上交，pass on 传递。译：这学期初，我们的英语老师为我们开出了一份阅读书单。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Here are some toys. You can one or two for your little son as a birthday present.
questions.explanation: pick out 挑选；single out 挑出（多指从众多中单独挑出某人某物），work out 算出、解决，find out 查明真相。译：这里有些玩具，你可以挑一两件作为你小儿子生日礼物。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The trip has his memory of his childhood.
questions.explanation: bring back 使回想起、唤起（回忆）；bring about 引起、导致，bring over 把……带来，bring forth 提出、生产。译：这次旅行唤起了他对童年的回忆。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If you don’t smoking you will never get recovered.
questions.explanation: give up 放弃、戒掉（give up smoking 戒烟）；give off 发出（气、光），give in 屈服，give out 分发、用完。译：如果你不戒烟，你的病就永远好不了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I should be very glad to you on the subject as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: hear from sb 收到某人的来信/消息；hear of/about 听说（某人某事），hear to 无此搭配。译：关于这个问题，我愿尽快收到你的回信。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Gorge took of the fine weather to do a day’s work in this garden.
questions.explanation: take advantage of 趁机利用，固定搭配；profit 利润，preference 偏好，provided 倘若（连词）。译：乔治趁着好天气在花园里干了一天的活。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He finds it difficult to himself to the climate.
questions.explanation: accustom oneself to 使自己习惯于，固定搭配；apply...to 应用，account 解释，avail 无 avail oneself to 的搭配。译：他发现自己很难适应这里的气候。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When she heard the bad news, she completely .
questions.explanation: break down（身体、精神）垮掉、崩溃；break away 挣脱，break out 爆发，break through 突破。译：听到这个坏消息，她的身体完全垮了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: This is much to the one I bought last week.
questions.explanation: be inferior to 比……差，固定搭配（不与 than 连用，且 inferior 前不加比较级 more）；worse/lower 后接 than，equal to 与……相等。译：这个比我上周买的那个差得多。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Once we receive your order, we will goods to you within twenty-four hours.
questions.explanation: deliver 投递、送货（deliver goods 送货）；distribute 分发，transfer 转移、调动，convey 传送（信息、情感）。译：一旦收到你们的订单，我们将在二十四小时内把货送到。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She her husband his clumsy bearing (举止).
questions.explanation: lecture sb on sth 就某事训诫、指责某人，固定搭配；reflect on 反思（主语为自己），condemn sb to 判某人……刑，talk about 泛泛谈论、无指责义。译：她因丈夫举止笨拙而训斥他。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Only one more week and the contract will .
questions.explanation: run out 到期、用完（合同到期）；bring out 出版、拿出，put through 接通、完成，carry on 继续。译：再过一个星期合同就要到期了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Packing all the goods will take days.
questions.explanation: another+数词+复数名词＝数词+more+复数名词，another ten days 再要十天；other 不能这样直接置于数词前，the other ten 指另十个（物）而非十天。译：把所有货物打包还需要十天。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We buy our __________ at a large__________ store.
questions.explanation: clothes 指具体的衣服（只有复数形式），buy our clothes 买衣服；clothing 是服装总称（不可数），用于 clothing store 服装店。译：我们在一家大服装店买衣服。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If you can't remember, let me try to __________ your memory.
questions.explanation: refresh one's memory 唤起记忆、帮助回忆，固定搭配；awaken 唤醒，stimulate 刺激，arouse 激起，均不与 memory 构成此搭配。译：如果你记不得了，让我帮你回忆一下。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Mother is preparing a meal while keeping __________ the baby.
questions.explanation: keep an eye on 照看、留意，固定搭配（eye 用单数并带冠词 an）；an eye for 指对……有鉴赏力，eyes on 与 keep 不构成此义。译：妈妈一边做饭一边照看着孩子。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He braked hard__________ a sudden panic.
questions.explanation: in a panic 处于惊慌之中，固定搭配用介词 in；brake hard in a sudden panic 在一阵突然的惊慌中猛踩刹车。译：他在一阵突然的惊慌中猛地刹住了车。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I didn't expect you to finish so soon. How long did the work__________
questions.explanation: how long did the work take 这项工作花了多长时间，take 花费时间；endure 忍受、持久，continue 持续（不及物，不强调完成所耗时间），go 须加 on。译：我没料到你这么快就完成了，这工作花了多长时间？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The muffled cry seemed to come__________ the wall which was 15 inches thick.
questions.explanation: from behind the wall 从墙的后面传来，from（从，表来源）与 behind（在……后面）两个介词叠用；只选 from 或 behind 都不能同时表达来源与方位。译：那低沉的哭声似乎是从那面十五英寸厚的墙后面传来的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: No one could explain how it had__________ that he survived the air crash.
questions.explanation: come about 发生（it has come about that... ……的情况是怎么发生的）；become/arrive/result 均不能接 that 从句表达此义。译：没人能解释他怎么会在空难中幸存下来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Even a mighty express train can be__________ by signals.
questions.explanation: hold up 阻挡、使延误（be held up by signals 被信号拦停）；prevent 须接 from doing，keep up 保持，slow up 使慢下来但多用于主动减速。译：即使是高速快车也会被信号拦停。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Microcomputers__________ with the invention of microchips.
questions.explanation: come into being 产生、形成，固定搭配，强调随微芯片的发明而出现；appear/turn up 只表出现，were realized 被实现。译：随着微芯片的发明，微型计算机应运而生。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The small lake was only four miles__________
questions.explanation: across 在距离词后作副词表宽度，four miles across 横宽四英里，是惯用表达；wide 多作定语或与名词连用表宽度。译：这个小湖只有四英里宽。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You've made some progress. Keep it__________
questions.explanation: keep it up 坚持下去，固定搭配；keep on 须接 doing，keep off 远离、避开，keep down 压制、控制。译：你已经取得了一些进步，坚持下去。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The old lady lost her cat last week and it miraculously turned _______ yesterday in her back yard.
questions.explanation: turn up（意外地）出现、露面；turn on 打开，turn in 上交，turn back 返回。译：老太太上周丢了猫，昨天它奇迹般地在她家后院出现了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He chose a tie which would__________ his suit.
questions.explanation: go with 与……相配（衣着搭配用 go with）；fit 指尺寸合身，agree（with）与……一致，suit 虽有适合义但此处强调与套装协调相配。译：他挑了一条与西装相配的领带。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The couple never got__________ the loss of their son.
questions.explanation: get over 从（打击、损失、疾病）中恢复过来；get on 上车、相处，get down 下来、记下，from/down 不与 get 构成此义。译：这对夫妇始终未能从失去儿子的悲痛中走出来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Aleko denied__________ Mary's little lamb.
questions.explanation: deny（否认）后固定接动名词 doing 作宾语，不接不定式；to have stolen（不定式）与 having to steal（形式错误）均不对，故选 stealing。译：阿列科否认偷了玛丽的小羊羔。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: _______ him go out if he wants to.
questions.explanation: let sb do sth 允许某人做某事（宾补用动词原形），与 if he wants to（随他意愿）呼应；allow/permit 须接 to do（allow him to go），make 表强迫，与句意不符。译：如果他想去，就让他出去吧。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: How much would you__________ me for repairing my bike?
questions.explanation: charge sb (money) for sth 向某人收取……的费用；pay sb 付钱给某人（方向相反），cost 主语为物，take 用于花费时间。译：修我的自行车你要收我多少钱？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You won't be seeing Jane any more. The boss fired her. She's gone__________
questions.explanation: for good 永久地、一去不返，固定搭配；for all 尽管、虽然，for the time 与 for days 均非表永久的地道表达。译：你不会再见到简了，老板解雇了她，她一去不返了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She spent the _______ day washing and cleaning.
questions.explanation: the whole day 整天，whole 须置于冠词之后；all 须置于冠词之前（all the day），空格前已有 the 故不能用 all；full 完整的，complete 完全的，均不合句意。译：她花了一整天洗洗涮涮、打扫卫生。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I won't go if it _______ changing trains in London.
questions.explanation: mean doing sth 意味着要……，如果那意味着要在伦敦换乘火车我就不去；care 在意，indicate 表明，want 想要。译：如果那意味着要在伦敦换乘火车，我就不去了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Stephen tried to the boss as soon as he began to work at the office.
questions.explanation: make up to sb 巴结、讨好某人；make up for 弥补，make for 走向、有助于，make over 转让、翻新。译：斯蒂芬一开始在办公室上班，就极力讨好老板。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He failed knowledge.
questions.explanation: for want of 因缺乏……，固定搭配（中间不加冠词）；in want of 意为需要，但 fail for want of 表因缺乏而失败。译：他因缺乏知识而失败了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They are correctly placed as regards size and color.
questions.explanation: according to 按照、根据（according to size and color 按尺寸和颜色）；with regard to/as to/as for 均表至于、关于，不表依据。译：它们按尺寸和颜色被摆放得恰到好处。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His face him when he told a lie.
questions.explanation: give away 泄露、暴露；give back 归还，give out 分发、公布，give over 移交。译：他撒谎时，脸色把他自己暴露了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Robert narrowly escaped being arrested robbery.
questions.explanation: on a charge of（因……罪名）此处为 on charge of robbery 因抢劫罪；in charge of 负责、管理（主语为人），under the charge of 在……管理之下，taking charge of 接管。译：罗伯特险些因抢劫罪被捕。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I had a tiny apartment, and I was earning barely enough money to .
options: keep my body and soul together
make an end of two ends
keep and hold my end up
questions.explanation: keep body and soul together 勉强维持生计、糊口，英语习语；其余选项均非地道表达。译：我住着一间小公寓，挣的钱仅够勉强糊口。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I would have lost my head in that position.
questions.explanation: lose one's head 惊慌失措、失去理智，等于 get confused；become sick 生病，其余选项歪曲原义。译：在那种处境下我会惊慌失措的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Paula has a bent for music. the writer is saying .
options: Paula is totally absorbed in music
Paula is bent on listening to the music
questions.explanation: have a bent for 对……有天赋、爱好，等于 be fond of（喜爱）；be bent on 一心要（形近干扰），dislikes 与句意相反。译：葆拉对音乐很有天赋，作者的意思是她喜爱音乐。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He was by the wonderful piece of music.
questions.explanation: be carried away 被……陶醉、入迷；carry out 执行，carry on 继续，carry in 无此搭配。译：他被这首美妙的乐曲陶醉了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Dr. Thomas discussed the problem its application.
questions.explanation: in terms of 就……而言、从……角度，固定搭配（中间不加冠词）；to terms with 是 come to terms with（达成和解）的误置。译：托马斯博士就其应用方面讨论了这个问题。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Jean became ill with a cold when she was in Los Angeles.
questions.explanation: come down with 患上（病），come down with a cold 得感冒；come by 得到，come into 继承，come off with 无此搭配。译：琼在洛杉矶时得了感冒。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The many newly-built first class hotels have added greatly to the beauty of the city.
questions.explanation: add to 增加，等于 increase；impede 阻碍（与句意相反），immortalize 使不朽，impose 强加。译：许多新建的一流大酒店大大增添了这座城市的美丽。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Mr. Allen betrayed a top secret, and had to face the music.
options: play truant with his own will
beat a hasty retreat or fight-back
questions.explanation: face the music 承担后果、接受责难，英语习语，等于 accept the serious consequences；不能按字面理解为听音乐演出。译：艾伦先生泄露了一份绝密文件，不得不承担后果。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I could hardly make him out .
questions.explanation: make out 理解（人）、辨认出，等于 understand him；agree with 同意，fool 愚弄，help 帮助，均非 make out 之义。译：我几乎不能理解他。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We have to install new water pipes in our house, these are corroded.
questions.explanation: wear away 磨损、腐蚀，等于 corrode（水管被腐蚀）；其余 worn thin/up/hollow 均非惯用表达。译：我们得在家里安装新水管了，这些管子已经被腐蚀了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After lunch I resumed reading where I left off.
questions.explanation: leave off 停止，从上次停下的地方接着读＝stopped；marked 做记号，forgotten 忘记，deserted 抛弃。译：午饭后我从上次停下的地方接着读。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Though the affairs seem easy at the first blush __________.
options: they are not difficult at all
questions.explanation: at the first blush 乍一看，though 引出让步：乍一看容易，实际上难，故后面表转折 They are really difficult。译：虽然这些事务乍一看容易，实际上却很难。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I’m endeavoring to keep up with the current events in Southeast Asia.
questions.explanation: endeavor to do 努力做，等于 trying hard；planning/intending 表打算，expecting soon 表期待，均弱于努力义。译：我正努力跟上东南亚当前的时事动态。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The food and drinks give out around nine o’clock.
questions.explanation: give out 在此意为分发、供应，食物和饮料在九点左右被分发出去，等于 were served；其余选项与 give out 语义不符。译：食物和饮料在九点左右分发。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Judy happened to meet an old friend today.
questions.explanation: run across 偶然遇见，等于 happen to meet；run over 碾过、匆匆过一遍，talk to 与……交谈，ran around about 无此搭配。译：朱迪今天碰巧遇见了一位老朋友。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: With the state of affairs in Lancashire so dangerous I see no reason for the government’s satisfaction with itself.
questions.explanation: satisfaction with itself 此处指政府自我满足，等于 complacency（自满）；compliment 赞美，complement 补足物，complaint 抱怨。译：鉴于兰开夏郡局势如此危险，我认为政府没有理由自我满足。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Round up a few friends to help you.
questions.explanation: round up 聚拢、召集，等于 gather；catch 捕捉，request/require 请求、要求。译：召集几个朋友来帮你。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She declared forcefully that she was not guilty.
questions.explanation: assert 断言、坚决声明，等于 declared forcefully；assist 帮助，assume 假定，assure 保证。译：她坚定地声明自己是无罪的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The dentist bill was in the neighborhood of fifty dollars.
questions.explanation: in the neighborhood of 大约、左右，等于 approximately；anxiously 焦急地，substantially 大幅地，slightly 稍微。译：牙医的收费大约五十美元。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They tried to reduce the price to please the public.
questions.explanation: bring down 降低（价格），reduce the price＝bring down the price；bring through 使脱离险境，bring in 引进、赚得，bring off 成功完成。译：他们试图降价以取悦公众。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Jim was able to hold________ his anger and avoid to fight.
questions.explanation: hold back 抑制（情绪、怒气）；hold up 阻挡，hold on 坚持（不及物），hold over 延期。译：吉姆忍住了怒气，避免了打架。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We proved to be untrue to his claim that all wars were unjust.
questions.explanation: refute 驳倒、证明……不实，对应 proved to be untrue；retort（口头）反驳，rebuke 斥责，recede 后退。译：他声称所有战争都是非正义的，这一说法被证明是不实的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: During my long study of mathematics, I have come across insoluble problems only once in a blue moon.
questions.explanation: once in a blue moon 千载难逢、极少发生，习语，等于 very rarely；与月亮的字面义无关。译：在我长期学习数学的过程中，我极少遇到无解的难题。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________ Mr. Smith, Susan to blame for the mistake.
questions.explanation: according to sb 据某人说、按某人的说法；with reference to 关于，in accordance with 依照（法律、规则等），by 凭借。译：据史密斯先生的说法，这个错误该怪苏珊。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: whether Mr. Smith’s idea can be applied to our performance or not is held in the balance.
questions.explanation: be held in the balance（悬而未决）等于 undecided；unimportant 不重要，unauthorized 未经授权，uncovered 未被覆盖的。译：史密斯先生的想法能否用于我们的项目仍悬而未决。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Mrs. Longman is pleased that her son________ his lack of talent.
questions.explanation: 句意为母亲欣慰于儿子清楚（意识到）自己缺乏天赋；标准搭配应为 be sensible of（＝aware of），本题选项中并无此搭配，原答案 is sensible for 搭配并不规范（sensitive 后通常接 to），此题答案存疑，暂按原答案 B。译：朗曼夫人很欣慰，因为她的儿子清楚自己缺乏天赋。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The prices of clothes are now_________ on account of the oil shortage.
questions.explanation: on the rise 在上涨、在上升，固定搭配（rise 前用 on 不用 in，且不加 a）。译：由于石油短缺，服装价格现在正在上涨。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Lucia’s success is owing to her brother John in all senses.
questions.explanation: in all senses 在各种意义上，等于 in all respects；in a sense 在某种意义上（与 all 不符）。译：露西娅的成功在各方面都归功于她哥哥约翰。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He soon _______ his illness.
questions.explanation: get over 痊愈、康复（get over an illness 病愈）；get across 使被理解，get through 完成、接通，get around 回避、四处走动。译：他很快就从病中康复了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Jane devoted herself to ________ Paul.
questions.explanation: devote oneself to 中的 to 是介词而非不定式符号，后须接动名词，故用 bringing up；bring up 原形与 bringing down 均不符合该结构。译：珍妮全身心地抚养保罗长大。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You don’t ________ of getting the job.
questions.explanation: stand a chance（of doing）有机会、有希望，固定搭配，冠词用 a；其余选项搭配不地道。译：你没有得到这份工作的希望。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The cost of living in almost every country in the world has sky-rocketed in the past ten years.
questions.explanation: sky-rocket 飞涨，等于 rise rapidly；increase slowly 缓慢增长，level off 趋于平稳，grow steadily 稳步增长，均与急剧上涨不符。译：在过去十年里，世界上几乎所有国家的生活成本都急剧上涨。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: “Tom is tender in meeting her” means _______.
options: Tom is very kind to her when he meets her.
Tom is afraid of meeting her.
Tom is cruel to her when he meets her.
Tom isn’t afraid of meeting her.
questions.explanation: tender 此处取胆怯、发怵的义项，即汤姆见她时紧张害怕，等于 afraid of meeting her；其余选项或意思相反或程度不符。译：Tom is tender in meeting her 意为汤姆害怕见到她。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: This question_______ prompt settlement.
questions.explanation: call for 需要、要求（call for prompt settlement 需要立即解决）；call upon 号召、拜访，call in 召来，call up 打电话、使想起。译：这个问题需要立即解决。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When the reporters asked him if he had any comments, he was_______ what to do.
questions.explanation: at a loss 茫然不知所措，固定搭配（loss 前必须带冠词 a 且 loss 用原形）。译：当记者问他对此事有何评论时，他茫然不知所措。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If you think your child’s request is _____, give him a chance to earn the money to buy the item.
questions.explanation: worthwhile 值得的，可单独作表语；worth 后须接名词或 doing，worthy 须接 of doing 或 to be done，worthless 无价值的（与句意相反）。译：如果你认为孩子的要求是值得的，就给他一个机会去挣买那件东西的钱。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Watching me pulling the calf awkwardly to the barn, the Irish milkmaid fought hard to _____ her laughter.
questions.explanation: hold back 忍住、抑制（忍住笑）；hold on 坚持（不及物），hold out 伸出、维持，hold up 举起、延误。译：爱尔兰挤奶女工看着我笨拙地把小牛拽向谷仓，拼命忍住笑。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: How does it ______ that your answers are identical with his?
questions.explanation: come about 发生（How does it come about that...……是怎么回事/怎么会发生）；come out 出版、结果是，come off 举行、成功，come up 被提出。译：你的答案怎么会和他的完全一样呢？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There are a few small things that I don’t like about my job, but______ it’s very enjoyable.
questions.explanation: by and large 总的来说、大体上；above all 首要的是，as usual 像往常一样，by all means 当然可以。译：我的工作有些小的不如意，但总的来说非常令人愉快。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I ______ you that the goods will be delivered next week.
questions.explanation: assure sb that 向某人保证（assure 可接人称宾语再加 that 从句）；confirm/ensure 后直接接 that 从句但不能接 sb that，insist 表坚持（insist sb that 不成立）。译：我向你保证货物下周送到。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Our journey was slow because the train stopped_______ at different villages.
questions.explanation: continually 反复地、断断续续地（动作多次重复）；continuously 连续不断地、无间断；火车不断在村庄停靠是反复发生而非连续不停。译：我们的旅程很慢，因为火车不断在不同村庄停靠。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He prefers _______ as a businessman so as to avoid being recognized.
questions.explanation: prefer 后接不定式 to do；dress up sb 打扮某人，此处他被人打扮成商人以免被认出，须用不定式被动 to be dressed up as。译：他宁愿把自己打扮成商人，以免被认出来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: _______, a policeman came to the scene.
questions.explanation: shortly afterwards 不久之后，固定表达；not long 须接 after，sooner 用于比较结构，lately 多用于完成时且表最近。译：不久，一名警察来到了现场。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I love my country so much that I am prepared to _______ her.
questions.explanation: devote...to... 奉献……给……（to 为介词，后接宾语），devote my life to her 把一生献给她；devote to 缺宾语，devoting 与 to devote 均不能接在 am prepared to 后。译：我深爱我的国家，愿把一生献给她。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: City born and city bred, he always thinks city life is _______ country life.
questions.explanation: be superior to 比……优越（superior/inferior 后接 to 而不接 than）；他是城市出生长大的，自然认为城市生活优于乡村生活，故用 superior 而非 inferior。译：他是城市出生、城市长大的，总觉得城市生活比乡村生活优越。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The precious manuscripts were hopelessly ______ by long exposure in the cold, damp cellar.
questions.explanation: ruin 毁坏（强调结果无法挽救，hopelessly ruined 是惯用搭配）；damage 指部分损坏尚可修复，destroy 强调摧毁的动作本身，harm 多指伤害人。译：这些珍贵的手稿因长期放在阴冷潮湿的地窖里而彻底毁了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The board of the company has decided to ________ its operation to include all aspects of the clothing business.
questions.explanation: expand 扩张、扩大（经营范围、业务）；extend 延伸（长度、时间），enlarge 放大（尺寸），amplify 放大（声音、信号）。译：公司董事会决定扩大经营范围，把服装业务的各个方面都包括进来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: That sound doesn’t ______ in his language, so it’s difficult for him to pronounce it.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误：enlarge（扩大）与句意完全不符。句意为那个音在他的语言中不出现，标准用词应为 occur（出现、存在于）；给定选项均不理想，其中 happen 与 occur 同义相对最接近，故改为 A。译：那个音在他的语言中不存在，所以他很难发出来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The accommodation was cheap, but the food was bevy_____.
questions.explanation: costly 昂贵的，作表语形容食物贵；high 只与 price 搭配（价格高），overpaid 指多付了钱，dear 表贵多见于英式口语。译：住宿很便宜，但食物相当贵。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My boss insists on seeing everything in ______before he makes a decision.
questions.explanation: in black and white 白纸黑字、书面形式，习语；老板凡事要看到书面材料才做决定。译：我的老板凡事都要看到书面材料才做决定。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The work is not very profitable_____ cash, but I am getting valuable experience from it.
questions.explanation: in terms of 就……而言（in terms of cash 就现金收入而言）；in the light of 鉴于，according to 根据，on the basis of 在……基础上，均不表从某方面衡量。译：这份工作就现金收入而言并不太划算，但我从中获得了宝贵的经验。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: At the meeting, Smith argued _____ in favor of the proposal.
questions.explanation: argue forcefully 有力地主张、据理力争；severely 严厉地，warmly 热情地，heavily 沉重地，均不修饰据理力争的气势。译：会上，史密斯有力地支持了这项提议。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His attention often______ at lectures. No wonder he failed the exam.
questions.explanation: wander 走神、（注意力）游离（attention wanders）；wonder 想知道（形近干扰词），branch 分支，go out 熄灭。译：听课时他的注意力常常走神，难怪他考试不及格。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It’s often a mistake to ______ appearance: that poor-looking individual is anything but poor. In fact, he is a millionaire.
questions.explanation: go by 依据……判断（go by appearance 凭外表判断）；go over 复习、检查，go against 违背，go for 去请、主张。译：以貌取人常常是个错误：那个看起来穷困的人根本不穷，实际上是个百万富翁。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He doesn’t seem to be able to _____ any interest in his studies.
questions.explanation: work up 激起、培养出（work up interest 培养起兴趣）；make up 编造、弥补，turn up 出现，use up 用完。译：他似乎无法对自己的学业产生任何兴趣。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In the past, most foresters have been men, but today, the number of women______ this field is climbing.
questions.explanation: pursue this field 从事该领域（pursue 为及物动词直接接宾语）；devote 须接 oneself to，engage 须接 in，register 须接 for，均缺介词。译：过去林业工作者多为男性，如今从事这一领域的女性人数正在上升。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The banknotes which had fooled many bank tellers were discovered to be ____.
questions.explanation: counterfeit 伪造的（counterfeit banknotes 伪钞）；artificial 人造的，genuine 真的（与句意相反），faulty 有缺陷的。译：那些骗过许多银行出纳员的钞票被发现是伪造的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: All transactions are strictly ______ , and we never sell, rent or trade any customer’s name.
questions.explanation: confidential 机密的、保密的（transactions are strictly confidential 交易严格保密）；confident 自信的，considerable 相当大的，considerate 体贴的，均为形近干扰。译：所有交易严格保密，我们从不出售、出租或交易任何客户的姓名。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Big businesses enjoy certain_____ that smaller ones do not have.
questions.explanation: privileges 特权、优惠（大企业享有的优势）；transactions 交易，subsidies 补贴（多来自政府），substitutes 替代品。译：大企业享有一些小企业所没有的特权。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Your kindness in giving______ to the consideration of the above problem will be highly appreciated.
questions.explanation: give priority to 优先考虑，固定搭配；attach importance to 表重视（动词搭配不同），take advantage of 利用，authority 权威。译：您若优先考虑上述问题，我们将不胜感激。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The border incident led to the two countries ______ their diplomatic relations.
questions.explanation: break off 中断（break off diplomatic relations 断交）；break out 爆发，break in 闯入，break through 突破。译：边境事件导致两国中断了外交关系。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: John planned to take part in the competition but had to _____ on account of the car accident.
questions.explanation: drop out 退出、中途退出（比赛因故弃权）；hold out 坚持，get out 出去，run out 用完。译：约翰本打算参加比赛，但因车祸不得不退出。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He doesn’t work but he gets a good ____ from his investment.
questions.explanation: income 收入（get an income from his investment 从投资中获得收入）；subsidy 补贴，earnings 挣得的钱（多与劳动挂钩），salary 工资（工作报酬）。译：他不工作，但从投资中获得可观的收入。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Dinner will be ready_____, but we still have time for a drink.
questions.explanation: presently 不久、很快（Dinner will be ready presently 晚饭马上就好）；currently 目前，lately 最近（用于完成时），finally 最终。译：晚饭马上就好，但我们还有时间先喝一杯。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They worked together and so _____ the task in a month.
questions.explanation: carry through 意为“（克服困难）把……进行到底、完成”，与 worked together 和 in a month 的语境相符；carry out 侧重“执行（计划、命令）”，carry on“继续”，carry off“成功应付/赢得”。句意：他们通力合作，终于在一个月内完成了任务。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The FBI arrived in time to prevent the ____ of the secret documents.
questions.explanation: transmission 意为“传送、传递”，prevent the transmission of the documents 指阻止文件被传送；transformation“转变”，transportation“运输”，translation“翻译”。句意：联邦调查局及时赶到，阻止了机密文件的传送。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Banking and financial systems filled with _____ and corruption hinder the region’s success.
questions.explanation: mismanagement 意为“管理不善”，与 corruption（腐败）构成并列贬义，语义顺承；management 为中性词“管理”，mismanaging 是动名词，此处需要名词。句意：充满管理不善与腐败的银行金融体系阻碍了该地区的成功。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The bill is _____ at any time up to next Friday.
questions.explanation: payable 意为“应付的、可支付的”，be payable 指账单到期可付；commercial“商业的”，luxurious“奢侈的”，enormous“巨大的”。句意：这张账单在下周五之前的任何时间都可支付。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Those gifts of rare books that were giber to us were deeply ____.
questions.explanation: appreciated 意为“感激的”，were deeply appreciated 指所赠之书“使人深为感激”；approved“认可”，appealed“呼吁”（须接 to），applied“应用”。句意：对赠予我们的那些珍贵图书，我们深表感谢。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: People seldom trust him since he usually fails to ____ his promises.
questions.explanation: keep to 意为“遵守、信守（诺言、规则）”，keep to his promises 即“信守诺言”；keep on“继续”，keep off“避开”，keep up“保持”。句意：人们很少信任他，因为他常常不守诺言。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Some economists say that South Korea, while still deep in ____, feels confident in its economy to increase its reserves.
questions.explanation: recession 意为“（经济）衰退”，deep in recession 深陷衰退，与后文“有信心增加储备”形成让步对比；recovery“复苏”，reduction“减少”，reception“接待”。句意：一些经济学家说，韩国虽仍深陷衰退，却对经济有信心并会增加储备。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: However much he _____ his expenses , he cannot make both ends meet.
questions.explanation: cut down 意为“削减（开支、花费）”，cut down his expenses 削减开支；cut in“插嘴”，cut out“裁剪/戒除”，cut off“切断”。句意：无论他怎样削减开支，都无法做到收支平衡。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The police stopped him because he ______ the traffic regulation.
questions.explanation: break the traffic regulation 是固定搭配，“违反规则”用 break；damaged“损坏”，destroyed“摧毁”，corrupted“腐蚀、败坏”，均不与 regulation 搭配。句意：警察拦下了他，因为他违反了交通规则。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Imports for the first half of this year are large by 21 percent for the____ period last year.
questions.explanation: corresponding period 是固定表达，意为“（去年）同期”，corresponding“相应的”；respective“各自的”，concerning“关于”，responding 无此形容词用法。句意：今年上半年的进口额比去年同期增长百分之二十一。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If I am not _____ when you come to my office, ask for my secretary.
questions.explanation: available 意为“有空的、可找到的”，If I am not available 指人不在或没空；suitable“合适的”，comfortable“舒适的”，proper“恰当的”。句意：你来我办公室时如果我不在，就找我的秘书。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I need to move to a large apartment. Do you know any ______ ones in this area?
questions.explanation: vacant 意为“未被占用的、空置的”，指房子可入住可租；bare“光秃的”，empty 侧重“内部无物”，void“无效的”。句意：我想搬到大一点的公寓，你知道这一带有哪些空着的房子吗？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They noted that special manner of walking which was________ to her alone.
questions.explanation: peculiar to... 是固定搭配，意为“为……所特有”，peculiar to her alone 即“她独有的”；private“私人的”，precise“精确的”，precious“珍贵的”。句意：他们注意到了那种只有她才有的特殊走路姿势。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He had been working for over 30 years and when he retired he found it hard for him to live on the state_________.
questions.explanation: pension 意为“养老金”，live on the state pension 靠国家养老金生活，与 retired 呼应；award“奖品”，reward“报酬、奖赏”，revenue“（财政）收入”。句意：他工作了三十多年，退休后发觉靠国家养老金过日子很艰难。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The ceasefire will only provide a______ solution to the current military crisis in this area.
questions.explanation: temporary 意为“临时的”，temporary solution 临时解决方案，与 only 呼应——停火只是权宜之计；permanent“永久的”，contemporary“当代的”，sympathetic“同情的”。句意：停火只能为该地区当前的军事危机提供一个临时解决方案。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is difficult to ______ these points of view; they are too different from each other.
questions.explanation: reconcile 意为“调和、使一致”，reconcile these points of view 调和这些观点，后半句“差别太大”解释难以调和；unite“联合”，adjust“调整”，compromise“妥协”。句意：很难调和这些观点，它们彼此差异太大。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There is real concern that food supplies will not be _____ to feed the increasing world population.
questions.explanation: sufficient 意为“足够的”，be sufficient to do sth 足以做某事；satisfactory“令人满意的”，aggregate“总计的”，efficient“高效的”。句意：人们确实担心粮食供应将不足以养活日益增长的世界人口。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Let’s go out during the break to ______ our legs.
questions.explanation: stretch one's legs 是固定说法，意为“伸伸腿、活动一下腿脚”；expand“膨胀、扩张”，extend“延长、延伸”，move around“四处走动”与 legs 搭配不当。句意：休息时我们出去伸伸腿、活动活动吧。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The word ______ refers to a sum of money which a person agrees to pay to an insurance company.
questions.explanation: premium 意为“保险费”，即投保人同意付给保险公司的钱，与 insurance company 直接对应；compensation“补偿金”，investment“投资”，commission“佣金”。句意：“premium”一词指个人同意付给保险公司的一笔钱。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Jim’s plan ______ because he couldn’t find a good assistant.
questions.explanation: fall through 意为“（计划等）失败、落空”，与找不到好助手构成因果；fell behind“落后”，fell out“吵架”，fell back“后退”。句意：吉姆的计划落空了，因为他找不到一个好助手。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The automation has made it possible to ______ great changes in industry.
questions.explanation: bring about 意为“引起、带来（变化）”，bring about great changes 带来巨大变化；bring down“降低”，bring out“出版/使显现”，bring up“抚养/提出”。句意：自动化使工业发生巨大变化成为可能。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The safety of air travel hangs partly _____ the thoroughness of baggage checking.
questions.explanation: hang on 是固定短语，意为“取决于”，相当于 depend on，安全“取决于”行李检查是否彻底；in/over/about 均无此搭配义。句意：航空旅行的安全部分取决于行李检查是否彻底。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Very few experts_____ with completely new answers to the world’s economic problems.
questions.explanation: come up with 意为“提出、想出（答案、办法）”，与空后 answers 搭配；come to“到达/总计”，come round“苏醒”，come on“快点/上演”。句意：很少有专家能对世界经济问题提出全新的答案。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Though it was only a ______ fever, the doctor gave him an injection.
questions.explanation: mild fever 是固定搭配，mild 意为“（病情、气候）轻微的、和缓的”；small/weak/faint 表“弱、微弱”，不与 fever 搭配。句意：虽然只是轻微发烧，医生还是给他打了针。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They always _____ a large supply of tinned food in winter in case they are snowed up.
questions.explanation: lay in 意为“储备、贮存”，lay in a large supply of tinned food 储备大量罐头食品，与 in case they are snowed up 呼应；lay off“解雇”，lay down“制定/放下”，lay out“布置”。句意：冬天他们总要储备大量罐头食品，以防大雪封门。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He was so angry that he just couldn’t _____ from telling them what he thought.
questions.explanation: hold back from doing 意为“抑制、忍住不做”；hold off“推迟”，hold on“坚持/别挂断”，hold up“阻挡、延误”。句意：他气得根本忍不住，非把自己的想法告诉他们不可。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Suddenly there was a _____ of lightning followed by a clap of thunder.
questions.explanation: a flash of lightning 是固定搭配“一道闪电”，与 a clap of thunder“一声雷响”对应；ray“光线”，stream“溪流”，flame“火焰”。句意：突然一道闪电划过，紧接着传来一声雷响。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Parental love should include _____ , and so the teen-ager who is truly loved will receive guidance.
questions.explanation: discipline 意为“管教、纪律”，父母之爱应包含管教，与 receive guidance 呼应；acceptance“接受”，allowance“零用钱、津贴”，principal“校长/本金”。句意：父母之爱应包括管教，因此真正被爱的青少年会得到引导。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: As a teacher you have to _____ your methods to suit the needs of slower children.
questions.explanation: adjust 意为“调整、调节”，adjust your methods to suit the needs 调整方法以适应需要，to suit 是关键词；adopt“采纳”，adapt 侧重“改编/使适应”，acquire“获得”。句意：作为教师，你必须调整教学方法来适应接受较慢的孩子。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The public opinion was that the time was not _____ for the election of such a radical candidate as Mr. Jones.
questions.explanation: the time is ripe 是固定表达，ripe 意为“（时机）成熟的”，the time was not ripe for...“……的时机尚不成熟”；reasonable“合理的”，practical“实际的”，ready“准备好的”（多指人）。句意：舆论认为，选举琼斯先生这样激进候选人的时机还不成熟。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: One reason for the successes of Asian immigrants in the U. S. is that they have taken great _____ to educate their children.
questions.explanation: take pains to do sth 是固定搭配，意为“煞费苦心做某事”；efforts/attempts/endeavors 均须与 make 搭配（make efforts/an attempt）。句意：亚裔移民在美国成功的原因之一，是他们在子女教育上煞费苦心。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Kindness is the most important _____ a man can have.
questions.explanation: quality 意为“品质、素质”，kindness（善良）是人的一种品质；habit“习惯”，accident“事故”，effect“影响”。句意：善良是一个人所能拥有的最重要的品质。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Colored people are by no means ______ white people.
questions.explanation: inferior 本身已含比较意义，属“拉丁比较级形容词”，不能加 more 构成比较级，也不与 than/over 连用，必须接 to：be inferior to“劣于、低于”；同类词还有 superior/senior/junior/prior。by no means 绝不。句意：有色人种绝不比白人低劣。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There are _____ the three-year-old child can count.
questions.explanation: far 可放在比较级前加强程度：far more toys than...“玩具比……多得多”，than 后接比较从句；A、D 选项缺被修饰名词，B 语序错误。句意：玩具多得连这个三岁孩子也数不过来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ______ to what I thought, he has proved to be successful.
questions.explanation: Contrary to what I thought 是固定表达，意为“与我预想的相反”，contrary“相反的”；content“满足的”，complex“复杂的”，contract“合同”，均不能构成此搭配。原答案有误，应为 D。句意：与我预想的相反，事实证明他是成功的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The crisis in our industry was _____ by intense competition from foreign producers.
questions.explanation: bring on 意为“引起、导致（危机、疾病等不良后果）”，was brought on by intense competition 由激烈竞争引起；bring forward“提出/提前”，bring up“抚养/提出”，bring round“使苏醒”。句意：我们行业的危机是外国生产商的激烈竞争引起的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I am feeling too tired to drive any more, will you _____ ?
questions.explanation: take over 意为“接替、接管”，指接过对方手中的活儿（此处指开车）；turn over“翻转/移交”，hand over“交出”，go over“复习/检查”。句意：我累得开不动车了，你来接替好吗？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It would be ______ to get a second opinion before taking any further action.
questions.explanation: sensible 意为“明智的”，It would be sensible to do sth“做某事是明智的”；sensational“轰动的”，sensitive“敏感的”，senseless“无意义的”。句意：在采取进一步行动之前，先征求另一方的意见是明智的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She decided to _____ in the history course at the local evening school.
questions.explanation: enroll in a course 是固定搭配，意为“报名参加（课程）”；enter 后直接接学校、场所，attend 后直接接课程不加 in，register 常与 for 连用。句意：她决定在当地夜校报名上历史课。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The fall in the number of deaths from heart disease is generally _____improvements in diet.
questions.explanation: be attributed to 是固定搭配，意为“被归因于”，the fall...is attributed to improvements in diet 下降被归因于饮食改善；adjust to“调整以适应”，adapt to“适应”，accustom to“习惯于”。句意：心脏病死亡人数的下降被普遍归因于饮食的改善。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: People are criticizing the economic policies that have _____ the decline of manufacturing industry.
questions.explanation: accelerated 意为“加速”，have accelerated the decline 加速了制造业的衰落，与批评语境一致；assessed“评估”，accepted“接受”，accessed“存取、进入”。句意：人们正在批评那些加速了制造业衰落的经济政策。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Dr. Johnson was granted an honored title in ______ of his valuable work for the college.
questions.explanation: in acknowledgement of 是固定搭配，意为“为答谢、感谢（某人的工作）”，acknowledgement“感谢、承认”；advancement“进步”，acquisition“获得”，announcement“宣布”。句意：约翰逊博士因其为学院做出的宝贵工作而被授予荣誉称号。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They have ______ most carefully the time and the materials needed to complete the project.
questions.explanation: figure out 意为“计算出、弄清楚”，figure out the time and materials 算出所需时间和材料；picked out“挑出”，left out“遗漏”，taken out“取出”。句意：他们已非常仔细地算出了完成该项目所需的时间和材料。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His remarks finally _____ me that I had made the right decision.
questions.explanation: reassure sb that 意为“使（心存疑虑的人）放心、确信”，与 finally 呼应；ensure 后接 that 从句或名词，不接 sb that；insured“投保”；assured 侧重“保证”，此处强调消除疑虑。句意：他的话终于让我确信自己做对了决定。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Despite his _____ planning, the exposition turned out to be a failure.
questions.explanation: elaborate 意为“详尽周密的”，despite his elaborate planning 尽管计划周密，与 turned out to be a failure 构成让步；exquisite“精美的”，exhausted“精疲力竭的”，insufficient“不足的”。句意：尽管他的计划十分周密，博览会还是失败了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He made a ______ gesture, which offended the young lady greatly.
questions.explanation: vulgar 意为“粗俗的、下流的”，vulgar gesture 粗俗的手势，offended 提示贬义；vague“模糊的”，vogue 是名词“时尚”，vigorous“精力充沛的”。句意：他做了一个粗俗的手势，极大地冒犯了那位年轻女士。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He was ______ of stealing and send to prison for third time.
questions.explanation: be convicted of 是固定搭配，意为“被判……罪”，与 sent to prison 衔接——定罪后才入狱；be accused of 仅指“被指控”，charged 后接 with，sentenced 后接 to。句意：他被判犯有盗窃罪，第三次被送进了监狱。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: An inquiring mind can catch ______ to a new idea quickly.
questions.explanation: catch on (to) 意为“理解、领会”，catch on to a new idea 很快领会新想法；catch up (with)“赶上”，catch at“试图抓住”，catch out“识破”。句意：好探究的头脑能很快领会新想法。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Many of the former associates _______ him when it became known how he had abused his position of trust.
questions.explanation: turn against 意为“转而反对”，turned against him 即因其滥用职位信任而反目；helped up 非固定搭配，convinced of 缺完整结构，went on“继续”。句意：他滥用职位信任的事被揭穿后，许多昔日的同事都转而反对他。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Plenty of facts _______ him to our view.
questions.explanation: convert sb to 意为“使某人转变（信仰、观点）”，converted him to our view 使他转而接受我们的观点；consented“同意”（主语应为人），conversed“交谈”，conformed“符合”（conform to）。句意：大量事实使他转而接受了我们的观点。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A hidden alarm under the cashier’s can be ______ in case of emergency.
questions.explanation: activated 意为“启动、触发”，the alarm can be activated 警报可被触发，与 in case of emergency 对应；negotiated“谈判”，initiated“发起（开始某事）”，launched“发起（活动、产品）”。句意：收银台下装有暗藏的警报器，紧急情况下可以触发。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If you can not attend the meeting, please find someone to ______ for you.
questions.explanation: substitute for sb 是固定搭配，意为“代替某人”；replace 是及物动词直接接宾语（replace you），displace“取代（地位）”，misplace“放错地方”。句意：如果你不能参加会议，请找个人代替你。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The exposure to foreign cultures gradually led to the ______ .
questions.explanation: disintegration 意为“瓦解、解体”，led to the disintegration 导致解体，与“接触外来文化”的影响对应；distribution“分配”，disorder“混乱”，destruction“破坏”。句意：接触外国文化逐渐导致了它的解体。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Ironically, racial discrimination, which is _______ with democratic principles, has existed in America, “ his greatest democracy in the world ”.
questions.explanation: incompatible with 是固定搭配，意为“与……不相容”，种族歧视与民主原则不相容，ironically 提示矛盾关系；unanimous“一致的”，disagreeable“不合意的”，contrary 须接 to。句意：讽刺的是，与民主原则格格不入的种族歧视一直存在于这个“世界上最伟大的民主国家”。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The professor needs an assistant that he can _____ to take care of problems in his absence.
questions.explanation: count on 意为“依靠、指望”，an assistant that he can count on 可以指望的助手，与 in his absence 对应；count in“把……算入”，count up“合计”，count out“不把……算入”。句意：教授需要一名他不在时能靠其处理问题的助手。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I am not sure whether I can get any profit from the business, so I can’t make a(n) _____ decision about what to do next.
questions.explanation: definite 意为“明确的、确定的”，make a definite decision 作出明确的决定，与 not sure 呼应；exact“精确的”，denied“被否认的”，sure 用于人作主语。句意：我不确定这项生意能否盈利，所以无法对下一步做什么作出明确决定。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Convenience foods which are already prepared for cooking are ________ in stores.
questions.explanation: available 意为“可获得的、可买到的”，be available in stores 商店里有售；ready“准备好的”，probable“很可能的”，approachable“（人）可接近的”。句意：已经备好待烹饪的方便食品在商店里都能买到。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The photos on the wall _______ grandma of those happy old days when a large family lived together.
questions.explanation: remind sb of sth 是固定搭配，意为“使某人想起……”；recall 和 remember 主语通常为人且直接接宾语，retain“保留”。句意：墙上的照片让奶奶想起一大家人生活在一起的幸福往昔。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We all hope he’ll soon _______ his disappointment and be happy again.
questions.explanation: get through 意为“度过、熬过（困难、情绪）”，get through his disappointment 走出失望；get away“逃离”，get up“起床”，get down“下来/使沮丧”。句意：我们都希望他很快走出失望，重新快乐起来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The problem of environment protection has been studied ________ .
questions.explanation: intensively 意为“深入地、集中地”，studied intensively 深入地研究；extremely“极其”，originally“最初”，violently“猛烈地”。句意：环境保护问题已得到深入研究。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: “ Did you buy anything at the clothing store? ” “ Yes, I bought three _______ shirts for just $ 120. ”
questions.explanation: 数词与名词构成复合形容词时须加连字符且名词用单数：fifty-dollar shirts 即“五十美元一件的衬衫”，dollar 不能加 s；fifties-dollar、fifty-dollars、fifties-dolls 均违反该规则。句意：“你在服装店买东西了吗？”“买了，120 美元就买了三件 50 美元价位的衬衫。”

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His written English was first-class, and he had a(n) ______ vocabulary for a sophomore.
questions.explanation: incredible 意为“惊人的、难以置信的”，an incredible vocabulary 惊人的词汇量，与 first-class 并列递进；intimate“亲密的”，initial“最初的”，inevitable“不可避免的”。句意：他的书面英语是一流的，而且对一个大学二年级学生来说，他的词汇量大得惊人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After the company ______ the problem of unfair competition, its sales figures dropped to a record low.
questions.explanation: ran into 意为“遭遇、陷入（问题、困难）”，ran into the problem 遭遇不正当竞争问题，与销量骤降构成因果；look into“调查”，come into“继承/进入”，put into“投入”。句意：这家公司遭遇不正当竞争问题后，销售额跌到了历史最低点。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Last year, the production rate ________ by 20 %.
questions.explanation: rise 是不及物动词，意为“上升”，the production rate rose by 20% 生产率上升了 20%，by 表增加幅度；raise 是及物动词须接宾语，arose“出现（问题等）”，aroused“唤起”。句意：去年，生产率提高了百分之二十。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Each person in the world has a(n) _______ personality. They are different from one another.
questions.explanation: unique 意为“独特的、独一无二的”，与后文 They are different from one another 呼应；only 须与 the 连用（the only），sole 强调“唯一”，one 是数词。句意：世界上每个人都有独特的个性，彼此互不相同。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I am sorry to ________ your feelings.
questions.explanation: hurt one's feelings 是固定搭配，意为“伤害某人的感情”；spoil 侧重“破坏（计划、兴致）”，destroy“摧毁”，damage“损坏（物品）”，均不与 feelings 搭配。句意：很抱歉伤害了你的感情。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He is so wise a man that all the people __________ .
questions.explanation: look up to 意为“尊敬、敬仰”，so...that 结果状语从句中 all the people look up to him 所有人都敬重他；look him up“拜访/查阅”，look into“调查”，look to“指望”。句意：他是一个如此睿智的人，以至于所有人都敬重他。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Though Mum is very busy, she always _______ some time every day to read to her children.
questions.explanation: set aside 意为“留出（时间、金钱）”，sets aside some time every day 每天留出一些时间；sets off“出发/引发”，sets in“开始（并可能持续）”，sets up“建立”。句意：妈妈虽然很忙，却每天都留出一些时间读书给孩子们听。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He participated in the reconstruction of the city _______ the war was over.
questions.explanation: soon after 意为“……之后不久”，soon after the war was over 战争结束后不久；before long 是副词短语，后面不接从句；long after“很久之后”，soon before“不久之前”。句意：战争结束后不久，他就参加了这座城市的重建工作。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A teacher who is _______ to the needs of individual student is sure to achieve some success.
questions.explanation: be sensitive to 意为“对……敏感、能体察”，be sensitive to the needs of individual students 敏锐体察每个学生的需求；serious“严肃的”，secure“安全的”，senior“年长的”（senior to）。句意：能敏锐体察学生个体需求的教师一定会取得成功。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Staying in a hotel costs ______ renting a room in an apartment for a week.
questions.explanation: 倍数须放在比较结构的最前面：twice as much as... 意为“是……的两倍”，结构为“倍数 + as much as”；twice more than 不符合规范结构，as much as twice 与 much as twice as 语序错误。句意：住旅馆一周的花费是在公寓租一个房间的两倍。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The next afternoon he went to _________ Mr. Smith again.
questions.explanation: call on 意为“拜访（某人）”，went to call on Mr. Smith 去拜访史密斯先生，again 提示此前拜访过；call forth“唤起”，call off“取消”，call by 非标准搭配（可说 call in/at）。句意：第二天下午他又去拜访了史密斯先生。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You should not _______ too much fun from him.
questions.explanation: expect sth from sb 是固定搭配，意为“期望从某人那里得到某物”；expose“暴露”（expose...to），express“表达”，experience“经历”。句意：你不应该指望从他那里得到太多乐趣。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: At least twenty firemen were killed ______ of the collapse of the building during the fire accident.
questions.explanation: as a result of 是固定搭配，意为“由于、因为”，后接名词 the collapse；as a rule“通常”，as for“至于”，as far 须与 as 连用才完整。句意：在这起火灾事故中，至少二十名消防员因大楼倒塌而丧生。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Make sure to ______ the children ________ swimming in the dirty river.
questions.explanation: keep sb from doing sth 是固定搭配，意为“阻止某人做某事”，keep the children from swimming 不让孩子们游泳；protect...from 后接伤害性名词而非动名词，avoid 是及物动词不接 from，ask 不与 from 搭配。句意：务必不让孩子们到那条脏河里游泳。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In the advanced reading course students must take tests at monthly _______ .
questions.explanation: at monthly intervals 是固定搭配，意为“每隔一个月”，interval 指“间隔”；at length“详细地/最终”，distance“距离”，periods 不用于此搭配。句意：在高级阅读课上，学生必须每月接受一次测试。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The scientist was so absorbed in his work that he was not _______ of the fire that was spreading to his room.
questions.explanation: be aware of 是固定搭配，意为“意识到”，not aware of the fire 没有察觉火情，与 so absorbed in his work 对应；adequate“足够的”，alive“活着的”，awake“醒着的”。句意：这位科学家工作太专注了，没有意识到大火正向他的房间蔓延。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The manager _______ all the engagements on the ground that he needed more rest.
questions.explanation: canceled 意为“取消”，cancel all the engagements 取消所有约会安排，与 needed more rest 因果一致；announced“宣布”，eliminated“淘汰、消除”，kept“保持”。句意：经理以需要更多休息为由取消了所有的约会安排。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The vitamins necessary for a healthy body are normally supplied by a _______ of fruit and green vegetables.
questions.explanation: a variety of 是固定搭配，意为“各种各样的”，a variety of fruit and green vegetables 各种各样的水果和绿色蔬菜；fraction“小部分”，section“部分”，series“系列”。句意：健康身体所需的维生素通常由各种各样的水果和绿色蔬菜提供。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Jack spent the whole day repairing the car. The work was ________ easy.
questions.explanation: anything but 意为“根本不、绝不是”，the work was anything but easy 这活儿一点也不容易，与花了一整天呼应；nothing but 意为“只是、仅仅”，语义相反。句意：杰克花了一整天修那辆车——这活儿一点也不轻松。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Mrs. Jones seems to think that the delay of the conference is to suit the director’s ______.
questions.explanation: convenience 意为“方便、便利”，to suit the director's convenience 迁就主任的方便，与会议推迟呼应；confidence“信心”，curiosity“好奇”，challenge“挑战”。句意：琼斯太太似乎认为会议的推迟是为了迁就主任的方便。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
