questions.stem: Nobel Prizes are annual made to persons who have contributed to the good of mankind.
questions.explanation: awards 意为“奖项”，与 Nobel Prizes（诺贝尔奖）构成同义复指——诺贝尔奖是授予为人类福祉做贡献者的奖项；salaries“薪水”，wages“（体力劳动的）工资”，rewards“报酬、赏金”。句意：诺贝尔奖每年颁发给那些为人类福祉做出贡献的人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The professor found no student in the lecture hall when he arrived. Only then did he realize that he came early.
questions.explanation: much too 后接形容词或副词原级加强程度，much too early“太早”；too much 的中心词是 much，后接不可数名词，不直接修饰副词；so much/much so 不符合此结构。句意：教授到达时报告厅里没有学生，直到那时他才意识到自己来得太早了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Peter said he was in no for going to the movie with me because he had to make preparations for his GRE.
questions.explanation: in no mood for/to do sth 是固定搭配，意为“没有心情做某事”；motive“动机”，mind“头脑”（make up one's mind 下决心），liking“喜好”。句意：彼得说他没有心情和我一起去看电影，因为他得准备 GRE 考试。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The minister gave a report the effect on the economy after China became a member of WTO.
questions.explanation: regarding 是介词，意为“关于”，a report regarding the effect 一份关于……影响的报告；relating 须说 relating to，involving“涉及”，as for“至于”（多置于句首）。句意：部长作了一份关于中国加入世贸组织后对经济影响的报告。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When she found her daughter was running a high fever, she took her to hospital.
questions.explanation: promptly 意为“立即、迅速地”，发现孩子发高烧后马上送医院，符合紧急语境；consequently“因此”，consistently“一贯地”，provokingly“气人地”。句意：当她发现女儿发着高烧时，立刻把孩子送进了医院。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Most Americans would like to do shopping in the weekends since they expect to pick up wonderful in the supermarkets or shopping malls.
questions.explanation: bargains 意为“便宜货、特价商品”，pick up bargains 淘到便宜货，是周末购物的主要期待；batteries“电池”，baskets“篮子”，barriers“障碍”。句意：大多数美国人喜欢周末购物，因为他们期望在超市或购物中心淘到物美价廉的商品。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She did not throw away the stockings until they were so that they couldn’t be mended anymore.
questions.explanation: worn out 意为“穿破的、用坏的”，so worn out that 破得不能再补，此处表状态用过去分词；wearing off 指药效、感觉“逐渐消退”，wearing out 表正在磨损的动作。句意：直到长袜破得没法再补了，她才把它们扔掉。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The young engineer was quite excited when he the experts in this complicated project.
questions.explanation: assisted 意为“协助、帮助”，assisted the experts 协助专家，与 excited 的正面语境相符；insisted“坚持”（接 on），resisted“抵抗”，persisted“坚持”（接 in）。句意：这位年轻工程师在协助专家进行这个复杂项目时非常兴奋。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The book is as it was the only one ever signed by the President last month in the White House.
questions.explanation: unique 意为“独一无二的”，因为它是唯一一本总统签过名的书；common“普通的”，rare“稀有的”（侧重少见而非唯一），singular“单数的/非凡的”。句意：这本书是独一无二的，因为它是上个月总统在白宫签名的唯一一本书。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The day she got married is a day she will always though her children have grown up and also got married.
questions.explanation: look back to/on 意为“回顾、追忆”，a day she will always look back to 她会永远追忆的一天；look up to“尊敬”，look forward to“盼望（将来）”，look down upon“看不起”。句意：她结婚的那一天是她将永远追忆的日子，尽管孩子们都已长大成家。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The launching of China’s first manned-spaceship was televised by CCTV.
questions.explanation: live 作副词意为“现场直播地”，televised live 电视直播；alive 是形容词“活着的”，life 是名词“生活”，lively 是形容词“活泼的”。句意：中国首次载人航天飞船的发射通过中央电视台进行了现场直播。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It would do no _______ to call him.
questions.explanation: do no good 是固定搭配，意为“没有好处、无济于事”，It would do no good to call him 给他打电话也没用；well 在此义中不与 do 搭配（do well 干得好）。句意：给他打电话也无济于事。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I enjoy the peaceful and ______ environment of the country.
questions.explanation: quiet 意为“安静的”，形容词修饰 environment，与 peaceful（宁静的）语义并列协调；silence 和 leisure 是名词，comfortable 侧重“舒适”，与“宁静”语境不搭。句意：我喜欢乡村宁静祥和的环境。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The breakfast at the school cafeteria usually ______ fired eggs, bread and milk.
questions.explanation: consist of 意为“由……组成”，固定动词短语，主动形式表状态，不用于被动（没有 be consisted of）；makes up 方向相反（应为 is made up of），is included 介词搭配不当。句意：学校食堂的早餐通常由煎蛋、面包和牛奶组成。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The seller signed the ______ , promising to ship the goods before the end of July.
questions.explanation: contract 意为“合同、契约”，sign the contract 签订合同，与承诺发货的语境对应；contact“联系”，contrast“对比”，treaty“（国家间的）条约”。句意：卖方签署了合同，承诺七月底之前发货。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Many children chose “ Animal World ” as their ______ TV programme.
questions.explanation: favorite 意为“最喜欢的”（形容词），their favorite TV programme 他们最喜欢的电视节目；favor 是名词“恩惠、赞成”，favorable“赞同的、有利的”，favoring 是现在分词。句意：许多孩子选择《动物世界》作为他们最喜欢的电视节目。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They always keep on good ______ with their next-door neighbors for the children’s sake.
questions.explanation: keep on good terms with 是固定搭配，意为“与……保持友好关系”；friendship 和 relations 不构成此固定短语，relatives“亲戚”语义不通。句意：为了孩子，他们总是与隔壁邻居保持友好的邻里关系。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: This light bulb doesn’t work. Can you _____ it by another one?
questions.explanation: replace sth by/with sth 是固定搭配，意为“用……替换……”，空后 by 提示 replace；substitute 用于 substitute A for B 结构，change 不接 by，exchange“交换”。句意：这只灯泡不亮了，你能换一个新的吗？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I’m afraid that there is no ______ for you in my car.
questions.explanation: room 表“空间、空位”时是不可数名词，there is no room for you 即“没有你的空位”；place 指“地方”，seat 指“座位”，corner“角落”，均不如 room 表“车内空间”贴切。句意：恐怕我的车里已经没有空位了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The real trouble _______ their lack of confidence in their abilities.
questions.explanation: lie in 意为“在于”，the real trouble lies in their lack of confidence 真正的问题在于缺乏自信；lie on“取决于、靠在”，results in 和 lead to 意为“导致”，与句义不符。句意：真正的问题在于他们对自己的能力缺乏信心。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I don’t feel like swimming in the sea today, I’d rather lie on the ______.
questions.explanation: beach 意为“海滩”，lie on the beach 躺在海滩上，与在海里游泳的语境对应；coast“海岸线”（地理概念），bank“河岸”，seaside“海滨地区”。句意：今天我不想在海里游泳，我宁愿躺在沙滩上。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He behaves in a strange manner, and nobody can ______ this.
questions.explanation: account for 意为“解释、说明（原因）”，nobody can account for this 没人能解释这一点；care for“关心、喜欢”，allow for“考虑到”，call for“需要、号召”。句意：他举止古怪，没有人能解释这一点。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is good manners for men to behave _______ toward women.
questions.explanation: considerately 意为“体贴地”，副词修饰 behave，behave considerately toward women 对女士举止体贴；considerably“相当大地”，consciously“有意识地”，contentedly“心满意足地”。句意：男士对女士举止体贴才算是有礼貌。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She has been working in this factory _______ .
questions.explanation: since + 过去时间点（since 1980）是现在完成时（进行）的标志，表示动作从过去持续到现在，与 has been working 连用；in 1980 和 after 1980 常配一般过去时，until 1980 表示“直到 1980 年”。句意：自 1980 年以来，她就一直在这家工厂工作。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is the girl’s laziness that _______ her failure in the exams.
questions.explanation: result in 意为“导致”，主语是原因：懒惰（原因）导致了考试不及格（结果）；result from 意为“起因于”，主语应为结果；brought in“引进”；led into 非固定搭配。原答案有误，应为 A。句意：正是这个女孩的懒惰导致了她考试不及格。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: All parts of the house _______ the windows were in good condition.
questions.explanation: other than 意为“除了……之外（不包括在内）”，除窗户之外房子其他部分都完好；rather than“而不是”，no more than“仅仅”，better than“比……好”。句意：除了窗户，房子里的各个部分都完好无损。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The big room was almost empty _______ a table or two.
questions.explanation: except for 意为“除了……之外”，用于整体评价后修正细节——房间几乎全空，只是有一两张桌子；except 表示排除同类项，besides 和 in addition to 表“包括在内”，语义相反。句意：那个大房间几乎是空的，只有一两张桌子。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He was said to be very formal, rigid and ______ conventional.
questions.explanation: hopelessly 意为“无可救药地”，修饰 conventional（因循守旧）加强贬义程度，与 formal、rigid 的贬义并列；desperately 多用于危急、迫切语境，carelessly“粗心地”，splendidly“极好地”。句意：据说他非常刻板、古板，而且因循守旧到了无可救药的地步。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The soft handwriting _______ a thoughtful soul and clever mind.
questions.explanation: reflected 意为“反映、映衬”，笔迹“映出”深思的灵魂与聪慧的头脑；reminded“提醒”（remind sb of），attracted“吸引”，affected“影响”。句意：柔和的笔迹透出一个善于思考的灵魂和聪慧的头脑。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It was very dark in the tunnel so he ______ a match.
questions.explanation: strike a match 是固定搭配，意为“划火柴”，strike 表“擦（火柴）”；hit“打”，fired“点燃/解雇”（不与 match 搭配），burned“燃烧”。句意：隧道里很黑，于是他划了一根火柴。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After a very busy schedule in the past three weeks, John plans to take things ______ for a while.
questions.explanation: take things easy/at ease 表“放松、不紧张”，at ease“自在、放松”最贴近此义，与繁忙日程后想休息的语境相符；easily 是副词“容易地”，ease 是名词需冠词或介词，with ease“轻松地”指做事不费劲。句意：在过去三周的繁忙安排之后，约翰打算放松一阵子。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The scientific concepts can be ______ by words and diagrams.
questions.explanation: conveyed 意为“传达、表达”，concepts can be conveyed by words and diagrams 概念可通过文字和图表传达；concluded“总结”，contained“包含”，continued“继续”。句意：科学概念可以通过文字和图表来传达。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: People in that area experienced a serious storm. It was so ______ that many buildings collapsed.
questions.explanation: destructive 意为“毁灭性的”，so destructive that many buildings collapsed 破坏力大到许多建筑倒塌；constructive“建设性的”，instructive“有教育意义的”，inclusive“包容的”。句意：那个地区的人经历了一场强风暴，风暴破坏力极大，许多建筑都倒塌了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Linda is a good teacher, she always _______ our memory when we can’t remember.
questions.explanation: refresh one's memory 是固定搭配，意为“唤起某人的记忆、帮某人想起来”，与 when we can't remember 对应；arouse 常接 interest/curiosity/suspicion，wakes“唤醒（人）”，stimulates“刺激、激励”。原答案有误，应为 B。句意：琳达是位好老师，我们想不起来时她总能帮我们唤起记忆。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The pile of books fell down from the shelf and _______ all over the floor.
questions.explanation: scattered 意为“散落、四处散开”，books scattered all over the floor 书散落一地；slipped“滑落、滑倒”，extended“延伸”，separated“分离”。句意：那堆书从书架上掉了下来，撒了一地。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We would much ______ it if you could do us a favor.
questions.explanation: would appreciate it if... 是固定句型，意为“如果……将不胜感激”，it 作形式宾语；associate“联系”，prove“证明”，praise“表扬”，均无此句型。句意：如果您能帮我们一个忙，我们将不胜感激。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The candidate arrived _______ at 8 o’clock for the job interview.
questions.explanation: punctually 意为“准时地”，arrived punctually at 8 o'clock 八点整准时到达，与求职面试的语境相符；directly“径直地”，properly“恰当地”，immediately“立即”。句意：这位求职者八点整准时到达参加面试。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The music would stop at the intervals, then ______ after a while.
questions.explanation: resume 意为“（中断后）重新开始”，音乐停一段时间后又继续；restore 是及物动词“恢复（他物）”，recover“恢复（健康、体力）”，reform“改革”。句意：音乐每隔一段时间就会停下，过一会儿又重新响起。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The boy who applied to join the army was _______ because he was under age.
questions.explanation: turned down 意为“拒绝（申请、请求）”，was turned down 被拒绝，与 under age（未到年龄）构成因果；turned away 侧重“拒之门外、打发走”，turned over“翻转、移交”，turned up“出现”。句意：那个报名参军的男孩因年龄不够而被拒绝了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The actual cost of the house was higher than their original _______ .
questions.explanation: estimate 意为“估计”，original estimate（最初的估价）与 actual cost（实际成本）相呼应；consideration 考虑、plan 计划、judgment 判断均不合语境。译：这栋房子的实际成本比他们最初的估计要高。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Don’t _______ to let me know if there is anything I can do for you.
questions.explanation: Don't hesitate to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“尽管做某事、别犹豫”；reject/refuse 表“拒绝”，prevent 表“阻止”，均不构成此劝告句式。译：如果我有什么能帮上忙的，请尽管告诉我。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Let’s hang up some paintings on these _______ walls.
questions.explanation: bare 意为“光秃的、无遮盖的”，bare walls 指墙上没有任何装饰物；empty 指内部没有东西，blank 指纸面等空白无字，free 指空闲的。译：咱们在这几面光秃秃的墙上挂几幅画吧。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: At the conference he expressed some personal views which later brought him into ______ with the Party leadership.
questions.explanation: bring sb into conflict with... 为固定搭配，意为“使某人与……发生冲突”；action 行动、crisis 危机、power 权力均不构成此搭配。译：会上他发表了一些个人观点，后来这使他与党的领导层发生了冲突。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They have developed techniques which are _______ to those used in most factories.
questions.explanation: superior to... 为固定搭配，意为“优于……”，本身已含比较意义，不能再加 more；talented 指人有天赋，better/greater 不与介词 to 搭配。译：他们研发出的技术优于大多数工厂所使用的技术。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Man must stop ________ the earth’s atmosphere.
questions.explanation: pollute 意为“污染”，pollute the atmosphere 污染大气；fill 填满、waste 浪费不合语境，emit 指排放气体、光线等，不与 atmosphere 搭配。译：人类必须停止污染地球的大气层。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: No one has yet succeeded in explaining the _______ of how life began.
questions.explanation: puzzle 意为“令人费解的谜”，the puzzle of how life began“生命起源之谜”最贴切；problem 一般性问题，cause 起因，logic 逻辑。译：至今还没有人能成功地解释生命起源这个谜。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Unfortunately, very few ship _______ the severe winter last year.
questions.explanation: survive 意为“幸存、挺过（灾难）”，是及物动词，直接接 the severe winter 作宾语；endure 强调“忍受”，spent 花费，remained alive 后不能直接接宾语。译：不幸的是，去年很少有船只挺过了那个严冬。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They discussed the problem three or four times, but could come to no _______ .
questions.explanation: come to a conclusion 为固定搭配，意为“得出结论”，come to no conclusion 即“没能得出结论”；end 结束、result 结果、judgment 判断均不与 come to 构成此义。译：他们把这个问题讨论了三四次，但都没有得出结论。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Well, let’s put our heads together and find ________ to the problem.
questions.explanation: a solution to the problem 为固定搭配，意为“问题的解决办法”，solution 与介词 to 连用；way/method 不与 to the problem 搭配，answer 虽也可接 to，但此处标准搭配为 solution。译：来，咱们集思广益，找出解决这个问题的办法。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The old couple decided to move out of town to a quiet ________ , where they had spent several years immediately after their marriage.
questions.explanation: suburb 意为“郊区”，与 move out of town（搬出城）相呼应；pace 步伐，neighborhood 街区、住宅区，area 泛指地区。译：这对老夫妇决定搬出城去住到一个安静的郊区，婚后那几年他们就是在那里度过的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Bob tried in vain to trick his little brother ________ some money from their mother’s purse.
questions.explanation: trick sb into doing sth 为固定搭配，意为“诱骗某人做某事”，into 是介词，后须接动名词 stealing；to steal、to stealing、into steal 结构均错误。译：Bob 想诱骗弟弟从母亲的钱包里偷钱，但没有得逞。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I was _______ to find his article on such an ________ topic so ________ .
questions.explanation: 分词作形容词的标志：人作主语表“感到……”用 -ed，事物“令人……”用 -ing。I was surprised（我感到惊讶），an exciting topic（令人兴奋的话题），so boring（文章内容令人乏味），故选 C。译：我很惊讶地发现，他那篇关于如此令人兴奋的话题的文章竟写得如此乏味。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The two boys had so ______ in common that they soon became good friends.
questions.explanation: many/few 修饰可数名词复数，much/little 修饰不可数名词；in common 指抽象的“共同点”，属不可数概念，排除 few/many，又因“共同点多才会成为好友”排除 little，故选 much。译：这两个男孩有这么多共同点，很快就成了好朋友。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If you undertake this project you are bound to _______ many difficulties.
questions.explanation: encounter 意为“遭遇（困难等）”，及物动词直接接 difficulties；face with 结构错误（应为 be faced with），overcome 克服、handle 处理与 be bound to（必定会）的语境不符。译：如果你承接这个项目，就必定会遇到许多困难。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I suddenly realized that he was trying to ________ quarrelling with me.
questions.explanation: avoid doing sth 为固定搭配，意为“避免做某事”；consider/enjoy 虽也接 doing 但语义不合，prevent 须用于 prevent sb (from) doing 结构。译：我突然意识到他是想避免和我争吵。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The three hours I spent in the school library ______ my old passion for reading.
questions.explanation: bring back 意为“唤起、使恢复（记忆、热情等）”；bring about 导致，bring over 把……带来，bring forth 产生、提出。译：在学校图书馆度过的三个小时唤回了我昔日对阅读的热情。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The real trouble _______ their lack of confidence in their abilities.
questions.explanation: lie in 意为“（问题、根源）在于”；lie on 依赖，results in/leads to 意为“导致”，逻辑方向颠倒（不是 trouble 导致 lack，而是 trouble 在于 lack）。译：真正的问题在于他们对自己的能力缺乏信心。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Henry looked very much _______ when he was caught cheating in the biology exam.
questions.explanation: 分词作形容词标志：主语为人表“感到……”用 -ed 形式。Henry 作弊被抓感到“尴尬”，用 embarrassed；-ing 形式（disappointing/pleasing/discouraging）表“令人……”，主语应为物。译：亨利在生物考试中作弊被抓时显得非常尴尬。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I am afraid I won’t have any influence over my 18-year-old daughter ______ her mind is made up.
questions.explanation: 空后 her mind is made up 是完整从句，需选连接词。once 意为“一旦”，引导条件（时间）状语从句，符合“一旦女儿打定主意我就没有影响力”的逻辑；at the moment 只是时间状语不能引导从句，in order that 表目的，because 表原因不合逻辑，故选 C。译：恐怕一旦我 18 岁的女儿打定了主意，我对她就没有任何影响力了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Jane’s dress is similar in design _______ her sister’s.
questions.explanation: be similar to... 为固定搭配，意为“与……相似”，中间可插入 in design（在款式上）；with/like/as 均不搭配。译：简的裙子在款式上与她妹妹的相似。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There was more than ______ rain and snow last year, so some parts of the country have been severely flooded this spring.
questions.explanation: more than adequate 意为“绰绰有余、过量”，雨雪过量才会引发洪灾；extra 额外的，efficient 高效的，effective 有效的。译：去年的雨雪过于充沛，所以今年春天这个国家的一些地区遭受了严重洪灾。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It was not a serious accident, the car needs only some ______ repairs.
questions.explanation: minor 意为“轻微的”，minor repairs 小修小补，与 not a serious accident 呼应；major 重大的，secondary/primary 表次要的/主要的层级。译：这不是一起严重的事故，汽车只需小修一下。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Don’t be afraid to ______ him if you are in trouble.
questions.explanation: turn to sb 意为“向某人求助”；turn in 上交，turn down 拒绝，turn against 背叛。译：遇到困难时，别害怕去向他求助。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Going out of the room, ________ .
options: the air felt cool and fresh
a boy was seen in a tree
she saw a big bird in the tree
questions.explanation: 标志：句首现在分词短语 Going out of the room 作状语。分词作状语时其逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致，只有 she 能发出“走出房间”的动作；air/sun 不能，a boy was seen 中 boy 是“被看见”也不能主动走出，故选 D。译：走出房间时，她看见树上有一只大鸟。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Luckily, most ship _______ the flood last month.
questions.explanation: survive 意为“幸免于、挺过”，及物动词直接接 the flood；endure 忍受，live 须接 through 才表“挺过”，passed 经过。译：幸运的是，上个月大多数船只都挺过了那场洪水。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We can depend on John to make a _______ choice.
questions.explanation: sound 意为“明智的、可靠的”，a sound choice 明智的选择；loud 吵闹的，noisy 嘈杂的，well 作形容词仅指身体健康的。译：我们可以指望约翰做出明智的选择。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It was getting late, so we set off _______ .
questions.explanation: home 此处是副词（＝to one's home），前面不加介词，set off home 意为“动身回家”；to home、at home 结构错误，for home 把 home 当名词看待，不如副词用法地道。译：天色已晚，所以我们动身回家了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Finding it difficult to ______ to the climate there, he decided to move to the north.
questions.explanation: adapt to...（＝adapt oneself to...）为固定搭配，意为“适应……”；adopt 意为“采纳、收养”，fit/suit 是及物动词，不接 to。译：他发现难以适应那里的气候，便决定搬到北方去。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I suddenly _______ that it was past ten o’clock.
questions.explanation: realize 意为“意识到”，suddenly realized 突然意识到；recognize 意为“认出（曾见过的人或物）”，understand/know 表持续状态，与 suddenly 的瞬时性不符。译：我突然意识到已经十点多了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Good ________ ! I hope you’ll win the race.
questions.explanation: Good luck! 为固定祝福语，意为“祝你好运”，与 win the race 呼应；fortune 多指财富、时运，chance 机会，fate 命运，均不用于此祝福。译：祝你好运！希望你赢得这场比赛。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________ he works hard, I don’t mind when he will finish the experiment.
questions.explanation: 主从句逻辑为“只要他努力，我就不在乎何时完成”，是条件关系。so long as（＝as long as）引导条件状语从句，意为“只要”；as soon as 表“一……就……”，as well as 不引导从句，so far as 表“就……而言”，故选 D。译：只要他努力工作，我就不在乎他什么时候完成这个实验。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Please ________ the light before you go to sleep.
questions.explanation: turn off the light 意为“关灯”；die out 指（物种）灭绝，go out 指（火、灯自行）熄灭，put on 穿上。译：睡觉前请把灯关掉。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I tried to invite him to have a drink with me but he said that he was in such a hurry that he had no time to _______ .
questions.explanation: spare 意为“抽出、匀出（时间）”，have no time to spare 抽不出时间；spend 花费，save 节省，share 分享。译：我想请他喝一杯，可他说自己太匆忙，抽不出时间。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Her English is ______ better than mine, for she knows ________ English words and expressions than I do.
questions.explanation: 标志：空后是比较级 better than。far/much 可修饰比较级（far better 好得多）；第二空后 words and expressions 是可数名词复数，“更多”须用 many more，much more 只修饰不可数名词，故选 B。译：她的英语比我的好得多，因为她掌握的英语单词和词组比我多得多。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The new evening dress _______ her as much as 400 dollars.
questions.explanation: cost 意为“花费”，主语为物：sth costs sb money；pay/spend 的主语必须是人，take 多用于 it takes sb time/money 结构。译：这条新的晚礼服花了她整整 400 美元。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You should make sure that you have not _______ any detail in the design.
questions.explanation: neglect 意为“疏忽、遗漏（该做的事）”，neglect any detail 忽略任何细节；disappear 消失（不及物），throw 须加 away 才完整，deliver 递送。译：你应当确保自己在设计中没有遗漏任何细节。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I found _______ to answer all the questions within the time given.
questions.explanation: 标志：found 后为复合宾语结构，真正的宾语是不定式 to answer...。不定式作宾语时用 it 作形式宾语，构成 find it＋形容词＋to do，impossible 作宾语补足语；no possibility/there was impossibility 搭配错误，impossible 不能直接作 found 的宾语。译：我发现自己不可能在给定的时间内答完所有题目。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: All substances, ________ they are gaseous, liquid or solid, are made of atoms.
questions.explanation: 标志：空后 they are gaseous, liquid or solid 出现 or 的三项并列。whether...or... 为固定搭配，引导让步状语，意为“无论是……还是……”；though/even if/as 都不能与 or 构成此结构，故选 B。译：一切物质，无论是气态、液态还是固态，都是由原子构成的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The Smiths asked the lady at the information desk for a ______ room for the night.
questions.explanation: double 意为“双人的”，a double room 双人间；couple 夫妇、一对，twice 两次，pair 一对、一副。译：史密斯夫妇向问讯处的女士要了一间双人房过夜。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My opinion is as good ________ .
questions.explanation: 标志：as good 是原级比较 as...as 的开头，必须补全为 as good as or better than...。比较对象是 opinion，须用名词性物主代词 his 代替 his opinion；he 是主格，as he is 缺后一个 as，or better than his 缺前半个 as，故选 C。译：我的看法不比他的差，甚至比他的更好。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: _______ that your son is well again, you no longer have anything to worry about.
questions.explanation: 标志：空后已有 that，构成“____ that＋从句”。now that 为固定连词，引导原因状语从句，意为“既然”；since 虽可表“既然”但不能与 that 连用，when/after 表时间不合逻辑，故选 B。译：既然你儿子痊愈了，你就没有什么可担心的了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Most people will find it easier to speed on a highway when everybody _______ is driving over the speed limit.
questions.explanation: else 意为“其他的”，用于疑问词和不定代词之后，everybody else 意为“其他每个人”；too/also 意为“也”，alone 意为“独自”，均不能后置修饰 everybody。译：当其他人都在超过限速行驶时，大多数人会发现在高速公路上超速更容易。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You are ______ your time trying to persuade him. He will never join us.
questions.explanation: waste one's time (in) doing sth 为固定搭配，意为“浪费时间做某事”；spend time doing 意为“花时间做”（不含“白费”之义），lose/miss 不构成此搭配。译：你试图说服他是在白白浪费时间，他绝不会加入我们。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Animals that could not _______ themselves to the changed environment perished and those that could survived.
questions.explanation: adapt oneself to... 为固定搭配，意为“使某人自己适应……”；apply 应用，modify 修改，change 改变，均不构成 oneself to 的搭配。译：那些不能使自己适应变化了的环境的动物灭亡了，而能适应的存活了下来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The tomato juice left brown _______ on my coat.
questions.explanation: spot 意为“斑点、污点”，leave brown spots on... 在……上留下棕色污渍；trace 指踪迹、痕迹线，dirt 指污垢、脏物，point 指抽象的点。译：番茄汁在我的外套上留下了棕色的污渍。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Remember, nothing hurts concentration ________ reading too slowly.
questions.explanation: 标志：主语是否定词 nothing。“否定词＋比较级＋than”相当于最高级，nothing hurts concentration more than... 意为“没有什么比……更损害专注力”；rather than/instead of 表“而不是”，as well as 表“和……一样”，故选 C。译：记住，没有什么比读得太慢更损害专注力了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Educational reforms in the 1980s _______ compulsory education to nine years.
questions.explanation: extend...to... 意为“把……延长/扩展到”，extend compulsory education to nine years 把义务教育延长至九年；expand 扩张（规模、体积），stretch 拉伸，widen 拓宽（宽度）。译：20 世纪 80 年代的教育改革把义务教育延长到了九年。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I don’t think John and I have anything ________ .
questions.explanation: have...in common 为固定搭配，意为“有共同点”；in depth 深入地，at random 随机地，in detail 详细地。译：我认为约翰和我没有任何共同之处。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A sense of well-being should always be an important part of life ______ your age.
questions.explanation: 标志：空后 your age 是省略式成分，构成让步。whatever your age (is) 意为“无论你的年龄多大”，whatever 可引导让步状语从句（成分可省略）；whatsoever 须置于否定词之后（no...whatsoever），however 后须接形容词/副词，no matter 不能单独使用，故选 B。译：无论年龄多大，幸福感都应当始终是人生重要的一部分。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It was the local people who helped us out of the difficult ________ .
questions.explanation: circumstances 意为“境况、处境”，help us out of the difficult circumstances 帮我们摆脱困境；occasion 场合，phenomenon 现象，status 地位。译：是当地人帮助我们摆脱了困境。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We will be broadcasting the programme ________ from Austin.
questions.explanation: live 意为“实地地、以直播方式”，是副词，broadcast live 现场直播；alive/living 意为“活着的”（形容词），lively 意为“活泼的”。译：我们将从奥斯汀现场直播这个节目。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Please keep me _______ your whereabouts in case I have something urgent to tell you.
questions.explanation: keep sb informed of sth 为固定搭配，意为“让某人随时了解某事的情况”（选项 informed off 为 informed of 的误排）；stuck to 粘住，linked with 与……相连，separated from 与……分离，均不合句意。译：请让我随时知道你的行踪，以防我有急事要告诉你。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The increase in student numbers _______ many problems for the universities.
questions.explanation: pose 意为“造成、引起（问题、困难、威胁等）”，pose problems 为常用搭配；exert 施加（exert pressure on），press 按压，provide 提供。译：学生人数的增加给大学带来了许多问题。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I was not given any legal aid and I felt there was no justice in the country _______ .
questions.explanation: after all 意为“毕竟”，与“未获法律援助、感到不公”的语气呼应；above all 首要的是，all in all 总的来说，in all 总共。译：我没有得到任何法律援助，我觉得这个国家毕竟没有什么正义可言。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A complete investigation into the causes of the accident should lead to improved standards and should _______ new operating procedures.
questions.explanation: result in 意为“导致、带来（某种结果）”，与前半句 lead to 并列呼应；subject to 使遭受，proceed with 着手继续，match with 与……匹配。译：对事故原因的全面调查应促使标准得到改进，并带来新的操作规程。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The students are _______ young people between the ages of sixteen and twenty.
questions.explanation: mostly 意为“主要地、大部分”，副词修饰表语 young people；most 大多数（作定语修饰名词），almost 几乎（修饰动词、形容词），at most 至多。译：这些学生主要是 16 岁到 20 岁之间的年轻人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I took the children to the zoo today to ________ the party they missed yesterday.
questions.explanation: make up for 意为“弥补”，弥补昨天错过的聚会；take up 占据（时间、空间），stand up for 维护、捍卫，send up 发射。译：我今天带孩子们去动物园，以弥补他们昨天错过的那次聚会。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The food smells very good, but what does it ________ like?
questions.explanation: taste 意为“尝起来”，与 smells（闻起来）相对应，问味道如何；feel 摸起来，try 尝试，eat 吃。译：这食物闻起来很香，但尝起来味道怎么样呢？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: At that time they were poor, and they _______ a difficult time.
questions.explanation: go through 意为“经历、经受（困难时期）”；go down 下降，go in for 参加、爱好，go along with 赞同、陪同。译：那时他们很穷，度过了一段艰难的岁月。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There were 12 policemen _______ at the football ground during the match.
questions.explanation: on duty 为固定搭配，意为“在值班、执勤”；out duty/of duty/over duty 均为错误搭配（“下班”应为 off duty）。译：比赛期间有 12 名警察在足球场执勤。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The twins look so much alike that we can hardly _______ one from the other.
questions.explanation: distinguish one from the other 意为“辨别两者、分辨”，强调分辨差异；separate 强调把连在一起的东西“分开”，contrast A with B 对比，compare...with 比较。译：这对双胞胎长得太像了，我们几乎没法分辨出谁是谁。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Most of the cattle are ________ under the trees.
questions.explanation: lie（躺、位于）的现在分词是 lying；laying 是 lay（放置、产卵）的现在分词，牛是自己“躺”在树下而非被放置；remaining 保持，learning 学习。译：大多数牛正躺在树下。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Please________ my shirt, it’s torn.
questions.explanation: mend 意为“修补、缝补”，多用于衣服、鞋袜等小物件，衬衫破了应 mend；repair 多用于修理机器、车辆等，wash 洗，iron 熨烫。译：请把我的衬衫补一补，它破了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He is sometimes bad-tempered but he is a good fellow________.
questions.explanation: at heart 为固定搭配，意为“本质上、内心里”；by heart 意为“凭记忆”（learn by heart），in heart/with heart 非固定搭配。译：他有时脾气不好，但本质上是个好人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Many children chose “ Animal World” as their _______ TV program.
questions.explanation: favorite 意为“最喜爱的”，favorite TV program 最喜欢的电视节目；preferred 更喜欢的，preferable 更可取的（常作表语），favorable 有利的、赞同的。译：许多孩子选择《动物世界》作为他们最喜欢的电视节目。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Features such as height, weight, and skin color _______ from individual to individual and from face to face.
questions.explanation: vary from...to... 意为“因……而各不相同”，vary from individual to individual 因人而异；change 改变，alter 局部更改，convert 转变（形式、用途）。译：诸如身高、体重和肤色之类的特征因人而异、因脸而异。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I caught a ______ of the taxi before it disappeared around the corner of the street.
questions.explanation: catch/get a glimpse of 为固定搭配，意为“瞥见”；vision 视力、幻象，look 须用 have a look at，scene 场景。译：在那辆出租车消失在街角之前，我瞥了它一眼。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You must walk through the underground _______ to get across that busy street.
questions.explanation: passage 意为“通道”，underground passage 地下通道；pass 通过（动词），past 过去（名词/介词），passenger 乘客。译：你必须走这条地下通道才能穿过那条繁忙的街道。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Miss Green didn’t care for the job offered by the shop-keeper; what she wanted was a post with more______.
questions.explanation: challenge 意为“挑战”，a post with more challenge 更有挑战性的职位，与 didn't care for the job 呼应；struggle 奋斗、挣扎，function 功能，fund 基金。译：格林小姐不在乎店主提供的那份工作；她想要的是一个更有挑战性的职位。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You see the lightning _____ it happens, but you hear the thunder later.
questions.explanation: 标志：空后 it happens 是完整从句，需选能引导时间状语从句的连接词。the instant 意为“一……就……”，名词短语可作连词引导时间状语从句；for an instant 短时间，on the instant/in an instant 立即，均只作时间状语不能引导从句，故选 A。译：闪电一发生你就能看见，而雷声要稍后才能听到。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I’ve made an ______ for you to see the dentist at 5 o’clock tomorrow.
questions.explanation: make an appointment 为固定搭配，意为“预约”，与 see the dentist at 5 o'clock 呼应；interview 面试、采访，opportunity 机会，occasion 场合。译：我已经为你预约好明天五点去看牙医。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: However, at times this balance in nature is _______, resulting in a number of possibly unforeseen effects.
questions.explanation: disturb 意为“扰乱、打破（平衡、安宁）”，balance is disturbed 平衡被打乱；trouble 使烦恼，confuse/puzzle 使迷惑（用于人的头脑）。译：然而，自然界的这种平衡有时会被扰乱，从而导致许多可能无法预料的后果。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The policeman went from door to door, _______ whether anyone had seen the lost boy.
questions.explanation: inquire 意为“询问、打听”，inquire whether... 询问是否……；require 要求，acquire 获得，inform 通知。译：警察挨家挨户地询问是否有人见过那个走失的男孩。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Floods cause billions of dollars worth of property damage_______.
questions.explanation: annually 意为“每年”，说明巨额财产损失是每年发生的常态；relatively 相对地，actually 实际上，comparatively 比较而言。译：洪水每年造成价值数十亿美元的财产损失。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He made it his ______ to fetch water for the old woman.
questions.explanation: make it one's business to do sth 为固定搭配，意为“把做某事当作自己的分内事”；matter 事情、affair 事务、operation 操作均不构成此搭配。译：他把替那位老妇人打水当作自己分内的事。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is our _______ policy t6hat we will achieve unity through peaceful means.
questions.explanation: consistent 意为“一贯的、始终如一的”，consistent policy 一贯的政策；continuous 连续不断的，considerate 体贴的，continual 多次重复的、断断续续的。译：通过和平方式实现团结是我们一贯的政策。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He is _______ about his chances of winning a golden medal in the Olympics next year.
questions.explanation: be optimistic about... 为固定搭配，意为“对……感到乐观”；optional 可选的，outstanding 杰出的，obvious 明显的。译：他对在明年奥运会上赢得金牌的可能性持乐观态度。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She cooked the meat for a long time so as to make it _________ enough to eat.
questions.explanation: tender 意为“（肉等）嫩的、易嚼的”，tender enough to eat 炖得够烂能吃；mild 温和的，slight 轻微的，light 清淡的、轻的。译：她把肉炖了很长时间，为的是让它嫩得容易入口。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is not the consciousness of man that determines his existence, but, ________ , his social existence determines his consciousness.
questions.explanation: on the contrary 意为“相反”，用于否定前句后引出相反的论断；on the average 平均而言，on the whole 总体上，on the other hand 表“另一方面”（并列两方面而非对立否定）。译：不是人的意识决定他的存在，相反，是他的社会存在决定他的意识。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We can’t tell what home of the future will be like because new material and inventions are ______ being developed.
questions.explanation: constantly 意为“不断地、一直”，与“无法预知未来的家”呼应——新发明在不断涌现；commonly 普通地，normally 正常地，regularly 定期地。译：我们无法预知未来的家会是什么样子，因为新材料和新发明正在不断地被开发出来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The computer revolution may well change society as _____ as did the Industrial Revolution.
questions.explanation: fundamentally 意为“根本地、从根本上”，as...as did the Industrial Revolution 强调变革之深；certainly 当然，insignificantly 微不足道地，comparatively 比较地。译：计算机革命很可能像工业革命那样从根本上改变社会。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Niagara Fall is a great tourist _______ drawing millions of visitors every year.
questions.explanation: attraction 意为“吸引人的事物、景点”，tourist attraction 旅游景点为固定搭配；attention 注意，appointment 预约，arrangement 安排。译：尼亚加拉瀑布是一大旅游景点，每年吸引数百万游客。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: As we can no longer wait for the delivery of our order, we have to _______ it.
questions.explanation: cancel 意为“取消”，再也等不到交货只能取消订单；postpone 推迟（能等到才谈推迟），refuse 拒绝，delay 延误。译：由于再也无法等待订购货物的交付，我们只好把它取消。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is said that the math teacher seems ________ towards bright students.
questions.explanation: partial 意为“偏袒的、偏爱的”，be partial towards... 对……偏心；beneficial 有益的，preferable 更可取的，liable 有倾向的、易于……的。译：据说这位数学老师似乎偏袒聪明的学生。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Young people are not ________ to stand and look at works of art; they want art they can participate in.
questions.explanation: content 意为“满足的”，be content to do sth 满足于做某事，与后文“他们想要能参与的艺术”呼应；conservative 保守的，confident 自信的，generous 慷慨的。译：年轻人不满足于站在一旁观看艺术作品，他们想要的是自己能够参与的艺术。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The clothes one wears may express one’s _______ or social position.
questions.explanation: status 意为“身份、社会地位”，与 social position 同义呼应；curiosity 好奇心，determination 决心，significance 意义、重要性。译：一个人的穿着可能体现其身份或社会地位。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Everybody ________ in the hall where they were welcomed by the secretary.
questions.explanation: assemble 意为“集合、聚集”，everybody assembled in the hall 大家在大厅集合；accumulate 积累，pile 堆放，join 加入、参加。译：大家在大厅里集合，在那里他们受到了书记的欢迎。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In the ________ of the project not being a success , the investors will lose up to $30 million.
questions.explanation: in the event of... 为固定搭配，意为“万一、倘若发生……”，后接名词性成分（the project not being a success）；face 须用 in the face of，time/course 不构成此含义。译：万一这个项目不成功，投资者将损失多达 3000 万美元。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The idea of spending the rest of my life there never _______ me.
questions.explanation: appeal to sb 意为“吸引某人”，主语是 the idea：never appeals to me 从不吸引我；appeal for 恳求得到，attract 是及物动词，后不能加 to。译：在那里度过余生的念头从未吸引过我。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She looked _______ to make sure that I was not telling a lie.
questions.explanation: look sb in the eye(s) 为固定搭配，意为“直视某人的眼睛”，宾语后不加介词 at，且用 the 而不用 one's；故 at me in the eye、me in my eye、at me in my eyes 均错误。译：她直直地盯着我的眼睛，以确认我没有撒谎。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Good advice is _______ price.
questions.explanation: beyond price 为固定搭配，意为“价值连城、无法估价”，beyond 表“超出……的范围”；for/no/without 与 price 连用均非此习语。译：好的忠告是无价的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He _______ talking about his experience in Japan.
questions.explanation: tire of doing sth 意为“厌倦于做某事”，表状态不用进行时，主语 he 后用 never tires of；is never tired 缺介词 of，is never tiring of 误用进行时，is never tiring when 结构不通。译：他谈论自己在日本的经历从不感到厌倦。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His mind was _______ on one thing: How to win the game.
questions.explanation: be concentrated on... 意为“集中在……上”，his mind was concentrated on one thing 他的心思集中在一件事情上；observed 观察，indicated 表明，declared 宣布，均不与 on 搭配表此义。译：他的心思集中在一件事上：如何赢得这场比赛。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We didn't know what had happened to her until we _______ the accident in the news-paper.
questions.explanation: read of（＝read about）意为“读到、从（报上）获悉”；read 单用须直接接所读内容，read over 通读、细看，read from 无此搭配。译：直到在报纸上读到这起事故，我们才知道她出了什么事。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If someone is competent for his job, we say he is __________
questions.explanation: worth one's salt 为固定习语，意为“称职、胜任”；worthy 后须接 of＋名词，但无 worthy of his salt 的说法，worthwhile 意为“值得做的”，用法不同，worth salt 缺物主代词。译：如果一个人胜任自己的工作，我们就说他称职。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: What did you _______ my book? I can't find it.
questions.explanation: What did you do with...? 为固定表达，意为“你把……弄到哪儿去了/怎么处理了”；do about 表“对……采取行动”，leave/put 单独使用须带明确的地点状语。译：你把我的书弄到哪儿去了？我找不到了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She _______ her jewels _______ money.
questions.explanation: exchange A for B 为固定搭配，意为“用 A 换得 B”，用首饰换来钱；change...for 表“把 A 换成 B”（更换），change/exchange...with 表“与某人互换”，均不合句意。译：她用珠宝换成了钱。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He took a nap to _______ the loss of sleep the night before.
questions.explanation: compensate for 为固定搭配，意为“弥补、补偿”，compensate for the loss of sleep 弥补睡眠不足；compensate 不与 up 连用，make for 意为“走向、有助于”。译：他小睡了一会儿，以弥补前一晚睡眠的不足。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Houses there _______ paper to keep cold out.
questions.explanation: 标志：主语 houses 是 insulate（使隔热）动作的承受者，“房子被隔热”。语态规则：主语为动作承受者须用被动语态 be done；“用……材料”由介词 with 引出，故 are insulated with 正确。译：那里的房子用纸作隔热层来阻挡寒气。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Some people did not go to university _______ their own choice.
questions.explanation: of one's own choice 为固定搭配，意为“出于自己的选择”，of 表原因、由来；from/by/in 不构成此习语。译：有些人没有上大学并非出于自己的选择。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He is the only one _______ these files.
questions.explanation: have access to 为固定搭配，意为“有权使用、可以接触”，access 是名词；to access 误把 access 当动词且介词 to 重复，to have access 缺介词 to，be accessible to 的主语应为物。译：他是唯一有权查阅这些档案的人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We offer four courses, each _______ two weekly programmes.
questions.explanation: 标志：逗号后 each ______，主句谓语 offer 已存在，此处只能用非谓语作补充说明。each 与 consist 之间是主动关系，用现在分词构成独立结构 each consisting of；consisted of 表被动错误，made up 缺 of，was made up of 会出现两个谓语，故选 C。译：我们提供四门课程，每门课程包含两个周计划。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The amount of the money they received _______ from person to person.
questions.explanation: vary from person to person 意为“因人而异”，强调各人所得不同；change 改变，differ 与 from 连用表“与……不同”（不用于 from person to person 结构），moved 移动。译：他们收到的钱数因人而异。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Another subway has been _______ operation since last December.
questions.explanation: in operation 为固定搭配，意为“在运转中、已投入使用”，has been in operation since... 自……以来一直在运营；on/with 均不搭配。译：另一条地铁自去年 12 月起已投入运营。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Can you tell us how you _______ the earthquake?
questions.explanation: survive 意为“幸免于、从……中活下来”，及物动词直接接 the earthquake，不加介词；were survived 被动错误，survived in/after 均非正确用法。译：你能告诉我们你们是怎样在那场地震中幸存下来的吗？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It was midnight when Uncle Podger at last had the picture _______ in the living-room.
questions.explanation: 标志：had the picture ______ 为 have sth done 结构，picture 与 hang（悬挂）之间是被动关系，用过去分词作宾补；hang 的过去分词 hung 指“悬挂”，hanged 指“绞死”，hanging 表主动进行，故选 hung。译：波杰叔叔直到半夜才终于把那幅画挂进了客厅。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The weather was very good on the first day. It rained for __________
questions.explanation: the rest of the time 意为“其余的时间”，结构为 the rest of＋限定词＋名词；the rest time/the other time 结构错误，the rest of time 缺定冠词。译：第一天天气很好，其余的时间一直在下雨。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The lawn-mower broke _______ last month and it failed to operate.
questions.explanation: break down 意为“（机器等）出故障、坏掉”，与 failed to operate 呼应；break off 折断，break up 解体、分解，break away 挣脱、脱离。译：那台割草机上个月坏了，无法运转。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The General Store sells clothing and many other things _______ food.
questions.explanation: apart from 意为“除……之外（还有）”，相当于 in addition to；in addition 须接 to 才完整，except for 表“除了……”（排除在外），beside 意为“在……旁边”（besides 才是“除之外还有”）。译：这家综合商店除食品外还卖服装和许多其他东西。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: About 2000 years ago, the Chinese paper was made _______ the hair-like parts of certain plants.
questions.explanation: be made from 意为“由……制成”，用于成品中看不出原材料的场合（纸由植物制成看不出原料）；be made of 用于看得出原材料，be made into 意为“被制成”，out of 单用不完整。译：大约两千年前，中国的纸是由某些植物的毛发状部分制成的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The _______ between the rich and poor regions is being bridged.
questions.explanation: gap 意为“差距、隔阂”，the gap between the rich and poor regions 富裕地区与贫困地区之间的差距；space 空间，distance 距离，room 房间、空间。译：富裕地区与贫困地区之间的差距正在弥合。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You have no right to _______ more information than you should.
questions.explanation: give away 意为“泄露（秘密、信息）”，give away information 泄露信息；give way 让路、让步（give way to 被……取代），give out 分发、公布。译：你无权把本不该你知道的更多信息泄露出去。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He has been a valued _______ of our company for many years.
questions.explanation: client 意为“（有长期服务关系的）客户、委托人”，valued client 重要客户；customer 指商店购物的顾客，professor 教授，businessman 商人。译：多年来他一直是我们公司一位颇受重视的老客户。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: “Are you still homesick? Believe me, you'll soon __________”
questions.explanation: get over 意为“克服、从（疾病、情绪）中恢复过来”，代词 it 须放在副词之后：get over it；get it over (with) 意为“把事情了结”，recover 用作“恢复”时不接宾语。译：你还想家吗？相信我，你很快就会克服的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Everything will be all right, Jane. _______ easy.
questions.explanation: Take it easy 为固定表达，意为“放轻松、别紧张”；Let it easy、Take easy、Keep it easy 均非固定表达。译：一切都会好起来的，简。放轻松。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: One possible solution _______ the population problem has been suggested by an American scientist.
questions.explanation: a solution to the problem 为固定搭配，意为“问题的解决办法”，solution 后接介词 to；about/in/for 均不搭配。译：一位美国科学家提出了一种解决人口问题的可能办法。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Father insisted on sending me to Harrow to _______ me a good education.
questions.explanation: ensure 意为“确保”，可接双宾语 ensure sb sth（ensure me a good education）；make sure 后须接 that 从句或 make sure of＋名词，ensure of 结构错误。译：父亲坚持要送我去哈罗公学，以确保我受到良好的教育。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Three Days To See _______ my interest in knowing more about Helen Keller.
questions.explanation: arouse 意为“唤起、激起”，arouse one's interest 激发兴趣；rise（上升）/arise（出现）均是不及物动词，raise 意为“举起、提高（价格、水平等）”，不与 interest 搭配。译：《假如给我三天光明》激发了我进一步了解海伦·凯勒的兴趣。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Not knowing what to reply _______ such a question, we kept silent.
questions.explanation: reply to... 为固定搭配，意为“对……作出回答”，reply 是不及物动词，须接介词 to 再接宾语。译：因为不知道该如何回答这样的问题，我们保持了沉默。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The four-wheeler was lost to sight, the sound of the slow wheels__________
questions.explanation: 逗号后没有连词，the sound of the slow wheels dying away 是名词加现在分词构成的独立主格结构，作伴随状语，故不能用谓语形式 died away；die away 指声音逐渐减弱直至消失，die off 指成员相继死去，故选 C。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: _________ objective tests, they use "essay" tests.
questions.explanation: in addition to 意为“除……之外（还有）”，是固定短语介词；along with、together with 才成立，Along to、In addition with、Together to 搭配均错误。全句译：除了客观题测验，他们还采用“作文”式测验。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He _______ the gap in his education _______ lack of opportunity.
questions.explanation: attribute...to... 意为“把……归因于……”，把教育上的欠缺归因于缺少机会语义贴切；owe...to 多用于“归功于、欠”，owned 是拼写干扰，contributed...to 意为“把……贡献给”。全句译：他把自己教育上的欠缺归因于缺少机会。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The doctor advised him to _______ fattening food.
questions.explanation: cut down on 意为“减少（摄入、使用）”，cut down on fattening food 即少吃增肥食物；reduce 不与 on 搭配，crease 为拼写干扰，cut off 意为“切断”。全句译：医生建议他少吃使人发胖的食物。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Summer here is so hot that most people try to _______ somewhere.
questions.explanation: get away 意为“离开、外出躲避（度假）”；get off 指下车、下班，move off 指（车辆）驶离，leave away 搭配不存在。全句译：这里的夏天太热，大多数人都设法到什么地方躲一躲。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My mother manages the entire _______, including taking care of my grandfather.
questions.explanation: household 指“家务及全家构成的整体”，manage the entire household 即操持整个家；family 侧重家庭成员，home 侧重住所与情感，house hold 拼写错误。全句译：我母亲操持整个家，包括照顾我爷爷。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She wore a dress for that occasion in the prettiest fashion__________
questions.explanation: imaginable 意为“可想象的”，常置于最高级、all、every 等词之后作后置定语：the prettiest fashion imaginable 即“能想象到的最漂亮的样式”；imaginative 富于想象力的，imaginary 想象中的、虚构的。全句译：在那个场合，她穿着能想象到的最漂亮样式的连衣裙。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: _______ open for an exercise book with a blue cover for me.
questions.explanation: keep your eyes open for sth 是固定表达，意为“留意、留神某物”；keep an eye on 后须接 on 再接宾语，而本句介词是 for，故选 B。全句译：请帮我留意一本蓝色封面的练习本。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He failed to _______ himself to the new environment.
questions.explanation: adapt oneself to... 意为“使自己适应……”；adopt 意为“采纳、收养”，adept 是形容词“熟练的”，addict 意为“使沉溺”。全句译：他未能使自己适应新环境。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If tomorrow is fine, we shall go on a trip __________
questions.explanation: all together 意为“大家一起、一同”；altogether 意为“总共、完全”，get-together 是名词“联欢会”，all-together 拼写错误。全句译：如果明天天气好，我们就大家一起去旅行。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I was sick _______ his way of speaking.
questions.explanation: be sick of 意为“厌烦、厌恶”，是固定搭配，不与 with、off、against 搭配。全句译：我讨厌他说话的样子。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My parents are not interested in pop music. They are _______ the times.
questions.explanation: behind the times 意为“落伍、跟不上时代”；对流行音乐不感兴趣正是落伍的表现，before、against、after 均不合语义。全句译：我父母对流行音乐不感兴趣，他们跟不上时代。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His repeated efforts did not _______ a miracle.
questions.explanation: work a miracle（work wonders）意为“创造奇迹”，是固定搭配；make、get 不与 miracle 搭配，promote 意为“促进、晋升”。全句译：他一再努力却没有创造奇迹。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You are always _______ fault with him. Please don't be too hard on him.
questions.explanation: find fault with sb 意为“挑剔、找茬”，是固定搭配；making、looking、getting 与 fault with 均不构成搭配。全句译：你总是对他挑剔，请别对他太苛刻。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I saw a _______ of fish in the pond.
questions.explanation: a school of fish 意为“一群鱼”，school 在此指鱼群；crowd 指人群，swarm 指蜂群、虫群，group 泛指一般群体。全句译：我在池塘里看到一群鱼。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: As the bus is so _______, we had better go home on foot.
questions.explanation: be 动词后作表语要用形容词 crowded“拥挤的”；crowdedly 是副词不能作表语，crowding 是现在分词，crowd 是名词或动词。全句译：公共汽车这么挤，我们最好步行回家。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When will you _______ this new policy?
questions.explanation: adopt 意为“采取、采用（政策、方法）”，adopt this policy 即采用这项新政策；adapt 使适应，addict 使沉溺，adorn 装饰。全句译：你们什么时候会采用这项新政策？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I still cannot figure _______ the sum I require.
questions.explanation: figure out 意为“算出、弄明白”；figure in、figure up、figure over 均非固定搭配。全句译：我还是算不出我需要的那个数目。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Signpost _______ along the way directed us to the town.
questions.explanation: erect 意为“竖立、架设（路标、纪念碑）”；elect 选举，correct 改正，collect 收集，均不合句意。全句译：沿途竖立的路标指引我们进城。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Smoking in this five-star hotel is _______
questions.explanation: prohibit 意为“（以规章）禁止”，Smoking is prohibited 是标准禁令表达；decline 婉言谢绝，prevent 指阻止某事发生，refuse 拒绝（请求、邀请）。全句译：这家五星级酒店禁止吸烟。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The music they are playing is not at all _______ my taste.
questions.explanation: to one's taste 意为“合某人的口味”，not at all to my taste 即“完全不合我的口味”；for、in、with 均不构成此搭配。全句译：他们演奏的音乐完全不合我的口味。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: How did you while _______ your time during the holiday?
questions.explanation: while away 意为“消磨（时间）”，while away your time during the holiday 即消磨假期时光；off、over、for 不构成此短语。全句译：假期里你是怎么消磨时间的？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I don't like him; he always pokes his _______ into other people's affairs.
questions.explanation: poke one's nose into sth 意为“探听、干涉（别人的事）”，是固定习语；fingers、hands、foot 无此搭配。全句译：我不喜欢他，他总是爱探听、干涉别人的事务。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You are unlikely to succeed unless you _______ his advice.
questions.explanation: follow one's advice 意为“听从某人的建议”；unless 条件句要求“不听从建议就不会成功”，ignore（忽视）、understand、remember 与结果矛盾。全句译：除非你听从他的建议，否则你不太可能成功。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Have you brought the old man his stick, which he can never do _______ when walking?
questions.explanation: do without 意为“没有……也行、将就”，can never do without 即“离不开”；do for、do with、do away（废除须说 do away with）均不合此义。全句译：你把老人走路离不开的那根手杖带来了吗？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Helen Keller was blind, deaf and mute. She was ___________.
questions.explanation: handicapped 意为“残疾的”，blind、deaf、mute 三者皆属残疾，概括用 handicapped；frustrated 受挫的，stable 稳定的，unpredictable 难以预料的。全句译：海伦·凯勒又盲又聋又哑，她是位残疾人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When the kind girl ___________ all of the birds from the cages, they all flew away.
questions.explanation: release 意为“释放、放走”，release the birds from the cages 即把鸟从笼中放走；relieve 缓解（痛苦），ease 减轻，tease 取笑。全句译：善良的女孩把鸟从笼中放走后，它们全都飞走了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Sometimes he eats a lot and sometimes he eats nothing. He goes from one ___________ to the other.
questions.explanation: from one extreme to the other 意为“从一个极端到另一个极端”，是固定搭配；top、end、result 不构成此表达。全句译：他有时暴食，有时什么都不吃，从一个极端走向另一个极端。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The storm was___________. Many buildings collapsed because of it.
questions.explanation: destructive 意为“破坏性的”，与“许多建筑倒塌”呼应；instructive 有教育意义的，conclusive 结论性的，constructive 建设性的。全句译：这场风暴极具破坏性，许多建筑因它而倒塌。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The conference will begin ___________ at 9:30.
questions.explanation: precisely 与具体钟点连用强调“分秒不差、准点”，begin precisely at 9:30 即准点九点半开始；concisely 简洁地，correctly 正确地，exactly 侧重“正是、确切”。全句译：会议将准点在九点半开始。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The interest on my small savings is ___________.
questions.explanation: negligible 意为“微不足道的”，小额存款的利息 negligible 贴切；neglectful 疏忽的（人），negative 消极的、负的，negligent 玩忽职守的。全句译：我这点存款的利息微不足道。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The lady was ___________ of the quality of the service.
questions.explanation: be assured of 意为“确信、对……放心”，是固定搭配；entrust 常与 with 连用，confirm、guarantee 是及物动词直接接宾语，不用于 be + ed + of 结构。全句译：这位女士确信服务质量是好的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Keep an extra pencil ___________ while taking the examination.
questions.explanation: keep sth handy 意为“把某物放在手边、便于取用”；nearby、close 只表方位远近，there 指远处，均不如 handy 贴切。全句译：考试时把一支备用铅笔放在手边。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The _________ of X-rays in 1895 was an important development in the history of medicine.
questions.explanation: discovery 意为“发现（原本存在的事物）”，X 射线本就存在，1895 年被发现；invention 发明（原本不存在的东西），arrival 到达，origin 起源。全句译：1895 年 X 射线的发现是医学史上的一个重要进展。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Make sure that you _________ that present carefully or it may get damaged in the post.
questions.explanation: wrap 意为“包裹”，wrap the present carefully 即仔细把礼物包好以免损坏；fold 折叠，enclose（随函）附寄，close 关闭。全句译：务必把礼物仔细包好，否则邮寄时可能会损坏。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We were given a lot of information at the beginning of the course, but I'm afraid I didn't _________ very well.
questions.explanation: take in 意为“理解、吸收（信息）”；take up 开始从事，take on 承担，take over 接管。全句译：课程开始时给了我们大量信息，恐怕我没很好地消化。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Thousands of _________stood up to pay tribute to the outstanding performance of the football team.
questions.explanation: spectators 指观看比赛、表演的观众，可与 thousands of 连用；audience 是集体名词，不能说 thousands of audience；viewers 指电视观众，sightseers 指观光客。全句译：数千观众起立，向这支足球队的出色表现致敬。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I'm sorry to let you _________.
questions.explanation: let sb down 意为“让某人失望”，是固定搭配；let off 放过、燃放，let out 放出、泄露，let in 放进。全句译：很抱歉让你失望了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The examiner looked at me so _________that I didn't feel nervous.
questions.explanation: kindly 意为“和善地”，考官如此和善我才不紧张；coldly 冷冰冰地与句意相反；lovely 是形容词不能修饰动词，well 不表此处的态度。全句译：考官看我的神情如此和善，我一点儿也不紧张。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: As far as _________, October is the best time for our holiday.
questions.explanation: as far as I'm concerned 意为“就我而言”，是固定表达；I see 须说 as far as I can see，I think 不与 as far as 连用，it goes 不成立。全句译：就我而言，十月是我们度假的最佳时间。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After climbing the top of the mountain, we all _________for air.
questions.explanation: gasp for air（breath）意为“大口喘气”，登顶后 gasped for air 贴切；breathed 泛指呼吸，took、grasped 不与 for air 搭配。全句译：爬上山顶后，我们都大口喘着气。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He was so________ that he believed whatever he was told.
questions.explanation: credulous 意为“轻信的”，与“别人说什么他都信”呼应；incredulous 不轻信的，credible 可信的（修饰事物），incredible 难以置信的。全句译：他太轻信了，别人说什么他都信。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Milk of this kind doesn't seem to________ my baby.
questions.explanation: agree with 意为“（食物、气候等）适合（某人）”；suit 适合（衣服、时间），fit 合身，match 匹配，均不表示食物适合体质。全句译：这种牛奶似乎不适合我的宝宝。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Parents and teachers should work together to________ students' lives.
questions.explanation: shape 意为“塑造”，shape students' lives 即塑造学生的生活；effect 作动词意为“实现、引起”，make 不搭配，influence 泛指影响，不如 shape 贴切。全句译：家长和老师应共同努力去塑造学生的生活。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We would like to________ you in this research project.
questions.explanation: involve sb in sth 意为“使某人参与某事”；call on 号召、拜访（人），call at 拜访（地点），draw 不构成此搭配。全句译：我们愿意请你参与这项研究项目。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There is always a(n) ________ smile on his face.
questions.explanation: sickly 意为“病态的、苍白的”，sickly smile 即病态的笑；sick 作定语指“生病的”，diseased 指患病的（器官、组织），ill 一般只作表语。全句译：他脸上总挂着一丝病态的笑。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He promised that he would________ at least two hours on his English study every day.
questions.explanation: put in 意为“投入（时间、精力）”，put in two hours 即投入两小时；put down 放下、记下，put on 穿上、增加，put away 收好。全句译：他承诺每天至少投入两小时学英语。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Michael________ wild when he went shopping in town for the first time.
questions.explanation: run wild 意为“撒欢、变得放纵无拘”，是固定搭配；go wild 多指“发疯、狂怒”，became、grew 不及 run wild 地道。全句译：迈克尔第一次进城购物时撒了欢儿。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There's so much variety of goods in the shops that you don't have to________ the second best.
questions.explanation: make do with 意为“将就、凑合使用”；choose 后不接 the second best 表将就，do with 意为“处置、忍受”，make with 非固定搭配。全句译：商店里商品种类繁多，你不必将就次优的选择。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The math teacher is the only one she looks________.
questions.explanation: look up to sb 意为“尊敬、敬仰某人”；look for 寻找，look up 查阅，look upon 看作（须与 as 连用）。全句译：数学老师是她唯一敬仰的人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The two outlaws were so carried________ in the spelling game that they forgot why they were there.
questions.explanation: be/get carried away 意为“玩得忘乎所以、入迷”；carried off 拿走，carried out 执行，carried over 延续下来。全句译：这两个歹徒玩拼写游戏玩得忘乎所以，忘了自己为何在那儿。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It was clear to everyone that my father indulged________ the do-it-yourself game.
questions.explanation: indulge in sth 意为“沉溺于、纵情于”，是固定搭配，不与 on、for 搭配。全句译：大家都清楚，我父亲沉迷于自己动手（DIY）的游戏。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The birth of Tony Blair's fourth son was truly________, the first time in 152 years that a British Prime Minister has fathered a child while in office.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 B。historic 意为“具有历史意义的”，与“152 年来英国首相首次在职添子”这一历史性事件呼应；historical 意为“与历史有关的”，historically 是副词，history 是名词，均不合语法或语义。全句译：托尼·布莱尔第四个儿子的出生确有历史意义，是 152 年来英国在职首相首次添子。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Those who lost their husbands during World War II were________ war widows.
questions.explanation: be spoken of as 意为“被称为”，选项中只有它自带介词 as，可接补足语 war widows；call、name 是及物动词须直接接宾语，referred to 缺少 as 不完整。全句译：二战中失去丈夫的那些妇女被称为“战争寡妇”。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In China a young person comes of________ on his/her 18`h birthday.
questions.explanation: come of age 意为“成年、达到法定年龄”，是固定搭配；adult、year、growth 不构成此短语。全句译：在中国，年满 18 周岁即为成年。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Faced with so many competitive rivals, he felt his business was________ to failure.
questions.explanation: be doomed to failure 意为“注定失败”，是固定搭配；due to 表“由于”，result 需说 result in，likely 需说 likely to fail 且语义不符。全句译：面对这么多强劲的对手，他感觉自己的生意注定要失败。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Many students set________ three hours a day to learn English.
questions.explanation: set aside 意为“留出（时间、金钱）”；set off 出发、引爆，set out 出发、着手，set on 袭击。全句译：许多学生每天留出三小时来学英语。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The new bridge will be designed in________ with the international standards.
questions.explanation: in line with 意为“与……一致、符合”，in line with international standards 即符合国际标准；in relation to 关于，in addition to 除……之外，degree 不构成此搭配。全句译：这座新大桥将按照国际标准来设计。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He is always committed________ his work.
questions.explanation: be committed to 意为“致力于、献身于”，to 是介词；不与 in、of、on 搭配。全句译：他总是全身心投入工作。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Do you think that the students will________ from this method of teaching?
questions.explanation: benefit from 意为“从……中受益”，是固定搭配；interest、value、advantage 不能在此处作动词。全句译：你认为学生们会从这种教学方法中受益吗？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You should ask your son to________ from bad company.
questions.explanation: keep from 意为“避开、远离”，keep from bad company 即远离坏伙伴；run from 表“从……逃跑”，work、manage 不搭配。全句译：你应该让儿子远离坏伙伴。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She has reached the________ of her patience.
questions.explanation: reach the limit of one's patience 意为“达到耐心的极限”，是惯用搭配；top、peak 指顶点、顶峰，degree 指程度，均不合语境。全句译：她的耐心已经达到极限。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________ of danger, he jumped into the river all at once.
questions.explanation: regardless of 意为“不顾、不管”，regardless of danger 即不顾危险跳河；because of 表原因（跳河并非因为危险），in terms of 就……而言，instead of 而不是。全句译：他不顾危险，立刻跳进了河里。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He took the side of the argument, which was out of our expectation.
questions.explanation: reverse 意为“相反的”，the reverse side of the argument 即论点的对立面，与“出乎我们意料”呼应；next 下一个，different 搭配生硬，another 须接单数泛指名词。全句译：他站在了论点的对立面，这出乎我们的意料。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I didn't want to get involved in the argument, so I held________ my tongue when asked about my opinion.
questions.explanation: 本句考习语 hold one's tongue（保持沉默、不开口），选项按原答案取 up；on、in、off 与 tongue 均无固定搭配。全句译：我不想卷入争论，所以被问到看法时我保持了沉默。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A skillful reader is________ to what is implied in the text.
questions.explanation: be alert to 意为“对……警觉、敏锐”，alert to what is implied 即对文中言外之意很敏锐；intensive 密集的，allergic 过敏的，vigilant 多指提防危险。全句译：善于阅读的人对文章的言外之意很敏锐。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He often________ fun at his deskmate, who is undersized.
questions.explanation: poke fun at sb 意为“取笑某人”，是固定搭配；make fun of 才用 of，cause、show 不与 fun at 搭配。全句译：他经常取笑他那身材矮小的同桌。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Call me when you get and I'll pick you up at your work place.
questions.explanation: get off 意为“下班”，when you get off 即“你下班的时候”；get from、get down、get over 无“下班”之义。全句译：你下班时给我打电话，我会去你工作的地方接你。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The water supply will give________ at the end of this week.
questions.explanation: give out 意为“用尽、耗尽”，the water supply will give out 即供水将耗尽；give off 散发（气味），give in 屈服，give away 泄露、赠送。全句译：到本周末供水就要耗尽了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Sorry, I can't bring ________any proof of my story.
questions.explanation: bring forward 意为“提出（证据、论据、建议）”，can't bring forward any proof 即拿不出任何证据；bring on 引起，bring up 抚养、提出话题，bring about 导致。全句译：抱歉，我拿不出证据来证明我的说法。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Many students perfect themselves by learning French, Japanese and________ like.
questions.explanation: and the like 意为“……之类、诸如此类”，是固定表达；those、such、the other 不构成此短语。全句译：许多学生通过学习法语、日语等来完善自己。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The workers were on strike, ________ higher pay and better working conditions.
questions.explanation: demand 意为“（坚决）要求”，可直接接宾语 demanding higher pay；require 多指规定所需，persist 须接 in doing，insist 须接 on 或从句。全句译：工人们正在罢工，要求提高工资并改善工作条件。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She is a filial daughter and________ over all of her money to her parents every month.
questions.explanation: turn over...to 意为“把……移交、上交（某人）”，turns over all of her money to her parents 即每月把钱都交给父母；makes、puts 不构成此义。全句译：她很孝顺，每月把全部钱都交给父母。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The writer________ good with evil in his book.
questions.explanation: contrast A with B 意为“把 A 与 B 对照”，强调对比差异，contrast good with evil 即把善与恶作对照；compare...with 侧重比较异同，differ 须说 differ from，vary 指变化。全句译：这位作家在书中把善与恶进行了对照。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We have to adjust ourselves________ all kinds of situations.
questions.explanation: adjust oneself to 意为“使自己适应……”，to 是介词；不与 on、in、towards 搭配。全句译：我们必须使自己适应各种各样的情况。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I wonder how this place has________ for a four-star hotel.
questions.explanation: pass for 意为“被当作、被认为（是）”，has passed for a four-star hotel 即被认定为四星级酒店；go、settle、take 不构成此义。全句译：真不知道这个地方是怎么被当成四星级酒店的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They sent him to hospital as soon as he________ out on the ground.
questions.explanation: pass out 意为“昏倒、失去知觉”，与“立即送医院”呼应；fall out 掉落、闹翻，drop out 退出，dragged 不搭配。全句译：他一在操场上昏倒，人们就立刻把他送进了医院。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She has been ill for a month, which set her________ in her studies.
questions.explanation: set back 意为“使延误、使受挫”，set her back in her studies 即使她学业耽误；set off 出发，set down 记下，set in（坏天气）开始。全句译：她病了一个月，这使她的学业耽误了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Though he is not very rich, he always sets________ some money to help the homeless.
questions.explanation: set aside 意为“留出、拨出（金钱）”，sets aside some money 即留出一些钱；set back 阻碍，set in 开始，set on 袭击。全句译：他虽然不富裕，却总是留出一些钱帮助无家可归的人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The magazines and newspapers were________ with stories about her private life.
questions.explanation: be flooded with 意为“被……大量充斥”，flooded with stories 即登满了报道；packed、stuffed、loaded 多指塞满实物，不如 flooded with 贴切。全句译：杂志和报纸上登满了关于她私生活的报道。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: During his stay in Japan, he________ some Japanese habits.
questions.explanation: pick up 意为“（非正式地、无意中）学会、染上”，picked up some Japanese habits 即染上了些日本习惯；learned 多指学得知识技能，earned 挣得，had 不搭配。全句译：在日本逗留期间，他染上了一些日本习惯。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I know an excellent engineer, John________, who works for a famous American company.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 A。“人名 + by name”是固定表达，意为“名叫……的”，作同位补充说明；with name、the name、as name 均非固定搭配。全句译：我认识一位名叫约翰的优秀工程师，他在一家著名的美国公司工作。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________ cultural conflicts are more serious than language problems.
questions.explanation: at times 意为“有时、偶尔”；for times 不成立，some times 意为“几次”，sometime 意为“（过去或将来）某个时候”。全句译：有时候，文化冲突比语言问题更严重。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Her parents don't________ her boy friend, who is 15 years older than she.
questions.explanation: approve of 意为“赞成、认可”，approve 作不及物动词须加 of；approve 作及物动词意为“批准”；agree with 同意（人、观点），agree on 就……达成一致。全句译：她父母不赞成她的男朋友，他比她大 15 岁。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We will try to________ those small conflicts before they come.
questions.explanation: smooth over 意为“平息、化解（冲突、分歧）”，smooth over those small conflicts 即化解小冲突；get through 通过、接通，get over 克服（困难），pass 不搭配。全句译：我们会在那些小冲突出现之前设法把它们化解掉。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The government has this application.
questions.explanation: approve 作及物动词意为“批准、核准”，has approved this application 即已批准这项申请；agree with 接人或观点，approve of 表“赞成”且不及物，accept 接受，正式公文用 approve。全句译：政府已经批准了这项申请。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is _______ that the opinions of students from different backgrounds converge.
questions.explanation: It is here that... 构成强调句型 It is + 被强调部分 + that...，此处强调地点副词 here，意为“正是在这里”；from/in this point 搭配不成立，at this point 意为“在此时、在这一点上”，与“观点汇聚于一处”的地点语义不符。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We should________ high standard for our kids.
questions.explanation: set high standards 意为“设定高标准”，set 与 standards 是惯用搭配；settle、put、place 不与 standards 搭配表此义。全句译：我们应该为孩子们设定高标准。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She is always________ to helping the needy.
questions.explanation: be committed to 意为“致力于”，to 是介词，后接 helping；ready、willing 须接 to do，like 不搭配。全句译：她一直致力于帮助贫困的人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The________ of Confucianism have a profound influence on Chinese society.
questions.explanation: teachings 意为“学说、教诲”，the teachings of Confucianism 即儒家学说；sayings 指格言、俗语，instructions 指指示、说明，dogma 指教条（贬义）。全句译：儒家学说对中国社会有着深远的影响。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She loves her________ city, which she regards as her second hometown.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 B。adopted 意为“（移居后）认定的、选定的”，her adopted city 即她认定的城市，与 second hometown 呼应；adapted 意为“适应的”，temporary 意为“暂时的”，与“第二故乡”语义矛盾，addicted 上瘾的。全句译：她热爱自己认定的这座城市，把它视为第二故乡。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is suggested that children should________ the problems of real life as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: be exposed to 意为“接触、面对”，be exposed to the problems of real life 即尽早接触现实生活的问题；tackle 是及物动词不加 with，compromise 妥协，encounter 表“遭遇”不如 exposed to 贴切。全句译：建议孩子们尽早接触现实生活中的问题。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Her illness________ our plan for the party.
questions.explanation: block 意为“阻塞、妨碍”，blocked our plan 即妨碍了我们的计划；prevent 须说 prevent sb（from）doing，call for 需要、号召，revoke 撤销（法令、决定）。全句译：她的病打乱了我们聚会的计划。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He________ my anger and held back what he had said.
questions.explanation: sense 意为“觉察、感觉到”，sensed my anger 即察觉到我的怒气，于是把话咽了回去；realize 指明白道理，know 知道，discover 发现事实，均不如 sense 贴切。全句译：他察觉到我的怒气，把要说的话咽了回去。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The boring lecture________ me off.
questions.explanation: turn sb off 意为“使某人厌烦”，The boring lecture turned me off 即乏味的讲座让我提不起兴趣；get sb off 让某人脱身，let sb off 宽恕，made 须接补语。全句译：这场乏味的讲座让我倒了胃口。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It's a good suggestion and a new one________.
questions.explanation: at that 意为“而且、况且”（口语补充语气），a new one at that 即“而且还是个新的”；also 位置不当，anyway 表无论如何，so on 须说 and so on。全句译：这是个好建议，而且还是个新的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He________ to a quiet village after his failure in the election campaign.
questions.explanation: retreat 意为“撤退、退居”，retreated to a quiet village 即竞选失败后退居安静的村庄；flee 强调仓皇逃走，disappear 消失，reverse 逆转。全句译：竞选失利后，他退居到一个安静的村庄。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: People must be________ to the responsibility to their own nation.
questions.explanation: be awakened to 意为“被唤醒而意识到”，awaken to the responsibility 即唤醒责任意识；wake 表“叫醒”不接 to 表觉悟，realize、known 不用于此被动搭配。全句译：人们必须被唤醒，意识到对本民族的责任。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His suggestion was approved by a(n) ________ majority in the company.
questions.explanation: an overwhelming majority 意为“压倒性多数”，是固定搭配；countless 数不清的，many、unlimited 不修饰 majority 表此义。全句译：他的建议在公司内以压倒性多数获得通过。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is not an easy job for the teacher to________ the books because there are 100 students in this class.
questions.explanation: distribute 意为“分发、分配”，distribute the books 即把书分发给一百名学生；pass 须说 pass out，send 寄送，disperse 驱散。全句译：班上有一百名学生，老师要分发这些书可不容易。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A headache is an________ pain.
questions.explanation: internal 意为“内部的”，internal pain 即体内疼痛，与 external（外部的）相对；inside 是口语用词，inherent 意为“固有的”。全句译：头痛是一种体内疼痛。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: May likes________ life. She quitted her job when she became a mother and devoted herself to the baby.
questions.explanation: domestic 意为“家庭的、家务的”，domestic life 即家庭生活，与辞职照顾宝宝呼应；internal 内部的，ordinary 普通的，popular 流行的。全句译：梅喜欢家庭生活，当了母亲后她辞去工作，专心照顾宝宝。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: During an economic crisis, jobs are hard to________ by.
questions.explanation: come by 意为“得到、获得”，hard to come by 即难以获得，是固定搭配；pass by 经过，get by 勉强度日，gain 不接 by。全句译：经济危机期间，工作很难找到。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The police tried to hold the journalists________ when the President came out of the car.
questions.explanation: hold back 意为“阻拦、拦住”，hold the journalists back 即把记者们拦住；hold on 等一下，hold off 推迟、保持距离，hold in 抑制（情绪）。全句译：总统下车时，警察设法把记者们拦住。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She is so satisfied with her present job that she hasn't intended to________ about finding another one.
questions.explanation: go about（doing sth）意为“着手做、忙于做”，go about finding another one 即着手另找工作；search 须接 for，start about 不成立，wander 漫游。全句译：她对现在的工作非常满意，没打算着手另找一份。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A multifaceted manager should not only understand the world of business, but also be________ to the employees' needs and feelings.
questions.explanation: be sensitive to 意为“对……敏感、体察”，sensitive to the employees' needs 即体察员工的需求；sensible 明智的，susceptible 易受影响的（多指负面），suspensive 悬而未决的。全句译：一位全面的管理者不仅要懂商业，还要体察员工的需求与感受。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She has________ hobbies, such as skiing and swimming.
questions.explanation: diverse 意为“多种多样的、互不相同的”，diverse hobbies 即互不相同的爱好；reversed 颠倒的，varied 强调多变，changeable 易变的。全句译：她有各种各样的爱好，比如滑雪和游泳。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They are________ the causes of the accident.
questions.explanation: probe 意为“探查、深入调查”，probing the causes 即深入调查事故原因；search 须接 for，seek 寻求具体目标，ransack 翻遍搜寻。全句译：他们正在深入调查事故的原因。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Jack is considered an eccentric as he________ social conventions.
questions.explanation: disregard 意为“无视、不顾”，disregard social conventions 即无视社会习俗，因此被视为古怪；neglect 疏忽（该做的没做），overlook 忽略（没注意到），despise 鄙视。全句译：杰克无视社会习俗，被视为怪人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Laughing at him is a (n) ________ because he is the headmaster's son.
questions.explanation: blunder 意为“大错、愚蠢之错”，嘲笑校长之子是会带来严重后果的蠢错；mistake、error 泛指一般错误，fallacy 指观点上的谬误。全句译：嘲笑他是犯了大错，因为他是校长的儿子。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: How well patients________ with doctors' orders depends on patients' personality.
questions.explanation: comply with 意为“遵守、遵从”，comply with doctors' orders 即遵从医嘱；apply 须说 apply to，approve 须接 of，accept 是及物动词直接接宾语。全句译：病人遵从医嘱的程度取决于病人的性格。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A bird in the hand is worth two in the________.
questions.explanation: 谚语 A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush，意为“一鸟在手胜过二鸟在林”，bush 是固定用词。全句译：一鸟在手胜过二鸟在林。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The best way to________ your vocabulary is to read widely.
questions.explanation: enrich 意为“充实、丰富”，enrich your vocabulary 即丰富词汇；spread 传播，extend 延伸（时间、长度），expand 扩大（规模、体积），与 vocabulary 搭配最贴切的是 enrich。全句译：丰富词汇的最好办法是广泛阅读。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It________ on Helen Keller that everything had a name.
questions.explanation: It dawned on sb that... 意为“某人恍然明白……”，是固定句型；occur 须说 It occurred to sb that，down、hit 不与 on 搭配表此义。全句译：海伦·凯勒恍然明白：万物皆有名称。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Drop________ whenever you have time. You are always welcome.
questions.explanation: drop in 意为“顺便来访、串门”，Drop in whenever you have time 即有空随时来坐坐；drop down 落下，drop off 减少、睡着，drop out 退出。全句译：有空随时来串门，我们随时欢迎你。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You can find his office number in a telephone________.
questions.explanation: directory 意为“（姓名地址、电话）簿”，telephone directory 即电话号码簿；record 记录，operator 话务员，book 泛指书，不如 directory 准确。全句译：你可以在电话号码簿里查到他的办公室电话。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You had better keep him at________ length; he is dishonest.
questions.explanation: keep sb at arm's length 意为“与某人保持距离、避免亲近”，是固定习语；hand's、finger's、leg's 均不构成此习语。全句译：你最好与他保持距离，他不诚实。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Those endowed________ ingenuity and industry had more prospects of survival at that time.
questions.explanation: be endowed with 意为“天生具有、被赋予”，是固定搭配；不与 at、for、on 搭配。全句译：在那个年代，天生聪慧又勤奋的人更有生存的机会。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It was________ the driver's carelessness that the accident happened.
questions.explanation: It was through the driver's carelessness that... 为强调句（强调原因状语），介词 through 表“由于”；because 须接从句或 because of，for、with 不用于此强调原因的搭配。全句译：正是由于司机的疏忽才发生了事故。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I was________ when I learned that they turned down your application.
questions.explanation: regretful 意为“感到遗憾的、懊悔的”，形容人的感受，I was regretful；regret 是动词或名词，regretted 是过去式（此处需形容词作表语），regrettable 意为“令人遗憾的”（修饰事物）。全句译：得知他们拒绝了你的申请，我感到很遗憾。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I was impressed by his highly developed________ of humour.
questions.explanation: a sense of humour 是固定搭配，意为幽默感；idea 指主意，feeling 泛指感觉，emotion 指情绪，均不与 of humour 构成此搭配。句意：他极发达的幽默感给我留下了深刻印象。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There are still some difficulties we must bridge ________ before we can accomplish the task.
questions.explanation: bridge over 意为架桥跨越、克服（困难），bridge over difficulties 为固定搭配；with/on/up 均不与 bridge 搭配出此含义。句意：在完成这项任务之前，我们还有一些必须克服的困难。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The sweater is too small for you. Don't try to put it on or you'll ________it.
questions.explanation: stretch 指把有弹性的东西拉长、撑大，毛衣硬穿会被撑坏；prolong 延长时间，extend 延长（长度、期限），spread 铺开、传播。句意：这件毛衣你穿太小了，别硬穿，否则会把它撑坏。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________from prison last week, he determined to turn over a new leaf.
questions.explanation: be released from prison 意为被释放出狱，与 turn over a new leaf（重新做人）呼应；Escaped 指越狱，Rescued 指获救，Removed 指被移除，均不合语境。句意：上周获释出狱后，他决心重新做人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A ________ diet with plenty of fresh vegetables is said to be good for you.
questions.explanation: varied 意为多种多样的，varied diet 丰富多样的饮食是常用搭配；different 强调彼此不同，changeable 易变的，various 修饰复数名词（various vegetables）。句意：据说含有大量新鲜蔬菜的多样化饮食对你有好处。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Don't blow up that balloon any more or it will ________.
questions.explanation: burst 指内部压力导致的突然爆裂，气球吹太大会爆；break 指外力打破，crack 指出现裂缝，open 指打开。句意：别再吹那个气球了，不然它会爆的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He ________ of the lead for a moment and the dog ran off.
questions.explanation: let go (of) 意为松手、放开，he let go of the lead 他松开了牵狗绳；held 握住不合句意，dropped 须直接接宾语，made loose 非固定表达。句意：他松开狗绳一会儿，狗就跑了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It's forbidden to swim in this part of the river because of the strong ________.
questions.explanation: current 指水流，strong current 水流湍急是禁止游泳的常见原因；waves 波浪，flood 洪水，tide 潮汐。句意：这条河的这一段禁止游泳，因为水流很急。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He was injured in the arm in the accident, but was ________ well.
questions.explanation: otherwise 作副词意为在其他方面，手臂受伤但其他方面还好；elsewhere 在别处，altogether 完全地，nevertheless 然而是连词。句意：他在事故中手臂受了伤，但其他方面都还好。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If he is jealous, he is ________.
questions.explanation: green-eyed 是英语中表嫉妒的固定比喻（green-eyed monster 出自莎士比亚，指嫉妒的化身），其余颜色组合无此含义。句意：如果他爱嫉妒，他就是绿眼睛（善妒）的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A ________ man has been sitting at the gate of the bank for more than an hour.
questions.explanation: 空格修饰名词 man 作前置定语，须构成复合形容词；由形容词/名词加分词构成复合形容词时，第一部分用形容词形式并加连字符，即 suspicious-looking，不能用副词形式 suspiciously。句意：一个面容可疑的男人在银行门口已坐了一个多小时。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We can't be ________ the sufferings of the people in the flood area.
questions.explanation: be indifferent to 对……漠不关心为固定搭配，can't be indifferent to 意为不能漠不关心；winking at 对……睁一只眼闭一只眼，inflicted with 搭配错误（inflict...on），lamenting over 为……悲痛。句意：我们不能对洪灾区人民的苦难漠不关心。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The painting is too expensive. If you beat ________ the price to 50 dollars, I shall buy it.
questions.explanation: beat down the price 意为把价格压低，是讨价还价的固定搭配；beat away/over/under 无此含义。句意：这幅画太贵了，如果你能把价格压到 50 美元，我就买。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: What a ________ it is to hear that I've passed the exam.
questions.explanation: relief 意为宽慰、松一口气，What a relief it is to hear... 听到……真是松了口气；news 为不可数名词不能说 What a news，reward 报酬，release 释放。句意：听说我通过了考试，真是让人松了一口气。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His father used to deal ________ tobacco.
questions.explanation: deal in 意为经营（某类商品），deal in tobacco 经营烟草；deal with 处理、对付，deal out 分发。句意：他父亲过去做烟草生意。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________ learning is a dangerous thing.
questions.explanation: learning 为不可数名词，a little 表肯定含义一点、少许，修饰不可数名词，构成谚语 A little learning is a dangerous thing（一知半解是危险的）；little 表否定几乎没有，A few 修饰可数名词。句意：一知半解的学问是危险的事。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Please lend me a ________ to move this piano, will you?
questions.explanation: lend sb a hand 意为帮某人一把，是固定搭配；force 力量，push 推，shoulder 肩膀，均不构成此含义。句意：请帮我抬一下这架钢琴，好吗？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After earning a degree in creative writing at Carnegie Mellon University in Pittsburgh, Lois ________ a job at the Sentinel Star in Orlando, Fla.
questions.explanation: found a job 意为找到一份工作；apply 须接 for，look 须接 for，did a job 指做某份工作，不如 found 贴切。句意：洛伊斯在匹兹堡的卡内基梅隆大学取得创意写作学位后，在佛罗里达州奥兰多的《哨兵星报》找到了一份工作。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They have ________ a hands-on approach to helping poor children and have launched similar programs to provide school supplies.
questions.explanation: take an approach to doing sth 意为采取……的方法，take a hands-on approach 采取亲身实践的方法；come/go/approve 均不与 approach 搭配。句意：他们采取了帮助贫困儿童的亲身实践方法，并发起了类似的提供学习用品的项目。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Mutual funds are thus best for investors who don't want to take the time to study stocks ________ or who _______ the resources to build a portfolio.
questions.explanation: in detail 意为详细地，固定短语不加 the；lack 为及物动词直接接宾语 the resources，lack in 只用于 be lacking in 结构。句意：共同基金因此最适合那些不想花时间详细研究个股、或缺乏构建投资组合所需资源的人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: As Blair was in Pakistan on the last ________of a south Asian diplomatic tour, India ruled out any immediate talks with Pakistan.
questions.explanation: leg 可指行程中的一段，the last leg of a tour 行程的最后一站是新闻英语常用表达；portion/part 泛指部分，stage 指阶段。句意：当布莱尔在南亚外交之行的最后一站巴基斯坦访问时，印度排除了与巴基斯坦立即谈判的可能性。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A mid-western farm family ________ after federal financial support and protection was withdrawn.
questions.explanation: go bankrupt 是固定搭配，go 加形容词表示状态转变；bankruptcy 为名词不能接在 became 后作表语（became bankruptcy 错误），came broke 与 approached bankrupt 均非正确搭配。句意：联邦财政支持与保护撤销后，中西部的一个农户破产了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: According to a _______ by IKEA, the top five worries keeping people awake at night are fear of aging, personal finance, own weight, career and friends' health.
questions.explanation: according to a survey 意为根据一项调查；summery 拼写错误（摘要应为 summary），statistics 统计数据，sample 样本，均不合语境。句意：根据宜家的一项调查，让人们夜里失眠的前五大担忧是害怕变老、个人财务、自己的体重、事业和朋友健康。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: "________," Kane told the boy, "you'll be a contender for the Olympic team."
questions.explanation: someday（合写）为副词，意为将来某一天，可单独作状语用于对未来的展望；some days 意为几天，是名词短语。句意：总有一天，凯恩对男孩说，你会成为奥运代表队的有力竞争者。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Hotel rooms used to be dictated by the seasons, but today hotels are using "yield management," the same system airlines use to ________ full flights.
questions.explanation: ensure 意为确保，及物动词可直接接宾语 full flights；insure 指投保，sure 是形容词，make sure 后须接从句。句意：酒店房价过去由季节决定，但如今酒店正在使用收益管理，即航空公司用来确保客满的那套系统。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The people who ________ in your life are the ones who care.
questions.explanation: make a difference 意为有重要影响、起作用，是固定搭配；make a distinction 指作区分，cause/bring 不与 difference 构成此含义。句意：在你生命中真正产生影响的，是那些关心你的人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: For many working people, their largest ________ is their ability to produce an income.
questions.explanation: asset 意为资产、宝贵的东西，挣钱能力是最大的资产；access 通道、使用权，accession 就任、获得，estate 房地产。句意：对许多上班族来说，他们最大的资产是挣钱的能力。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If you moonlight, ________ of saving those additional dollars.
questions.explanation: make a point of doing sth 意为特意、务必做某事，是固定搭配；make sure 后须接从句，careful 是形容词，pay attention 后须接 to。句意：如果你兼职，务必把这些额外的钱存起来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Do you know how many glasses of milk it ________ to get your daily calcium?
questions.explanation: It takes + 数量 + to do sth 意为做某事需要……，it 作形式主语指代后面的不定式；requires/needs 的主语应为人，uses 不构成此句型。句意：你知道每天摄取足量的钙需要喝多少杯牛奶吗？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Levels of pesticides and other toxins in fish ________ in commercial ponds tend to be much lower than levels in fish caught recreationally.
questions.explanation: raise 为及物动词意为饲养，fish raised in commercial ponds 指在商业池塘养殖的鱼，raised 作过去分词后置定语表被动；risen 是不及物动词 rise 的过去分词，grown 指种植，produced 指生产。句意：商业池塘养殖的鱼体内杀虫剂及其他毒素的含量，往往远低于休闲垂钓捕获的鱼。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They had been ________ with each other for years before they actually met in Pittsburgh.
questions.explanation: correspond with sb 意为与某人通信，是固定搭配；writing/calling/visiting 与 with each other 搭配均不地道，且语境强调多年未见、靠书信往来。句意：在匹兹堡真正见面之前，他们已通信多年。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
