questions.stem: Has it ________ to you that he might have thought differently?
questions.explanation: It occurred to sb that 意为某人突然想到，是固定句型，Has it occurred to you that 你有没有想到过；known 不用于此结构，dawned 须与 on 连用且不用于疑问句式，happened to sb 指某事发生在某人身上。句意：你是否想到过，他的想法可能不一样？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It suddenly ________ on me that I had turned to the wrong person for help.
questions.explanation: It dawned on sb that 意为某人（突然）明白、意识到，常与 suddenly 连用强调恍然大悟；occurred to 虽搭配正确但 suddenly dawned on me 更贴合此处语感，happened/known 不用于此结构。句意：我突然明白，我求助错了人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You can help ________ your bones by eating foods containing vitamin D, needed for absorption of calcium.
questions.explanation: maintain 意为保持、维持，help maintain your bones 帮助保持骨骼强健；remain 为不及物动词，retain 指保留记忆、水分等，keep 接名词时不如 maintain 贴切。句意：食用含维生素 D 的食物（钙吸收所必需）有助于保持骨骼健康。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The amount of time you spend outdoors ________ your skeleton.
questions.explanation: affect 为动词意为影响；effect 作动词意为促成、实现，作名词才是影响；impairs 削弱、weakens 减弱，语气过于具体负面。句意：你在户外度过的时间会影响你的骨骼。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: During his next race, in the last 100 meters he ________ power and was beaten.
questions.explanation: run out of 意为用完、耗尽，he ran out of power 他体力耗尽；come out of 从……出来，became/went out of 不构成此含义。句意：在下一场比赛的最后 100 米，他体力耗尽，被击败了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Hearing the noise outside, the man went cautiously to the steel-sheathed door, which was ________ by the heavy iron outer grille.
questions.explanation: reinforce 意为加固、加强，钢门由厚重的铁栅栏加固；included 包括，made 制作，prevented 阻止。句意：听到外面的响声，那人小心翼翼地走到包钢门前，这扇门由厚重的铁栅栏加固。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Chris ran into John at a sporting-goods trade show in New York and the two quickly ________ an easy rapport.
questions.explanation: strike up 意为开始建立，strike up a rapport 建立起融洽关系是固定搭配；made up 编造、和解，built up 逐步增强，turned up 出现。句意：克里斯在纽约的体育用品展销会上遇到约翰，两人很快建立起轻松融洽的关系。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In the South such roads are called cow trails because they are ________ by farm equipment and vehicles that plod along at bovine speed.
questions.explanation: frequent 作动词意为常到、常去，这些小路常被农用设备和车辆通行；seen 被看见，taken 被使用（语义弱），occupied 被占用。句意：在南方，这类路被称为牛道，因为常被以牛步速度缓慢前行的农用设备和车辆通行。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: According to people who have been to the park, it is a place with views that will take your breath ________.
questions.explanation: take one's breath away 意为令人惊叹、叹为观止，是固定搭配；off/on/down 均不构成此短语。句意：去过公园的人说，那里的景色美得令人窒息。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He viewed the match in 1998 as a turning ________ in his life.
questions.explanation: turning point 意为转折点，是固定搭配；place/corner/position 不与 turning 构成此含义。句意：他把 1998 年那场比赛视为人生的转折点。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The breakfast at the school cafeteria usually ________ fried eggs, bacon, ham and hash browns.
questions.explanation: consist of 意为由……组成，用主动形式表状态，没有被动式，故 is consisted of 错误；makes up 意为组成（应为 be made up of），including 不能单独作谓语。句意：学校食堂的早餐通常由煎蛋、培根、火腿和土豆煎饼组成。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: One evening as the manager was leaving the store, Susan and Jane expressed their ________ to him about their safety, being two women working alone at night.
questions.explanation: concern 意为担忧，express one's concern about 对……表示担忧；comment 评论，idea 想法，wonder 惊讶。句意：一天晚上经理要离开商店时，苏珊和简向他表达了对安全的担忧，因为她们是两名深夜独自工作的女性。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Group discussions, moderated by the teacher, give young learners important practice in taking ________ and stating one's views.
questions.explanation: take turns 意为轮流，是固定搭配；take shifts 指轮班工作，changes/parts 不与 take 构成轮流之义。句意：由教师主持的小组讨论，让年轻学习者获得了轮流发言和陈述观点的重要练习。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Jim says that he is willing to ________ tomorrow's meeting.
questions.explanation: chair 可作动词意为主持（会议）；preside 须接 over，lead 指领导，take part 须接 in。句意：吉姆说他愿意主持明天的会议。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In all countries it is good manners to behave ________ toward others.
questions.explanation: considerately 意为体贴地，behave considerately toward others 对人体贴周到；considerably 相当地，conscientiously 尽责地，consciously 有意识地。句意：在所有国家，对他人体贴有礼是良好的举止。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: According to research findings, many suicide ________ are impulsive.
questions.explanation: suicide attempt 意为自杀企图，attempt 指尝试做某事；contempts 蔑视，tempts 是动词 tempt（引诱）的误用，trials 指试验、审判。句意：研究结果表明，许多自杀企图都是一时冲动。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Opening remarks constitute a warm-up designed to put you ________ and capture the audience's attention.
questions.explanation: put sb at ease 意为使某人放松、不紧张，是固定搭配；with ease 指轻而易举地，不合此语境，in ease/for ease 非固定搭配。句意：开场白是一种热身，旨在让你放松下来并抓住听众的注意力。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: These guidelines will prove helpful if you are a high-level executive ________a group of managers.
questions.explanation: address sb 意为向……发表讲话；speaking/talking 后须接 to，discussing 意为讨论。句意：如果你是向一群经理讲话的高层管理人员，这些指导原则会对你很有帮助。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The boys discovered that they had much more ________ than their mix-race heritage, including a love of basketball, rap music and computers.
questions.explanation: have...in common 意为有共同之处，是固定搭配，much more in common than... 比……有更多共同点；as the common/commonly/with each other 均不构成此搭配。句意：男孩们发现，除了混血血统，他们还有更多共同点，比如都热爱篮球、说唱音乐和电脑。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A portal is a site that serves as a starting point, typically allowing easy ________ to other sites.
questions.explanation: access 意为通道、进入，easy access to other sites 便于进入其他网站，access to 是固定搭配；asset 资产，reach 作名词指可及范围（搭配为 within reach），way 需说 a way to。句意：门户站是一个充当起点的网站，通常便于进入其他网站。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Typing in all capital letters is poor etiquette, Internet etiquette, because it ________ shouting.
questions.explanation: be equivalent to 意为相当于、等同于，是固定搭配；equal 作及物动词直接接宾语（equals shouting），不作动词时 is equal 后缺 to 不完整，equates 须用于 equate...to/with 结构。句意：全用大写字母打字是不好的网络礼仪，因为它相当于在喊叫。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When my mother saw the school's advertisement in the newspaper, she enrolled my older brother and me for music and literature ________.
questions.explanation: courses 意为课程，enroll sb for music and literature courses 报名音乐文学课程；causes 原因、事业，schools 学校，assignments 作业。句意：当母亲在报纸上看到那所学校的广告时，她为我和哥哥报名了音乐和文学课程。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: To my disappointment, it quickly became obvious that I knew ________ nothing about their world.
questions.explanation: next to nothing 意为几乎没有，是固定短语；nothing 前不用 quite/rather 修饰，however 不搭配。句意：令我失望的是，我很快就明显发现自己对他们的世界几乎一无所知。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Writing has given her a broader ________ on human nature.
questions.explanation: perspective 意为视角、观点，a broader perspective on 对……更宽的视角；prospect 前景，aspect 方面，interpretation 解释。句意：写作使她对人性有了更开阔的视角。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Cars are involved in many accidents, and they ________ heart disease.
questions.explanation: contribute to 意为促成、是……的原因之一；attribute to 意为归因于（应为 be attributed to），tribute to 指向……致敬，result from 意为由……引起（因果方向相反）。句意：汽车造成了许多事故，而且它们还会诱发心脏病。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Most of the workplace accidents resulted from backward infrastructure, loopholes in management and ________ work safety awareness.
questions.explanation: lack of 意为缺乏，lack of work safety awareness 与 infrastructure、loopholes 并列作介词宾语；lacking in 用于 be lacking in，for lack of 意为因缺乏（作状语）。句意：大多数工作场所事故源于基础设施落后、管理漏洞和安全生产意识缺乏。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The Prime Minister said that he would stay in power despite the ________ number of members of parliament quitting his party.
questions.explanation: growing 意为日益增长的，the growing number 不断增长的数目；grown 意为长成的，growth 是名词，increase 不作定语修饰 number（应为 increasing）。句意：首相表示，尽管退出其政党的议员人数不断增加，他仍将继续执政。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The managing director has so far categorically refused to make any ________ in the report.
questions.explanation: make alterations in/to 意为对……作修改；alternatives 指替代方案，views 观点，disagreements 分歧，均不与 make...in the report 构成此含义。句意：总经理到目前为止断然拒绝在报告中作任何修改。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After high school, Joanne went to Detroit to take a job in an auto plant, but could not ________ the routine and confinement.
questions.explanation: endure 意为忍受，endure the routine and confinement 忍受单调的日常与束缚；endow 赋予、捐赠，endear 使受喜爱，endorse 背书、赞同，均为形近干扰。句意：高中毕业后，乔安妮去底特律在一家汽车厂工作，却无法忍受那种单调例行和受束缚的生活。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Make your controlling idea as specific as possible. You can continually ________ the controlling idea to keep yourself on the right track.
questions.explanation: check back to 意为回顾、对照（以保持方向正确）；catch up with 赶上，look up to 尊敬，go in for 从事、爱好。句意：把你的中心思想写得尽可能具体。你可以不断回顾这一中心思想，让自己保持正确方向。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If you are unsure of your legal rights, you'd better check ________ a lawyer.
questions.explanation: check with sb 意为向某人核实、咨询；check out 指核实后离开，check in 指登记入住，check up 须接 on 表调查。句意：如果你不确定自己的法律权利，最好向律师咨询。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: For reasons which are not yet known, the warehouse ________ last Saturday.
questions.explanation: catch fire 意为着火，是固定搭配，fire 前不加冠词；got fire/afire/became fire 均非正确表达。句意：由于原因尚不清楚，仓库上周六着了火。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Because he did a very poor job and came up with bad results, his boss felt that he hadn't ________ his responsibilities.
questions.explanation: live up to 意为不辜负、达到（期望、职责的要求）；put up with 忍受，look forward to 期待，go in for 从事。句意：由于他工作做得差、结果糟糕，老板认为他没有尽到自己的职责。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: WWF's "Living Planet Report 2002" states that humans are currently using over 20 percent more natural ________ than can be regenerated.
questions.explanation: natural resources 意为自然资源，是固定搭配；sources 指信息来源，environment 指环境，elements 指元素、要素。句意：世界自然基金会 2002 年地球生命力报告指出，人类目前消耗的自然资源已超出可再生量的 20% 以上。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The article implies that people have realized the dangers of automobiles. and they are becoming less ________ them.
questions.explanation: be attached to 意为依恋、喜爱，less attached to them 对它们不再那么迷恋；detached from 意为分离、超然（less detached 会与句意矛盾），inclined to 后接动词原形，aware of 意为意识到。句意：文章暗示人们已意识到汽车的危险，对汽车的迷恋正在减弱。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His friend suggested that he should ________ advice from the legal department.
questions.explanation: seek 为及物动词直接接宾语 advice，seek advice from 向……征求意见；seek for/after 中介词多余，seek out 意为找出、搜寻到。句意：他的朋友建议他向法律部门征询意见。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The bad news deprived them ________ the hope that there was a safe and socially approved road to success and happiness.
questions.explanation: deprive sb of sth 意为剥夺某人某物，是固定搭配；from/with/about 均不与 deprive 搭配。句意：这个坏消息剥夺了他们的希望，即存在一条安全且为社会认可的成功幸福之路。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Most of the employees are said to ________ the proposed new training system.
questions.explanation: oppose 为及物动词，直接接宾语 the proposed new training system；object 不及物须接 to，disagree 须接 with，opposite 是介词/形容词。句意：据说大多数员工反对拟议的新培训制度。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: No one at the meeting seemed to ________ to the closing of the old airport.
questions.explanation: 空格后已有介词 to，object to 意为反对，object 作不及物动词正好搭配；oppose 为及物动词可直接接宾语，不能再接 to；opposite/opposed 词性不符（seemed to 后接动词原形）。句意：会上似乎没有人反对关闭旧机场。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Many parents are apparently ________ to the religious education in schools.
questions.explanation: be opposed to 意为反对，are apparently opposed to 系动词后用形容词 opposed；object 是动词原形不符，disagreement 是名词，objected 与 be...to 连用不成立。句意：许多家长显然反对学校开展宗教教育。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In 1998, Jenny ________ divorce, saying that her husband physically and psychologically abused her.
questions.explanation: file for divorce 意为正式提出离婚申请，是固定搭配；filled in for 是 fill（填写）的拼写陷阱且意为顶替，sued for 多指起诉索要（须先有被告宾语），applied 须接 for。句意：1998 年，珍妮提出离婚，称丈夫在身体和心理上虐待她。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: "Physicians," he said, "are more interested in writing ________ and billing patients than caring for and about them."
questions.explanation: write prescriptions 意为开处方，是固定搭配；descriptions 描述，transcriptions 转写，subscriptions 订阅。句意：他说，医生们更热衷于开处方和向病人收费，而不是关心照料病人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The couple bought their son an annual ________ to the tennis club as a birthday gift.
questions.explanation: subscription 意为订阅费、会员费，an annual subscription 年度会员资格；prescription 处方，description 描述，transcription 转写。句意：这对夫妇给儿子买了一份网球俱乐部年度会员资格作为生日礼物。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The graduate students in the English department were told to study the phonetic ________ of the conversations.
questions.explanation: phonetic transcription 意为语音转写、标音；prescriptions 处方，descriptions 描述，subscriptions 订阅。句意：英语系的研究生被要求研究这些对话的语音转写。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: With a new wife, alimony and child support to pay, he struggled to ________.
questions.explanation: make ends meet 意为使收支相抵，是固定习语；take ends meet/manage ends to meet/bring ends to meet 均为错误形式。句意：有了新妻子，还要支付赡养费和子女抚养费，他艰难地维持着收支平衡。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Barnes ________ to involuntary manslaughter, and on May 29, 1981; a judge gave him three years in prison.
questions.explanation: plead guilty to sth 意为对某项罪名认罪，plead 后接形容词 guilty，是最标准的法律用语；pleaded guilt 中接名词错误，admitted guilty 中接形容词错误，admitted guilt 虽可说，但与后文 to involuntary manslaughter 衔接时 plead guilty to 更规范。句意：巴恩斯对过失杀人罪认罪，1981 年 5 月 29 日法官判处他三年监禁。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Money, the lifestyle and respect in the community were what ________ him.
questions.explanation: motivate 意为激励、驱动，金钱、生活方式和社区尊重正是激励他的东西；cause 须接 to do，drove 指驱赶、驱使（常接 to do 或补语），caught 抓住。句意：金钱、生活方式和社区里的尊重正是激励他的东西。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The young man seemed to have few regrets for the damage he had on those closest to him.
questions.explanation: inflict sth on sb 意为使某人遭受伤害等，the damage he had inflicted on... 他给……造成的伤害（题干省略了空格，考查 inflict 的选用，afflict 不与 damage 搭配且须接 with）；conflict 冲突，relied 依靠。句意：这个年轻人对他给最亲近之人造成的伤害几乎没有悔意。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The arguments the writer made in chapter III and chapter VIII obviously ________ with each other.
questions.explanation: conflict with 意为与……冲突，两章论点相互矛盾；inflict/afflict 意为使遭受痛苦，不合句意，contradictory 是形容词不能作谓语。句意：作者在第三章和第八章提出的论点明显相互矛盾。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is a disease which mainly ________ children below the age of 6.
questions.explanation: afflict 意为折磨、侵扰，a disease which afflicts children 一种折磨儿童的疾病；inflicts 须接 on，conflicts 冲突，effects 是名词。句意：这是一种主要侵袭六岁以下儿童的疾病。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I kept her ________ till her parents returned home.
questions.explanation: keep sb company 意为陪伴某人，company 此处为不可数名词，不加冠词；companion 是可数名词意为同伴，不用于此结构。句意：我陪着她直到她父母回家。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Cathy doesn't care what she eats, but she is very ________ about what she wears.
questions.explanation: be particular about 意为对……讲究、挑剔，她对穿着很讲究；caring 关爱的，careless 粗心的，demanding 要求高的，均不构成此搭配。句意：凯茜不在乎吃什么，但对穿什么却非常讲究。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________ his right hand left the railing of the bridge, Buttenhoff knew he'd made a mistake.
questions.explanation: 空格后是完整的主谓结构从句，句意为右手一离开栏杆他就知道自己错了，属于时间状语从句；the instant（以及 the moment/minute）可作连词引导时间状语从句，意为一……就……，相当于 as soon as；Instantly 和 At once 是副词只能作状语，不能引导从句。句意：他的右手一离开桥上的栏杆，巴滕霍夫就知道自己犯了个错误。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He had learned the story of these remarkable women from his mother, and was ________ their courage, passion for life and their inner peace.
questions.explanation: in awe of 意为对……敬畏，他对这些女性的勇气、生活热情和内心宁静心怀敬佩；with bewilderment about/under impression of 搭配不成立，for fear of 意为担心。句意：他从母亲那里听说了这些杰出女性的故事，并对她们的勇气、生活热情和内心宁静深怀敬佩。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Dale said, "I want my parents to be proud of me. I want them to know that what they did for me was not ________.
questions.explanation: in vain 意为徒劳、白费，是固定搭配；for vain 不成立，no use 须用于 it is no use doing 结构，worthy 意为值得的，不合语境。句意：戴尔说，我希望父母为我骄傲，我要让他们知道他们为我付出的一切没有白费。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: On Take Your Daughter to Work Day, I brought my niece to the office with me so she could experience many ________ of being a social worker.
questions.explanation: aspect 意为方面，many aspects of being a social worker 社会工作者工作的许多方面；respects 须用于 in many respects，ideas 想法，reasons 原因。句意：在带女儿上班日，我带侄女去办公室，让她体验社会工作者工作的方方面面。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is common that some young mothers decide to postpone their ________ and look after their kids at home.
questions.explanation: aspiration 意为志向、抱负，postpone their aspirations 搁置抱负；preparations 准备，inspirations 灵感，speculations 推测。句意：常见的情况是，一些年轻妈妈决定推迟自己的抱负，在家照顾孩子。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The government ________ great importance to intellectual property protection.
questions.explanation: attach great importance to 意为高度重视，是固定搭配；puts 须用于 put emphasis on，associates 须接 with，emphasize 为及物动词后不接 to。句意：政府高度重视知识产权保护。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The speaker ________ the importance of adopting a positive attitude towards life.
questions.explanation: stress 及物动词直接接宾语，stress the importance of 强调……的重要性；emphasized on 中介词多余，attached 须用于 attach importance to 结构，pointed 须接 out。句意：演讲者强调了培养积极人生态度的重要性。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: More ________ the issue of business ethics in the context of economic globalization.
questions.explanation: place emphasis on 意为把重点放在……上，其被动式为 emphasis should be placed on，即 More emphasis should be placed on the issue；stress/attention 的固定介词应为 on/to 而非 about/on，efforts 搭配为 make efforts to do。句意：在经济全球化的背景下，应更加重视商业伦理问题。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The investigators ________ the possible consequences of the incident.
questions.explanation: study 及物动词直接接宾语；analyzed/discussed 后介词 about 多余，pointed 须接 out。句意：调查人员研究了这起事件可能造成的后果。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A recent study has shown that the ________ to child care centers, for working mothers, is the all-purpose grandmother, who watches the children and does much of the cleaning, shopping and cooking.
questions.explanation: alternative to 意为……的替代物，全能奶奶是托儿中心的替代选择；option/choice 后接 of 或从句，substitute 须接 for。句意：最近一项研究表明，对职业母亲来说，托儿中心的替代选择是全能奶奶——她照看孩子，还承担大量的清洁、购物和做饭工作。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Please contact the supervisor if you have questions ________ the accommodation on campus.
questions.explanation: concerning 意为关于，是介词，questions concerning the accommodation 关于住宿的问题；concerned 作后置定语须用 concerned with，concerning with 搭配不成立。句意：如果你对校内住宿有疑问，请联系主管。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Some people don't want to get up simply because they don't like the activity that ________ them.
questions.explanation: await 意为等待，the activity that awaits them 等待着他们的活动；stimulates 刺激，irritates 激怒，pleases 取悦。句意：有些人不愿起床，仅仅是因为他们不喜欢那件正等着他们去做的事。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: This article states that Indians have had a hard time ________ their pride because they have had many problems.
questions.explanation: maintain 意为保持，maintain their pride 保持自尊；remain 为不及物动词，detaining 拘留，attaining 获得，均为形近干扰。句意：文章指出，由于经历了许多问题，印第安人一直难以保持自尊。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Color blindness is a genetically-caused condition in which a person cannot detect all colors, and this ________ is more common in men than in women.
questions.explanation: defect 意为天生的缺陷、毛病，指身体机能上的缺陷；fault 指过失、错误，shortcoming 指性格能力上的缺点，disease 指疾病。句意：色盲是一种遗传性状况，患者无法识别全部颜色，而且这种缺陷在男性中比女性更常见。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Barnes was arrested on at least five occasions and spent less than two years at any one time behind ________.
questions.explanation: behind bars 意为在狱中、坐牢，是固定习语；windows/doors 无此搭配，jail 表坐牢应用 in jail。句意：巴恩斯至少被捕过五次，每次在狱中待的时间都不超过两年。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Whether it's pride or delusion, Donald ________ believes he has the skills of a physician.
questions.explanation: genuinely 意为真正地、真诚地；genially 和蔼地，genetically 从基因上，generously 慷慨地，均为形近干扰。句意：无论是出于骄傲还是妄想，唐纳德都真心相信自己具有医生的本领。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Gerald's interest in medicine began as a boy, but he never really ________ medical career.
questions.explanation: pursue 意为从事、追求，pursue a medical career 从事医学职业；take 须用 take up a career，found 指找到、创办，practiced 指行医（practice medicine）。句意：杰拉尔德对医学的兴趣始于孩提时代，但他从未真正追求过医学职业。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Joanne ________ the newspaper for damages after they wrongly described her husband as a drug dealer.
questions.explanation: sue sb for sth 意为因某事起诉某人，sued the newspaper for damages 起诉报社索赔；accused 须接 of，pushed 推，filed 须接 for/against。句意：报纸错误地把她的丈夫描述成毒贩，乔安妮因此起诉该报索赔。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My mother used to ________ to a gardening magazine.
questions.explanation: subscribe to 意为订阅，subscribe to a gardening magazine 订阅园艺杂志；describe 描述，transcribe 转录，prescribe 开处方。句意：我母亲过去订阅一份园艺杂志。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: To his amazement, no one ever bothered to check his bona fides as a druggist, or ________ his credentials as a doctor.
questions.explanation: verify 意为核实、查证，verify his credentials 核实他的资历证书；justify 意为证明正当，prove 指证实，rectify 意为改正。句意：令他惊讶的是，竟然从来没人费心核实过他作为药剂师的身份，或查证过他作为医生的资历证书。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Introducing oneself is an important part of establishing ________ with one's students.
questions.explanation: establish/build (up) rapport with sb 意为与某人建立融洽关系，是固定搭配；agreement 一致，harmony 和谐，connection 联系，均不构成此教学语境的惯用表达。句意：自我介绍是与学生建立融洽关系的重要环节。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Nonverbal communication ________ the information, attitudes, or feelings that we communicate to others without using words.
questions.explanation: refer to 意为指的是；prefers to 意为更喜欢（后接动词原形），defines as 应为 define...as 结构，associates with 应为 associate...with 结构。句意：非语言交际指的是我们不借助词语而向他人传递的信息、态度或情感。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Over many centuries, the Silk and Spice Routes, two of the greatest trade routes in our history, ________ their way across Asia, linking its people and those of Europe.
questions.explanation: wind one's way 意为蜿蜒前进，其过去式为 wound，两条贸易之路蜿蜒穿越亚洲；wounded 意为使受伤，wove 是 weave（编织）的过去式，won 意为赢得。句意：许多世纪以来，丝绸和香料之路这两条历史上最伟大的贸易路线蜿蜒穿过亚洲，将其人民与欧洲人民连接起来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Developments in ship design and construction methods came about in ________ to challenges encountered in trading ever farther afield.
questions.explanation: in response to 意为作为对……的回应，是固定搭配；in awareness to 不成立，in contrast to 意为与……相反，in agreement 须接 with。句意：船舶设计与建造方法的发展，是为了应对在更远的海外贸易中遇到的挑战。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The art of writing has enabled people to make ________ records of their achievements and culture.
questions.explanation: permanent 意为永久的，permanent records 永久性记录；pertinent 意为相关的，prominent 突出的，personal 个人的。句意：书写艺术使人们能够对自己的成就和文化做永久性的记录。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Patiently and persistently, man learned his art by ________, passing on his specialized knowledge over thousands of years by example and word of mouth.
questions.explanation: trial and error 意为反复试验、试错法，是固定习语；其余组合均非固定表达。句意：人类以耐心和毅力通过反复试验学会了技艺，几千年来通过示范和口传心授传递着专门知识。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: China's glass production may have ________ a debt to the West, but in ceramics the situation was reversed.
questions.explanation: owe a debt to 意为受惠于、欠……的情，中国的玻璃制造可能得益于西方；owned 是 own（拥有）的拼写陷阱，paid a debt 指还清债务（与句意不符），become 不与 debt 搭配。句意：中国的玻璃制造可能受惠于西方，但在陶瓷方面情况正好相反。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In many places, illness was seen either as an invasion of the body by some poison or it was ________ to the work of an angry god, malignant magic, or witchcraft.
questions.explanation: be attributed to 意为被归因于，it was attributed to the work of... 它被归因于愤怒之神、恶毒魔法或巫术的作用；contributed 须接 to 表促成，distributed 分发，tributed 无此词。句意：在许多地方，疾病要么被视为某种毒素对身体的入侵，要么被归因于愤怒之神、恶毒魔法或巫术的作为。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If you are ________ on finding a new job or career, the Web is the place to start.
questions.explanation: be bent on doing 意为一心要、决心做某事，是固定搭配；be determined 后接 to do，be eager 后接 to do 或 for，be engaged 后接 in。句意：如果你一心想找份新工作或开创新事业，网络正是起步之处。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A part of the education we seek to ________ at school is that each individual does bear some responsibility for his own choices.
questions.explanation: impart 意为传授、传达（知识），impart education 传授教育；impair 意为损害，inform 通知，impel 驱使，均为形近干扰。句意：我们在学校力求传授的教育之一是：每个人确实要为自己的选择承担一定责任。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When he heard the news, Wold realized that there was a lot more ________ risk than his camping trip.
questions.explanation: at risk 意为处于危险中，是固定搭配，a lot more at risk 面临大得多的风险；off/in/of 不构成此短语。句意：听到消息后，沃尔德意识到所面临的危险比他的野营之行要大得多。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You must insist that students give a truthful answer ________ with the reality of their world.
questions.explanation: consistent with 意为与……一致，是固定搭配，answer consistent with the reality 与现实相符的回答；relevant 须接 to，simultaneous 须接 with，practical 不构成此含义。句意：你必须坚持要求学生给出与他们的现实世界相符的真实回答。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In order to raise money, Aunt Nicola had to ________ with some of her most treasured possessions.
questions.explanation: part with 意为舍弃、放弃（心爱之物），是固定搭配；divide 须接 into，separate 须接 from，abandon 是及物动词直接接宾语不接 with。句意：为了筹钱，尼古拉婶婶不得不舍弃一些她最珍爱的物品。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The car was in good working ________ when I bought it a few months ago.
questions.explanation: in good working order 意为运转状态良好，是固定搭配；in good form 指竞技状态好，state 前须有冠词，circumstance 指境况。句意：几个月前我买这辆车时，它的运转状况良好。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The customer expressed her ________ for that broad hat.
questions.explanation: distaste for 意为对……的厌恶，是固定搭配；disapproval 须接 of，dissatisfaction 须接 with，dismay 意为沮丧。句意：那位顾客表达了她对那顶宽檐帽的厌恶。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In order to repair barns, build fences, grow crops, and care for animals, a farmer must indeed be ________.
questions.explanation: versatile 意为多才多艺的，修理、建造、种植、照看样样能干，正是多面手；restless 意为不安定的，skilled 熟练的，strong 强壮的。句意：为了修谷仓、筑篱笆、种庄稼和照看牲畜，农民确实必须是个多面手。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His expenditure on holidays and luxuries is rather high in ________ to his income.
questions.explanation: in proportion to 意为与……成比例、相对于，是固定搭配；comparison 须接 with，association 须接 with，calculation 意为计算。句意：相对于他的收入而言，他在度假和奢侈品上的开支相当高。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Although he has become rich, he is still very ________ of his money.
questions.explanation: frugal 意为“节俭的”，与 Although he has become rich 的转折语义呼应；economic 意为“经济的、经济学的”，thrifty 节俭的但惯与 with 搭配，careful of 意为“小心……”，均不合题意。句意：虽然他富了，但花钱仍然很节俭。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: As the manager was away on a business trip. I was asked to ________ the weekly staff meeting.
questions.explanation: chair 作及物动词意为“主持（会议）”；preside 不及物，须接 over，introduce 介绍，dominate 支配，均不合句意。句意：经理出差在外，我被要求主持每周的员工例会。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The ________ of the word is unknown, but it is certainly not from Greek.
questions.explanation: origin 意为“起源、来源”，the origin of the word 指这个词的来历；generation 一代、产生，descent 血统、下降，cause 起因，均不合题意。句意：这个词的起源不详，但肯定不是来自希腊语。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She did her best to stay awake, but the performance was so boring that she just ________ to sleep.
questions.explanation: drop off 意为“睡着、打盹”；drop in 顺便来访，drop out 退出、辍学，drop down 落下，均不合句意。句意：她尽力保持清醒，但演出太无聊了，她还是睡着了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Paul was a very lively child, always in ________.
questions.explanation: in high spirits 为固定短语，意为“兴高采烈、情绪高昂”；excellent、good、bright 均不与 in...spirits 构成此惯用搭配。句意：保罗小时候是个活泼的孩子，总是兴高采烈。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Lilly made no attempt to ________ the problem.
questions.explanation: tackle the problem 意为“解决问题”，tackle 与 problem 是惯用搭配；try 后应接 to do，undertake 承担（任务、工程），achieve 达到（目标、成就），均不与 the problem 直接搭配。句意：莉莉没有做任何解决这个问题的尝试。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The boy began to cry and tears slowly ________ down his face.
questions.explanation: trickle 意为“（液体）细细流淌”，tears trickle down his face 形容眼泪缓缓流下；ooze 渗出，dribble 一滴滴地滴落，leak 漏出，均不合语境。句意：男孩哭了起来，眼泪慢慢从脸上流下。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: On January 1', many people make a New Year ________.
questions.explanation: make a New Year's resolution 为固定搭配，resolution 意为“决心”；intention 打算，determination 决心（不构成此短语），dedication 奉献，均不合惯用表达。句意：1月1日，许多人许下新年决心。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In this country it is against the ________ not to wear seat belts in a car.
questions.explanation: against the law 意为“违法”，是固定说法；rule 具体规则，regulation 规章条例，order 命令、秩序，均不如 law 准确。句意：在这个国家，坐车不系安全带是违法的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Johnny's parents always let him have his own ________.
questions.explanation: have one's own way 为固定短语，意为“随心所欲、自行其是”；will、wish、demand 均不构成此搭配。句意：约翰尼的父母总是让他随心所欲。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Our telephone has been ________ for a month.
questions.explanation: out of order 意为“（机器、设备）出故障”；out of line 出格、不成直线，out of touch 失去联系，out of place 不合适、格格不入，均不合句意。句意：我们的电话已经坏了一个月了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She was extremely ________, always ready to agree with other people's wishes.
questions.explanation: adaptable 意为“适应性强的、随和的”，与 always ready to agree with other people's wishes 呼应；mellow 圆润的、成熟的，moderate 温和的，supple 柔韧的，均不合题意。句意：她非常随和，总是乐于顺从别人的意愿。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The woman tripped over the uneven pavement and ________ her elbow.
questions.explanation: dislocate 意为“使（关节）脱臼”，dislocated her elbow 肘部脱臼；distort 使变形，dislodge 移开、逐出，disable 使丧失能力，均不合题意。句意：这位妇女被不平的路面绊倒，肘关节脱臼了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He knew that he couldn't change anything so he just ________ himself to the situation.
questions.explanation: resign oneself to (doing) sth 为固定短语，意为“使自己顺从于、听任”；assign 分派，retire 退休，keep 保持，均不合搭配。句意：他知道自己无法改变什么，便索性听任现状。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Game pie was a(n) ________ of this famous restaurant.
questions.explanation: speciality 意为“特色、招牌（菜）”，a speciality of this restaurant 这家餐馆的特色菜；singularity 奇特，particularity 特殊性，originality 独创性，均不合题意。句意：野味馅饼是这家著名餐馆的特色菜。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Mr. Williamson was acting peculiarly and seemed in a funny ________.
questions.explanation: state of mind 意为“心境、精神状态”，in a funny state of mind 心态有点怪；state of affairs 事态，state of grace 蒙恩状态，state of nature 自然状态，均不合题意。句意：威廉森先生举止反常，看起来心态有点怪。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The scientists became very excited as they felt they were ________ of a discovery.
questions.explanation: on the brink of 为固定短语，意为“濒于、处于……的边缘”，on the brink of a discovery 即将有所发现；on the crest of (a wave) 处于成功的顶峰，on the surface 表面上，on the borderline 处于边界，均不合语境。句意：科学家们非常兴奋，因为他们觉得自己即将有一项发现。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: An ________ degree was conferred on the distinguished economist.
questions.explanation: honorary 意为“（学位等）名誉的”，honorary degree 名誉学位，为惯用搭配；honour 名誉（名词），honoured 受尊敬的，honorable 可敬的、体面的，均不合题意。句意：这位杰出的经济学家被授予了名誉学位。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Mary is very set in her ways, but her brother has a more ________ attitude to life.
questions.explanation: flexible 意为“灵活的”，flexible attitude to life 对生活持灵活态度，与 set in her ways（墨守成规）形成转折；changeable 易变的，changing 正在变化的，variable 多变的，均不合题意。句意：玛丽墨守成规，而她哥哥对生活的态度要灵活得多。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My passport ________ last month, so I will have to get a new one.
questions.explanation: expire 意为“（证件、合同等）到期、失效”，passports expire 护照到期；end 结束，finish 完成，terminate 终止（多指人为终止合同、雇佣），均不合语境。句意：我的护照上个月到期了，所以我得再办一本新的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Your room must be ________ by 12 o'clock, but your luggage may be left with the porter.
questions.explanation: vacate 意为“腾出（房间、座位）”，the room must be vacated 房间必须腾空；evacuate 疏散、撤离（人员），desert 抛弃（职责、军队），abandon 放弃、遗弃，均不合题意。句意：你的房间必须在12点前腾出来，但行李可以交给行李员保管。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My grandma's condition looks very serious and it is doubtful if she will ________.
questions.explanation: pull through 意为“（重病后）康复、渡过难关”；pull up 停车，pull in 进站，pull out 驶出、撤离，均不合语境。句意：我奶奶的病情看起来很重，她能否挺过去还很难说。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The purpose of the survey was to ________ the school inspectors with local school conditions.
questions.explanation: acquaint sb with sth 为固定搭配，意为“使某人熟悉某事”；inform sb of sth，notify sb of sth，instruct sb in sth，介词搭配均与空后的 with 不符。句意：这项调查的目的是让学校督学了解当地学校的情况。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Sam is being ________ for his stomachache at the hospital now.
questions.explanation: be treated for + 疾病为固定搭配，意为“接受……的治疗”，is being treated 现在进行时被动语态正与 now 呼应；cure 治愈（强调结果），heal 愈合（多指伤口），operate 须搭配 on。句意：萨姆现在正在医院接受胃病治疗。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Because of his poor health, it took him a long time to ________ his bad cough.
questions.explanation: throw off 意为“摆脱（疾病）”，throw off a bad cough 摆脱严重的咳嗽；throw away 扔掉，throw down 扔下，throw over 抛弃，均不合句意。句意：由于身体不好，他花了很长时间才治好严重的咳嗽。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: People under 21 are not ________ to join the sports club.
questions.explanation: eligible 意为“有资格的”，be eligible to do sth 有资格做某事；desirable 理想的、可取的，advisable 明智的，admissible（证据等）可采纳的，均不合题意。句意：未满21岁的人没有资格加入这个体育俱乐部。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Though seriously damaged by a fire, the ancient mansion was eventually ________ to its original splendor.
questions.explanation: restore...to... 为固定搭配，意为“把……修复、恢复到……（原状）”，restored to its original splendor 恢复原来的辉煌；repair 修理，renew 更新，renovate 翻新，均不与 to 搭配表达“恢复原貌”。句意：这座古宅虽被大火严重损毁，最终还是恢复了原先的辉煌。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I cannot bear the noise coming from my neighbour's house; it ________ me from my work.
questions.explanation: distract sb from (doing) sth 为固定搭配，意为“使某人分心、转移注意力”；interrupt 打断（动作），disturb 打扰，annoy 使恼怒，均不与 from my work 构成此搭配。句意：我无法忍受邻居家传来的噪音，它使我无法专心工作。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Vincent cannot ________ without at least one pack of cigarettes.
questions.explanation: get through 意为“熬过、度过（一天等）”，cannot get through without at least one pack of cigarettes 没烟就熬不过去；get on 相处、进展，get over 克服（困难）、痊愈，get by 勉强应付，语义均不如 get through 贴切。句意：文森特一天不抽至少一包烟就熬不下去。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In Scotland, minor cases were ________ with a jury in the Sheriff courts.
questions.explanation: try a case 为法律用语，意为“审理案件”，were tried with a jury 由陪审团审理；test 检验，examine 检查，consider 考虑，均不合法律语境。句意：在苏格兰，轻微案件在郡法院由陪审团审理。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Lisa Black is ________ as a Labour candidate in the forthcoming election.
questions.explanation: stand as a candidate 为固定搭配（英式英语），意为“作为候选人参加竞选”；sitting 现任的（a sitting MP），contend 须与 for 搭配，enter 进入，均不合句意。句意：莉萨·布莱克将作为工党候选人参加即将举行的选举。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Eighteen is the ________ voting age in our country.
questions.explanation: minimum 意为“最低的”，minimum voting age 最低投票年龄；minimal 极小的（指量少），competent 胜任的，maximum 最高的，均不合题意。句意：在我国，18岁是最低投票年龄。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Cases involving young people under 18 are heard in specially constituted ________ courts.
questions.explanation: juvenile court 为固定术语，意为“少年法庭”，juvenile 指青少年的；junior 年幼的、资历浅的，youth 多作名词，infantile 幼儿（多含贬义），均非规范用语。句意：涉及18岁以下青少年的案件由专门设立的少年法庭审理。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: According to the latest ________ poll, the Opposition is likely to win the next General Election.
questions.explanation: opinion poll 为固定搭配，意为“民意测验”；inquiry 调查（多接 into），question 问题，impression 印象，均不与 poll 构成搭配。句意：根据最新的民意测验，反对党可能赢得下届大选。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After three hours, the jury was still unable to reach a unanimous ________.
questions.explanation: reach a unanimous verdict 为惯用搭配，verdict 特指陪审团的“裁定”；decision 一般性决定，judgment 法官的判决，conclusion 结论，均不如 verdict 贴切。句意：三个小时过去了，陪审团仍未能达成一致裁决。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A ________ survey was conducted among local families to find out the average amount of expense on their children's education.
questions.explanation: questionnaire 意为“问卷”，a questionnaire survey 问卷调查；representation 代表，referendum 公民投票，question 问题，均不合语境。句意：这项问卷调查在当地家庭中开展，以了解其子女教育支出的平均数额。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A popular way of keeping fit is to go ________ which is a kind of slow- to medium-paced running.
questions.explanation: go jogging 为固定搭配，jogging 意为“慢跑”，与 slow- to medium-paced running（中慢速跑）的定义相符；trot 快步小跑，saunter 漫步，stroll 散步，均不符定义。句意：一种流行的健身方式是慢跑，即一种中慢速的跑步。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Piles of old books and newspapers ________ her desk.
questions.explanation: litter 意为“（杂物）乱扔、使凌乱”，litter her desk 把她的书桌弄得乱七八糟；spread 铺开，heap 堆积（多与 up 连用），scatter 撒（多与 on/over 连用），均不如 litter 贴切。句意：成堆的旧书旧报纸把她书桌弄得乱七八糟。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Exercising generally begins with standing up straight, ________ slowly and then letting your breath out evenly.
questions.explanation: inhale 意为“吸气”，与后文 letting your breath out（呼气）逻辑呼应；exhale 呼气（与后文重复），draw 不单独表呼吸，puff 喘气，均不合逻辑。句意：锻炼一般从站直开始，先慢慢吸气，然后均匀地呼气。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The woman remained depressingly fat ________ all her efforts to slim.
questions.explanation: despite 是介词，后直接接名词短语 all her efforts；although 是连词，须接从句；against 表“反对”，contrary 须与 to 连用，均不合语法。句意：尽管这位妇女努力减肥，她还是胖得令人沮丧。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Many Asian people are of ________ build while Europeans often have a heavier frame.
questions.explanation: of slim build 为固定搭配，意为“体形苗条”，与 Europeans often have a heavier frame 形成对比；slight 瘦小的，lean 精瘦的，thin 瘦的，均不如 slim 贴切。句意：许多亚洲人体形苗条，而欧洲人的骨架往往更壮实。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The pupil ________ a story to explain why he was absent from school.
questions.explanation: invent a story 为惯用搭配，invent 意为“编造（借口、故事）”；develop 发展，describe 描述，outline 概述，均不合“编瞎话解释旷课”的语境。句意：那个小学生编造了一个说法来解释他为什么没来上学。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There are ________ that the weather is changing in the region.
questions.explanation: indication 意为“迹象”，there are indications that...（有迹象表明……）为惯用表达；associations 协会、联系，comments 评论（后接 on），concerns 担忧，均不合语境。句意：有迹象表明该地区的天气正在变化。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is an encouraging sign that people's purchasing power is ________ the rise recently.
questions.explanation: on the rise 为固定短语，意为“在上升、不断增长”；in、at、with 均不与 the rise 构成此搭配。句意：人们的购买力近来不断上升，这是一个令人鼓舞的迹象。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The speaker had no ________ in himself when facing a large audience.
questions.explanation: have confidence in oneself 为固定搭配，意为“对自己有信心”；experience 经验，progress 进展，objection 反对（后接 to），均不合句意。句意：这位演讲者面对众多听众时对自己毫无信心。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The man drew the curtain and ________ the painting behind it.
questions.explanation: reveal 意为“使显露、展现”，拉开窗帘露出后面的画用 reveal；expose 暴露、揭露（多含揭发之意），project 投射，bring 带来，均不合题意。句意：那个人拉开窗帘，露出了后面的画。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The football club tried to ________ the famous player with a generous offer of money.
questions.explanation: tempt sb with sth 为固定搭配，意为“以……引诱、吸引某人”；promote 提升，defend 保卫，force 强迫（force sb to do），均不合搭配。句意：这家足球俱乐部试图用优厚的报酬吸引那位著名球员。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Cindy ________ some sweets from her bag and insisted they be shared among her friends.
questions.explanation: produce 可表“（出人意料地）拿出、出示”，produced some sweets from her bag 从包里掏出糖果；distribute 分发（与下文 insisted they be shared 重复），pull 拉，draw 拖、吸引，均不合习惯用法。句意：辛迪从包里掏出一些糖果，坚持要和朋友们分享。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Not a ________ has been found so far that can help the police find the robber.
questions.explanation: clue 意为“（破案的）线索”，能帮警察找到抢劫犯的应是线索；fact 事实，mark 记号、痕迹，sign 迹象、标志，均不合题意。句意：到目前为止还没有找到任何能帮助警察找到抢劫犯的线索。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She is a teacher ________ of our great respect.
questions.explanation: worthy of 为固定搭配，a teacher worthy of our great respect 一位值得我们敬重的老师；aware of 意识到，confident of 对……有信心，capable of 有能力做，均不合句意。句意：她是一位值得我们十分敬重的老师。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They had ________ it for granted that they would succeed in their research.
questions.explanation: take it for granted (that)... 为固定搭配，意为“认为……理所当然”，此处用过去完成时 had taken it for granted。句意：他们想当然地认为自己会在研究中取得成功。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The final cost was considerably higher than the builder's original ________.
questions.explanation: estimate 意为“估算、估计”，the builder's original estimate 建筑商最初的估算；amount 总额，sum 金额，account 账目，均不合语境。句意：最终造价大大高于建筑商最初的估算。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He couldn't tell ________ from a distance whether it was Sam or his brother.
questions.explanation: for sure 为固定短语，意为“确切地、有把握地”，couldn't tell for sure 无法确切判断；at large 逍遥法外、整体，in name 名义上，in short 简而言之，均不合句意。句意：他从远处无法确定那到底是萨姆还是他弟弟。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: No matter how much progress we've made in our work, we shouldn't get ________.
questions.explanation: complacent 意为“自满的”，get complacent 变得自满，与“无论取得多少进步都不该……”的告诫呼应；perfect 完美，satisfactory 令人满意的，fortunate 幸运的，均不合语境。句意：无论工作中取得了多少进步，我们都不该自满。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The ________ instrument requires a skilled operator.
questions.explanation: intricate 意为“复杂精细的”，intricate instrument 结构复杂的仪器，与 requires a skilled operator 呼应；artificial 人工的，fashionable 时尚的，difficult 困难的（多修饰任务而非器物），均不合题意。句意：这种复杂的仪器需要熟练的操作人员。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We should ________ all possible ways to create jobs for the unemployed.
questions.explanation: explore ways (to do sth) 为惯用搭配，意为“探索……的途径”；provide 提供，review 回顾，make 不与 ways 构成此搭配，均不合句意。句意：我们应探索一切可能的途径，为失业者创造就业岗位。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The coupon ________ you to a free meal in our new restaurant.
questions.explanation: entitle sb to sth 为固定搭配，意为“使某人有资格获得某物”；confers 须接 on，grants sb sth、offers sb sth 均不带 to，与空后的 to 不符。句意：这张优惠券可让您在我们的新餐厅免费享用一餐。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The old woman opened the box and emptied the ________ into a jar.
questions.explanation: contents 意为“（容器内的）内装之物”，emptied the contents into a jar 把盒中之物倒进罐子；insides 内脏，interior 内部（空间本身），refills 替换装，均不合题意。句意：老太太打开盒子，把里面的东西倒进一个罐子里。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: At the weekend, all the local TV channels provide extensive ________ of sporting events.
questions.explanation: coverage 意为“（新闻）报道”，provide extensive coverage of sporting events 对体育赛事作大量报道；view 观看、观点，broadcast 广播节目，network 网络，均不合搭配。句意：周末，当地所有电视频道都对体育赛事作了大量报道。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In order not to be heard, the woman ________ that someone was moving about in the bush.
questions.explanation: whisper 意为“低语、耳语”，与 In order not to be heard（为了不被人听见）呼应；scream 尖叫，shout 喊叫，speak 说话，均不合逻辑。句意：为了不让人听见，那个女人低声说有人正在灌木丛里走动。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The appeal to the senses known as ________ is a common technique in poetry.
questions.explanation: imagery 意为“意象、形象化描述”，是名词，known as 后须接名词；imaginative 富于想象力的，imaginable 可想象的，ingenious 巧妙的，均为形容词，不合句子结构。句意：诗歌中诉诸感官的“意象”手法是一种常见技巧。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The possibility that the explosion was caused by sabotage cannot be ________.
questions.explanation: rule out 意为“排除”，cannot be ruled out 不能被排除；cancel out 抵消，wipe out 消灭，broken bout 非固定搭配，均不合题意。句意：不能排除这次爆炸是蓄意破坏造成的可能性。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The headquarters of this oil company is in London while its ________ companies are located in different parts of the world.
questions.explanation: subsidiary company 为固定搭配，意为“子公司”，与 headquarters（总部）相对；parent company 母公司（语义相反），inferior 较差的，ultimate 最终的，均不合题意。句意：这家石油公司的总部设在伦敦，而其子公司分布在世界各地。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Sitting on the table, two small cats were ________ round the inside of the empty ham tin.
questions.explanation: lick 意为“舔”，lick round the inside of the empty ham tin 舔空罐头内壁；swallow 吞咽，chew 咀嚼，munch 大口嚼，空罐头内壁只能“舔”。句意：两只小猫坐在桌上，绕着空火腿罐头的内壁舔舐。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The Renaissance was a (n) ________ of unparalleled cultural achievement and had a great impact on almost all European countries.
questions.explanation: epoch 意为“时代、纪元”，指历史上具有重大意义的时期，文艺复兴正是一个时代；moment 时刻，dynasty 王朝，instant 瞬间，均不合题意。句意：文艺复兴是一个文化成就空前辉煌的时代，对几乎所有欧洲国家都产生了巨大影响。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Absorbed in her work, she was totally ________ her surroundings.
questions.explanation: be oblivious of/to 为固定搭配，意为“没察觉到、浑然不觉”，与 Absorbed in her work 呼应；liable for 对……负法律责任，separated by 由……隔开，concerned about 担心，均不合句意。句意：她埋头工作，对周围的一切浑然不觉。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The young man has ________ some brilliant scheme to double his income.
questions.explanation: come up with 意为“想出、提出（计划、办法）”，come up with a brilliant scheme 想出绝妙方案；come out 出版，come to 苏醒、共计，come about 发生，均不合句意。句意：这个年轻人想出了一个使自己收入翻倍的绝妙方案。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Social ________ vary greatly from country to country.
questions.explanation: customs 意为“风俗、习俗”，social customs 社会风俗，随国家而异；rules 规则，habits 个人习惯，regulations 规章，均不如 customs 贴切。句意：各国社会风俗习惯差别很大。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He is our best player, and is ________ to our team.
questions.explanation: be integral to 为固定搭配，意为“对……不可或缺”；internal 内部的，intelligent 聪明的，insistent 坚持的，均不合句意。句意：他是我们最好的球员，是球队不可或缺的一员。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The Olympic Games ________ in 776 B. C. in Olympia, a small town in Greece.
questions.explanation: originate in + 地点/时间为固定搭配，意为“起源于”；descend from 传下来，stem from、derive from 均须接 from 且多指派生，不能接 in。句意：奥运会起源于公元前776年希腊小镇奥林匹亚。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: As a developing country, we must keep ________ with the rapid development of the world economy.
questions.explanation: keep pace with 为固定搭配，意为“与……保持同步”；motion 运动，speed 速度（不与 keep...with 搭配），step 步调（keep step with 指行进步伐一致），表达“跟上发展”惯用 keep pace with。句意：作为发展中国家，我们必须与世界经济的快速发展保持同步。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I gave the car a thorough ________ before buying it.
questions.explanation: inspection 意为“检查、查看”，give the car a thorough inspection 对车作彻底检查；review 回顾、评论，survey 大规模调查，check-up 体格检查、例行检查，均不合语境。句意：买这辆车之前，我对它作了一次彻底检查。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Sue joined the drama society but didn't seem to ________, so she left.
questions.explanation: fit in 意为“（与群体、环境）合得来、融入”，不及物；fit in with 后须接宾语，fit out/up 装备、装修，均不合句意。句意：休加入了戏剧社，但似乎无法融入其中，于是退出了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The company ________ the crisis by obtaining a low-interest loan from the bank.
questions.explanation: get round 意为“设法克服、化解（困难、问题）”，get round the crisis 设法渡过危机；get through 多指熬过时间、通过考试，get off to (a start) 开始，get into 陷入，均不如 get round 贴切。句意：公司通过从银行获得低息贷款化解了这场危机。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The lecture was boring and the students could hardly ________ their yawns.
questions.explanation: suppress 意为“抑制、忍住”，suppress one's yawns 忍住哈欠，惯用搭配；depress 使沮丧，oppress 压迫，press 按压，均不合搭配。句意：讲座很乏味，学生们几乎忍不住要打哈欠。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Please dispose ________ those old books while you're cleaning up the room.
questions.explanation: dispose of 为固定搭配，意为“处理掉、丢弃”；out、away、in 均不与 dispose 搭配。句意：打扫房间时，请把那些旧书处理掉。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: As we've run out of beef, we will have to ________ with pork for dinner.
questions.explanation: make do with 为固定短语，意为“将就使用、凑合着用”；do it up 修复，make up 编造、弥补，compensate for 补偿，均不合句意。句意：牛肉用完了，晚饭我们只好将就吃猪肉了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: An important property of a scientific theory is its ability to ________ further research.
questions.explanation: stimulate 意为“激发、促进”，stimulate further research 推动进一步研究；arouse 唤起（情绪，如 arouse interest/suspicion），renew 更新，advocate 提倡，均不如 stimulate 贴切。句意：科学理论的一个重要特性就是它能激发进一步的研究。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In education, there should be a good ________ among the branches of knowledge that contribute to effective thinking and wise judgment.
questions.explanation: balance 意为“平衡”，a good balance among...（各部分之间保持良好平衡）符合句意；distribution 分配，combination 结合，spread 传播，均不合题意。句意：在教育中，各知识门类之间应有良好的平衡，才能促成有效的思考与明智的判断。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The judge ruled that the evidence was inadmissible on the grounds that it was ________ to the issue at hand.
questions.explanation: be irrelevant to 为固定搭配，意为“与……无关”，正是证据不予采纳的恰当理由；irrational 不理智的，unreasonable 不合理的，invalid 无效的（不接 to），均不合搭配。句意：法官裁定该证据不予采纳，理由是它与眼下的争点无关。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The mayor is a woman with great ________ and therefore deserves our political and financial support.
questions.explanation: integrity 意为“正直、诚信”，a woman with great integrity 正直的女性，因此值得支持；intention 意图，instinct 本能，intensity 强度，均不合题意。句意：这位市长是一位非常正直的女性，因此值得我们政治上和财力上的支持。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When the working committee ________ to details, the proposed plan seemed unworkable.
questions.explanation: get down to 为固定短语，意为“开始认真处理（细节、正事）”，get down to details 着手处理细节；set about 后接 doing，go off 离开、变质，come up 出现，均不合搭配。句意：当工作委员会开始着手研究细节时，那个拟议的计划似乎行不通了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He spoke so ________ that even his opponents were won over by his arguments.
questions.explanation: convincingly 意为“有说服力地”，与 even his opponents were won over（连对手都被争取过来）呼应；frankly 坦率地，emphatically 强调地，determinedly 坚决地，均不合“说服对手”的逻辑。句意：他说得如此有说服力，连他的对手都被他的论点争取过来了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Firms that use computers have found that the number of staff ________ is needed for quality control can be substantially reduced.
questions.explanation: 先行词 staff 后的定语从句 ________ is needed for quality control 缺主语，需用关系代词，且先行词被 the number of 结构限定，用 that 引导；what 不能引导定语从句，as 须与 such/the same 连用，whose 表所属与句意不符，故选 that。句意：使用计算机的公司发现，质量控制所需的人员数量可以大幅减少。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Many people are ________ to insect bites, and some even have to go to hospital.
questions.explanation: be allergic to 为固定搭配，意为“对……过敏”，与 have to go to hospital 呼应；insensitive 不敏感的（与“去医院”矛盾），sensible 明智的，infected 被感染的，均不合题意。句意：许多人对虫咬过敏，有些人甚至不得不去医院。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When you're driving on a motorway, you must obey the signs telling you to get into the right ________.
questions.explanation: lane 意为“（公路的）车道”，get into the right lane 驶入右侧车道，是高速公路语境的标准用词；way 路线，track 轨道、小道，road 公路（整体），均不合“分道”语义。句意：在高速公路上驾车时，必须遵守指示牌，驶入右侧车道。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The motorist had to ________ to avoid knocking the old woman down in the middle of the road.
questions.explanation: swerve 意为“（车辆）突然转向”，swerve to avoid doing sth 急打方向以避免撞上，惯用表达；twist 扭转，depart 离开，swing 摆动，均不合紧急避让语境。句意：那位司机只好猛打方向，以避免撞上路中间的老妇人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In winter, drivers have trouble stopping their cars from ________ on icy roads.
questions.explanation: skid 意为“（车辆）打滑、侧滑”，专指刹车或路滑时车轮失控；skate 滑冰，slide 平滑滑动，slip 滑倒（多指人），均不如 skidding 贴切。句意：冬天，司机很难让汽车不在结冰的路面上打滑。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: This project would ________ a huge increase in defense spending.
questions.explanation: entail 意为“必然伴有、带来（作为必然后果）”，entail a huge increase 必然带来大幅增长；result 须接 in，assure 须接 sb of sth，accomplish 完成，均不合语法或语义。句意：这项工程将意味着国防开支的大幅增加。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The chances of a repetition of these unfortunate events are ________ indeed.
questions.explanation: chances are slim 为固定搭配，意为“可能性渺茫”，slim 常与 chance/possibility/hope 搭配；distant 遥远的，unlikely 不太可能的（描述事件而非 chances 本身），narrow 狭窄的，均不合搭配。句意：这些不幸事件重演的可能性确实很小。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We should make a clear ________ between "competent" and "proficient" for the purposes of our discussion.
questions.explanation: make a distinction between 为固定搭配，意为“区分、区别”；separation 分离，division 划分，difference 多用于 tell the difference between，均不如 distinction 贴切。句意：为了讨论的需要，我们应当把“胜任”与“精通”明确区分开来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In the present economic ________ we can make even greater progress than previously.
questions.explanation: climate 意为“（社会、经济的）形势、风气”，economic climate 经济形势，惯用引申；air 空气、神情，mood 心情（多指个人），area 地区，均不合题意。句意：在当前的经济形势下，我们能够取得比以前更大的进步。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Rite of Passage is a good novel by any standards; ________, it should rank high on any list of science fiction.
questions.explanation: consequently 意为“因此、因而”，表因果关系，与前句“无论按什么标准都是好小说”构成推理；consistently 一贯地，invariably 始终地，fortunately 幸运地，均不合逻辑。句意：《成人礼》无论以什么标准衡量都是一部好小说；因此，它在任何科幻小说书目中都应名列前茅。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The diversity of tropical plants in the region represents a seemingly ________ source of raw materials, of which only a few have been utilized.
questions.explanation: inexhaustible 意为“取之不尽的”，与 of which only a few have been utilized（仅少数被利用）呼应；exploited 已开发的（与此矛盾），controversial 有争议的，remarkable 显著的，均不合语境。句意：该地区热带植物的多样性代表着一个看似取之不尽的原材料来源，其中只有少数得到了利用。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: While he was in Beijing, he spent all his time ________ some important museums and buildings.
questions.explanation: visit 意为“参观（博物馆、名胜等）”，visit museums 搭配直接；travel 不及物（接地点须加 to/around），watch 观看（节目、比赛），tour 多指巡回游览多地，均不如 visiting 贴切。句意：在北京期间，他把全部时间都用来参观一些重要的博物馆和建筑。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You must let me have the annual report without ________ by ten o'clock tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: without fail 为固定短语，意为“务必、必定”；without hesitation 毫不犹豫（不合语境），without trouble 无麻烦，fail 是动词原形不能作介词宾语，均不合惯用表达。句意：明天上午十点前，你必须务必把年度报告交给我。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: As the director can't come to the reception, I'm representing the company ________.
questions.explanation: on one's behalf 为固定短语，意为“代表某人”；on his account 因他的缘故，for his part 就他而言，in his interest 为了他的利益，均不合句意。句意：主任不能出席招待会，所以我代表公司出席。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Dreams are ________ in themselves, but, when combined with other data, they can tell us much about the dreamer.
questions.explanation: uninformative 意为“不提供信息的”，与 but 后“结合其他数据就能告诉我们很多”构成转折；startling 令人吃惊的，harmless 无害的，uncontrollable 无法控制的，均不合转折逻辑。句意：梦本身并不能提供什么信息，但与其他数据结合起来，就能让我们了解做梦者的许多情况。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: During the famine, many people were ________ to going without food for days.
questions.explanation: be reduced to (doing) sth 为固定搭配，意为“沦落到、被迫处于……境地”，to 为介词后接动名词 going；be forced to 后须接动词原形，sunk 不构成此搭配，declined 不及物，均不合语法。句意：饥荒期间，许多人沦落到几天吃不上饭的境地。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The computer can be programmed to ________ a whole variety of tasks.
questions.explanation: tackle 意为“处理、应付”，tackle tasks 处理任务，搭配自然；assign 分派，realize 实现（多接理想、目标），solve 解决（多接问题），均不如 tackle 贴切。句意：通过编程，计算机可以处理各种各样的任务。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The team's efforts to score were ________ by the opposing goalkeeper.
questions.explanation: frustrate 意为“挫败、阻挠”，efforts were frustrated 努力被挫败，惯用表达；prevent 须用 be prevented from doing，discourage 使泄气，accomplish 完成（语义相反），均不合题意。句意：球队进球的努力被对方守门员挫败了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I only know the man by ________ but I have never spoken to him.
questions.explanation: know sb by sight 为固定短语，意为“面熟、只是面识”；by chance 偶然，by heart 熟记，experience 经验，均不合句意。句意：那个人我只是面熟，但从未跟他说过话。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Being color-blind, Sally can't make a ________ between red and green.
questions.explanation: make a distinction between 为固定搭配，意为“区分”；make a difference 意为“有影响”（不接 between），difference 的惯用搭配是 tell the difference between，comparison 比较，division 划分，均不合搭配。句意：由于色盲，萨莉无法区分红色和绿色。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The plane found the spot and hovered close enough to ________ that it was a car.
questions.explanation: verify 意为“核实、证实”，verify that it was a car 证实那是一辆汽车，可接 that 从句；ensure 确保，examine 检查（不接 that 从句），testify 作证，均不合题意。句意：飞机找到了那个地点并悬停在足够近的位置，以证实那是一辆汽车。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The encouraging factor is that the ________ majority of people find the idea of change acceptable.
questions.explanation: the vast majority of 为固定搭配，意为“……的绝大多数”；numerous 大量的（不修饰 majority），most 直接修饰名词前不加 the，massive 巨大的（不构成此惯用语），均不合搭配。句意：令人鼓舞的是，绝大多数人都认为变革的想法可以接受。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The increase in student numbers ________ many problems for the universities.
questions.explanation: pose problems 为固定搭配，意为“引起、造成问题”；force 强迫，press 施压，provide 提供，均不与 problems 构成此义。句意：学生人数的增加给大学带来了许多问题。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Please ________ from smoking until the aeroplane is airborne.
questions.explanation: refrain from (doing) sth 为固定搭配，意为“克制不做某事”；prevent、restrain 须先接宾语（prevent/restrain sb from doing），resist 不与 from 连用，均不合语法。句意：飞机升空之前请勿吸烟。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Reporters and photographers alike took great ________ at the rude way the actor behaved during the interview.
questions.explanation: take offence at 为固定搭配，意为“对……生气、见怪”；annoyance、irritation 不与 take...at 构成惯用语，resentment 虽表不满但惯用搭配是 feel/hold resentment against，故选 offence。句意：那位演员在采访中举止粗鲁，记者和摄影师都对此十分恼火。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Topics for composition should be ________ to the experiences and interests of the students.
questions.explanation: be relevant to 为固定搭配，意为“与……相关”；concerned 须接 about/with，dependent 须接 on，connecting 应为 connected with，介词均与空后的 to 不符。句意：作文题目应与学生的经历和兴趣相关。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The novel contains some marvelously revealing ________ of rural life in the 19th century.
questions.explanation: glimpse 意为“（对事物的）粗略呈现、一瞥”，revealing glimpses of rural life 对乡村生活的生动展现；glance 匆匆一瞥（指看的动作），glare 怒视，gleam 微光，均不合语境。句意：这部小说包含一些极其生动地展现19世纪乡村生活的片段。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Sometimes the student may be asked to write about his ________ to a certain book or article that has some bearing on the subject being studied.
questions.explanation: reaction to 为固定搭配，意为“对……的反应”，空后介词 to 决定选 reaction；comment 须接 on，impression、comprehension 均惯与 of 搭配，介词不符。句意：有时学生会应要求就自己对与研究课题相关的某本书或某篇文章的看法和反应写点什么。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Picking flowers in the park is absolutely ________.
questions.explanation: prohibit 意为“（以法律、规章）禁止”，Picking flowers is absolutely prohibited 摘花被明令禁止；avoid 避免，reject 拒绝（提议、申请），repel 击退，均不合题意。句意：在公园里摘花是绝对禁止的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Tony has not the least ________ of giving up his research work.
questions.explanation: have (not the least) intention of doing sth 为惯用搭配，意为“毫无做某事的打算”；interest 须接 in，wish、desire 多与 for 或不定式连用，介词搭配不符。句意：托尼丝毫没有放弃研究工作的打算。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Two of the children have to sleep in one bed, but the other three have ________ ones.
questions.explanation: separate 意为“各自的、单独的”，separate ones 各自单独的床，与前文 sleep in one bed（两人合睡一张床）对比；similar 相似的，singular 单数的、奇特的，different 强调彼此不同而非“每人一张”，separate 最贴切。句意：孩子们中有两个必须合睡一张床，而另外三个孩子各有各的床。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Am I to understand that his new post ________ no responsibility with it at all?
questions.explanation: carry responsibility 为惯用搭配，意为“承担职责”，carries no responsibility with it 没有附带任何职责；keep 保持，support 支持，possess 拥有（多指能力、品质），均不合搭配。句意：难道要让我理解成：他的新职位完全没有附带任何职责吗？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Animals that could not ________ themselves to the changed environment perished and those that could survived.
questions.explanation: adapt oneself to 为固定搭配，意为“使自己适应……”；change oneself to、modify oneself to 均非惯用搭配，conform oneself to 多指顺从规范，语义不符。句意：不能适应变化了的环境的动物死去了，能适应的则存活下来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The membership card entitled him ________ certain privileges in the club.
questions.explanation: entitle sb to sth 为固定搭配，意为“使某人有权享有某物”，空后接宾语 certain privileges，故选介词 to；on、in、at 均不与 entitle 构成此搭配。句意：会员卡使他在俱乐部里享有某些特权。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Obviously, the chairman's remarks at the conference were ________ and not planned.
questions.explanation: spontaneous 意为“自发的、即兴的”，与 not planned（并非事先准备）呼应；substantial 大量的，simultaneous 同时发生的，synthetic 合成的，均不合题意。句意：显然，主席在会上的发言是即兴的，并非事先准备的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: For the success of the project, the company should ________ the most of the opportunities at hand.
questions.explanation: make the most of 为固定短语，意为“充分利用”，make the most of the opportunities 充分利用机会；obtain 获得，grasp 抓住（grasp the opportunity 可用但不能接 the most of），catch 抓住，均不合空后的 the most of。句意：为了项目的成功，公司应当充分利用眼前的种种机会。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Failure to follow the club rules ________ him from the volleyball team.
questions.explanation: disqualify sb from 为固定搭配，意为“使某人丧失……的资格”，不遵守俱乐部规则使他失去排球队（参赛）资格；dismiss sb from 多指从职务、职位上解雇；disfavored 使失宠，dispel 驱散，均不合句意。句意：由于违反俱乐部规则，他被取消了排球队的资格。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The discovery of new oil-fields in various parts of the country filled the government with ________ hope.
questions.explanation: infinite（无限的）与 hope 搭配，指政府满怀无限希望；eternal 永恒的、ceaseless 不停的、everlasting 永久的都强调时间无止境，常修饰过程或状态，不与 hope 惯用搭配。句意：该国各地新油田的发现使政府充满无限的希望。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: At first the company refused to purchase the equipment, but this decision was ________ revised.
questions.explanation: subsequently 意为'随后'，与句首 at first（起初）形成时间呼应；successively 接连地，predominantly 主要地，preliminarily 初步地。句意：起初公司拒绝购买该设备，但这一决定随后被修改。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The local police are authorized to ________ anyone's movements as they think fit.
questions.explanation: halt 意为'使停止、阻止'，be authorized to halt anyone's movements 即授权阻止任何人的行动；pause 暂停（不及物），repel 击退、排斥，keep 保持。句意：当地警方获授权可按其判断阻止任何人的行动。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Have you ever received ________ of what has happened to her?
questions.explanation: word 表'消息、音讯'时为不可数名词，用零冠词，receive word of... 意为'收到…的消息'；the word/words 均不表达此义。句意：你有没有收到关于她遭遇的消息？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Twelve is to three ________ four is to one.
questions.explanation: 'A is to B what C is to D' 为固定比较句型，意为'A 之于 B 正如 C 之于 D'，空格处只能用 what 引导从句。句意：12 比 3 正如 4 比 1。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Things went well for her during her early life but in her middle age her ________ seemed to change.
questions.explanation: luck 意为'运气'，与前文 Things went well（一帆风顺）呼应；affair 事务，event 事件，chance 机会。句意：她早年一帆风顺，但人到中年运气似乎变了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Although I spoke to her about the matter several times, she took little ________ of what I said.
questions.explanation: take notice of 为固定搭配，意为'注意、留意'，took little notice of 即'毫不在意'；attention 需与 pay 搭配（pay attention to），remark/warning 无此搭配。句意：虽然此事我跟她说过多次，她对我的话毫不在意。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The scheme was ________ when it was discovered it would be very costly.
questions.explanation: abandon 意为'放弃、舍弃'，计划因成本过高被放弃用 was abandoned；resign 辞职，surrender 投降、交出，release 释放。句意：当发现该计划耗资巨大时，它便被放弃了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Yesterday my aunt bought some new ________ for her flat at the seaside.
questions.explanation: furniture（家具）是不可数名词，没有复数形式，some new furniture 正确；furnitures 拼写错误；possession 表'财物'须用复数 possessions，且不特指'家具'。句意：昨天我姑妈为她的海滨公寓买了一些新家具。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My cousin likes eating very much, but he isn't very ________ about the food he eats.
questions.explanation: be particular about 为固定搭配，意为'对…挑剔'；special 特别的，peculiar 古怪的，specific 明确具体的，均无 be...about 表'挑剔'的用法。句意：我表哥很爱吃，但他对吃的东西并不挑剔。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Your advice would be ________ valuable to him, who is now at a loss as to what to do first.
questions.explanation: exceedingly 意为'非常、极其'，修饰 valuable 表程度极高；excessively 过度地（含贬义），extensively 广泛地，exclusively 排他地、专门地。句意：你的建议对他会非常有价值，他现在正不知该先做什么。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: More often than not, it is difficult to ________ the exact meaning of a Chinese idiom in English.
questions.explanation: convey 意为'传达、表达（含义、情感）'，convey the exact meaning 即传达准确含义；exchange 交换，transfer 转移、调动，convert 转换（形式）。句意：人们往往很难用英语传达出汉语习语的准确含义。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She refused to ________ the door key to the landlady until she got back her deposit.
questions.explanation: hand over 意为'移交、交给（某人）'，hand the key over to the landlady 即把钥匙交给房东；hand in 上交（交给组织），hand out 分发，hand down 把…传下去（后代）。句意：她拒绝把门钥匙交给房东太太，直到拿回押金。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The scientists have absolute freedom as to what research they think it best to ________.
questions.explanation: pursue 意为'从事、进行（研究、事业等）'，it best to pursue research 即从事研究；engage 须接 in，devote 须接 to，seek 寻找、谋求。句意：科学家在从事他们认为最好的研究方面拥有绝对自由。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The Olympic Games ________ in 776 B.C. in Olympia, a small town in Greece.
questions.explanation: originate in 意为'起源于（某地）'；stem from、derive from、descend from 均须接 from，与题干的 in 不符。句意：奥林匹克运动会于公元前776年起源于希腊小镇奥林匹亚。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We should always bear in mind that ________ decisions often result in serious consequences.
questions.explanation: hasty 意为'仓促的、草率的'，hasty decisions（草率的决定）常导致严重后果；urgent 紧急的，instant 立即的，prompt 迅速及时的（褒义）。句意：我们应始终牢记，草率的决定往往导致严重后果。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The fact that the management is trying to reach agreement ________ five separate unions has led to long negotiations.
questions.explanation: reach agreement with sb 为固定搭配，意为'与…达成协议'，with 引出协议的另一方；over/upon 表'就某事'，in 不用于此结构。句意：资方正试图与五个独立工会达成协议，这一事实导致了漫长的谈判。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The chairman of the company said that new techniques had ________ improved their production efficiency.
questions.explanation: radically 意为'根本地、彻底地'，radically improved 即大幅提高；violently 猛烈地，severely 严重地（多指造成损害），extremely 极其（不与 improved 搭配表'彻底改进'）。句意：公司董事长说，新技术极大地提高了他们的生产效率。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The local authorities realized the need to make ________ for elderly people in their housing programmes.
questions.explanation: make provision for 为固定搭配，意为'为…预先作安排、为…提供保障'；preparation 表此义须用复数 make preparations for，requirement/specification 不与 make...for 搭配。句意：地方当局意识到需要在住房规划中为老年人作出安排。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The guest team was beaten by the host team 2 ________ 4 in last year's CFA Cup Final.
questions.explanation: 表示比分'2比4'用介词 to，beaten 2 to 4；over/in/against 均不用于比分。句意：客队在去年的中国足协杯决赛中以 2 比 4 输给了东道主。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The police let him go, because they didn't find him guilty ________ the murder.
questions.explanation: be guilty of 为固定搭配，意为'犯有…罪'，find him guilty of the murder 即认定他犯了谋杀罪。句意：警察放他走了，因为他们没有发现他犯有谋杀罪。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The police have offered a large ________ for information leading to the robber's arrest.
questions.explanation: reward 意为'赏金、酬金'，offer a reward for information 即悬赏征集线索；award 因成绩颁发的奖品，compensation 赔偿金，prize 竞赛奖金。句意：警方已悬赏巨款，征集有助于抓获抢劫犯的线索。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I arrived at the airport so late that I ________ missed the plane.
questions.explanation: narrowly 意为'差一点、勉强地'，narrowly missed the plane 即差点误了飞机，与 so late 呼应；only/quite/seldom 均无此义。句意：我到机场太晚了，差一点就误了飞机。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The popularity of the film shows that the reviewers' fears were completely ________.
questions.explanation: unjustified 意为'没有根据的'，fears were unjustified 即担忧毫无根据，与影片大受欢迎呼应；unjust 不公正的，misguided 被误导的，unaccepted 不被接受的。句意：这部影片大受欢迎，说明影评人的担忧完全没有根据。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The head of the Museum was ________ and let us actually examine the ancient manuscripts.
questions.explanation: obliging 意为'乐于助人的、好心的'，was obliging and let us examine 即热心地让我们查看；promising 有前途的，agreeing/pleasing 不作形容词表'好心的'。句意：博物馆馆长非常热心，让我们实际查看了那些古代手稿。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The multinational corporation was making a take-over ________ for a property company.
questions.explanation: make a take-over bid 为固定商业用语，意为'出价收购、竞标收购'；application 申请，proposal 提议，suggestion 建议，均不构成此搭配。句意：这家跨国公司正在出价收购一家房地产公司。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The party's reduced vote was ________ of lack of support for its policies.
questions.explanation: be indicative of 为固定搭配，意为'表明、暗示'，was indicative of lack of support 即表明缺乏支持；revealing 为及物动词不接 of，positive/evident 不接 of 表此义。句意：该党选票减少，表明其政策缺乏支持。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There has been a ________ lack of communication between the union and the management.
questions.explanation: regrettable 意为'令人遗憾的'，修饰事物（a regrettable lack of communication）；regretful 意为'感到遗憾的'，修饰人；regretting/regretted 是分词形式，不作定语。句意：工会与管理层之间的沟通一直很缺乏，令人遗憾。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The teacher ________ expects his students to pass the university entrance examination.
questions.explanation: confidently 意为'满怀信心地'，confidently expects 即满怀信心地期待；confidentially 机密地，proudly 骄傲地，assuredly 确定无疑地。句意：这位老师满怀信心地期待他的学生通过大学入学考试。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The ________ family in Chinese cities now spends more money on housing than before.
questions.explanation: average 意为'普通的、平常的'，the average family 即普通家庭，为惯用表达；normal 正常的，usual 惯常的，general 总体的。句意：如今中国城市的普通家庭在住房上的花销比过去多了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The new colleague ________ to have worked in several big corporations before he joined our company.
questions.explanation: claim to have done 意为'声称做过某事'，claims to have worked 即声称曾在…工作；confess 须接 to doing 或 that 从句，declare/confirm 须接 that 从句。句意：这位新同事声称，来我们公司之前他曾在几家大公司工作过。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: During the reading lesson, the teacher asked students to read a few ________ from the novel.
questions.explanation: extracts 意为'摘录、选段'，read a few extracts from the novel 即读小说中的几段节选；pieces 件/片（不指选文），essays 散文，fragments 碎片、残片。句意：阅读课上，老师让学生们读了这本小说的几个选段。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: During the summer holiday season it is difficult to find a ( n) ________ room in the hotels here.
questions.explanation: vacant 意为'未被占用的'，a vacant room 指可入住的空房；empty 空的（里面没有东西），free 空闲的（指人或时间），deserted 被遗弃的。句意：暑期旺季，在这里的旅馆很难找到空房间。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The old couple will never ________ the loss of their son.
questions.explanation: get over 意为'从（打击、悲痛）中恢复过来'，never get over the loss 即永远无法走出丧子之痛；get away 逃脱，get off 下车、脱身，get across 使被理解。句意：这对老夫妇将永远无法从失去儿子的悲痛中走出来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Scientific research results can now be quickly ________ to factory production.
questions.explanation: be applied to 为固定搭配，意为'被应用于'；use 表被动须用 be used to do 结构，tried/practiced 不与 to 搭配表'应用'。句意：科研成果如今可以很快地应用于工厂生产。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Do you think there's any ________ of him passing the exam?
questions.explanation: chance 意为'可能性'，any chance of him passing the exam 即他通过考试的可能性；opportunity 人为提供的机会，occasion 场合，expectancy 期待。句意：你认为他还有可能通过考试吗？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If reading is to accomplish anything more than ________ time, it must be active.
questions.explanation: pass time 意为'消磨时间'，more than passing time 即'不只是消磨时间'；waste 浪费，spend 花费，idle 闲混，均不带'消遣打发'的惯用义。句意：如果阅读不只是为了消磨时间，它就必须是主动的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My cousin Mary is often in a poisonous mood; I suppose it's because she is ________ child.
questions.explanation: an only child 为固定表达，意为'独生子女'，only 前须加不定冠词 an；a single child/a unique child 均不是惯用说法。句意：我表妹玛丽总爱发脾气，我想那是因为她是独生女。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: On January 1st many people make a New Year ________.
questions.explanation: make a New Year resolution 为固定搭配，意为'立新年决心'；intention 意图，determination 决心（品质），dedication 奉献，均不构成此习语。句意：1 月 1 日那天，许多人都会立下新年决心。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The two scholars worked at the task of writing a preface to the new dictionary for three hours ________ last night.
questions.explanation: on end 意为'连续地'，for three hours on end 即连续三个小时；at length 最终/详尽地，in full 全部地，in time 及时。句意：昨晚两位学者连续三个小时致力于为新词典撰写前言。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The juvenile delinquent was released in ________ of his good behavior.
questions.explanation: in view of 为固定搭配，意为'鉴于、考虑到'，in view of his good behavior 即鉴于他表现良好；in case of 万一，in the way 挡道，in the event of 如果发生。句意：鉴于这名少年犯表现良好，他被释放了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Kenya's Tsavo Game Park ________ Susan much of the wildlife park she had visited in New Jersey.
questions.explanation: remind sb of sth 为固定搭配，意为'使某人想起'；recall 为及物动词，直接接宾语（recall the park），不接 of。句意：肯尼亚的察沃野生动物园使苏珊想起她在新泽西州参观过的那座野生动物园。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When the crowd saw the prize-fighter stretched out on the canvas, shouts and cheers ________ from it.
questions.explanation: break forth 意为'（欢呼、声音）突然迸发'，shouts and cheers broke forth 即欢呼声骤然响起；break up 结束、拆散，break through 突破，break upon 并非常用搭配。句意：当人群看到拳击手被击倒在拳台上时，欢呼和喝彩声骤然迸发。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Outside my office window, there is a fire ________ on the right.
questions.explanation: fire escape 意为'太平梯、安全出口'，为固定复合名词；fire ladder 不是惯用说法，steps/stairs 泛指台阶、楼梯。句意：我办公室窗外的右侧有一座太平梯。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The ________ crown jewels are kept in the Tower of London.
questions.explanation: invaluable 意为'极其珍贵的、无价的'（in- 在此表强调而非否定）；valued 受珍视的，valueless 毫无价值的，worthy 值得…的。王室珠宝自然价值连城。句意：那些贵重无比的王室珠宝保存在伦敦塔中。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I don't think those curtains ________ very well with the wallpaper.
questions.explanation: go with 为固定搭配，意为'与…相配'，curtains go with the wallpaper 即窗帘与壁纸相配；suit/fit/match 均为及物动词，直接接宾语，不接 with。句意：我觉得那几幅窗帘与壁纸配得并不好。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He enjoyed the dessert so much that he accepted a second ________ when it was offered.
questions.explanation: helping 意为'（食物的）一份'，a second helping 即再添的一份；load 负载，pile 一堆，sharing 分享量，均不表'一份食物'。句意：他非常喜欢那种甜点，所以再端上来时又接受了一份。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The outline of the figure was barely ________ in the darkness.
questions.explanation: perceptible 意为'可察觉到的'，barely perceptible 即'勉强可辨认'，与 darkness（黑暗）呼应；invisible 看不见的（与 barely 矛盾），susceptible 易受影响的，perceptive 感知敏锐的（修饰人）。句意：黑暗中，那个身影的轮廓勉强可以辨认。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They bought the land with a ________ to building a new office block.
questions.explanation: with a view to doing 为固定搭配，意为'意图做…、以…为目的'（to 是介词，后接 doing）；purpose/reason/goal 均无 with a...to doing 结构。句意：他们买下这块地，打算建一座新办公楼。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Maggie tiptoed over and took the clock away because she hated to hear it ________ when she was trying to go to sleep.
questions.explanation: tick 意为'（钟表）滴答作响'，hear it ticking 即听见它滴答响；hum 发嗡嗡声，ring 指铃响，sound 笼统地'发声'。句意：玛吉踮着脚过去把钟拿走了，因为她讨厌在想入睡时听到钟的滴答声。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Mrs. Smith is afraid that she and her husband don't see ________ on New Year Resolutions.
questions.explanation: see eye to eye on sth 为固定习语，意为'（在某事上）意见一致'；face to face 面对面，hand to hand 短兵相接，heart to heart 坦诚交心，均不与 see...on 搭配表'意见一致'。句意：史密斯太太担心她和丈夫在新年计划上看法不一。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Fred has ________ kind of humour that can only be appreciated by those willing to search beneath the surface.
questions.explanation: subtle 意为'微妙含蓄的'，a subtle kind of humour 与后半句'须深挖表层之下才能体会'呼应；obvious 明显的（矛盾），hidden 被藏起来的，controlled 克制的。句意：弗雷德有一种含蓄的幽默，只有愿意探究其表层之下的人才能体会。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His argument does not ________ up to close scrutiny.
questions.explanation: stand up to 为固定短语，意为'经得起'，does not stand up to close scrutiny 即经不起仔细推敲；hold up 表'支撑、耽误'，不接 to 表此义；come/look 无此短语。句意：他的论点经不起仔细推敲。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The sight of the fruit salad made John's mouth ________.
questions.explanation: make one's mouth water 为固定表达，water 在此作动词'流口水'；wet/moisten 是'使…湿'的动词，需接宾语；ooze 渗出。句意：一看到水果沙拉，约翰就流口水了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He promised to return the book next day without ________.
questions.explanation: without fail 为固定短语，意为'务必、肯定不误'，其中 fail 用动词原形；default 违约，trouble/failure 不构成此短语。句意：他答应第二天一定把书还回来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The ________ in David's character has hindered him from advancement in his career.
questions.explanation: defect 意为'（性格、身体上的）缺陷、瑕疵'，the defect in his character 与'阻碍晋升'相呼应，程度较重；weakness 弱点（泛指），shortcoming 缺点（行为层面），demerit 过失（多指记过）。句意：大卫性格上的缺陷妨碍了他事业上的晋升。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The government is doing a ________ of people's changing social habits.
questions.explanation: do a survey of 为固定搭配，意为'对…进行调查'；plan 计划，project 项目，research 研究（do research 不加冠词 a）。句意：政府正在进行一项关于人们社会习惯变化的调查。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: By cutting down trees we ________ the natural habitat of birds and animals.
questions.explanation: damage 意为'损坏、破坏（具体事物）'，damage the natural habitat 即破坏栖息地；injure/hurt 指伤害人，harm 多指损害健康、利益等抽象对象。句意：砍伐树木破坏了鸟类和动物的天然栖息地。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The snow seems to have set ________ for the evening.
questions.explanation: set in 意为'（坏天气等）开始并可能持续'，the snow has set in for the evening 即雪要下一晚上；set upon 袭击，set about 着手，set down 记下。句意：这场雪看来要下一整晚。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________ of the department, I would like to thank Mr. Jones for his stimulating lecture.
questions.explanation: on behalf of 为固定搭配，意为'代表'；on account of 因为，in person 亲自，instead 表'代替'但不构成 of 前的介词短语。句意：我谨代表本系，感谢琼斯先生作了这场令人深受启发的讲座。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Be careful with John; I think he has ________ motives for being so generous.
questions.explanation: ulterior motives 为固定搭配，意为'别有用心的动机'；ultimate 最终的，interior 内部的，hidden 隐藏的（表'别有用心'惯用 ulterior motives）。句意：对约翰要当心，我看他如此大方是别有用心的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Paul earns very little as a classical cellist, ________ his brother's pop musicals have made millions.
questions.explanation: whereas 意为'然而'，是连词，可连接前后两个完整分句表对比；in contrast to/compared with 是介词短语，只能接名词短语，不能连接两个句子；though 表让步，逻辑不合。句意：保罗当古典大提琴手挣得很少，而他兄弟的流行音乐剧已赚了数百万。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is bad manners to ________ other people behind their backs.
questions.explanation: do down 意为'说…的坏话、诋毁'，do other people down behind their backs 即背后说人坏话；do up 系扣、修缮，do by 对待（罕用），do away with 废除、去掉。句意：背后诋毁别人是不礼貌的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Samuel has curly hair but his twin sister's is quite ________.
questions.explanation: straight 意为'直的'，与 curly hair（卷发）直接相对；even 平整的，uneven 不平的，regular 规则的。句意：塞缪尔一头卷发，而他孪生妹妹的头发却是直的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My classmates stood there looking uneasily at me, puzzling why I hadn't got an­noyed this time when I couldn't get my own ________.
questions.explanation: get one's own way 为固定习语，意为'随心所欲、如愿以偿'；wish/will/desire 均不构成此搭配。句意：同学们站在那里不安地望着我，纳闷这次未能如愿时我怎么没生气。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The economists are not quite optimistic about the economic ________ for Europe.
questions.explanation: outlook 意为'前景、展望'，economic outlook 即经济前景；lookout 瞭望员/瞭望台，foresight 远见，project 项目。句意：经济学家们对欧洲的经济前景不太乐观。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Jenny is not in the ________ for going to the party tonight.
questions.explanation: in the mood (for/to do) 为固定搭配，意为'有心情做…'；temper 脾气，condition 状况，health 健康。句意：珍妮今晚没有心情去参加聚会。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There is no ________ in applying for that job, as you are not properly qualified.
questions.explanation: There is no point (in) doing sth 为固定句型，意为'做某事没有意义'；reason 表此义须用 There is no reason to do，result/chance 不构成此句型。句意：申请那份工作毫无意义，因为你并不具备相应资格。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After leaving the art college, she ________ as an interior designer.
questions.explanation: set up (as) 意为'开业、自立门户做（某职业）'，set up as an interior designer 即开业当室内设计师；take up 从事，直接接职业名词，不接 as；get up 起床，put up 张贴、搭建。句意：从艺术学院毕业后，她自己开业当了一名室内设计师。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Henry Adams felt so hungry that he ordered a double ________ of fish.
questions.explanation: portion 意为'（食物的）一份'，a double portion of fish 即双份鱼；part 部分，piece 片、块，section 部分、章节。句意：亨利·亚当斯饿极了，要了双份的鱼。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is hard to imagine a large city without policemen, but such was the ________ in London in the early 18th century.
questions.explanation: situation 意为'情况、局面'，such was the situation 即当时的情形就是如此，指伦敦一度没有警察的状况；affair 事务，condition 状态，matter 事情。句意：很难想象一座大城市没有警察，但 18 世纪初的伦敦就是这种情形。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The Martian surface temperature is 100 degrees below zero at night, so that but-ter put outside will not ________.
questions.explanation: melt 意为'（固体受热）融化'，黄油常温会融化，零下 100 度则不会 melt；thaw 指冰雪、冷冻食物'解冻'，dissolve 指在液体中'溶解'，fuse 指金属'熔化'。句意：火星表面夜间温度为零下 100 度，所以放在外面的黄油不会融化。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Having kissed her son, Eve gave him a dismissive ________ towards the car.
questions.explanation: push 意为'推'，a dismissive push towards the car 即随手把他朝汽车方向一推，打发他走；pull/draw/drag 均为'拉、拖'。句意：吻别儿子后，伊芙随手朝汽车方向推了他一把，打发他上路。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Wild ducks always fly in a definite ________.
questions.explanation: formation 意为'队形'，fly in formation（编队飞行）为固定搭配；figure 体型、图形，formula 公式，shape 形状。句意：野鸭总是按一定的队形飞行。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: This road is completely ________ deep at night.
questions.explanation: deserted 意为'空无一人的'，a deserted road 指深夜无人的路；isolated 孤立的、隔绝的，lonely 偏僻的、荒凉的（强调远离人烟），neglected 因无人照管而破败的。句意：这条路深夜完全空无一人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It rained heavily last night; ________ the land was flooded.
questions.explanation: consequently 意为'因此、结果'，连接因果关系（雨大→土地被淹）；in other words 换言之，in addition/besides 表递进'此外'。句意：昨晚雨下得很大，因此田地被淹了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When our university laboratory bought this microscope we were given a one year's ________.
questions.explanation: guarantee 意为'保修单、保修期'，a one year's guarantee 即一年保修；reservation 预订，security 安全保障，proof 证明。句意：我们大学实验室购买这台显微镜时，获得了为期一年的保修。
