questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Don't ________ about lunch for the instructors, because they promised to get some on the way.
questions.explanation: bother about 为固定搭配，意为'为…费心、操心'，Don't bother about lunch 即别为午餐操心；fuss about 小题大做、瞎忙活，trouble 为及物动词（trouble oneself），think about 语义不合。句意：别为教官们的午餐操心了，他们答应在路上买些吃的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Caracus has been called the Los Angles of South America; at ________ they look exactly the same.
questions.explanation: at first sight 为固定搭配，意为'乍一看'；at short notice 一接到通知（立即），first impression 第一印象（不与 at 构成此短语），first appearance 无此搭配。句意：加拉加斯被称为南美洲的洛杉矶；乍一看两座城市一模一样。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A Dictionary of the English Language , ________ by Dr Samuel Johnson, was the first real attempt as a systematic and interestingly written survey of English usage.
questions.explanation: compile 意为'编纂（词典、汇编）'，compiled by Dr Samuel Johnson 即由约翰逊博士编纂；construct 建造，compose 创作（乐曲、诗文），collect 收集。句意：由塞缪尔·约翰逊博士编纂的《英语词典》，是对英语用法进行系统性且趣味性整理的第一次真正尝试。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After I heard that I took a deferred pass in botany, I was in a ________ emotional state.
questions.explanation: highly 意为'非常'，highly emotional state 即情绪极为激动的状态，highly 修饰形容词表程度；greatly 一般修饰动词或分词，doubtfully/nervously 语义不符。句意：听说植物学缓考通过了，我的情绪非常激动。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Since I could not see anything through the microscope, ________ my careful adjustment, I gave up.
questions.explanation: for all 为固定介词短语，意为'尽管'（=in spite of），for all my careful adjustment 即尽管我仔细调校；above all 首先，after all 毕竟，in all 总共。句意：尽管我仔细调校过，显微镜下仍什么也看不见，于是只好放弃。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When the Victorians had family reunions, the hosts went ________ their way to entertain the guests.
questions.explanation: go out of one's way (to do) 为固定习语，意为'特意、不辞辛劳地做'；go in for 参加、爱好，go over 复习、检查，go back on 违背（诺言）。句意：维多利亚时代的人举行家庭团聚时，主人总会不辞辛劳地款待客人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Peter ________ his breath in wonder when he saw the Christmas tree in the sitting room.
questions.explanation: hold one's breath 为固定搭配，意为'屏住呼吸'；keep/blew/grasp 不构成此习语。句意：彼得看到客厅里的圣诞树，惊奇得屏住了呼吸。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The old buildings blend with the new ones in perfect ________, so a walk along Huai Hai Road is an enjoyable discovery.
questions.explanation: in harmony 为固定搭配，意为'和谐一致'，blend...in perfect harmony 即完美和谐地交融；order 秩序，control 控制，action 行动。句意：老建筑与新建筑完美和谐地交融，因此沿淮海路漫步是一次令人愉悦的发现之旅。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The energy gained from the sun can then be used during the night to enable the necessary chemical reactions to ________ in his body.
questions.explanation: proceed 意为'（不间断地）进行'，chemical reactions proceed 即化学反应得以进行；conduct 为及物动词，须接宾语；progress 指事业等'取得进展'；practice 练习、实践。句意：白天从阳光获得的能量可在夜间用来使他体内必需的化学反应继续进行。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When John was away on business, his neighbor gave his wife ________ with the housework.
questions.explanation: give sb a hand (with sth) 为固定习语，意为'帮某人（做某事）'；aid/help 在此结构中不加冠词 a；a lift 指搭便车。句意：约翰出差期间，邻居帮他妻子料理家务。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We know she was always as ________ as her word, so we trusted her.
questions.explanation: as good as one's word 为固定习语，意为'守信、说到做到'；honest/faithful/true 均不构成 as...as her word 结构。句意：我们知道她一向说话算数，所以信任她。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Newspapers vary greatly in their ________ to the government.
questions.explanation: bias 意为'倾向、偏见'，vary in their bias to/towards the government 即各家报纸对政府的倾向大不相同；opinion 后接 of/about/on，comment 后接 on；attitude 虽可接 to，但此处强调报纸的政治倾向差异，bias 最贴切。句意：各家报纸对政府的倾向大不相同。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The members in the testing team were quite ________ and could change their schedule upon request.
questions.explanation: flexible 意为'灵活的'，quite flexible and could change their schedule 即可按要求改变日程；lenient 宽大的（指人态度），supple 柔韧的（指身体），gentle 温和的。句意：测试组的成员相当灵活，可应请求改变日程安排。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Marge's bedroom was in a ________, with books and papers covering every possible surface.
questions.explanation: in a mess 为固定搭配，意为'乱七八糟'；rubbish 垃圾（不可数名词，不与 in a 连用），in disorder 中间不加 a，litter 不用于 in a litter 表房间凌乱。句意：玛吉的卧室乱七八糟，书本和报纸铺满了所有能放东西的地方。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Tim, the footballer, always scores ________ at football matches, but he feels frustrated at each examination.
questions.explanation: score goals 意为'进球'，足球射门得分用 goal；points 多指篮球等计分，games 比赛，targets 靶子、目标。句意：足球运动员蒂姆在球场上总能进球，可每次考试他都感到沮丧。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After the cameraman had taken three or four photographs of the soldier ants, he found they had ________ all over his feet.
questions.explanation: swarm 意为'（昆虫）成群密集地爬/飞'，swarmed all over his feet 即密密麻麻爬满双脚；gather 一般性聚集，flock 指鸟、羊、人群成群，crowd 拥挤、挤满（多指人群）。句意：摄影师对军蚁拍了三四张照片后，发现它们已密密麻麻爬满他的双脚。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Sylvia was in low spirits because her throat infection left her very ________ and made her solo at the party impossible.
questions.explanation: hoarse 意为'（嗓子）嘶哑的'，throat infection left her very hoarse 即咽喉感染使她嗓音嘶哑，故无法独唱；dumb 哑的，silent 沉默的，speechless（因震惊）说不出话的。句意：西尔维娅情绪低落，因为咽喉感染让她嗓音嘶哑，聚会上无法再独唱。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It's not far to the village if we take the short ________ through the jungle.
questions.explanation: cut 意为'捷径'，take the short cut 即抄近路；pass 山口、关口，corner 拐角，turning 转弯处。句意：如果从丛林中抄近路，到村子就不远了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Working under the new expert who always encourages creativity in young peo­ple, we have been ________ with better ideas in test design.
questions.explanation: come up with 意为'想出（主意、方案）'，have been coming up with better ideas 即不断想出更好的点子；come down 下降、病倒，come out 出版、显露，come along 进展、一起来。句意：在一位总是鼓励年轻人发挥创造力的新专家手下工作，我们在测试设计方面不断想出更好的点子。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Label on bottle of medicine: It is dangerous to exceed the stated ________.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 C。dose 意为'（药的）一剂、剂量'，exceed the stated dose 即超过规定剂量，是药瓶标签的惯用警示语；drops 滴剂，measure 计量单位，limit 泛指限度，不如 dose 贴切。句意：药瓶标签：超过规定剂量是危险的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She is as ________ as her mother is beautiful.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 A。plain 意为'相貌平平的'，与 beautiful（漂亮的）构成同一维度的对照，即'她母亲多漂亮，她就多平凡'；common 普通的，humble 谦卑的，dull 指乏味、迟钝，不形容外貌。句意：她相貌平平，而她母亲却很漂亮。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Get him to sign the contract before he has second ________.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 B。have second thoughts 为固定搭配，意为'（对原决定）产生动摇、改变主意'；plans/intentions/ideas 均不构成此习语。句意：趁他还没改变主意，赶紧让他签下合同。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If you keep getting wrong numbers, your phone could be ________.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 D。defective 意为'（机器、产品）有毛病的'，总接到错号说明电话机本身有缺陷；deceptive 骗人的，ineffective 不起效果的（多指方法、措施），deficient 不足的、缺乏的。句意：如果你总是接到错的号码，你的电话可能出了毛病。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It was difficult to ________ a date which was convenient for everyone.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 B。arrange 意为'安排'，arrange a date（安排日期）为惯用搭配；decide 须说 decide on a date，organize 多指组织活动，provide 提供（provide a date 不通）。句意：很难安排出一个对大家都方便的日期。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: "Do you like your new job?" "Yes, it's very ________ work."
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 A。enjoyable 意为'令人愉快的'，可修饰事物（enjoyable work 令人愉快的工作）；joyful 意为'充满欢乐的'，多形容人、气氛、场合；enjoyed/enjoying 为分词形式，不作前置定语。句意：'你喜欢新工作吗？''喜欢，这是份令人愉快的工作。'

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is ________ whether Sam will come to attend his best friend's funeral as he has taken the town's money and made off with it.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 B。It is doubtful whether... 为固定句型，意为'…是否会…令人怀疑'；unlikely/improbable 后习惯接 that 从句或不定式，不接 whether；unexpected 不接 whether。句意：萨姆是否会来参加他挚友的葬礼令人怀疑，因为他卷走了镇里的钱。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: To attend the grand dinner party, the French cabinet minister had a new suit made to ________.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 A。(made) to order 为固定搭配，意为'定做的'，have a new suit made to order 即定做一套新西服；direction/instruction/command 均无 to...表'定做'的用法。句意：为出席盛大晚宴，这位法国内阁部长定做了一套新西服。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Present at the Christmas party were the two princesses and their ________ husbands and the Duke of Edinburgh.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 C。respective 意为'各自的'，their respective husbands 即她们各自的丈夫，与'两位公主'对应；respectable 体面的，respectful 恭敬的，respected 受人尊敬的，语义均不合。句意：出席圣诞晚会的有两位公主、她们各自的丈夫以及爱丁堡公爵。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In an attempt to get to the ________ of the problem, the reporter interviewed every eyewitness.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 A。get to the root of 为固定搭配，意为'查明…的根源'，get to the root of the problem 即找到问题的症结；gist 要旨（get the gist of），base 基础，center 中心，均不构成此习语。句意：为了查明问题的根源，这位记者采访了每一位目击者。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The narrow, sunless hall smelled ________ of stale cabbage.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 B。unpleasantly 意为'令人不快地'，smelled unpleasantly of stale cabbage 即散发出难闻的馊卷心菜味；uninterestingly 无趣地（不形容气味），uninvitingly 无吸引力地，unpleasingly 并非常用词。句意：那条狭窄阴暗的过道里有一股难闻的馊卷心菜味。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The ordinary Zulu fighters were not ________ to Shaka's plan of throwing away their sandals.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 A。be opposed to 为固定搭配，意为'反对'（opposed 作形容词用）；object to 为主动用法，不能说 were not objected to；opposing/conflicting 不构成 be...to 结构。句意：普通祖鲁战士并不反对沙卡扔掉凉鞋的计划。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The tourists ________ through the fog, trying to read what was engraved on the gravestone Shakespeare had chosen for himself.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 C。peer 意为'费力地看、仔细端详'，常与 through 连用，peer through the fog 即透过浓雾费力辨认；glance 匆匆一瞥，glimpse 瞥见（及物），peep 偷看，均不合语境。句意：游客们在雾中费力地辨认，想看清莎士比亚为自己选定的墓碑上刻的文字。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There is ________ telling what the tiger will do when it is cornered.
questions.explanation: There is no telling (what...) 为固定句型，意为'无法预料…'，telling 为动名词，前面用 no；nothing/none/not 均不构成此结构。句意：无法预料老虎被逼入绝境时会做出什么来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I'm sorry, but I didn't do it on ________.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 D。on purpose 为固定搭配，意为'故意地'；intention 须用 with the intention of，design 须用 by design，choice 无 on choice 搭配。句意：对不起，我不是故意这样做的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His brother found fault ________everything the doctor said.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 C。find fault with 为固定搭配，意为'挑剔、对…吹毛求疵'；in/at/of 均不构成此短语。句意：他哥哥对医生说的每一句话都要挑毛病。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Undergraduate students have no ________ to the rare books in the school library.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 A。have (no) access to 为固定搭配，意为'有（无）权使用、接近'，have no access to the rare books 即无权使用珍本图书；entrance 指物理入口，way 方式，admission 多指入场许可。句意：本科生无权使用学校图书馆的珍本书籍。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: She is always fashionably dressed and looks ________ among the girls in plain clothes.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 B。conspicuous 意为'显眼的、惹人注目的'，look conspicuous among... 即在一群人中显得扎眼；outstanding 指成就、品质'杰出的'，unusual 不寻常的，distinguishing 有区别性的。句意：她总是衣着时髦，在一群穿着朴素衣服的女孩中显得格外显眼。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: They've bought a holiday cottage near the sea, and in ________ course they plan to move there Permanently.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 A。in due course 为固定搭配，意为'到时候、在适当的时候'；future/coming/intended 与 course 连用均非固定短语。句意：他们在海边买了一栋度假小屋，打算到时候永久搬到那里住。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Such euphemisms may be stylistically "permissible" if they are kept within ________.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 D。within limits 为固定搭配，意为'在适度范围内'，kept within limits 即保持在一定限度之内；boundaries/borders 多指地理或领域边界，ranges 指变动范围。句意：这类委婉语只要保持在适度范围内，在文体上或许算是'可以接受的'。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: All his plan for starting his own business fell ________.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 B。fall through 为固定短语，意为'（计划、安排）落空、失败'；fall in 塌陷，fall down 倒塌、跌倒，fall away 减少、脱落。句意：他创办自己公司的全部计划都落空了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The National Geographic Society headquarters, ________ in Washington, D.C. , is well-known for its magazine.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 A。situated 意为'坐落于'，be situated in 为惯用表达；placed 放置，stood 站立，positioned 安置，均不用于说明机构所在地。句意：总部位于华盛顿特区的美国国家地理学会以其杂志而闻名。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It would be unwise to ________ too much importance to what he said.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 B。attach importance to 为固定搭配，意为'重视'，attach too much importance to 即过分重视；emphasize 为及物动词直接接宾语，pay 须接 attention to，concentrate 须接 on。句意：过分看重他说的话是不明智的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The words Francis Key wrote on the back of an old letter "The Star Spangled Banner" became the national ________ of the United States.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 C。national anthem 为固定说法，意为'国歌'；song 泛指歌曲，hymn 多指宗教赞美诗，motto 座右铭、格言。句意：弗朗西斯·基写在旧信背面的《星条旗歌》成为美国国歌。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If you wear that red hat, I'll be able to ________ you in the crowd.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。spot 意为“从人群中认出、发现”，spot sb in the crowd 是惯用说法；pick 需搭配 out（pick out），discover 指发现本已存在的事物，realize 指意识到。译：如果你戴上那顶红帽子，我就能在人群中认出你。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The king's daughter threatened to drink the ________ chemical if he refused her request.
questions.explanation: deadly 意为“致命的”，常修饰毒药、化学品、武器；fatal 多指导致死亡的后果（fatal accident），mortal 指致命的疾病或“终有一死的”，deathly 意为“死一般的”。译：如果国王拒绝她的请求，公主威胁要喝下那种致命的化学品。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Hello! Aviation Electronics? Could I speak to Mr. Jones on ________ 8866, please?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。extension 意为“（电话）分机”，on extension 8866 即“请接分机 8866”；branch 分支，system 系统，exchange 电话交换台。译：您好，航空电子公司吗？请帮我接琼斯先生，分机 8866。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The Sears Company recently made ________ because of financial troubles.
questions.explanation: make cuts 为固定搭配，意为“进行削减/裁员”，与 because of financial troubles（因财务困难）呼应；demands 要求，omissions 遗漏，orders 订单，均不合语境。译：西尔斯公司近来因财务困难进行了裁员。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It's an awful ________ your wife couldn't come. I was looking forward to meet­ing her.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。It's a (great/awful) shame 为固定表达，意为“真遗憾”，后接憾事；harm 伤害，sorrow 悲伤，shock 震惊，均不用于此句型。译：真遗憾你妻子没能来，我本来很期待见到她。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I had to pay ________ on a carpet I brought in through the Customs today.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。duty 意为“关税”，pay duty on... 即“为…缴纳关税”，与 through the Customs（过海关）呼应；taxes 一般税收，rates 地方税费，fines 罚款。译：今天我为一块从海关带进来的地毯缴纳了关税。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: That's a nice coat, and the color ________ you well.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。suit 指颜色、款式“适合、相称”某人，the color suits you 是惯用说法；fit 指尺寸合身，match 指两物相配，shows 不合句意。译：那件外套不错，颜色很衬你。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Those people who are ________ are most welcome to the politicians.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。credulous 意为“轻信的、易受骗的”，政客们最欢迎轻信的人；credible 可信的，incredible/unbelievable 难以置信的，均不合逻辑。译：那些轻信的人最受政客们的欢迎。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The contents of the box must ________ to the description on the label.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。correspond to 为固定搭配，意为“与…相符、一致”，盒中之物须与标签描述相符；yield to 屈服，appeal to 呼吁/吸引，relate to 与…有关。译：盒子里的东西必须与标签上的描述相符。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Ever ________ they came to live here, they have hated everything about the place.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。标志是句首的 Ever 与主句的现在完成时 have hated：since 引导时间状语从句“自从…以来”，ever since 加强语气，主句须用完成时；when/though/if 无此用法。故选 B。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It was not until it was getting dark ________ the child remembered to go back home.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。标志是 It was not until... 结构：强调 not...until 时间状语须用 It was not until...that...，强调句中只能用 that，不能用 when/then/had。故选 C。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The Chairman was evidently ________ by Jim's words and glared at him for a few seconds.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。be put out 为固定短语，意为“被惹恼、生气”，与后文 glared at him（瞪着他）呼应；put down 记下/放下，put across 讲清楚，put away 收好。译：主席显然被吉姆的话惹恼了，瞪了他好几秒。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I ________ you that I had no intention of offending you.
questions.explanation: assure sb that... 为固定搭配，意为“向某人保证”；convince/persuade 须接 sb of sth 或 sb to do，guarantee 后一般不接“人+that”。译：我向你保证，我无意冒犯你。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Norris has decided to ________ for some evening classes next term now that he has settled down in New York.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。enroll for/in classes 为固定搭配，意为“报名参加课程”；enlist 参军/征募，engage 从事（须接 in），enter 进入，均不与 for classes 搭配。译：既然已在纽约安顿下来，诺里斯决定下学期报读一些夜校课程。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Peter prefers to be his own boss and ________ his own business.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。run one's own business 为固定搭配，意为“经营自己的生意”，与前文 be his own boss（自己当老板）呼应；charge 收费，make/take 不与 business 搭配表经营。译：彼得宁愿自己当老板，经营自己的生意。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Robert says he bought these books in a ________.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。in a sale 为固定搭配，意为“在打折促销时”购买；bargain 指便宜货本身（at a bargain），disposal 处理，reduction 减价（不与 in a 连用）。译：罗伯特说这些书是打折时买的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He was always declining their invitations on the ________ of ill health.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。on the ground(s) of 为固定搭配，意为“以…为理由”，以健康不佳为由推辞邀请；reason 需说 for the reason of，excuse 常用 on the excuse that，cause 不用于此结构。译：他总是以身体不佳为由推辞他们的邀请。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My parents, ________ touring in Britain, are looking forward to a traditional English afternoon tea in a beautiful setting.
questions.explanation: presently 意为“目前、现在”（英式用法），作插入语修饰 touring；instantly 立即，nowadays 如今（不这样作插入语），publicly 公开地。译：我父母目前正在英国游览，期待在优美的环境中享用传统的英式下午茶。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: This supermarket has an excellent ________ for fair dealing.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。have a (good/excellent) reputation for 为固定搭配，意为“因…而有好名声”；fame 常与 win/come to fame 搭配，popularity 流行、受欢迎，impression 印象。译：这家超市在公平交易方面享有极好的声誉。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The whole embarrassing ________ in the bar was a great disappointment to them and set a bad example of English hospitality.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。incident 意为“（发生的）事件、插曲”，embarrassing incident 尴尬的事件；accident 事故，thing 泛指事物，matter 泛指事情，均不如 incident 贴切。译：酒吧里那件令人尴尬的事让他们大失所望，也给英国式的好客树立了坏榜样。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Some people enjoy training; for others it is only a ________ to an end.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。a means to an end 为固定短语，意为“达到目的的手段”；way/tool/method 均不构成此习语。译：有些人喜欢训练，而对另一些人来说，训练只是达到目的的手段。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The ________ last thing Peter wants now is to enter for the annual 24-day bike race.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。the very last thing 为固定强调结构，very 作形容词加强语气，意为“恰恰是、正是（最不想做的）”；most/extremely/utterly 均为副词，不能修饰名词 last thing。译：彼得现在最不想做的事，就是报名参加一年一度的24天自行车赛。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Could you ________ me to the railway station, please?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。direct sb to a place 为固定搭配，意为“给某人指路”；lead 带领（不用于指路请求），indicate 指示、表明，how 是疑问词不能作动词。译：请问您能给我指一下去火车站的路吗？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Our holiday was ________ by bad weather.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。spoilt 意为“（假期、兴致等）被破坏、扫兴”，our holiday was spoilt by bad weather 是惯用说法；damaged 损坏具体物品，destroyed 摧毁，wasted 浪费。译：我们的假期被坏天气毁了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Mr Robinson knew that the most trivial chore could prove to be a ________ if ap­proached with enthusiasm.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。reward 意为“报偿、回报”，带着热情去做，最琐碎的杂务也会成为一种回报；prize 奖品，bonus 奖金/额外好处，refund 退款。译：罗宾逊先生知道，只要满怀热情去做，最琐碎的杂务也能成为一种回报。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: On New Year's Eve, there will be a firework ________ at People's Square.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。a firework display 为固定搭配，意为“烟火表演”；show 泛指演出，performance 文艺演出，exhibition 展览，均不与 firework 构成固定搭配。译：除夕夜将在人民广场举行烟火表演。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The crippled Westley proudly walked with a ________ to the platform to join the children.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。limp 意为“跛行”，walk with a limp 一瘸一拐地走，与 crippled（跛脚的）呼应；jump 跳，hop 单脚跳，jog 慢跑。译：跛脚的韦斯特利一瘸一拐却自豪地走向平台，加入孩子们中间。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Betty advised me to label our luggage carefully in case it gets ________ in transit.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。mislay 意为“随手放丢、遗失”，给行李仔细贴标签是为了防止运输途中遗失；misuse 误用，mishandle 粗暴搬运，mistake 常接 for（误认为）。译：贝蒂叮嘱我仔细给行李贴好标签，以防运输途中遗失。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When Langston waited to be saved by Jesus, he saw the lighted candles on the altar ________ in the draught from the opening window.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。flicker 意为“（火焰、烛光）摇曳、闪烁”，烛火在穿堂风中 flicker 是惯用说法；flutter 指旗帜、翅膀拍动，shiver 指人因冷发抖，waver 指犹豫、动摇。译：当兰斯顿等待耶稣来拯救他时，他看到圣坛上点燃的蜡烛在窗口吹进的穿堂风中摇曳。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Marilyn will not be able to come to the Christmas party as she is ________ with a cold.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。be laid up (with) 为固定短语，意为“因病卧床、病例”，与 with a cold 呼应；laid down 放下/规定，laid out 布置/陈列，laid by 储存。译：玛丽莲不能来参加圣诞聚会了，因为她感冒躺下了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I can't read the marks and notes Jenny made in the margin because they are too ________.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。faint 意为“（字迹、声音）淡的、模糊不清的”，字迹太淡看不清用 faint；misty 多雾的、朦胧的，transparent 透明的，opaque 不透明的。译：我看不清珍妮在页边做的记号和笔记，因为它们太淡了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Mr. Harrington asked his son Clive to buy a ________ of bread at the baker's near his school.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。a loaf of bread 为固定量词搭配，“一条（个）面包”；pound 磅，packet 小包，bag 袋，均不与 bread 构成惯用量词。译：哈林顿先生让儿子克莱夫在学校附近的面包店买一条面包。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The two pieces of fried steak Mr. King had for dinner gave him ________.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。油炸食品吃多了最易引起肠胃不适，give him an upset stomach 合乎逻辑；a headache 头痛，a sore throat 嗓子痛，an infection 感染，均与吃油炸牛排无直接因果。译：金先生晚餐吃的两块炸牛排让他肠胃不适。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The young student who wears her long hair in ________ is from Yokohama.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。plait 意为“辫子”，wear one's hair in plaits 梳着辫子；tails 单独用不表辫子（须说 pigtails），fringe 刘海，ends 发梢。译：那个梳着长辫子的年轻学生来自横滨。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Fred doesn't like white coffee, nor does he like to put cream on his strawberries, be-cause he prefers them ________.
questions.explanation: plain 意为“（食物）不加东西的、原味的”，prefers them plain 即喜欢吃原味的；natural 天然的，simple 简单的，ordinary 普通的，均不如 plain 贴切。译：弗雷德不喜欢加奶的白咖啡，也不喜欢在草莓上加奶油，因为他喜欢原味的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: To say that all Americans wear ________ coloured clothes is a generalization.
questions.explanation: brightly coloured 为固定搭配，意为“色彩鲜艳的”，副词 brightly 修饰 coloured；well/gloriously/radiantly 均不与 coloured 连用。译：说所有美国人都穿色彩鲜艳的衣服是一种以偏概全的说法。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Could you please help me to ________ this wardrobe because it is too heavy.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。shift 意为“挪动、搬动（重物）”，因衣柜太重请人帮忙挪动用 shift 最贴切；remove 指移除拿走，carry 指搬运，pick up 指拿起。译：这个衣柜太重了，你能帮我把它挪动一下吗？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Don't leave your brand-new sweater and pajamas on the floor; please hang them on the ________ behind the door.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。hook 意为“挂钩”，hang them on the hook 挂在门后的挂钩上；rod 杆，pole 柱子，log 原木，均不是挂在门后的东西。译：别把崭新的毛衣和睡衣扔在地板上，请把它们挂在门后的挂钩上。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Christopher couldn't tell us the name of the monster he read about in the newspaper although it was on the ________ of his tongue.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。on the tip of one's tongue 为固定习语，意为“话到嘴边（却想不起来）”；end/slip/back 均不构成此习语。译：克里斯托弗说不出报纸上读到的那只怪物的名字，尽管那名字就在他嘴边。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Jean is slow but her brother, on the contrary, is quick at ________ the point of an argu­ment.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。grasp 意为“理解、领会”，grasp the point of an argument 即“领会论点要旨”；snatch 抢夺，capture 俘获，grab 抓取，均指具体动作。译：琼虽然迟钝，但她的兄弟恰恰相反，能很快领会论点的要旨。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In the headmaster's office, exercise- books kept ________ owing to the fact that he had marked very little recently.
questions.explanation: pile up 为固定短语，意为“堆积、越积越多”，练习本因很少批改而不断堆积；heap on/grow up/pile on 均不表达此意。译：校长办公室里的练习本一直越堆越多，因为他近来很少批改。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My journey to Croydon proved to be a miserable one as the rain did not ________.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。let up 意为“（雨、雪）减弱、停歇”，主语常为雨；clear up 指（天气）转晴，主语通常是 weather/the sky，got off 下车，slow down 减速。译：我去克罗伊登的旅程很糟糕，因为雨一直没有停。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Shakespeare's play "The Taming of the Shrew" is on ________ 3 tonight.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。channel 意为“（电视）频道”，on channel 3 即“在 3 频道播出”；wavelength 波长，post 岗位/邮寄，band 波段。译：今晚 3 频道将播出莎士比亚的戏剧《驯悍记》。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The tourists ________ through the fog, trying to read what was engraved on the grave-stone Shakespeare had chosen for himself.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。peer 意为“费力地凝视、眯眼细看”，peer through the fog 为固定搭配；glance/glimpse 指匆匆一瞥，peep 偷看。译：游客们在雾中费力地张望，想看清莎士比亚为自己选定的墓碑上镌刻的文字。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After visiting the Holy Trinity Church, the boys ________ leaving so long that they al-most missed the last train to London.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。put off doing 为固定搭配，意为“推迟做某事”，一再推迟动身以致差点误了末班车；stopped leaving 意为“停止离开（不再走）”不合逻辑，halted 不接动名词，delayed 不如 put off doing 惯用。译：参观完三一教堂后，男孩们一再推迟动身，结果差点误了去伦敦的末班车。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: At the party the ________ shy Chelsea felt comfortable enough to offer to give the guests a piano solo.
questions.explanation: ordinarily 意为“平常、通常”，the ordinarily shy Chelsea 即“平时害羞的切尔西”，与后文 felt comfortable 形成对比；always/never 与语境矛盾，completely 不修饰 shy 表常态。译：在聚会上，平时害羞的切尔西感到十分自在，主动提出为客人弹奏一首钢琴独奏曲。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If one slat in a Venetian blind is ________ in the wrong direction, Murray can't have a moment's peace until he has fixed it.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。tip 意为“使倾斜、扳斜”，百叶窗叶片被扳错方向用 be tipped；topped 加顶，tapped 轻敲，toyed 是不及物动词。译：如果百叶窗有一片叶片被扳斜了方向，默里就一刻也不得安宁，非把它调正不可。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Mary really couldn't stand the music by Richard Wagner, ________ David couldn't hear enough of it.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。标志是前后分句语义对比（玛丽受不了 vs 大卫听不够）：whereas 引导对比状语从句，意为“然而、反之”；because 表因果，although 表让步，when 表时间，均不合逻辑。故选 B。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The scientists realized it would be too ________ to lift the ship in one piece because it was fragile.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。risky 意为“有风险的”，因船体易碎，整体打捞有失败的风险，too risky to... 合逻辑；bold/daring 意为“大胆的”（褒义，不合语境），dangerous 危险的（侧重伤及人身）。译：科学家们意识到把船整体打捞上来风险太大，因为船体易碎。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We think this patient is going to be ________ on Tuesday by Dr Smith.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。examine 意为“检查（身体）”，be examined by Dr Smith 即“由史密斯医生检查”；operate 表“动手术”须说 be operated on，此处 on 已被 Tuesday 占用；inspect 查看（设施），handle 处理。译：我们认为这位病人周二将由史密斯医生检查。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________, a telephone is one of the most useful things in the world when it's working properly.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。on the whole 为固定搭配，意为“总的来说、大体上”；as a whole 意为“作为一个整体”（修饰名词），above all 最重要的是，as the whole 不存在。译：总的来说，电话在正常工作时是世界上最有用的东西之一。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________ dull Fred may be, he is certainly popular.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。标志是空格后直接接形容词 dull：however+形容词+主语+谓语构成让步状语从句，意为“无论…多么”；although/whatever/even if 均不能这样接前置形容词构成倒装让步。故选 C。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The secretary found the missing sample for TEM 8 ________ on the top shelf the next day.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。lie（平躺、位于）的现在分词是 lying，样本“躺在”架子上用 find it lying on the shelf；laying 是及物动词 lay（放置）的 -ing 形式，须带宾语；resting 不如此处惯用，placing 意为“放置”语义不通。译：第二天，秘书发现那份失踪的英语专业八级考试试卷样本躺在顶层架子上。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Though the hotel has only been open for a few days, it is already ________ booked.
questions.explanation: heavily booked 为固定搭配，意为“（客房等）被大量预订、订满”；expectantly 期待地，immediately/quickly 均不与 booked 构成惯用搭配。译：这家酒店虽然开张才几天，但已被大量预订。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The ________ rising numbers of those out of work will add greatly to the government's problems.
questions.explanation: steeply 意为“急剧地”，steeply rising numbers 即“急剧上升的数字”，副词修饰 rising；high 为形容词不能修饰 rising，hard 不用于此搭配，rocket 是动词/名词。译：不断急剧上升的失业人数将大大增加政府的难题。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Linda asked to be ________ to you.
questions.explanation: remember sb to sb 为固定搭配，意为“代某人向某人问好”；reminded 提醒，regarded 看待，recalled 召回/回想。译：琳达要我代她向你问好。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The highest mountain in New Zealand, Mount Cook, is now 10 feet shorter because some of the ________ at its top slid down in 1991.
questions.explanation: land 此处指山顶的土石、山体部分；soil 指可耕种的土壤，earth/dirt 指泥土、尘土，均不用于描述山体顶部滑落的土石。译：新西兰最高峰库克山现在矮了 10 英尺，因为 1991 年山顶的部分土石滑落了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When Ken studied at Stanford University, he lived ________ the University.
questions.explanation: a long way from 为固定搭配，lived a long way from the university 即“住得离大学很远”；out of 从…出来，apart from 除…之外，distant from 不与 live 如此连用。译：肯在斯坦福大学求学时，住得离学校很远。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Olivia obviously had no ________ of doing any work that day, although it was only a week before the Proficiency Test.
questions.explanation: have no intention of doing 为固定搭配，意为“无意做某事”；willingness 需说 be willing to do，ambition/desire 不与 of doing 构成此惯用否定。译：尽管离水平考试只有一周，奥利维亚显然那天无意做任何功课。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________ people are contemptuous of those who make obscene calls.
questions.explanation: respectable 意为“体面的、正派的”，正派的人鄙视打淫秽电话者；respectful 恭敬的（对人表示尊敬），respective 各自的，respected 受人尊敬的，均不合逻辑。译：正派的人都鄙视那些打淫秽电话的人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The National Gallery in London has more visitors than ________ any other because of its free admission.
questions.explanation: practically 意为“几乎、简直”，more visitors than practically any other 即“几乎比其他任何一家都多”；really/actually 指事实上，completely 不修饰 any other。译：由于免费入场，伦敦国家美术馆的参观者几乎比其他任何美术馆都多。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Mr. Johnson had a terrible cold and could not stop ________.
questions.explanation: sneeze 意为“打喷嚏”，重感冒导致不停地打喷嚏；sigh 叹气，yawn 打哈欠，spit 吐痰，均与感冒症状无关。译：约翰逊先生得了重感冒，不停地打喷嚏。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We haven't the ________ idea why we got such a massive telephone bill last month.
questions.explanation: not have the foggiest idea 为固定习语，意为“完全不知道”；dampest/mistiest/rainiest 虽同属天气类形容词，但不构成此习语。译：我们完全不知道上个月怎么会收到那么巨额的电话账单。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: David, who was spoilt, having been born with a ________ spoon in his mouth, was a very difficult student.
questions.explanation: born with a silver spoon in one's mouth 为固定习语，意为“生于富贵之家”，与 spoilt（娇生惯养）呼应；diamond/iron/gold 均不构成此习语。译：大卫生来就含着银汤匙（生于富贵之家），娇生惯养，是个很难教的学生。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We keep our curriculum _______ the changes in the business world more, I think, than other business school.
questions.explanation: keep abreast of 为固定搭配，意为“与…保持同步、及时了解…的最新情况”；ahead of 领先于，aloof from 对…冷漠疏远，aside from 除…之外。译：我认为，我们让课程跟上商业世界变化的程度比其他商学院更大。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Ronny’s steps died away, and there was a moment of ______ silence.
questions.explanation: absolute silence 为固定搭配，意为“万籁俱寂、绝对的寂静”；absent 缺席的，abstract 抽象的，accurate 精确的，均不修饰 silence。译：罗尼的脚步声渐渐远去，接着是一阵死一般的寂静。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In the past, common people can not possibly get _______ to the Imperial Palace.
questions.explanation: get access to 为固定搭配，意为“获得进入…的权利/机会”；approach 表“接近”不与 get...to 如此搭配，permission 需接 to do（get permission to enter），abdication 退位。译：过去，平民根本不可能获准进入皇宫。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Melting snow _______ for the regular spring floods in this areas.
questions.explanation: account for 为固定搭配，意为“是…的原因、解释”，融雪正是春汛的原因；accumulate 积累，compete 竞争，deposit 沉积，均不接 for 表原因。译：融雪是这个地区春季经常发生洪水的原因。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Very few foreigner travel in Sweden in winter _______ the intense cold.
questions.explanation: on account of 为介词短语，意为“由于”，多引出消极原因（严寒阻止旅行）；thanks to 意为“多亏”（积极原因），since 是连词须接从句，for the sake of 为了…起见。译：由于极度寒冷，冬天很少有外国游客在瑞典旅行。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The writer of the novel is well _______ with the problem in the company because she has been working there for almost a decade.
questions.explanation: be acquainted with 为固定搭配，意为“熟悉、了解”；enlightened 开明的，be informed of/about 获悉，acknowledged 公认的，均不构成此搭配。译：这位小说作者非常熟悉公司里的问题，因为她在那里工作了近十年。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He was unable to ______ to the group what he meant.
questions.explanation: get across (to sb) 为固定短语，意为“把…讲清楚、使被理解”；get in 进入，get along 相处/进展，get off 下车，均不合句意。译：他无法让全组人理解他的意思。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Individuals with characteristics ________ survive and make up an increasingly large proportion of their species, thus evolving new conditions.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。空格在名词 characteristics 之后作后置定语：特征与“适应”之间是被动关系，须用过去分词 adapted to（适应于…的）；exist 为动词原形不能作定语，existed 形式错误，现存环境应用 existing。故选 C。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Family planning has been _______ by the Chinese government for several decades.
questions.explanation: advocate 意为“提倡、倡导”，计划生育多年来一直被政府提倡；invoke 援引，adapt 适应/改编，convoke 召集（会议），均不合句意。译：几十年来，计划生育一直为中国政府所提倡。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The news had already been _______ before it was officially announced.
questions.explanation: in the air 意为“（消息、谣言等）在流传中”，消息在正式宣布前早已传开；on the air 指（电台、电视）正在播出，by air 乘飞机，among air 不存在。译：这条消息在正式宣布之前早已不胫而走。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: ________ to the art exhibition.
options: All but he and I am going
All but him and me are going
All but him and I am going
All but he and me are going
questions.explanation: 标志是 but 在此作介词“除…之外”：介词后的人称代词须用宾格，即 him and me；All 指三者以上作主语，谓语用复数 are going。故选 B。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My dress was too large so I went to the tailor’s and have it ______ .
questions.explanation: alter 意为“修改、改做（衣服）”，have it altered 即“找人把衣服改了”；adjusted 调整（机械、位置），changed 更换，turned 翻转。译：我的连衣裙太大了，于是我到裁缝店把它改了改。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His letter ________ an admission that he has done wrong.
questions.explanation: amount to 为固定搭配，意为“等于、实际上就是”，他的信等于承认错误；expose to 暴露于，yield to 屈服于，ascribe to 把…归因于。译：他的信等于承认自己做错了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Before you begin, try to __________ the difficulties.
questions.explanation: anticipate 意为“预见、预料（并预先作准备）”，开始之前预见困难；expect 期待、预计（等待某事发生），participate 参加，precipitate 促成/使突然发生。译：在开始之前，尽量预先估计到可能出现的困难。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The speaker ______ the feeling of his audience rather than to their reason.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。标志是后文 rather than to their reason 中的介词 to：前后须平行，appeal to 意为“诉诸、打动（情感、理智）”；appeal for 后接要争取的事物，arouse 及物不接 to/for。故选 C。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Today, housework has been made much easier by electrical _________ .
questions.explanation: electrical appliances 为固定搭配，意为“家用电器”；facilities 公共设施，instruments 精密仪器/乐器，equipment 为不可数名词没有 -s 形式。译：如今，家用电器使家务劳动轻松多了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Mrs. Harris’ ______ smile let us know that our speeches were well done.
questions.explanation: approving 意为“赞许的”（现在分词作定语表主动认可），approving smile 赞许的微笑；permitting 允许，admitting 承认，agreeing 同意，均不修饰 smile。译：哈里斯夫人赞许的微笑让我们知道我们的演讲很成功。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: A good judge tries to be fair and does not make ________ decision.
questions.explanation: arbitrary 意为“武断的、随心所欲的”，与 fair 呼应：公正的法官不做武断的裁决；objective 客观的（与公正同向），sympathetic 同情的，definite 明确的。译：好的法官力求公正，不做武断的裁决。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After the accident, she began to wear a set of ________ teeth.
questions.explanation: artificial teeth 为固定搭配，意为“假牙”；supernatural 超自然的，superficial 肤浅的/表面的，superstitious 迷信的。译：那次事故之后，她开始戴一副假牙。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He must have been almost the same age _______ when I first met him.
questions.explanation: 标志是 the same age：the same...as 结构中 as 引导定语从句，指代 the same age，从句可倒装为 as was my father；like 不能引导从句，with 介词不通，which 不与 the same 搭配。故选 A。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He _______ his belief that she was innocent.
questions.explanation: assert one's belief 为固定搭配，意为“断言、坚称自己的信念”；affirm 侧重肯定、证实，maintain 侧重在反驳中坚持，stress 强调（重点），均不如 assert 与 belief 贴合。译：他坚称她是无辜的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I’d like it to be my ______ , for I can do it only in my spare time.
questions.explanation: avocation 意为“业余爱好、副业”，只能在业余时间做，故为 avocation；vocation 职业、天职，vacation 假期，aversion 厌恶。译：我愿意把它当作我的业余爱好，因为我只能在业余时间做这件事。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When American astronaut Glen returned to the earth a hearty welcome ______ him.
questions.explanation: await 意为“等候着（某人）”，是及物动词，a hearty welcome awaited him 合语法；wait for 须带介词 for，anticipate/expect 的主语应是人而非 welcome。译：当美国宇航员格伦返回地球时，热烈的欢迎正等待着他。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: You’d better _______ when you speak to the boss. He is in a very bad mood this morning.
questions.explanation: watch your step 为固定习语，意为“小心行事、说话谨慎”，与老板心情很糟呼应；put your foot in it 说错话惹麻烦，steal a match 无此说法，mind your pace 注意步伐。译：你跟老板说话时最好小心点，他今天上午心情很不好。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Skyscrapers also interfere with television reception, ____ bird flyways, and obstruct air traffic.
questions.explanation: block 意为“阻塞、挡住”，挡住候鸟迁徙通道，与 interfere with、obstruct 并列表阻碍；disturb 打扰，destroy/ruin 摧毁（对象常为成果、建筑）。译：摩天大楼还会干扰电视接收、挡住候鸟的迁徙通道并妨碍空中交通。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: If you plant two orange trees in one square yard of land, and the trees’ productivity ______ decline.
questions.explanation: be bound to do 为固定搭配，意为“必定会”，一地种两棵树产量必然下降；be determined to 决心（主语多为人），be unlikely to 不太可能，be related to 与…有关。译：如果你在一平方码的土地上种两棵橙树，树的产量必定会下降。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Difficulties and hardships have _______ the best qualities of the young geologist.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。bring out 为固定短语，意为“激发出、使显现”，艰难困苦激发出他最优秀的品质；bring up 抚养，bring about 导致，bring on 引发（疾病）。故选 B。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In general, our society is becoming one of giant enterprises directed by ______ management.
questions.explanation: 空格处需形容词修饰 management：bureaucratic 意为“官僚的”；bureau 局，bureaucrat 官僚（名词），bureaucratical 为不规范变体。译：总体而言，我们的社会正在变成一个由官僚化管理主导的巨型企业。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Because of the unexpected illness of the players, the football match has been ________ .
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。cancel 意为“取消（比赛、活动、安排）”，球员突然患病，比赛被取消；abolish 废除（制度、法律），annull 废除（婚约、合同），revoke 撤销（决定、执照）。译：由于球员意外患病，这场足球赛已被取消。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The newly built auditorium has a seating _______ of 4,000.
questions.explanation: seating capacity 为固定搭配，意为“（场所的）容纳人数”；ability 能力，capability 才能，faculty 才能/全体教员。译：新建的礼堂可容纳 4000 人。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: whether changes should be made in the voting system is a _______ .
questions.explanation: 标志是多个修饰语共同修饰名词 question：按形容词排序规则，越是事物本质分类的形容词越靠近名词，故 political 紧贴 question，程度性修饰（highly changed）置于其前；C、D 的语序或词性错误。故选 B。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He doesn’t want to live on _______ , so went to the country to become a peasant there.
questions.explanation: live on charity 为固定搭配，意为“靠救济金/施舍生活”；clarity 清晰，chastity 贞洁，brevity 简短。译：他不愿靠救济过活，于是去了乡下当农民。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The youth who expects to get on in the world must make up his mind that, _______ , he will succeed.
questions.explanation: 标志是插入语 come what may：这是虚拟语气倒装的固定表达（=whatever may happen），动词原形 come 提前，意为“无论如何”；其余三项均不是正确形式。故选 B。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Your _______ at the party would be deeply appreciated. If you could not come, please inform us at your earliest convenience.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。company 此处为不可数名词，意为“陪伴、在场”，your company would be deeply appreciated 即“你能光临将不胜感激”；companion 是可数名词“同伴”，present 作名词意为“礼物”，attendant 随从。译：你能光临聚会我们将不胜感激；如不能来，请尽早告知。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The actor became very ________ after he made a name for himself.
questions.explanation: conceited 意为“自负的、自高自大的”，成名后变得自负；haughty 指对他人傲慢倨傲，haunted 受困扰的/闹鬼的，contemptuous 鄙视他人的。译：这位演员成名之后变得非常自负。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I don’t quite understand your attitude toward the government from your lecture. Could you ________ on that?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。elaborate on 为固定搭配，意为“详细阐述”，与语境“不太明白你的态度，能否详细说明”呼应；elevate 提升，concentrate on 集中于，illustrate 举例说明（及物，不接 on）。译：从你的演讲中我不太明白你对政府的态度，能否就这一点详细谈谈？

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I’d get it for you _______ I could remember who last borrowed it.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。if only 引导含蓄条件，表示“要是…就好了”，含惋惜语气，如 I'd get it for you, if only I could remember；on condition that 多用于提出可兑现的条件，except that 意为“除了”，considering whether 不合句法。译：要是我还记得这本书最后是谁借走的，我就把它拿给你。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: What I am telling you is strictly ________ .Don’t let anyone know of it.
questions.explanation: confidential 意为“机密的、保密的”，strictly confidential 绝对机密；secretive 指（人）遮遮掩掩的，special 特别的，individual 个人的。译：我现在告诉你的是绝密信息，别让任何人知道。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Margaret made a lot of effort to persuade her father into _________ to her going to the United States to study business administration in Harvard University.
questions.explanation: consent to 为固定搭配，意为“同意”，persuade sb into doing 说服某人做…，即说服父亲同意她赴美；contend 争辩/竞争，contest 争夺，content 使满足。译：玛格丽特费了很大力气说服父亲同意她去哈佛大学攻读工商管理。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: People today spend a _______ portion of their time conferring on the proper way to bring up children.
questions.explanation: considerable 意为“相当大的”，a considerable portion of their time；considered 经深思熟虑的，considerate 体贴的，considering 考虑到（介词）。译：如今人们花相当多的时间来讨论养育孩子的恰当方式。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Women used to be treated as the inferior sex though they _______ half the population.
questions.explanation: constitute 意为“（部分）构成（整体）”，女性占人口一半用 constitute；comprise 传统用法指整体“包含”部分，compromised 意为“妥协”，contained 容纳。译：尽管妇女占人口的一半，但过去却被当作低等性别对待。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: With a standard bulb, only 5% of the electricity is ________ to light, the rest is wasted away as heat.
questions.explanation: be converted to/into 为固定搭配，意为“被转化为”，电能转化为光；compressed 压缩，exhausted 耗尽，confined 限制于。译：使用标准灯泡时，只有 5% 的电能转化为光，其余都以热量形式浪费掉。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After a series of failures, the truth began to ________ him.
questions.explanation: dawn on sb 为固定搭配，意为“（真相、道理）开始被某人明白”；dawn to 不存在此搭配，light for/in 均不成立。译：经历一连串失败之后，他开始明白这个道理。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: _________ are better than words when people are in need of help.
questions.explanation: deed 意为“行动、行为”，Deeds are better than words 即“行动胜于言语”；reeds 芦苇，activities 活动，behaviors 行为举止。译：当人们需要帮助时，行动胜过言语。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I’d like to ______ the main subject of my speech for a few moments.
questions.explanation: depart from 为固定搭配，意为“离开、偏离（主题、常规）”，暂时离开演讲主题；part from 与（人）分别，part with 舍弃（物品），depart with 不成立。译：我想暂时离开我演讲的主题谈几句。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: On Sunday, the business center of the city was quite _________ .
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。deserted 意为“空无一人、冷清的”，形容周日无人的商业中心；vanished 不作表语形容场所，abandoned 被遗弃的，abolished 被废除的。译：星期天，这座城市的商业中心十分冷清。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My supply of confidence slowly _______ as the deadline approached.
questions.explanation: diminish 意为“逐渐减少、减弱”，信心随截止日期临近而渐减；abolish/eliminate/exterminate 均为及物动词“废除、消灭”，主语应为施动者。译：随着截止日期的临近，我的自信心慢慢减退。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There seems to be a _______ between what I see of him and what people have said of him.
questions.explanation: discrepancy 意为“（说法与事实间的）差异、出入”，discrepancy between...and... 为固定搭配；inconsistency 侧重言行前后矛盾，incontinuity 非规范词，disparagement 贬低。译：我亲眼见到的他与人们所说的他之间似乎有出入。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He is ______ for his knowledge in physics.
questions.explanation: be distinguished for 为固定搭配，意为“以…著称”；distinct 清楚的、有区别的，distinctive 独特的，distinguishable 可辨认的。译：他以物理学方面的渊博知识而闻名。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: No artistic creation can achieve greatness if _______ from life.
questions.explanation: be divorced from 为固定搭配，意为“与…相脱离”，脱离生活的艺术创作；result 与 from 的搭配在此语序不通，escaped 逃离，shielded 被保护。译：任何艺术创作如果脱离生活，都无法达到伟大的境界。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: There is not much time left, so I’ll tell you about it _______ .
questions.explanation: in brief 意为“简短地说”，时间不多故简要讲；in detail 详尽地（与时间少矛盾），in short 总之（用于总结前文），in all 总计。译：剩下的时间不多了，所以我简要地跟你讲讲这件事。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: One feels _______ when one reads a dull story.
questions.explanation: 人作主语表“感到无聊”用 -ed 形式 bored；boring/tiresome 修饰事物本身令人厌烦，uninteresting 指事物本身乏味。译：读枯燥的故事时会感到无聊。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The managing director took the ______ for the accident, although it was not really his fault.
questions.explanation: take the blame for 为固定搭配，意为“对…承担责任、受过”；guilt 不与 take...for 搭配，take charge 掌管（for 语义不通），accusation 指控。译：总经理承担了这次事故的责任，尽管其实并不是他的过错。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The strong wind with sand comes from the _______ hill in front of their house.
questions.explanation: bare 意为“光秃秃的、无草木的”，bare hill 光秃的山；empty 空的，isolated 孤立偏僻的，remote 遥远的。译：夹带沙尘的大风来自他们房前那座光秃秃的山。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When confronted with such questions, my mind goes _______, and I can hardly remember my own date of birth.
questions.explanation: mind goes blank 为固定表达，意为“大脑一片空白”；dim 昏暗的，faint 微弱的，vain 徒劳的（in vain）。译：遇到这类问题时，我的脑子一片空白，连自己的出生日期都想不起来。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: More than two hundred years ago the United States ________ from the British Empire and became an independent country.
questions.explanation: break away from 为固定搭配，意为“脱离、挣脱”，脱离英帝国宣布独立；got off 下车/离开，pulled down 拆毁，dropped off 减少/睡着。译：两百多年前，美国脱离了大英帝国，成为一个独立的国家。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: His absolute reliability is _______ suspicion.
questions.explanation: beyond suspicion 为固定搭配，意为“无可怀疑”，from/in/with 均不与 suspicion 构成此义。整句译：他的绝对可靠无可怀疑。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I left for office earlier than usual this morning ________ traffic jam.
questions.explanation: in case of 意为“万一、以防”，符合“为防堵车而早出门”的句意；in line with 与…一致，for the sake of 为了，at the risk of 冒…的风险。整句译：为防堵车，今天早上我比平时早出门上班。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The criminal always paid _______ cash so the police could not track him down.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误：pay in cash 是固定搭配，意为“用现金付款”，on cash 不存在此搭配。整句译：这个罪犯总是用现金付款，因此警方无法追查到他。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The governor had to ______ all his appointments for the day and rushed to the train accident.
questions.explanation: call off 意为“取消”，与 appointments 搭配；set off 出发，see off 送行，pay off 还清。整句译：州长不得不取消当天的全部约会，赶赴火车事故现场。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The village was _______ two or three groups of simple houses, a church, a post office and a small general store.
questions.explanation: be composed of 意为“由…组成”；consist of 表“组成”时是主动含义，不能用被动形式 be consisted of。整句译：这个村庄由两三组简陋的房屋、一座教堂、一个邮局和一家小杂货店构成。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The picnic _______ at last after being twice postponed.
questions.explanation: come off 意为“举行、成功进行”，与 twice postponed（两次延期）呼应；came up 出现，put on 上演，go on 继续。整句译：野餐在两次推迟之后终于举行了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Thirty dollars will ________ the hotel expenses.
questions.explanation: cover 此处意为“（钱）足以支付”；spend 主语应是人，cost 主语应是物，suit 指“适合”。整句译：三十美元将够支付旅馆的费用。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: After making a great effort, we finally ________ the plan.
questions.explanation: carry out 意为“执行、实施”，carry out the plan 实施计划；carry on 继续，carry off 赢得，carry over 延续。整句译：经过巨大的努力，我们最终实施了这个计划。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He was _______ of understanding anything which involved numbers.
questions.explanation: be incapable of doing sth. 是固定搭配，意为“没有能力做某事”；unable 后须接 to do，impossible 不以人作主语，useless 意为“无用的”。整句译：他理解不了任何涉及数字的东西。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I am sorry that I must _______ your invitation owing to a previous appointment.
questions.explanation: decline 意为“婉言谢绝”（邀请、请求），与 owing to a previous appointment 的委婉语气相符；reject 是断然拒绝，accept 接受，receive 收到。整句译：很抱歉，因事先另有约会，我不得不谢绝你的邀请。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When he was asked about the missing camera, the boy ________ ever seeing it.
questions.explanation: deny doing sth. 意为“否认做过某事”，后接动名词；refuse/pretend 后接 to do，oppose 表“反对”不合句意。整句译：当被问及丢失的照相机时，那男孩否认见过它。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: He had tried everything but it made little ________ .
questions.explanation: make little difference 是固定搭配，意为“没什么影响”；effect/outcome/result 均不与 make little 构成此搭配。整句译：他什么都试过了，却没什么效果。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Undersea scientists are learning how to stay alive and work in a _______ environment.
questions.explanation: deadly 是形容词，意为“致命的”，deadly environment 指致命的深海环境；death 是名词，dying 垂死的，dead 已死的。整句译：海底科学家正在学习如何在致命的环境中生存和工作。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Old Americans are extremely reluctant to buy on _______ and likely to save as much money as possible.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误：buy on credit 是固定搭配，意为“赊购”，与后文“尽可能多攒钱”正好相对；on deposit 指“存款存入”，不与 buy 搭配。整句译：美国老年人极不愿意赊购物品，而倾向于尽可能多攒钱。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I didn’t say anything like that at all. You are purposely _______ my idea to prove your point.
questions.explanation: distort 意为“歪曲”，distorting my idea 歪曲我的观点；revise 修改，contradict 反驳，distract 使分心。整句译：我根本没说过那样的话，你是在故意歪曲我的观点来证明你的论点。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In spite of Spanish origin, Brazil also has certain things which make her _______ .
questions.explanation: distinctive 意为“独特的、与众不同的”；specific 具体的，specialized 专门的，distinguished 卓越的。整句译：尽管有西班牙血统，巴西也有一些使她独具特色的东西。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I _______ watching this performance because it is wonderful.
questions.explanation: enjoy doing sth. 是固定用法，enjoy 后必须接动名词；delight 需接 in，amuse/please 意为“使…高兴”，主语通常是物。整句译：我喜欢观看这场演出，因为它非常精彩。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The park ________ as far as the river.
questions.explanation: extend 意为“（空间上）延伸”，extend as far as the river 一直延伸到河边；advance 前进，enlarge 扩大，expand 扩张、膨胀。整句译：这座公园一直延伸到河边。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is considered that the moon contains all the ________ found on the earth.
questions.explanation: elements 意为“元素”，指化学成分；components 指机器、系统的部件，factors 因素，solids 固体。整句译：人们认为月球含有地球上发现的所有元素。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Before he started the work, I asked the builder to give me an _______ of the cost of repairing the roof.
questions.explanation: an estimate of the cost 意为“费用估算”，动工前让承包商报价；assessment 是综合评估，announcement 通知，evaluation 评价。整句译：在他动工之前，我让建筑商给我估算一下修理屋顶的费用。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is well-known that the retired workers in our country are _______ free medical care.
questions.explanation: be entitled to sth. 意为“有权享有”；associated with 与…相关联，involved in 卷入，assigned to 被分配到。整句译：众所周知，我国的退休工人有权享受免费医疗。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: My students found the book _______ . It provided them with an abundance of information on the subject.
questions.explanation: enlightening 意为“使人受启发的”，与后句“提供了大量信息”呼应；distracting 使人分心的，confusing 令人困惑的，interesting 泛指有趣。整句译：我的学生们发现这本书很有启发性，它为他们提供了这个学科的大量信息。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Your advice would be ________ valuable to him, who is present at his wit’s end.
questions.explanation: exceedingly 意为“极其、非常”；extensively 广泛地，excessively 过度地，exclusively 仅仅、专有地。整句译：你的建议对他会非常有价值，因为他此刻正一筹莫展。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: _______ all our kindness to help her, Sara refused to listen.
questions.explanation: for all 相当于 in spite of，意为“尽管”，后接名词短语；at/in/on all 均无此让步含义。整句译：尽管我们好心帮助她，萨拉还是拒绝听从。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The light gradually _______ and shapes and colors grew fainter.
questions.explanation: fade 意为“逐渐变暗、渐渐消失”，与 gradually 及后句 shapes and colors grew fainter 呼应；disappear 消失（不强调渐变），melt 融化，die 死亡。整句译：光线渐渐暗下去，形体和颜色变得越来越模糊。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I have a _______ belief in his honesty.
questions.explanation: a firm belief 是固定搭配，意为“坚定的信念”；determined 下定决心的，certain 确定的，powerful 强有力的。整句译：我对他的诚实抱有坚定的信念。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I can’t _______ what has happened to the vegetables, for they were freshly picked this morning.
questions.explanation: figure out 意为“弄清楚、想明白”；look out 当心，draw out 取出，work out 解决（问题）、算出（答案）。整句译：我弄不明白这些蔬菜出了什么问题，它们可是今天早上刚摘下来的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The statue would be perfect but for a few small _______ in its base.
questions.explanation: flaws 意为“瑕疵、缺陷”，指物体本身固有的小毛病（雕像底座的裂纹）；mistakes/errors 指言行、计算中的错误，weaknesses 指人或抽象事物的弱点。整句译：这座雕像要不是底座上有几处小瑕疵，就完美了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When the engine would not start, the mechanic inspected all the parts to find what was at ______ .
questions.explanation: at fault 是固定搭配，意为“出故障、有过错”；wrong 须与 go 搭配（go wrong），trouble/difficulty 不与 at 直接构成此义。整句译：发动机发动不起来时，机修工检查了所有部件，想找出毛病所在。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The river is already _______ its banks because of excessive rainfall, and the city is threatened with a likely flood.
questions.explanation: be flush with 意为“与…齐平”，河水与堤岸齐平即意味着即将泛滥；parallel to 与…平行，flat on/level in 无此搭配。整句译：由于降雨过多，河水已经与堤岸齐平，这座城市面临可能发生的洪水威胁。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: China is trying to keep her population _________ down.
questions.explanation: population growth 意为“人口增长”，keep growth down 即控制增长；birth 指“生育”（出生率用 birth rate），size 指体量，increase 泛指增加。整句译：中国正努力控制人口增长。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The newly elected president is determined to ________ the established policy of developing agriculture.
questions.explanation: go by 意为“遵循、依照”，go by the established policy 遵循既定政策；go after 追求，go for 努力获取，go on 继续。整句译：新当选的总统决心遵循发展农业的既定政策。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Every camera we sell comes with a two-year ________ .
questions.explanation: 此句的标准搭配应为 a two-year guarantee（两年保修单），所给四个选项中均无 guarantee 一词，按原答案选 A，疑为原题选项印刷疏漏。整句译：我们售出的每一台相机都附有两年的保修。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: To survive in the intense trade competition, we must ________ market ______ demand.
questions.explanation: gear...to... 意为“使…适应/与…配合”；improve/enhance 与 to demand 不搭配，guarantee...for 意为“为…担保”。整句译：要在激烈的贸易竞争中生存，我们必须使市场适应需求。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: When he writes, he always keeps a dictionary ________ .
questions.explanation: at hand 意为“在手边、就在旁边”；by hand 用手工，in hand 在掌握之中，out of hand 失去控制。整句译：他写作时总是把一本词典放在手边。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: We should always keep in mind that _______ decisions often lead to bitter regrets.
questions.explanation: hasty 意为“仓促的、草率的”，hasty decisions 与 bitter regrets 呼应；urgent 紧急的，instant 即刻的，prompt 迅速的（褒义）。整句译：我们应始终记住，草率的决定常常导致痛苦的后悔。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The work in the office was ______ by a constant stream of visitors.
questions.explanation: hamper 意为“妨碍、阻碍”，络绎不绝的来访者妨碍了工作；confuse 使糊涂，reverse 颠倒，perplex 使困惑（宾语通常是人）。整句译：办公室的工作被川流不息的来访者耽搁了。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The wound is not yet _______ .
questions.explanation: heal 意为“（伤口）愈合”，主语常是 wound；treat 指治疗这一动作，cure 指治愈疾病，remedy 指补救。整句译：伤口还没有愈合。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: I am _______ the habit of brushing my teeth twice daily.
questions.explanation: be in the habit of doing sth. 是固定搭配，意为“有做某事的习惯”；on/off/with 均不与 habit 构成此搭配。整句译：我养成了每天刷两次牙的习惯。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Although the main characters in the novel are so true to life, they are entirely ________ .
questions.explanation: imaginary 意为“想象中的、虚构的”，与 true to life（逼真）形成对比；imagined 表“被想象出来的”，imaginative 富有想象力的，imaginable 可想象的。整句译：虽然小说中的主要人物十分逼真，但他们完全是虚构的。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: It is well known that knowledge is the ______ condition for expansion of mind.
questions.explanation: indispensable 意为“必不可少的”；incompatible 不相容的，incredible 难以置信的，indefinite 不确定的。整句译：众所周知，知识是开阔心智的必备条件。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: In this factory the machines are not regulated _______ but are jointly controlled by a central computer system.
questions.explanation: individually 意为“单独地、各自地”，与后半句 jointly（共同地）形成对比；independently 独立地，irrespectively 不考虑地，irregularly 无规律地。整句译：这家工厂的机器不是单独调控的，而是由一个中央计算机系统联合控制。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: Human behavior is mostly a product of learning, whereas the behavior of an animal depends mainly on _______ .
questions.explanation: instinct 意为“本能”，与 learning（学习）相对，whereas 表对比；consciousness 意识，impulse 冲动，response 反应。整句译：人类的行为主要是学习的产物，而动物的行为则主要取决于本能。

questions.part: 第一部分 词汇
questions.stem: The tragedy of the Challenger _______ an ongoing controversy on all aspects of America’s space program. ---
questions.explanation: ignite 意为“点燃、引发”，ignited an ongoing controversy 引起了一场持续的争论；arise 是不及物动词，result 须接 in/from，start 不含“激起”之义。整句译：“挑战者号”的悲剧引发了一场关于美国航天计划各个方面的持续争论。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The workers are paid _______.
questions.explanation: by the hour 表示“按小时计酬”：by + the + 单位名词表计量方式，单位名词前须加定冠词 the（同类：by the day/month/pound）。译：工人们按小时领取报酬。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ found four-leaf clover is considered a lucky sign.
questions.explanation: 冠词必须置于整个名词短语的最前面：the + rarely（副词修饰分词 found）+ found + four-leaf clover；A 项裸用分词短语缺冠词，B/D 结构不完整。译：罕见找到的四叶苜蓿被认为是幸运的标志。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We _______ our breakfast when an old man came to the door.
questions.explanation: 从句 came 表明是过去时间，“吃完早饭”发生在“老人来”之前，属于“过去的过去”，用过去完成时 had just had。译：我们刚吃完早饭，一位老人就来到了门口。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: This is the first time he _______ out with her alone.
questions.explanation: This is the first time (that) sb. have/has done... 是固定句型，从句须用现在完成时 has been。译：这是他第一次单独和她外出。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: His performance in the exam is excellent. He _______ a lot of time studying.
questions.explanation: 考试成绩优异是推断依据，对已发生的过去动作作肯定推测，用 must have done（一定花了）。译：他考试表现优异，一定花了很多时间学习。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ the salary meets my expectation, I will accept the job offered.
questions.explanation: Provided that 意为“只要、假如”，引导条件状语从句；Due to 不能接从句，Even if/Unless 与“接受工作”的逻辑相反。译：只要薪水符合我的期望，我就接受所提供的工作。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I wouldn’t be saying this _______ I were sure of the facts.
questions.explanation: unless 意为“除非（如果不）”，与主句 wouldn't 搭配；provided that 意为“只要”，逻辑正好相反。译：除非我确信这些事实，否则我不会说这些话。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If law and order _______ not preserved, neither the citizen nor her property is safe.
questions.explanation: law and order（法制与秩序）是固定短语，指单一的整体概念，作主语时谓语用单数 is。译：如果法制与秩序得不到维护，公民及其财产都不安全。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: One of the students who _______ to the authority about the problem of pollution raises his hand.
questions.explanation: 在 one of + 复数名词 + who... 结构中，定语从句的先行词是复数名词 students，从句谓语须用复数 have written。译：曾写信向当局反映污染问题的学生中，有一位举起了手。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The linebacker and captain of the team _______ most valuable player.
questions.explanation: the linebacker and captain 共用一个冠词，指同一人身兼两职，主语为单数；且球员是被评选，故用 has been selected。译：那位线卫兼队长被评为最有价值球员。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ of books on how to prepare for the entrance examination are compiled by him.
questions.explanation: a number of + 复数名词 意为“许多”，谓语用复数 are；the number of（…的数量）才接单数谓语。译：他编写了许多关于如何准备入学考试的书。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The majority _______ on Ben’s side. But Peter disagrees with them on two points.
questions.explanation: the majority 表“大多数成员”，后文用 them 指代说明强调个体，谓语用复数 are。译：大多数人站在本恩一边，但彼得在两点上不同意他们的看法。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Whether or not the new plan will yield any positive result _______ to be seen.
questions.explanation: whether 引导的主语从句作主语时，谓语用单数；remain 是主动含义，不能用被动 is remained，故选 remains。译：新计划能否产生积极的效果尚待观察。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: More than one best authority on science fiction _______ James Newman a science-fiction writer.
questions.explanation: more than one + 单数名词 虽意义为复数，谓语习惯上用单数，故 does not consider。译：不止一位科幻小说的权威人士认为詹姆斯·纽曼算不上科幻作家。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: John’s father, along with his two uncles, _______ in New York one more day.
questions.explanation: along with his two uncles 是附加成分，按就远原则谓语随主语 John's father 用单数 demands；demand 表“要求”时宾语从句须用（should）+ 动词原形，即 stay。译：约翰的父亲连同他的两个叔叔都要求他在纽约再待一天。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The cat with her kittens _______ in the bay window when I entered the room yesterday.
questions.explanation: with her kittens 是附加成分，就远原则谓语随 the cat 用单数；when I entered 表示过去某一时刻正在进行，用过去进行时 was sitting。译：昨天我进屋时，那只猫正带着小猫们趴在飘窗上。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The welfare department , as well as the other services, will have ______ budget cut.
questions.explanation: as well as the other services 是附加成分，句子主语中心词是 the welfare department（单数机构），物主代词用 its。译：福利部门和其他部门一样，将面临预算削减。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The criteria for promotion ______ clearly stated.
questions.explanation: criteria 是 criterion（标准）的复数形式，谓语用复数；criteria 与 state 是被动关系，故 are clearly stated。译：晋升的标准已清楚列明。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is said that most of the film we are going to see ______ the organized bank robbery.
questions.explanation: most of + 单数名词（film）作主语时，谓语用单数 describes。译：据说我们要看的这部电影大部分描述的是这起有组织的银行抢劫案。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The museum _______ the public every day.
questions.explanation: be open to the public 意为“对公众开放”，open 此处是形容词表状态，不用被动态（is opened/is being opened 不对）；opens 后又缺介词 to。译：这家博物馆每天向公众开放。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The jury _______ in opinion about “sentence to death.”
questions.explanation: jury 是集体名词，in opinion（意见不一）说明成员看法各异，视为个体，谓语用复数 disagree。译：陪审团在对“判处死刑”的问题上意见不一致。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There was nothing they could do _______.
questions.explanation: do nothing but do：but 前面有实义动词 do 时，其后的不定式省略 to，故用 but wait。译：他们除了等待别无办法。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: To her parents’ surprise, despite frequent absence, she managed ______ her studies.
questions.explanation: manage to do sth. 是固定用法，后接不定式；catch up on 意为“补上（拖欠的事）”。译：令父母惊讶的是，尽管经常缺课，她还是设法补上了功课。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The children went there to watch the iron tower ______.
questions.explanation: 铁塔与 erect 是被动关系，且塔尚未竖起，用不定式被动式 to be erected 表示“将被竖起”；erecting 表主动或正在进行，与语境不符。译：孩子们去那里观看铁塔被竖起来。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Upon being questioned, he denied _______ the article.
questions.explanation: deny doing sth. 是固定用法，deny 后接动名词，不接不定式，故 denied writing。译：一经盘问，他就否认写过这篇文章。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ after a long walk, Henry called and said he could not move.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 Henry 与 wear out 是被动关系（人被累垮），用过去分词 Worn out 作状语；Having worn out 表主动，逻辑错误。译：长途步行后筋疲力尽，亨利打来电话说他动不了了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The school cannot tolerate _______ on exam.
questions.explanation: tolerate 后接动名词作宾语；作弊由学生主动发出，用 cheating。译：学校不能容忍考试作弊。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: On my return journey, I stopped ______ two power plants the country had just established.
questions.explanation: stop to do 表示停下来去做另一件事（参观电厂）；stop doing 表示停止正在做的事。译：在归途中，我停下来参观了两座这个国家新建的电厂。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: When you were talking to the policeman, I saw a teenager ______.
options: getting on your car and driving off
get on your car and drive off
getting on your car and drive off
get on your car and drive off
questions.explanation: see 是感官动词，宾补用不带 to 的不定式表示动作的全过程；get on 与 drive off 是两个并列动作，均用原形。译：当你和警察交谈时，我看见一个少年上了你的车并把它开走了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mary is a turner. She spent years in a factory _______.
questions.explanation: spend time (in) doing sth. 是固定结构，spend years 后接动名词 training。译：玛丽是一名车工，她在工厂里花了多年时间受训。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Our modern civilization must not be thought of as _______ in a short period of time.
questions.explanation: think of...as 后接动名词；create 与 civilization 是被动关系，且创造发生在“被认为”之前，故用 having been created。译：绝不应把现代文明看作是在短时间内被创造出来的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They are testing the temperature of the water with both hands ______ together in it.
questions.explanation: with + 名词 + 分词的复合结构中，hands 与 place 是被动关系，且双手正放在水里，用 being placed。译：他们正把两只手一起放到水里测试水温。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He had no alternative but _______ to see him.
questions.explanation: have no alternative but to do sth. 意为“别无选择只能做某事”，but 前没有 do，其后的不定式须保留 to。译：他别无选择，只好去见他。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The student expected there ______ more reviewing classes before the final exams.
questions.explanation: expect 后接不定式作宾补，there be 结构的不定式形式为 there to be。译：这位学生期望期末考试前能有更多的复习课。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I saw _______ waiting in line applying for the only position.
questions.explanation: 形容词可名词化表示一类人：a lot of unemployed 相当于 a lot of unemployed people（失业者）；unemployment 是抽象名词“失业”，不能排队等候，unemployee 不是英语单词。译：我看见许多失业者在排队申请这唯一的一个职位。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ is often the case in nature, the common things are the most complicated.
questions.explanation: as 引导非限制性定语从句，指代整个主句，as is often the case 意为“正如常见的情况那样”。译：正如自然界中常见的情况，普通的事物往往是最复杂的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A deadlock was reached in the discussion as neither side would give away to _______.
questions.explanation: 谈判是双方，两者中的“另一方”用 the other（one...the other...）；another 用于三者以上。译：讨论陷入僵局，因为双方都不肯向对方让步。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The scholar standing over there is _______ the great mathematician, Robert Perrier, _______.
questions.explanation: none other than 是固定搭配，意为“不是别人，正是”；himself 是反身代词作同位语，强调“他本人”。译：站在那边的那位学者不是别人，正是伟大的数学家罗伯特·佩里埃本人。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Despite all his talent, John is _______ of a writer.
questions.explanation: be nothing of a... 是固定表达，意为“根本算不上…”；something of a 意为“有几分像”，anything of a 用于疑问句和否定句。译：尽管很有天赋，约翰根本算不上一位作家。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Whatever difficulties they may come across, they will help _______ to get over them.
questions.explanation: whatever difficulties（各种各样的困难）表明成员为三者以上，相互代词用 one another（each other 传统上用于两者之间）。译：无论他们遇到什么困难，他们都会互相帮助加以克服。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There are _______ more tall buildings in New York than here.
questions.explanation: many more + 可数名词复数 意为“多得多的”，buildings 是可数名词；a little 修饰不可数名词，all/any 不能修饰比较级 more。译：纽约的高楼比这里多得多。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is the most heart-rending story _______ I have read for a long time.
questions.explanation: 先行词 story 被形容词最高级 the most heart-rending 修饰时，关系代词只能用 that。译：这是我很长时间以来读到的最令人心碎的故事。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ you find yourself in difficulty, please ask us for help.
questions.explanation: Should you find... = If you should find...，是虚拟条件句省略 if、将 should 提至句首的倒装形式，表示“万一”。译：万一你发现自己有困难，请向我们求助。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: What could I do then except _______ you away.
questions.explanation: except 前面有实义动词 do（could do）时，其后的不定式省略 to；watch 又是感官动词，宾补 carry 也用原形，即 watch them carry。译：那时除了看着他们把你带走，我还能做什么呢？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She never doubted for a moment _______ she was right.
questions.explanation: doubt 在否定句中（never doubted）后接 that 引导的宾语从句；肯定句中的 doubt 才接 whether/if。译：她一刻也从未怀疑过自己是正确的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I don’t travel much. I have never been to _______ Detroit.
questions.explanation: other than 意为“除…之外”，a city other than Detroit 即“除底特律以外的城市”；another 不与 than 搭配。译：我不常旅行，除底特律外我哪个城市都没去过。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: What is _______ they have learnt about how to communicate effectively with someone from another culture?
questions.explanation: 强调句的特殊疑问句形式为“疑问词 + is/was + it + that + 其余部分”，故为 What is it that they have learnt...。译：关于如何与来自另一种文化的人有效沟通，他们究竟学到了些什么？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “Where should I send my application?” “ The personnel office is the place _______”
questions.explanation: 不定式作后置定语修饰 the place；send it to the place 中介词 to 不能省略，故用 to send it to。译：“我该把申请表寄到哪里？”“人事办公室就是寄送它的地方。”

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Are the terms “pure” and “applied” science two totally different activities, having little or no interconnection, _______ often claimed?
questions.explanation: as 引导非限制性定语从句，指代整个主句，as is often claimed 意为“正如人们常常宣称的那样”；which are 缺少合适的先行词。译：“纯科学”和“应用科学”正如人们常宣称的那样，是两种完全不同、几乎没有相互联系的活动吗？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: All things _______, the result is satisfactory.
questions.explanation: All things considered 是独立主格结构（名词 + 过去分词），things 与 consider 是被动关系；句中谓语已有 is，不能再用 are considered。译：把所有情况都考虑进去，结果是令人满意的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The most important problem _______ the Indians is the idea they have of themselves.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误：face 是及物动词，“问题摆在…面前”用主动关系，现在分词 facing 作后置定语（= which faces the Indians）；faced with 的逻辑主语应是人，不能是 problem。译：印第安人面临的最重要的问题是他们对自己的看法。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He is busy _______ his paper. He is far too busy _______ callers.
questions.explanation: be busy (in) doing sth. 忙于做某事，第一空用 writing；too busy to do sth. 太忙而不能做某事，第二空用 to receive。译：他正忙着写论文，忙得没有时间接待来访者。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If you don’t want to go with me, you ______ stay at home.
questions.explanation: may as well do sth. 意为“不妨、还是…的好”；may as well as 不存在此用法。译：如果你不想和我一起去，不妨待在家里。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Fat is not digested in the stomach, ______ in the small intestine.
questions.explanation: not...but... 意为“不是…而是…”，连接两个地点状语形成对比；which/and/though 均不能表达这种对比。译：脂肪不是在胃里消化的，而是在小肠里。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The reason I don’t go to France was ______ a new job.
questions.explanation: The reason... was that... 句型中表语从句须用 that 引导，reason 之后不用 because。译：我没去法国的原因是我得到了一份新工作。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was vital that you _______ there in person.
questions.explanation: It is vital that... 中主语从句用虚拟语气，谓语为（should）+ 动词原形，故选 be。译：你必须亲自到场，这至关重要。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ the train had departed _______ she left the station for home.
questions.explanation: 强调句型 It is + 被强调部分 + that...，此处强调时间状语从句 only when the train had departed，结构为 It is only when..., that...。译：直到火车已经开走，她才离开车站回家。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was the information that he accumulated there _______ gave him great help.
questions.explanation: 去掉 It was...that 后句子仍然完整，可判定为强调句；强调主语 the information，用 that 连接。译：正是他在那里积累的信息给了他很大的帮助。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Her uncle told her that it is _______ she was brought up after her mother’s death.
questions.explanation: 强调句强调施动者“由谁抚养”，原句为 she was brought up by a retired professor，故强调时保留介词 by。译：她叔叔告诉她，母亲去世后她是由一位退休的教授抚养大的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ do we go for picnic.
questions.explanation: Seldom 是否定意义副词，位于句首时句子须部分倒装，借助助动词 do，即 Seldom do we go for picnic。译：我们很少去野餐。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Hardly _______ his speech _______ the audience started cheering.
questions.explanation: Hardly had sb. done... when... 表示“刚…就…”：hardly 位于句首须部分倒装；讲话先于欢呼发生，用过去完成时 had he finished，且搭配连词是 when 而非 than。译：他刚一讲完，观众就开始欢呼起来。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ about phonetics for you to read.
questions.explanation: here 位于句首且主语是名词 a book，构成完全倒装 Here is a book...；A 项是正常语序，不构成倒装句型。译：这里有一本语音学方面的书供你阅读。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Busy _______ he is, he can fulfil the task ahead of schedule.
questions.explanation: Busy though he is 是让步状语从句的倒装形式（表语提前 + though），相当于 Although he is busy；because/even though 不能用于此倒装结构。译：他虽然很忙，却能提前完成任务。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______, you won’t be able to do it alone.
questions.explanation: however 引导让步状语从句时，其后必须紧跟形容词或副词再接主谓，即 However hard you try。译：无论你怎么努力，你都无法独自完成它。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Often _______ not to touch the poisonous chemical.
questions.explanation: 频度副词 often 位于句首表示强调，句子部分倒装，借助助动词 does：Often does Fort warn us...。译：福特经常告诫我们不要碰那种有毒的化学品。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ can we create or destroy energy.
questions.explanation: by no means（决不）是否定意义短语，位于句首时句子部分倒装，情态动词 can 提前：By no means can we...。译：我们决不能创造或消灭能量。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The Mets ended their season on Tuesday as _______.
questions.explanation: as 引导方式状语从句表示“正如…一样”，从句常用倒装：as did the Yankees（一般过去时借 did 提前）。译：大都会队于星期二结束了他们的赛季，正如洋基队一样。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ that the pilot could not fly through it.
questions.explanation: so + 形容词位于句首时主句部分倒装：So severe was the storm that...，that 引导结果状语从句。译：暴风雨非常猛烈，以至于飞行员无法飞越它。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The total number of articles published on cancer _______ amazing.
questions.explanation: the number of + 复数名词 意为“…的数量”，强调总数作单一概念，谓语用单数 is。译：已发表的关于癌症的文章总数多得惊人。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ little we may like it, old age comes to most of us.
questions.explanation: However little we may like it 是让步状语从句，however 须紧跟形容词/副词（little）；Despite 是介词，不能引导从句。译：无论我们多么不喜欢它，衰老仍会降临到我们大多数人身上。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is almost impossible for me to meet her _______ she really comes to see me
questions.explanation: unless 意为“除非”，引导条件状语从句，与 almost impossible 呼应；Provided/As long as/If 与句意逻辑相反。译：除非她真的来看我，否则我几乎不可能见到她。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The chief hid himself in the chimney _______ someone should catch him in the catch.
questions.explanation: lest 意为“以免”，引导目的状语从句，从句谓语用（should）+ 动词原形，与句中 should catch 相吻合。译：酋长躲进烟囱，以免有人抓到他。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He felt a bit worried, _______ they were not working hard, but that they did not pay enough attention to safety.
questions.explanation: not that...but that... 是固定结构，意为“不是因为…而是因为…”，引出两个并列的原因。译：他感到有点担心，不是因为他们在干活时不努力，而是因为他们对安全不够重视。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Steel , oil and coal are to industry _______ food to man.
questions.explanation: A is to B as C is to D 是固定比例结构，意为“A 之于 B 正如 C 之于 D”。译：钢、石油和煤炭之于工业，正如粮食之于人类。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______, someone rang me up.
questions.explanation: 主句主语是 someone，与 leaving 的逻辑主语（我）不一致，用分词短语会造成悬垂结构，必须用带主语和谓语的完整时间状语从句 While I was leaving。译：我正要出去的时候，有人给我打了个电话。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ the fine words he may say to your face, he hates you at heart.
questions.explanation: for all 相当于 in spite of，意为“尽管”，后接名词短语；after all 意为“毕竟”，even if/although 须接完整从句。译：尽管他可能当着你的面说漂亮话，但他内心恨你。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ everything ready for the spring outing, it began to rain.
questions.explanation: 分词短语作状语时其逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致，主句主语 it 指天气，不能发出“准备好一切”的动作，故不能用分词，须用完整的时间状语从句；“准备”发生在 began to rain 之前，从句用过去完成时 had got。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: When _______ where he came from, the little boy cried instead of replying.
questions.explanation: when 引导的状语从句与主句主语一致（the little boy）且谓语含 be 动词（was asked）时，可省略主语和 be 只保留分词；男孩与“问”是被动关系，故用过去分词 asked（= when he was asked）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The big waves might have drowned the child _______ fast to the saving boat.
questions.explanation: 主句 might have drowned 表示对过去的虚拟推测，从句与过去事实相反应用 had not held；从句中有 had 时可省略 if 并将 had 提前构成倒装（一省二提），即 hadn't he held；若选 had he held 则意思变成“如果他抓紧了”，与句意相反。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ he comes to Nanjing, he will go to the Eastern Suburb for sightseeing.
questions.explanation: Every time（每当）可引导时间状语从句；Sometimes 和 At times 是时间副词短语，不能连接从句；By the time 表示“到某时为止”，与“每次来南京都去郊外观光”的习惯性句意不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The speed _______ light travels is said to be the maximum in the universe.
questions.explanation: 先行词 speed 与从句动词 travel 之间是“以……速度”的关系，即 travel at the speed，介词 at 须提前与 which 连用构成 at which。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She bought a knife from the shop ______ to peel an apple.
questions.explanation: “用刀削苹果”即 peel an apple with the knife，介词 with 提前后构成“介词 + which + 不定式”结构作后置定语：with which to peel an apple。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The day will come _______ all the people in the world enjoy freedom and live in happiness.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the day 表示时间，从句 all the people in the world enjoy freedom 成分完整，只缺时间状语，故用关系副词 when 引导定语从句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: These students will graduate from the university next summer, _______ they _______ here for five years.
options: by which time, will have studied
questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，须用 which 指代先行词 next summer；by which time 意为“到那时为止”，与将来完成时 will have studied 连用，表示到明年夏天将已在这里学习五年。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The pilot lost contact with the military base, _______ the plane crashed in the desert.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句中“介词短语 + which”可指代整个主句；“飞行员失去联系”导致“飞机坠毁”，是因果关系，故用 as a result of which（其结果是）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You can write the paper _______ you like.
questions.explanation: anyway（= any way，以任何方式）修饰 you like，句意为“你可以随你喜欢的方式来写这篇论文”；whatever 是代词不能作方式状语，however 表示“无论如何”时通常后接形容词或副词，some way 是名词短语，前面缺介词。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There is no rule _______ has exceptions.
questions.explanation: but 在否定词 no 之后可作关系代词，相当于 that...not，“There is no rule but has exceptions”意为“没有不含例外的规则”，即凡规则皆有例外。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The reason _______ he rejected our plan is ______ he had no faith in us.
questions.explanation: 第一空 reason 后的定语从句中，he rejected our plan for the reason，介词 for 提前用 for which（相当于 why）；第二空是表语从句，“The reason is that...”为固定句型，不用 because。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ is often the case with a new idea, much preliminary activity and optimistic discussion produce no concrete proposals.
questions.explanation: as 引导非限制性定语从句，指代整个主句的内容，常译为“正如”，置于句首：“正如新想法常见的情况那样”；that 不能引导非限制性定语从句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Do you think the reason _______ he gave is believable?
questions.explanation: reason 在从句中作 gave 的宾语（he gave the reason），应用关系代词 which/that；for which 或 why 用于 reason 在从句中作原因状语时。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He studied hard and later became a well-known writer, _______ his father had expected.
questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，须用 which 指代整个主句（他后来成了知名作家这件事），that 不能引导非限制性定语从句；从句 was 之后缺表语，再由 what 引导表语从句，构成 which was what his father had expected。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The manager is satisfied with ______ you’ve done.
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后缺宾语，all that you've done 相当于 what you've done；先行词是 all 等不定代词时定语从句只能用 that 引导，all what 是错误结构（what 不能直接接在 all 之后）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You may depend on it _______ your son will be taken good care of here.
questions.explanation: depend on 这类介词短语后不能直接接 that 从句，须先接 it 作形式宾语（先行词），再用 that 引导真正的宾语从句，即 depend on it that...。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: this is the factory _______ odd jobs last summer.
questions.explanation: “在工厂里做零工”即 do odd jobs in the factory，介词 in 提前与 which 连用；last summer 是一般过去时的时间标志，故用 did 而不是 have done。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The hotel _______ when I went sighting in Huang Shan Mountain during the summer vacation is rather poorly managed.
questions.explanation: “住这家旅馆”即 stay at the hotel，介词 at 提前构成 at which I stayed；where 本身已含介词意义，不能再与 in 连用，which/that 单独使用则从句缺介词。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Watts and kilowatts are the units _______ electric power is measured.
questions.explanation: “以……为单位计量”即 measure...in units，介词 in 提前与 which 连用构成 in which；in that 意为“因为/在于”，不合句意。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The scholar has made another break-through in this field, _______ of great importance to the progress of science and technology.
options: about which I think it is
questions.explanation: which 引导非限制性定语从句并在从句中作主语，I think 是插入语；因 which 已充当主语，从句中不能再出现 it。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I consider _______ college students learn more about Chinese history.
questions.explanation: consider 接复合宾语时，用 it 作形式宾语，important 作宾语补足语，真正的宾语是 that 引导的从句，即 consider it important that...。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ radar is to airplanes and ships, ______ eyes are to human’s body.
questions.explanation: “Just as A is to B, so C is to D”是固定结构，表示“正如 A 之于 B，C 之于 D 也一样”，just as 引导比较（方式）状语从句，主句用 so 呼应。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The farmer put up iron fences around the flower garden _______ neighbor’s sheep should break in.
questions.explanation: lest（以免）引导目的状语从句，从句谓语用（should）+动词原形，与题干中的 should break in 呼应；on condition that 意为“只要/如果”，now that 意为“既然”，均不合句意。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The stout fellow over there is _______ the great magician, Charlie Chen himself.
questions.explanation: none other than 意为“不是别人，正是……”，用于强调身份。整句翻译：那边那个胖家伙不是别人，正是大魔术师查理·陈本人。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I met her in the street _______ and she told me she was leaving for France next month.
