questions.explanation: 主句 met 是一般过去时，the other day（几天前）是过去时的惯用时间状语；in three days 与将来时连用，the following day / the next day 多用于间接引语的过去语境，此处是直接叙述。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Tom isn’t the tallest boy in the class, but he is taller than _______ students.
questions.explanation: Tom 不是班里最高的，只能说比“其中一些学生”高，即 taller than some of the students；any other 表示“比其他任何一个都……”，是最高级含义，与 isn't the tallest 矛盾。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: When science, business, and art learn something of ______ methods and goals, the world will have come closer to cultural harmony.
questions.explanation: science, business, art 是三者之间，相互代词用 one another；修饰名词 methods 须用所有格形式 one another's；each other 一般用于两者之间。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Only the people concerned have access ______ the foreign teacher’s class.
questions.explanation: have access to 为固定搭配，意为“有权使用/可以接近”。整句翻译：只有相关人员才有资格去外教的班上听课。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: This film appeals _______ people from all walks of life.
questions.explanation: appeal to 意为“吸引，使感兴趣”。整句翻译：这部电影吸引了各行各业的人。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: These iron doors are secure ______ robbery.
questions.explanation: be secure against 意为“谨防，免遭（侵害）”。整句翻译：这些铁门可以防盗。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He is always thoughtful _______ others.
questions.explanation: be thoughtful of 意为“体贴的，考虑周到的”。整句翻译：他总是为别人着想。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He is completely occupied _______ money.
questions.explanation: be occupied with 意为“忙于，专心于”。整句翻译：他满脑子想的全是钱。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She won _______ a narrow margin in the race.
questions.explanation: by a narrow margin 为固定搭配，意为“以微弱的优势/差距很小”。整句翻译：她在比赛中以微弱优势获胜。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A pen can be defined ______ something with which we can write.
questions.explanation: be defined as 意为“被定义为”。整句翻译：笔可以被定义为一种我们用来写字的东西。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I say this in the light _______ the government’s plans for redevelopment(再发展).
questions.explanation: in the light of 意为“鉴于，根据”。整句翻译：我是根据政府的再开发计划说这番话的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The king promised to marry his daughter to ______ defeated the enemy.
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后接宾语从句，从句缺主语，须用可作主语的连接代词；whoever = anyone who，表示“无论是谁”，whomever 是宾格不能作从句主语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A modern city has sprung up in _______ there was a wasteland ten years ago.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 D。介词 in 后接 what 引导的名词性从句作介词宾语，what（= the place that）意为“……的地方”，即“在十年前还是荒地的地方建起了一座现代化城市”；which 引导定语从句必须有先行词，此处没有；that 不能直接跟在介词后引导从句；where 不能用于介词 in 之后。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ the financial means to remain independent, Thomas Edison was compelled to seek employment as a night telegraph operator.
questions.explanation: 主句已有谓语 was compelled，句首只能用非谓语形式；Edison 与 deprive（剥夺）之间是被动关系，应用过去分词 Deprived of... 作原因状语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The Republic party is one of the _______ parties of the United States.
questions.explanation: 多个形容词修饰名词时按“限定词→数词→性质评价→类别属性”排序，愈主观愈靠前，愈接近名词属性愈靠后：two（数词）+ principal（评价）+ political（类别）+ parties。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A tall man _______ down roadside at midnight.
questions.explanation: 男子是被看见的对象，须用被动语态 was seen；see sb doing sth 变被动后保留现在分词作补语，即 be seen running（看见他正沿路边跑）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The ship _______ when we arrived at the harbour.
questions.explanation: ship 与 unload 之间是被动关系（船被卸货）；when we arrived 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，故用过去进行时的被动语态 was just being unloaded。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He returned at midnight and found his house ________.
questions.explanation: break into（破门而入）的被动形式是 be broken into；“被闯入”发生在 returned/found 之前，属于“过去的过去”，用过去完成时的被动语态 had been broken into。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The boy _______ by the peddler to carry goods for him.
questions.explanation: make a fool of sb（愚弄某人）变被动时介词 of 必须保留：sb be made fool of；男孩是被愚弄的一方，故用 was made fool of。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You shouldn’t have asked the boy to run across the street to buy cigarette, he ______ by a passing car.
questions.explanation: 批评对方不该让男孩过街买烟，是因为他“本可能被过路汽车撞倒”——对过去可能发生但实际未发生的事情用 might have been knocked down。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The local peasants gave the soldiers clothes and food without which they _______ of hunger and cold.
questions.explanation: without which（若没有这些衣物和食物）是含蓄条件句，指过去已发生的事，与过去事实相反，主句用 would have died（早就死于饥寒了）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Those who had applied for the post _______ in the office when I entered.
questions.explanation: when I entered 表示过去某一时刻，“申请者当时正被面试”，须用过去进行时的被动语态 were being interviewed；B/C 为主动形式，与被动句意不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Absorbed in reading his book, he had his wallet _______.
questions.explanation: have sth done 表示“遭遇/使……被做”，wallet 与 steal 之间是被动关系，故用过去分词 stolen 作宾补：had his wallet stolen（钱包被偷了）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: This pen _______ be his; he was not here in the morning.
questions.explanation: 有事实依据（他早上不在这儿）的否定推测用 can't（不可能）；mustn't 表示“禁止”，不用于推测。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Jack was so drunk that he fell off the bike and _______ by the roadside until the next morning.
questions.explanation: lie（躺）的过去式是 lay（lie—lay—lain），laid 是 lay（放置）的过去式，lied 是 lie（说谎）的过去式；此处与 fell 并列作谓语，表示“躺着”。整句翻译：杰克醉得厉害，从自行车上摔了下来，在路边一直躺到第二天早上。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______, we should be economical and put money to the best use.
questions.explanation: to begin with 意为“首先”，是固定短语作独立成分，不能改成分词或完整句子形式。整句翻译：首先，我们应该厉行节约，把钱用在最有价值的地方。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We came early and had to wait for two hours before the ceremony. We _______.
questions.explanation: 早早到场白等了两个小时，说明“本不必那么匆忙赶早（却匆忙了）”，用 needn't have hurried；need not hurry 指现在不必，不合语境。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The young man proved _______ his parents’ expectation.
questions.explanation: be worthy of + 名词意为“配得上，不辜负”；worth 须直接接名词或动名词（worth the money），不与 of 连用。整句翻译：这个年轻人没有辜负他父母的期望。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: This morning I _______ on time, but unfortunately there was a car accident and the traffic was blocked for half an hour.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 C。mean to have done 表示“本打算做某事（但实际没做成）”，与后文“但不幸出了车祸、交通堵塞半小时”（没能准时到）呼应；meant to come 只表示“打算来”，体现不了意图未实现。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They promised us to give us whatever support we need, but nothing _______ it.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 B。come of 意为“由……产生、有结果”，nothing came of it 是固定表达，意为“毫无结果”；come to 意为“苏醒/共计”，come into 意为“继承/进入（某种状态）”。整句翻译：他们答应给我们所需的任何支持，但毫无结果。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is the people, not the thing, ________.
questions.explanation: 这是强调句 It is + 被强调部分 + that...，被强调的主语是 the people（复数），that 从句的谓语须与被强调的主语保持一致，用 are decisive。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He is _______ to speak the truth.
questions.explanation: too much of a + 名词 + to do 意为“太……以致不敢/不能”，much of a（称得上是）为固定用法。整句翻译：他胆子太小，不敢说真话。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I wish I could write English with _______ at present possible.
questions.explanation: 比较级须用 more freedom；than 引导的比较从句中省略了主语（what/that），指代单数不可数的 freedom，故谓语用 is 而不用 are。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: At no time in the history of mankind _______ greater opportunities for following careers they have now.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 C。at no time（从来没有）等否定意义的介词短语位于句首时，句子须部分倒装，将助动词提到主语之前；句子与“他们现在拥有的机会”（now）比较，用现在完成时 have women had，表示“人类历史上女性从未拥有过比现在更多的机会”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ map dates back to about 3000B.C.
questions.explanation: The oldest known map 意为“人们所知道的最古老的地图”，known 是过去分词作后置定语；若用分词短语作状语（Known as...），须用逗号与主句隔开且逻辑主语一致，此处不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: News of victory _______ pouring in.
questions.explanation: news 是形式上复数、意义上单数的名词，作主语时谓语动词用第三人称单数形式 keeps。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mr. Jones said that he would be punctual for the appointment, _______ he were late?
questions.explanation: what if... 意为“要是……该怎么办”，为固定句型；he were late 是对将来情况的虚拟。整句翻译：琼斯先生说他到时会准时赴约，可万一他迟到了怎么办？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The government directs its effort to expanding women’s employment opportunities in modern self-employed sectors and_______ the exploitation of the female labor.
questions.explanation: direct one's effort to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词 expanding；and 连接的并列成分须保持一致，故也用 to avoiding。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We have been told that under no circumstances _______ the telephone in the office for personal affairs.
questions.explanation: under no circumstances（绝不）等否定意义的短语位于句首时，句子须部分倒装，将助动词或情态动词提到主语之前；表示“不允许”用 may，故为 may we use。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Ann has never dreamed of _______ for her to be sent abroad very soon.
questions.explanation: 介词 of 后须接动名词；there be 句型的动名词形式为 there being，即 dreamed of there being a chance。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Don’t take his remarks so seriously. He will stop saying in that way if no notice _______ of him.
questions.explanation: take notice of（注意）的被动形式为 notice be taken of；if 引导的条件状语从句遵循“主将从现”，用一般现在时 is taken。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They will have to decide what to do about the energy crisis before the oil _______.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 C。run out（耗尽）是不及物动词短语，不能用于被动语态；before 引导的时间状语从句遵循“主将从现”，故用一般现在时 runs out。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I’m rather tired. I _______ since this morning.
questions.explanation: since this morning 表示动作从早上持续到现在且仍在进行，强调持续性，用现在完成进行时 have been doing housework。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I regret that I divorced him . I_______ stupid.
questions.explanation: be being + 形容词表示“一时的表现”而非一贯性格：was just being stupid 意为“当时只是一时糊涂”；am just stupid 表示一贯愚蠢，与“后悔离婚”的语境不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I’ll go to play football as soon as I _______ the composition.
questions.explanation: as soon as 引导的时间状语从句遵循“主将从现”；写完作文之后再踢球，用现在完成时 have finished 表示将来某时之前完成的动作。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You will hardly believe it, but this is the third times tonight someone ______ me.
questions.explanation: This is the third time (that) sb has done sth 为固定句型，从句须用现在完成时 has telephoned，表示到今晚为止已是第三次。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The company _______ a rise in salary for ages, but nothing has happened yet.
questions.explanation: for ages 与现在完成进行时连用，表示从过去持续到现在反复发生的动作：has been promising（一直在承诺加薪），与 but nothing has happened yet 呼应。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was not until then that I came to know that knowledge _______ only from practice.
questions.explanation: “知识只能来自实践”是客观真理，宾语从句中表真理的谓语不受主句过去时（came to know）限制，用一般现在时 comes。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I’m not sure whether he _______ the meeting or not, as he has not been here lately.
questions.explanation: whether 引导的宾语从句表示将来是否参加会议，用 will attend。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The film _______ how a university student _______ a criminal.
questions.explanation: 影片展示的内容是客观事实，主句用一般现在时 shows；从句说明影片中的情节，也用一般现在时 becomes。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: As a young man he did not know that he _______ become famous later on.
questions.explanation: 主句 did not know 以过去为立足点，“后来会成名”是从过去看的将来，用过去将来时 was going to become，表示按当时的情形将要发生。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Henry would rather that his girl friend ______ in the same department as he does.
questions.explanation: would rather 后接 that 从句时用虚拟语气：表示现在或将来的愿望，从句谓语用一般过去式 worked。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He always _______ a stomachache when he ate oyster.
questions.explanation: when he ate oyster 用一般过去时，主句描述与之相伴的过去习惯性状态，用 had 呼应；has 表示现在的习惯，与过去语境不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: When you ______, I’ll show you round our campus.
questions.explanation: when 引导的时间状语从句遵循“主将从现”；“休息好之后”用现在完成时 have rested 表示将来某时之前完成的动作。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Our university is no longer what she _______.
questions.explanation: our university is no longer what she was——“不再是过去的她”，表语从句指过去的实际状态，用一般过去时 was。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: James has just arrived, but I did not know he ______ until yesterday.
questions.explanation: did not know 以过去为立足点，until yesterday 表示过去时间，“他会来”是从过去看的将来动作，用过去进行时 was coming（进行时表按计划即将发生）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She gave me that notebook on my birthday, and I _______ it in my drawer.
questions.explanation: since（自那以后）与现在完成时连用，表示从生日那天起一直保存到现在：have since kept。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I would have gone to visit him in the hospital had it been all possible, but I _______ fully occupied the whole of last week.
questions.explanation: 前半句是对过去的虚拟（had it been possible... would have gone），but 转折之后陈述过去的事实；the whole of last week 是确定的过去时间，用一般过去时 was。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Great efforts to increase agricultural production must be made if food shortage _______ avoided.
questions.explanation: be to do 表示“必须/按计划要”；if 条件句中不可用 will，“is to be avoided”意为“要想避免粮食短缺”，符合句意。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Smith will not be able to attend the meeting tonight because _______.
options: he will be teaching a class
he will have been teaching a class
questions.explanation: tonight 表示将来某一时刻，“开会时他正在上课”用将来进行时 will be teaching。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He met her in the doorway just as he _______ go away.
questions.explanation: be about to do 表示“正要、马上就要”，与 just as（正当那时）呼应，说明动作即将发生之际；met 是过去时，故用 was about to。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He hardly _______ the theory of relativity.
questions.explanation: understand 是状态动词，不用进行时；hardly（几乎不）陈述现在的状态，用一般现在时 understands。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He did not arrive until the meeting was nearly over, for the simple reason that he _______ asleep while watching television.
questions.explanation: 他没到会的原因是“看电视时睡着了”，睡着与看电视同时发生在过去，用一般过去时 fell asleep；had fallen 表示睡着在先，与 while watching television 矛盾。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Jane could be a very attractive girl, but she ______ to her clothes.
questions.explanation: could be 表示现在有可能成为，but 后陈述现在的一般事实：她不注意穿着，用一般现在时 pays no attention。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The best use _______ our present equipment.
questions.explanation: make use of（利用）变被动时介词 of 必须保留：The best use must be made of our present equipment（必须最充分地利用现有设备）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: By signing this application, I ask that an account _______ for me and a credit card issued as I request.
questions.explanation: ask（要求）后的宾语从句用虚拟语气，谓语为（should）+动词原形；account 与 open 是被动关系，should 省略后为 be opened。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I found that my cheating in yesterday’s English test _______ to my parents that evening.
questions.explanation: 从句有明确的过去时间状语 that evening，“作弊行为在那天晚上被报告给了父母”，cheating 与 report 是被动关系，用一般过去时的被动语态 was reported。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Your hair wants _______ . You’d better have it ______.
questions.explanation: want/need/require 后接动名词的主动形式表被动含义（= to be done）：Your hair wants cutting；have sth done 表示“使……被做”：have it done。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I don’t remember _______ a chance to try this method.
questions.explanation: remember doing 表示“记得做过的事”；“我”是被给予机会的一方，是被动关系，用动名词的完成被动式 having been given。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We could ask someone to do the work privately without it _______.
questions.explanation: without 是介词，后接动名词；it 与 know 之间是被动关系，用动名词被动式 being known。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “I’d like to buy an expensive camera.” “Well, we have several models_______.”
questions.explanation: have several models to choose from——不定式作后置定语；“从这些型号中挑选”须保留介词 from（choose from the models），故为 to choose from。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They found the lecture hard _______ .
questions.explanation: “be + 形容词 + to do”结构中，不定式用主动形式表被动含义：The lecture is hard to understand（讲座难懂）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: These machines are difficult _______.
questions.explanation: 同理“be + 形容词 + to do”：These machines are difficult to operate（这些机器很难操作），不定式用主动形式表被动含义。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If the work _______ by the end of the month is delayed, the construction company will be fined.
questions.explanation: 不定式短语 to be completed by the end of the month 作后置定语，表示“将在月底前完成的”（将来 + 被动）；being completed 表示“正在被完成”，不合句意。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The goods _______ when we arrived at the airport.
questions.explanation: goods 与 load 是被动关系；when we arrived 表示过去某时正在发生，用过去进行时的被动语态 were just being loaded（正在被装货）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The riot is said _______ by the government’s negligence of the people’s welfare.
questions.explanation: be said to have done 表示“据说已……”；暴乱已经发生，“引发”先于“据说”，且 riot 与 cause 是被动关系，用不定式完成被动式 to have been caused。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The story of John implies that love_______ from responsibility.
questions.explanation: be separated from 意为“与……分开”，love 与 separate 是被动关系：love cannot be separated from responsibility（爱与责任不可分）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: As it turned out to be a small house party, we _______ so formally.
questions.explanation: 结果是小型家庭聚会，说明“本不必穿得那么正式（却穿了）”，用 needn't have dressed up（情态动词 + have done 表虚拟）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You _______ pay the money, but you _______ do so at once.
questions.explanation: “你必须付这笔钱，但不必立刻付”：must 表示必须，needn't 表示不必，两句形成合理的转折对比；needn't...must 则逻辑颠倒。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The car plunged into the river. The driver _______ get out but the passengers were drowned.
questions.explanation: was able to do 表示过去某次具体“成功地做到”（司机成功爬出了车）；could 只表示一般性的能力；succeed 须接 in doing。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If you _______ me, I shall be very grateful to you.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 B。if 条件状语从句通常用一般现在时表将来，但当 will 表示“意愿”（愿意）时可用于 if 从句：If you will help me（如果你愿意帮我）是固定用法；are helping 表示“正在帮”，不合句意。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I _______ in the kitchen when you phoned.
questions.explanation: when you phoned 是过去时间，“当时一定在厨房”是对过去的肯定推测，用 must have been。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I can’t find Mrs.Wang in her office. She _______ for home.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误，应为 A。“办公室里找不到王太太”说明她已经离开，对已发生动作的推测用 might have started（可能已经动身回家了）；might start 表示对将来的推测，与“现在找不到人”不呼应。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You don’t need _______ for his permission every time you want to leave the room.
questions.explanation: need 作实义动词时接不定式作宾语：don't need to ask；need doing 表示“某物需要被……”（被动含义），主语通常是物，不合此句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I wonder why they haven’t arrived yet. I told them how to get here but perhaps I _______ them a map.
questions.explanation: ought to have given = should have given，表示“本应该给（但实际没给）”，与“他们还没到”呼应。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: we had plenty of bread, so I _______ a loaf.
questions.explanation: needn't have done 表示“本不必做（却做了）”：家里面包很多，其实本不必买；didn't need to do 表示“当时不需要做”，通常指实际没做。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You _______ that if you don’t want to.
questions.explanation: need 作实义动词的否定形式为 don't need to do；needn't 是情态动词，后须接动词原形（needn't do），不能接 to do。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The students in the classroom ______ not to make such a big fuss.
questions.explanation: ought 后须接带 to 的不定式，否定式为 ought not to do；must/need/dare 后接动词原形，不能接 not to make。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You _______ quit your job until you find another one.
questions.explanation: had better（最好）的否定形式为 had better not do，not 置于 better 之后、动词原形之前。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “That must be a mistake.” “No. it _______ a mistake.”
questions.explanation: must 表肯定推测，其否定推测用 can't（不可能）；mustn't 表示“禁止”，不用于推测。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The swimmer was very tired, but he _______ reach the shore before he collapsed.
questions.explanation: 虽然很累，但“终于游到了岸边”——过去某次具体成功做到用 was able to；might 表可能，couldn't 与句意相反，succeeded 须接 in doing。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “Dr. Jones, many students of us want to see you.” “_______ we wait here or outside?”
questions.explanation: shall 用于第一人称疑问句，表示征求对方的意见或指示：“Shall we wait here or outside?”（我们在这儿等还是外面等？）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ come out at night.
questions.explanation: dare 作情态动词时构成疑问句 Dare he come out...?（后接动词原形）；作实义动词则为 Does he dare to come out，Dares he 是错误形式。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Do you object _______ with you tonight?
questions.explanation: object to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词；动名词复合结构用物主代词 my staying，即 object to my staying with you tonight。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The interest on our savings account has been _______ in the past few years.
questions.explanation: rise 是不及物动词，不能用于 has been risen；raise 是及物动词，应用 has been raised；arouse 意为“唤起”，与句意不符；has been on the rise 意为“持续上涨”。整句翻译：近几年我们储蓄账户的利息一直在上涨。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Professor Wang _______ be in Beijing because I saw him in the library only a few minutes ago.
questions.explanation: 句中 only a few minutes ago 在图书馆见过他是推测依据；情态动词否定推测中 can't 表示「不可能」，而 must 只用于肯定推测，must not 意为「禁止」，may not 意为「可能不」语气不符。故王教授现在不可能在北京，选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Lin doesn’t like milk. She says that she ______ it at home.
questions.explanation: used to do 表示「过去常常做某事」，后接动词原形；be used to doing 表示「习惯于做某事」。她说她过去在家从不喝牛奶，用 never used to drink。翻译：琳不喜欢牛奶，她说她过去在家从不喝牛奶。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He would prefer to stay at home rather than _______ in such bad weather.
questions.explanation: prefer to do sth rather than do sth 结构中，rather than 后接动词原形（与 would rather do than do 同理），故用 go out，不接不定式或过去式。翻译：这么坏的天气，他宁愿待在家里也不愿出去。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The desk _______ the corner near the south window.
questions.explanation: belong to 表示「属于（某人/团体）」，belong in 表示「应处在（某位置）」，桌子位于南窗旁的角落应用 belongs in；belong 是状态动词，不用进行时和完成进行时。翻译：那张桌子靠在南窗附近的角落里。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If we ______ the bus, we ______ their concert in the theatre now.
questions.explanation: 从句 hadn't missed 是对过去的虚拟（had done），主句有时间标志 now 表示对现在的影响，属错综时间虚拟，主句用 would be doing。翻译：要是我们没误了那班车，现在就能在剧院欣赏他们的音乐会了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The project requires more labor than______ because it is extremely complicated.
questions.explanation: than 引导比较状语从句并兼作从句主语，指代比较对象 more labor（不可数名词），谓语用第三人称单数 has been put in。翻译：这项工程极其复杂，需要的劳力比目前已投入的更多。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The boy was seen _______ on the sports ground.
questions.explanation: 感官动词 see 变被动为 be seen 后，作主语补语的 -ing 形式保留（主动为 see sb doing，被动还原补语），故用 doing running（即 doing some running，跑步）。翻译：有人看见那个男孩在操场上跑步。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I ______ you a valuable present for your birthday, but I was short of money at that time.
questions.explanation: but 后 I was short of money at that time 表明礼物没送成；「本想做而未做」用 would have liked to do（= would like to have done），属情态动词接 have done 表与过去事实相反的虚拟。翻译：我本想送你一件贵重的生日礼物，但那时我缺钱。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “Why was the official meeting called?” “_______ new officers.”
questions.explanation: 问句问开会「为什么」，答语用不定式 To select new officers 作目的状语回答 why；Selecting 是动名词不能直接作目的状语，For selecting 不合习惯。翻译：——为什么召开这次正式会议？——为了选举新的负责人。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If the United States had built more homes for poor people in 1955, the housing problems now in some parts of their country _______ so serious.
questions.explanation: 从句 had built（in 1955）是对过去的虚拟，主句有时间标志 now 表示对现在结果的推测，错综时间虚拟中主句用 wouldn't be；wouldn't have been 表示对过去结果的虚拟，与 now 不符。翻译：如果美国 1955 年为穷人多建些住房，现在国内部分地区的住房问题就不会这么严重。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I started to listen to the other student _______ social problem.
questions.explanation: listen to sb doing sth 表示「听某人正在做某事」，现在分词 discussing 作宾语补足语；listen to sb do 不带 to，故 to discuss 错误。翻译：我开始听那位同学讨论社会问题。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If you had taken the medicine timely, you _______ well now.
questions.explanation: 从句 had taken the medicine 是对过去的虚拟，主句有时间标志 now 表示现在的结果，用 would be；would have been 只能表示对过去结果的虚拟。翻译：如果你当时及时服药，现在病就好了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Of particular interest to visitors ______ the large number of bookstores that sell books in different languages.
questions.explanation: 介词短语 Of particular interest to visitors 置于句首构成完全倒装，真正主语是 the large number of bookstores，中心词 number 为单数，谓语用 is。翻译：令游客特别感兴趣的是大量出售多种语言书籍的书店。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The meeting is _______ next Tuesday.
questions.explanation: 会议是「被举行」的，hold 为及物动词要用被动式 to be held；take place 是不及物动词短语没有被动式，故 to be taken place 错误。be to do 表示按计划安排将要发生。翻译：会议定于下周二举行。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The reason I have to go is _______ if I don’t.
options: on account of her being disappointed
questions.explanation: reason 作主语时，表语从句要用 that 引导，习惯上不用 because（The reason is that...）；disappointed 意为「（人）感到失望的」，修饰 she 用 disappointed。翻译：我必须去的理由是，如果我不去她会失望。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He woke up, _______ a strange girl standing by his bed.
questions.explanation: 不定式 to find 作结果状语，表示出乎意料的结果（醒来却「发现」床边站着陌生女孩），这是 only to do 表意外结果结构的运用。翻译：他醒来，发现床边站着一个陌生的女孩。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is not the tools a scientist uses but how he uses the tools that _______.
options: makes him to be a scientist
questions.explanation: 本句是强调句 It is...that...；not...but 连接两个并列主语时，谓语就近与 but 后的从句（单数概念）保持一致，用 makes；make him a scientist 为 make + 宾语 + 名词结构。翻译：使科学家成为科学家的，不是他使用的工具，而是他使用这些工具的方式。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The problem _______.
questions.explanation: appear 是不及物动词，没有被动语态，排除 A、C；「问题被解决」发生在 appeared 之前，不定式用完成被动式 to have been settled。翻译：这个问题看来已经被解决了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______, the law regards him as a criminal.
options: Is he a friend or enemy
questions.explanation: Be he friend or enemy 是让步状语从句的倒装虚拟形式，相当于 Whether he is a friend or an enemy（无论他是朋友还是敌人），谓语原形 be 提至句首。翻译：无论他是朋友还是敌人，法律都把他视为罪犯。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The manager promised to keep me ________ of how our business was going on.
questions.explanation: keep sb informed of sth 为固定结构，me 与 inform 是被动关系（我被告知），用过去分词 informed 作宾语补足语；keep sb doing 表主动持续进行。翻译：经理答应让我随时了解我们生意的进展情况。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I have no idea ______.
options: what the meaning of this word
what kind of a meaning of this word
questions.explanation: idea 后接同位语从句，从句必须用陈述语序，what 在从句中作宾语；A 项 what does this word mean 用了疑问句倒装语序，错误。翻译：我不知道这个词是什么意思。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Many a man _______ life is meaningless without purpose.
questions.explanation: many a + 单数名词作主语时，谓语动词用单数形式（强调个体），故用 thinks。翻译：许多人认为没有目标的生活是毫无意义的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I don’t have a job. I would find one, but I _______ no time.
questions.explanation: I would find one 是虚拟表达，but 后陈述的是现在的事实「没有时间」，用一般现在时 have，不需用过去时或过去完成时。翻译：我没有工作。我会去找一份的，可是我现在没有时间。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: To reach it meant _______ up a small set of steps and carefully _______ over the jewelry and other goods on display.
questions.explanation: mean doing sth 意为「意味着做某事」（mean to do 表「打算做」），and 并列的两个动名词前后形式一致，用 climbing 和 leaning。翻译：要够到它就意味着爬上一段小台阶，并小心地俯身靠近陈列的珠宝等物品。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: To listen to fine music and to have stimulating conversation with good friends _______ two pleasures in life.
questions.explanation: 两个并列不定式作主语表达复数概念，且表语 two pleasures 为复数名词，遵循意义一致原则谓语用 are。翻译：听优美的音乐和与好友进行令人振奋的交谈是人生的两大乐趣。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The fuel must have been finished, _______ the engine stopped.
questions.explanation: for 表推断性原因，对前句「燃料一定用完了」这一推测给出依据，用逗号与主句隔开；because/since/as 表直接的因果，不用于此种推断补充。翻译：燃料准是用完了，因为发动机停了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was found that although the girl could perceive things with her fingers, this ability ceased ______ her hands were wet.
questions.explanation: the moment 可作连词引导时间状语从句，意为「一……就……」，后面不能再加 when。翻译：人们发现，尽管这个女孩能用手指感知东西，可手一湿，这种能力就消失了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I found it hard to _______ these books.
questions.explanation: resist 后固定接动名词 resist doing sth（抗拒/忍不住做某事）；refuse 须接不定式 refuse to do，故 A 项 refuse buying、B 项 resist to buy 均错。翻译：我发现很难抵制住买这些书的诱惑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The old man is said _______ a sailor when he was young.
questions.explanation: be said to do 结构中，「当过水手」发生在过去（when he was young），不定式用完成式 to have been；to be 表现在的状态不合语境。翻译：据说这位老人年轻时当过水手。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I don’t know if Tom ______ or not tomorrow.
questions.explanation: if 在此引导宾语从句表示「是否」（= whether），不遵循「主将从现」；时间标志 tomorrow 决定从句用一般将来时 will come。翻译：我不知道汤姆明天究竟来不来。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ radar is to airplanes and ships, ______ are eyes to a human body.
questions.explanation: Just as..., so... 为固定结构，意为「正如……，……也一样」；Such...as 是「像……这样的」，Just like 后接名词短语，均不合此句型。翻译：正如雷达之于飞机和轮船，眼睛之于人体也是如此。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Do you have any idea why he _______?
questions.explanation: look 在此是系动词，后接形容词 sad 作表语；系动词不用于被动语态、一般不用进行时，且不接副词，故 is looked sad、is looking sad、looks sadly 均错。翻译：你知道他为什么看上去很伤心吗？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The doctor first practiced _______ on his own body.
questions.explanation: practice 后固定接动名词 practice doing sth（练习做某事），故用 needling。翻译：这位医生先在自己身上练习针刺。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Evidence came up ______ specific speech sounds are recognized by babies as young as six months old.
questions.explanation: that 引导同位语从句，补充说明抽象名词 evidence 的内容；从句本身成分完整，that 只起连接作用不作成分，因谓语 came up 较短而从句被后移。翻译：有证据表明，六个月大的婴儿就能识别特定的语音。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He tried to make up ______ the lost time ______ staying up late.
questions.explanation: make up for 意为「弥补」，for 的宾语是 the lost time；by staying up late 表示「通过熬夜的方式」。翻译：他试图靠熬夜来弥补失去的时间。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Her beautiful hair and figure are some compensation _______ her homely face.
questions.explanation: compensation for sth 为固定搭配，意为「对……的补偿」。翻译：她秀美的头发和身材多少弥补了她相貌的平凡。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Work hard, _______ you will pass the final examination.
questions.explanation: 祈使句 + and + 陈述句表示「那么就会……」的积极结果；or 连接则表示「否则」的消极结果，与「通过考试」的好结果不符。翻译：努力学习，你就会通过期末考试。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ nobody was very enthusiastic about it, they decided to cancel the trip.
questions.explanation: Seeing that 意为「鉴于、由于」，引导原因状语从句；See that 意为「务必做到」不能引导从句，When 只表时间。翻译：鉴于没人对此热心，他们决定取消这次旅行。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I really don’t mind _______ to the ball.
questions.explanation: mind 后接动名词作宾语；动名词的否定式把 not 放在动名词之前，且「我被邀请」是被动关系，故用 not being invited。翻译：我真的不介意没被邀请去参加舞会。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I regret _______ you that we can do nothing to help you.
questions.explanation: regret to do sth 表示「遗憾地要做某事」（常与 tell/inform 连用），regret doing 表示「后悔做过某事」；此处「遗憾地通知你」用 to inform。翻译：我很遗憾地通知你，我们帮不了你什么忙。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ I must do another experiment.
questions.explanation: Be it ever so late 为让步状语从句的倒装虚拟形式，相当于 However late it may be（无论天多晚），谓语 be 提到主语前构成倒装。翻译：无论天多晚，我都必须再做一次实验。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Who is the man _______ is speaking at the meeting?
questions.explanation: 主句是以 Who 开头的特殊疑问句，按规则定语从句引导词避免重复要用 that 而不用 who。翻译：正在会上发言的那个人是谁？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The assistance sold five ______ this afternoon.
questions.explanation: safe 作名词意为「保险箱」，是可数名词，five 后用复数 safes；词尾 -fe 读 /f/，直接加 -s，不按 f→ves 规则变化。翻译：今天下午售货员卖出了五个保险箱。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: None of us missed _______ the plane in flight last night.
questions.explanation: miss 后固定接动名词 miss doing sth，missed catching sight of 意为「错过看见」；none of us...missed... 双重否定表示「人人都看见了」。翻译：昨晚我们每个人都看见了那架飞机在飞行。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Education system in China is very different in many aspects _______ of many overseas countries.
questions.explanation: be different from 为固定搭配；比较对象是「中国的教育体系」与「海外国家的教育体系」，用 that 替代单数的 the education system，those 对应复数不合。翻译：中国的教育制度在许多方面与许多海外国家的教育制度大不相同。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The boy found _______ for not going to school.
questions.explanation: excuse 以元音音素开头，前面用 an；find an excuse for doing sth 意为「为……找借口」，excuse 不与 a 连用。翻译：那个男孩为不上学找了个借口。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Today most people prefer watching TV at home _______ in the evening.
questions.explanation: prefer doing sth to doing sth 为固定搭配，to 是介词后接动名词；prefer 不与 than 连用，故 than to go/than going 均错。翻译：如今大多数人晚上更愿意在家看电视，而不愿去电影院。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Tropical cyclones _______ much of the rainfall in the Pacific regions.
questions.explanation: 句子缺少谓语动词，「热带气旋带来降雨」是客观事实，用一般现在时的主动形式 cause；causing/having caused 是非谓语不能作谓语，are caused 被动不合逻辑。翻译：热带气旋造成了太平洋地区的大部分降雨。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ all the difficulties, she finished the project by herself.
questions.explanation: despite 是介词，直接接名词表「尽管」，despite of 是错误搭配（in spite of 才带 of）；as for 至于、besides 除……之外还有，均不合句意。翻译：尽管困难重重，她还是独自完成了这个项目。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She is a good girl. I’ve been meaning_______ her on.
questions.explanation: mean to do 表示「打算做某事」（have been meaning to do 一直打算做），suggest 后固定接动名词 suggest doing sth，故为 to suggest keeping。翻译：她是个好姑娘，我一直打算建议把她留下。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ is needed in cold countries.
questions.explanation: clothing 是不可数名词，「需要许多衣服」用 much clothing 谓语单数 is needed；clothes 本身为复数形式，作主语谓语应用 are needed，与题干 is needed 不符。翻译：寒冷的国家需要大量的衣物。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He suggested _______ a talk with the crook and I thought his idea suggested that he ______ afraid of him.
questions.explanation: 第一空 suggest 表「建议」后接动名词 having a talk（不接不定式）；第二空 suggest 表「表明、暗示」时宾语从句用陈述语气，不虚拟，按句意（过去的状态）用 was。翻译：他建议和那个骗子谈一谈，我觉得他的想法表明他害怕那个骗子。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: His face was lined with many cares, and he had ______ .
questions.explanation: hair 指整体头发时不可数，指一根根头发时可数；「有几根灰白头发」用 a few grey hairs，a little 修饰不可数名词且 hairs 复数与之矛盾。翻译：他满脸愁容，头上只有几根灰白的头发。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I found her_______ at the desk_______ a book.
questions.explanation: seat 是及物动词，「坐着」表状态用过去分词 seated（= be seated）；reading 是现在分词作伴随状语表示正在读书。翻译：我发现她坐在书桌旁读一本书。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was_______ Christmas Eve that he came back to his home town.
questions.explanation: It was not until...that... 为强调句型，强调时间状语 not until Christmas Eve，意为「直到……才……」。翻译：直到圣诞前夜他才回到家乡。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ________ kinds of matters in the world.
questions.explanation: there be 句型中谓语与后面的真正主语 kinds（复数）保持一致，用 There are；a few million 修饰 kinds，There is 与 That there are/It is 均不成句。翻译：世界上有数百万种物质。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There are_______ so stupid as those who know nothing at all.
questions.explanation: none 可指人也可指物，none so stupid as... 为固定表达「没有人像……那样愚蠢」；no one/nobody 一般不用于此比较结构。翻译：没有人比那些一无所知的人更愚蠢。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ I am concerned, some other arrangement would have been better.
questions.explanation: As far as I am concerned 为固定表达，意为「就我而言」；so far 至今、as for 至于，均不能与 I am concerned 构成此结构。翻译：就我而言，另一种安排本会更好。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The millionaire is generous _______ his money on Hope Project.
questions.explanation: be generous with money 为固定搭配，意为「花钱大方」；be generous to sb 表示「对某人宽厚慷慨」。翻译：这位百万富翁在希望工程上花钱很大方。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: This reference book will prove _______ in your studies.
options: to be of some use to you
being of some useful for you
questions.explanation: prove to be of some use 意为「证明有些用处」，of + 抽象名词相当于形容词；对某人有用用介词 to，to be used to 意为「习惯于」不合句意。翻译：这本参考书将对你的学习有些用处。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The rainbow is one of the most beautiful _______ in nature.
questions.explanation: phenomenon 是源自希腊语的不规则名词，复数为 phenomena（-on 变 -a），phenomenas/phenomenons 均错误。翻译：彩虹是自然界最美丽的外观之一。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ book is interesting to her although reading is her hobby. She likes reading literature, not politics or economics.
questions.explanation: not every 表示部分否定「并非每一本都……」；由后文「她只爱读文学，不读政治或经济」可知并非每本书都令她感兴趣，None of 后须接名词复数，No 表完全否定不合句意。翻译：尽管读书是她的爱好，但并非每本书都让她感兴趣；她喜欢读文学，而不是政治或经济。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Neither the boss nor the employees _______ the advanced technique and administration experience abroad.
questions.explanation: neither...nor 连接两个主语时，谓语就近与 the employees 保持一致用复数原形 object；object to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词 importing，object 是主动用法不加被动。翻译：老板和员工们都不反对引进国外的先进技术和管理经验。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ he’s already heard the news.
questions.explanation: Chances are (that)... 为固定表达，意为「很可能……」；chance 表「可能性」惯用复数，opportunity 表「机会」不合句意。翻译：很可能他已经听到这个消息了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Great Salt Lake is fed by freshwater streams, _______ is about four or five times as salty as the ocean.
questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，which 指代 Great Salt Lake 作从句主语；that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，yet 连词则句子缺少主语。翻译：大盐湖由淡水河流注入，然而它的湖水咸度约为海水的四五倍。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ is known to the world, Mark Twain is a great American writer.
questions.explanation: as 引导非限制性定语从句指代整个主句，意为「正如」，As is known to the world 可置于句首；which 引导的同类从句不能放句首。翻译：世人皆知，马克·吐温是一位伟大的美国作家。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The little man was ______ one meter fifty high.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。hardly more than 意为「仅仅、不过」（= only），与 the little man（矮个子）语义一致；almost/nearly more than 表示「几乎超过」，as much as 表示「高达」，都与「个子矮」矛盾。翻译：这个小个子男人身高仅一米五。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mr. Smith is such a humorist that he had us_______ at the party all the time.
questions.explanation: have sb doing sth 表示「使某人一直处于做某事的状态」，had us laughing 即「逗得我们一直笑」；have sb do 表一次性动作，不合 all the time。翻译：史密斯先生真幽默，聚会上他总是让我们笑个不停。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ a hot day, John decided to go for a swim.
questions.explanation: 句首没有主语，且「天热」的逻辑主语 it 与主句主语 John 不一致，用独立主格结构 It being a hot day 作原因状语；Being 则逻辑主语与 John 混淆。翻译：由于是个大热天，约翰决定去游泳。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: After _______ absence, he found his wife much changed.
questions.explanation: a year or two（一两年）表所有格时，在最后一个词后加 's，即 a year or two's absence；a year's or two years' 拆开加所有格是错误形式。翻译：离开一两年后，他发现妻子变了很多。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The magician picked several people______ from the audience and asked them to help him with the performance.
questions.explanation: at random 意为「随机地、任意地」；by accident 偶然地、on occasion 间或、on average 平均，均不合「随机挑选」的语境。翻译：魔术师从观众中随机挑了几个人来协助表演。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The last time we had a family reunion was ______ my brother’s wedding ceremony four years ago.
questions.explanation: 表示「在婚礼、会议、聚会等场合」用介词 at，at the wedding ceremony；in 表在某年月，during/over 表时间段，不合语境。翻译：我们最后一次全家团聚是四年前在哥哥的婚礼上。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I have to buy ______ for the large house.
questions.explanation: furniture 是不可数名词，没有复数形式，「许多家具」用 much new furniture；many 只修饰可数名词，furnitures 拼写错误。翻译：我得为这套大房子买很多新家具。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ by appearance, he was a wise warm-hearted honest man.
questions.explanation: Judging by/from appearance 为固定用法「从外表判断」，作独立成分使用，逻辑主语不必与句子主语一致；Judgeing 拼写错误，To judge/Judge 不构成此惯用表达。翻译：从外表看，他是一个明智、热心而诚实的人。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Though Elizabethan was very pretty and gracious, she was none _______ happier for her beauty.
questions.explanation: none the + 比较级为固定结构，意为「一点也不更……」，none the happier 即「并没有因为美貌而更快乐」。翻译：尽管伊丽莎白非常漂亮、优雅，但她并未因美貌而更快乐。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The house is _______ outside but inside its condition is poor.
questions.explanation: in good condition 为固定短语，意为「状况良好」，condition 表「状况」时惯用单数且与介词 in 连用。翻译：这房子外表状况良好，但内部条件很差。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The heart is _______ intelligent than the stomach, for they are both controlled by the brain.
questions.explanation: no more...than 意为「和……一样都不」（两者都否定），即心脏和胃一样都没有智力，for 后给出原因：它们都受大脑控制；not more...than 表「不如……」不合句意。翻译：心脏并不比胃更有智力，因为它们都受大脑控制。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: John is ______ of the two boys standing over there.
questions.explanation: 「两者中较……的那个」用 the + 比较级 + of the two，故用 the taller；比较级前不加 the 则不表特指，more taller 重复。翻译：约翰是那边站着的两个男孩中较高的那个。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The ______ we saw yesterday come out to the farm once in a while.
questions.explanation: deer 是单复数同形的名词，谓语动词 come 为复数形式，说明主语是复数 deer；cow/dog/horse 的复数须加 -s，不能保持原形。翻译：我们昨天见到的那几只鹿偶尔会到农场来。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The harbour is sheltered by hills ______ the north wind.
questions.explanation: shelter...from... 为固定搭配，意为「保护……免受……」，海港被群山遮挡免受北风侵袭。翻译：这个海港有群山环抱，免受北风侵袭。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is on the second floor that_______ shoes are sold in that new store.
questions.explanation: 本句为强调句 It is...that...；男鞋和童鞋分属两类不同的人所有，须用分别所有格 men's and children's（shoes），man and child's 是共同所有格不合语义。翻译：那家新商店的男装鞋和童鞋是在二楼出售的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: With his head_______ and his voice_______, the boy apologized to the teacher for having made faces at him.
questions.explanation: with 复合结构中，head 与 drop（垂下）是被动关系用过去分词 dropped；voice 与 tremble（颤抖）是主动且正在进行的动作，用现在分词 trembling。翻译：那男孩耷拉着脑袋、声音颤抖地向老师道歉，因为他对老师做了鬼脸。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: George_______ in the exam.
questions.explanation: take first place 意为「获得第一名」，place 表名次时习惯不加冠词；take place 发生、take the place of 代替，均不合句意。翻译：乔治在这次考试中得了第一名。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The goals _______ he had fought all his life no longer seemed important to him.
questions.explanation: 定语从句中 fight for the goals 意为「为……而奋斗」，介词 for 提到关系代词前构成 for which。翻译：他曾毕生为之奋斗的那些目标，对他来说似乎不再重要了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The doctor decided that he could not conceal the truth _______ the old man any longer.
questions.explanation: conceal sth from sb 为固定搭配，意为「对某人隐瞒某事」。翻译：医生决定再也不能向老人隐瞒真情了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We have won great_______ both in industrial and agricultural production.
questions.explanation: success 表抽象的「成功」时不可数，表具体的「成就、成功之事」时可数；此处指工业和农业两方面的多项成就，用复数 successes；successness 不是英语单词，succeed 是动词。翻译：我们在工业和农业生产中都取得了巨大成就。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Many a time_______.
options: has he given us good advice
has he given us some good advices
he has given us good advice
questions.explanation: Many a time（多次）等频度状语位于句首时，句子要部分倒装，助动词 has 提到主语 he 之前；advice 是不可数名词没有复数，含 advices 的选项均错。翻译：他多次给我们提出过好的建议。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The river is about ______ wide.
questions.explanation: 数词 + 名词作表语或状语时名词用复数 600 meters；作定语时才用连字符形式 600-meter（单数）。翻译：这条河大约 600 米宽。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The criminal always paid______ cash
questions.explanation: pay in cash 为固定搭配，意为「用现金支付」，in 表示方式。翻译：那个罪犯总是用现金付款。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: English grammar is something, but it is not ______.
questions.explanation: 由句意「英语语法是重要的东西，但不是全部」可知用 everything；something 前半句已出现，nothing 与 anything 均不合逻辑。翻译：英语语法固然重要，但它并非一切。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: we can separate the mixture into the pure chemical compounds_______ it is composed .
questions.explanation: be composed of 为固定搭配，意为「由……组成」，介词 of 提前与 which 构成 of which 引导定语从句；介词后不能用 that，from/in 与 compose 搭配错误。翻译：我们可以把这种混合物分离成组成它的各种纯净化合物。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mary speaks English, but_______?
questions.explanation: 省略疑问句中助动词 does 须提到主语 Bill 之前，does Bill? 意为「比尔（说英语）吗？」；speaks Bill/Bill speaks 语序错误，Bill does 是陈述形式不合问号语境。翻译：玛丽会说英语，那比尔（说英语）吗？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: That fellow is clever. He has _______.
questions.explanation: brain 表「头脑、智力」时惯用复数 brains，have brains 为固定表达「有头脑」。翻译：那家伙很聪明，他很有头脑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: What I asked him is _______ the accident took place.
questions.explanation: is 后接表语从句，从句 the accident took place 缺少时间、地点状语，用连接副词 when and where 引导。翻译：我问他的是这次事故是何时何地发生的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The two girls are _______.
questions.explanation: of the same age 为固定表达，意为「同龄的」，of + 抽象名词表特征；same 前须加 the，same age 缺冠词与介词。翻译：这两个女孩年龄相同。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Who is the man ______ is talking to your teacher over there?
questions.explanation: 主句以 Who 开头，为避免重复，定语从句引导词用 that 而不用 who；先行词 the man 在从句中作主语，whom/whose 不作主语。翻译：在那边和你老师谈话的那个人是谁？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The animal has a brain which is nearest_______.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。be nearest to 意为「最接近」，in size 表示「在大小上」；比较对象是这种动物的脑与人的脑，man's 替代 man's brain 以保持同类比较，故应为 in size to man's，in size to man 比较对象不对等。翻译：这种动物的脑在大小上最接近人脑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The bridge was named ______ the hero who gave his life for the cause of the people.
questions.explanation: name...after... 为固定搭配，意为「以……的名字命名」。翻译：这座桥以那位为人民事业献出生命的英雄的名字命名。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: People are coming to understand that easy access to ______ is often the key to success in this highly developed society.
questions.explanation: information 是不可数名词，泛指「信息」时用零冠词，且没有复数形式；access to information 意为「获取信息」。翻译：人们逐渐认识到，在这个高度发达的社会里，能否便捷地获取信息往往是成功的关键。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The book _______ was not in the school library.
options: which the professor referred to us
to which the professor referred to us
to which the professor referred us
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。refer sb to sth 意为「让某人参考某物」，which 指代 the book 作介词 to 的宾语，to 提前构成 to which the professor referred us；C 项 referred 后又多了一个 to，与 to which 重复，故选 D。翻译：教授让我们参考的那本书不在学校图书馆里。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Somehow _______, he managed to get a well-paid job in the bank.
questions.explanation: somehow or other 为固定表达，意为「不知怎么地、设法」；or other 常用于 some...or other 结构加强不确定语气，or so/or else/or more 均不构成此搭配。翻译：不知怎么地，他在银行找到了一份报酬优厚的工作。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Her two brothers married this year, and now she has two _______.
questions.explanation: sister-in-law 这类复合名词的复数在中心名词 sister 上加 -s，即 sisters-in-law。翻译：她的两个哥哥今年结婚了，现在她有两个嫂子。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A good book is like a good friend; you cannot keep it _______long.
questions.explanation: cannot...too... 为固定结构，意为「再……也不为过」，cannot keep it too long 即「把它保存多久都不嫌长」。翻译：好书如良友，保存得再久也不为过。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Some companies have introduced flexible working time with less emphasis on pressure_______.
questions.explanation: and 并列两个比较结构 less emphasis on pressure and (more emphasis) on efficiency，more 后省略 emphasis，与 less 对应；than 需与比较级搭配，此处压力与效率是并列取舍而非比较。翻译：一些公司实行了弹性工作时间，较少强调压力，而更注重效率。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Some areas, _______ the severe weather conditions, are hardly populated.
questions.explanation: owing to 意为「由于」，后接名词短语 the severe weather conditions 作原因状语；in spite of 尽管、but for 要不是、with regard to 关于，均不合逻辑。翻译：有些地区由于气候条件恶劣，几乎无人居住。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Watch the girl and her dog _______ are crossing the bridge.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the girl and her dog 既有人又有物，定语从句的关系词只能用 that。翻译：看那个和她的狗正在过桥的女孩。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Some animals adjust themselves_______ their environment by instinct.
questions.explanation: adjust oneself to sth 为固定搭配，意为「使自己适应……」，to 是介词。翻译：有些动物凭本能使自己适应环境。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: My sister has been working in that theatre_______.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时的标志是 since + 过去时间点，since five years ago（自五年前起）正确；since + 时间段（since five years）是错误搭配，five years ago 单独使用也与此完成进行时语境不符。翻译：我姐姐从五年前起一直在那家剧院工作。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was the school_______ we got to know each other.
questions.explanation: 若为强调句应为 It was at the school that...，题干缺少介词 at，故此句是定语从句；先行词 the school 在从句中作地点状语，用 in which（= where）。翻译：这就是我们当初相识的那所学校。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Since he lied to me, he will never persuade me_______ his sincerity or truthfulness.
questions.explanation: persuade sb of sth 为固定搭配，意为「使某人相信某事」。翻译：既然他对我说过谎，他就永远无法让我相信他的诚意或真诚。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Since it is such a sunny day, we might_______ to the suburb for a picnic.
questions.explanation: might as well do sth 为固定表达，意为「不妨/倒不如做某事」，as well 直接接动词原形。翻译：既然天气这么晴朗，我们不妨去郊外野餐。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She wants to be a nurse, but her parents disapprove _______ her intention.
questions.explanation: disapprove of sth 为固定搭配，意为「不赞成某事」。翻译：她想当护士，但她的父母不赞成她的想法。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Language belongs to each one of us, to the flower-seller _______ to the professor.
questions.explanation: as much as 意为「和……同样的程度」，即语言属于卖花人，也同样属于教授；as far as 至于/远到、as long as 只要，均不合句意。翻译：语言属于我们每个人，既属于卖花的人，也同样属于教授。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She read the story twice, _______.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。前后两个分句主语不同（She 与 I），表示「某人也是这样」须用倒装结构 so + 助动词 + 主语，即 and so did I（我也读了两遍）；so I did 只用于确认同一主语前面说过的事。翻译：这个故事她读了两遍，我也读了两遍。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She never laughed, _______ lose her temper.
questions.explanation: 前句有否定词 never，后句表示「也从不……」用 nor + 助动词 did + 主语构成部分倒装，nor did she ever lose her temper；nor 后不用陈述语序。翻译：她从不放声大笑，也从不发脾气。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Prisons in some countries are short of staff, _______ means each prison officer is overworked and underpaid.
questions.explanation: which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整个主句「监狱缺乏员工」这件事，在从句中作主语；it/this 不能引导从句，what 不引导定语从句。翻译：有些国家的监狱缺少工作人员，这意味着每个监狱官都工作过度且报酬偏低。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: What is _______ ordered the English textbook?
options: the lady’s address in Tokyo who
the lady’s address in Tokyo which
the address of the lady in Tokyo where
the address of the lady in Tokyo who
questions.explanation: 定语从句修饰先行词 the lady，who 紧跟在先行词后以免误修饰 address；A、B 两项关系词远离先行词 lady，C 项 where 不能修饰指人的 lady。翻译：在东京订购英语教科书的那位女士的地址是什么？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She did not come back home after midnight, _______ turned her parents very upset and angry.
questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，which 指代整个主句「她午夜后才回家」这件事作从句主语；that 不能引导非限制性定语从句。翻译：她半夜之后才回家，这使她父母非常不安和生气。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Of the two T-shirts, I chose _______.
questions.explanation: 两者之间的比较用比较级；「两者中较不贵的那一个」表示特指，用 the less expensive one；the least expensive 是三者及以上的最高级，与 Of the two T-shirts 不符。翻译：这两件T恤中，我挑了较便宜的那件。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He has just recovered _______ a severe illness.
questions.explanation: recover from 为固定搭配，意为「从……（疾病）中康复」。翻译：他刚从一场重病中痊愈。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: people who want progress are hospitable _______ new ideas.
questions.explanation: hospitable 与介词 to 构成固定搭配 be hospitable to sth.，意为“乐于接受、欢迎”，其余介词均不与之搭配。句意：渴望进步的人乐于接受新思想。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Many of the human problems associated with living in the ocean are _______ the problems of living in outer space.
questions.explanation: the same as 为固定结构，意为“与……相同”：海洋生活中的问题与太空生活中的问题相同。just as 需引导完整比较从句，such as 表列举，such that 表结果，均不合句意。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: One more try, _______ you will succeed.
questions.explanation: One more try 为祈使句，“祈使句 + and + 陈述句”表示“那么就会……”的好结果；若用 or 则表示“否则”的不理想结果。句意：再试一次，你就会成功。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: On knowing that his novel won the Pulitzer Prize, his friends held a big party_______.
questions.explanation: in one's honour 为固定搭配，意为“为向……表示敬意”，hold a big party in his honour“为他举行聚会庆祝”；glory 不用于此搭配。句意：得知小说获普利策奖后，朋友们为他举办了一场大型聚会。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Of the two workers. Bob works_______.
questions.explanation: Of the two 表明比较范围为两者，须用比较级；“两者中较……的那一个”属特指，比较级前加 the，much 修饰比较级，故选 the much harder。句意：两个工人中，鲍勃干活更卖力。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Modern industry abounds _______ opportunities for young men with imagination.
questions.explanation: abound in/with 为固定搭配，意为“富于、充满”，abound in opportunities“充满机会”。句意：现代工业为有想象力的年轻人提供了大量机会。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mike is lazy, but ______ of Mary, she is just stupid.
questions.explanation: in the case of 为固定短语，意为“就……而言、至于”，in the case of Mary“至于玛丽”；in case 意为“以防”，in this/that case 意为“在这种情况下/那样的话”，均不合句意。句意：迈克很懒，但至于玛丽，她只是笨。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Of ham and beef, the _______ meat is the cheaper today, but it depends, in _______ years.
questions.explanation: latter 用于两者中指“后者”，the latter meat 指火腿和牛肉中的后者；later 意为“较晚的、以后的”，in later years“在后来的岁月里”。later 不能指“后者”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Nuclear science should be developed to benefit the people _______ harm them.
questions.explanation: rather than 意为“而不是”，连接并列成分：造福人民而不是伤害人民；other than 意为“除了”，more than 表“超过”，better than 表比较，均不合逻辑。句意：核科学的发展应造福人民而不是危害他们。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: No longer are contributions to computer technology confined to any one country; _______ is this more true than in Europe.
questions.explanation: 否定意义的副词 nowhere 置于句首引起部分倒装 nowhere is this more true；nowhere...more than... 用比较级表达最高级，意为“这一点在欧洲体现得最明显”。hardly/little/seldom 与 more true than 语境不合。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: New York is ______ in the world.
questions.explanation: 纽约本身也在“世界城市”范围内，同一范围内比较须排除自身，用“比较级 + than any other + 单数名词”表达最高级含义；larger than any city 会把纽约与自己比较，largest of all cities 缺定冠词 the。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We often go to the sea for _______.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。表示时间的无生命名词作所有格时加 's，a month's holiday 意为“一个月的假期”；a month holiday 缺所有格不合语法，a holiday month 意为“一个度假月”，a holiday of a month 表达不地道。句意：我们常去海边度一个月的假。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The invention of various _______ promotes the exploration of the outer space.
questions.explanation: spacecraft（航天器）为单复数同形名词，复数不加 s，排除 spacecrafts；aircraft 同为单复同形但意为“飞机”，与“探索外太空”语境不符。句意：各种航天器的发明促进了对外太空的探索。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ food is better than none.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。food 为不可数名词，句子表达“有一点食物总比没有强”的肯定含义，用 a little（肯定，有一点）；little 表否定“几乎没有”，与“比没有好”的语义矛盾，every 不修饰不可数名词。句意：有一点食物总比没有强。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There is a river about eight feet _______.
questions.explanation: 表示“深达多少”用形容词 deep 置于度量短语之后：eight feet deep“八英尺深”；deeply 表抽象的“深深地”，depth/length 为名词不合句法。句意：这里有一条约八英尺深的河。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Would you go and get me _______?
questions.explanation: chalk 为不可数名词，不能加 s，用 a piece of chalk 表“一支粉笔”，颜色词 red 修饰 chalk 本身应置于 piece of 之后：a piece of red chalk。句意：你能去给我拿一支红粉笔来吗？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Please wait here till _______ notice.
questions.explanation: till further notice（等待进一步通知）为固定表达，further 意为“进一步的”；farther 只表距离“更远”，faraway 意为“遥远的”。句意：请在此等候，直至另有通知。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Bob is very lazy. Through examination his study proves_______ than _______ in his class.
questions.explanation: 比较对象须一致：his study 与“其他人的学习情况”比较，后者用 that of others（that 替代 study）；better 已是比较级，不能再受 no more 修饰（应为 no better），故选 not much better…that of others。句意：通过考试证明，他的学习比班上其他人好不了多少。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I won’t make a _______ spelling mistake next time.
questions.explanation: similar 意为“类似的”，a similar spelling mistake“一个类似的拼写错误”；same 须与 the 连用（the same mistake），like 作定语不合习惯，near 意为“近的”不合句意。句意：下次我不会犯类似的拼写错误了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mr. David Smith is the only foreigner _______ I know.
questions.explanation: 先行词 foreigner 被 the only 修饰，按规则“先行词被 the only/the very/the same/the last 修饰时关系词用 that”，故选 that 而不用 who/whom。句意：大卫·史密斯先生是我认识的唯一的外国人。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The raincoat is two sizes _______ for me.
questions.explanation: two sizes too large 为“度量短语 + too + 形容词”结构，表示“大了两个尺码”，too 前可接表程度的名词短语；very large 不能被 two sizes 修饰。句意：这件雨衣我穿大了两个尺码。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The stars are _______ when there is no moon.
questions.explanation: 形容词最高级作表语表示自身在某条件下的最佳状态（绝对最高级）时，the 可省略：The stars are brightest... 意为“没有月亮时星星最亮”；more brighter、much more bright 结构错误（bright 的比较级是 brighter）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Why don’t you do it _______ other way?
questions.explanation: do it some other way 意为“用某种别的方法做”，some 在表示建议的句子中意为“某个”；any other 多用于否定句疑问句，by/with 为介词，此结构中不需要。句意：你何不用别的方法做这件事呢？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The article is easy to understand because there are only _______ new words in it.
questions.explanation: new words 为可数名词复数，且“文章容易懂”说明生词几乎没有，表否定含义用 few；a few 表肯定“有一些”，与 because 的逻辑矛盾，little/a little 只修饰不可数名词。句意：这篇文章很容易懂，因为里面几乎没有生词。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Do you know that _______ boy standing over there near the gate?
questions.explanation: long-haired 为“形容词 + 名词 + ed”构成的复合形容词，意为“长头发的”，修饰 boy；long-hairs 是名词形式不合修饰要求，hair long 语序错误。句意：你认识大门附近站着的那个长头发男孩吗？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: People in the _______ countries usually have three names, two _______ of Christian names and a surname or family name.
questions.explanation: countries 与 speak 是主动关系，复合形容词用现在分词：English-speaking countries“讲英语的国家”；“名”的固定说法为 given name（过去分词 given 作定语，表“被起的”）。句意：讲英语国家的人通常有三个名字：两个教名和一个姓。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I was surprised at the way _______ he treated the old man.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the way 后接定语从句时，关系词可用 in which、that 或省略，因为“以某种方式”用 in the way，故选 in which；on/by/to which 均不合搭配。句意：他对待那位老人的方式让我吃惊。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The price of this dress is much too _______.
questions.explanation: price 只能与 high/low 搭配，“价格高”说 The price is high，不能说 expensive（expensive 修饰商品本身）。句意：这条连衣裙的价钱太高了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He is _______ but not ______ as you.
questions.explanation: not so + 形容词原级 + as 为同级比较的否定式“不如……那样……”，故第二空填 so diligent；前半句 He is wiser（比较级，后省 than you）意为“他更聪明”。句意：他比你聪明，但不如你勤奋。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The students are _______ to be taught.
questions.explanation: worthy 可接不定式被动式：be worthy to be done“值得被做”，The students are worthy to be taught；worth 后接 doing，worthy of 后接名词或 being done，worth of 搭配不存在，worthwhile 多用于 It is worthwhile to do 结构。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The dress is _______ expensive. I can’t spend _______ money on it.
questions.explanation: much too 后接形容词/副词，much 加强 too 的语气：much too expensive“太贵了”；too much 后接不可数名词：too much money“太多的钱”。故选 much too…too much。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A freely falling body has an acceleration of 32 feet during each second _______ it falls.
questions.explanation: as 引导时间状语从句，意为“当……时”，强调与主句情况同时存在：during each second as it falls“在下落过程中的每一秒里”；that/which 不能引导时间状语从句。句意：自由落体在下落的每一秒内都具有32英尺的加速度。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The shelf is _______ the other one.
questions.explanation: the same + 名词 + as 为固定比较结构：the same height as 意为“与……一样高”；as...as 之间必须用形容词原级，as higher as 错误，high as 缺结构。句意：这个架子与另一个一样高。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: These are _______ machines made in China.
questions.explanation: very 可加强最高级，且必须放在 the 之后：the very best machines“最好的机器”；much 不能修饰最高级（最高级前用 by far），very the best 语序错误。句意：这些是中国制造的最好的机器。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The fog _____ dense, all the ferry boats were suspended.
questions.explanation: 逗号前后两部分之间没有连词，前半部分须用独立主格结构 The fog being dense（名词 + being + 表语），作原因状语；was 会使前半部分成为独立句子，与主句无法衔接。句意：由于雾很浓，所有渡船都停航了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Doctor by training _____ he was, he proved himself to be a greater writer.
questions.explanation: 本题为让步状语从句的倒装形式：表语 Doctor by training 提到句首，此时只能用 though（或 as）引导，although 引导的让步从句不可倒装。句意：他虽是学医出身，却证明自己是更出色的作家。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She said she wouldn’t call us the next day, ____she?
questions.explanation: 带宾语从句的反义疑问句：当主句主语不是 I/We 时，附加问句与主句保持一致。主句 She said 为肯定的一般过去时，故用 didn't she。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The prisoner pleaded that he _____ allowed to see his family, who did not yet know of his conviction.
questions.explanation: plead 意为“恳求、要求”，其后的 that 宾语从句用虚拟语气，谓语为 (should) + 动词原形，被动形式为 (should) be allowed，should 省略后选 be。句意：囚犯恳求准许他见见还不知道他已被定罪的家人。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A thorough overhauling of the accounts has revealed _____ a tax evader.
questions.explanation: reveal 后接复合宾语“宾语 + 不定式”：reveal him to be a tax evader，不定式 to be 作宾语补足语；reveal 不接 him being，that 从句应用陈述语气 that he was 而非虚拟 be。句意：对账目的彻底审查查明他是个逃税者。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The flowers need _____ . Would you like me to do it for you?
questions.explanation: need 后接动名词的主动形式表示被动意义：need watering = need to be watered“需要浇水”；to water 主动形式与 flowers 的被动关系不符。句意：花需要浇水了，你愿意替我浇吗？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Western Nebraska generally receives less snow than _____ eastern Nebraska.
questions.explanation: than 引导比较状语从句，从句主语 eastern Nebraska 较长，为避免头重脚轻将助动词 does 提到主语之前构成倒装，does 替代实义动词 receives。句意：内布拉斯加州西部的降雪通常比东部少。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Let us get out quickly. It is no good ____ time.
questions.explanation: It is no good doing sth. 为固定句型，动名词短语 wasting time 作真正主语，it 为形式主语。句意：我们快出去吧，浪费时间没有好处。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: No sooner had we finished the conversation _____ we heard a knock on the door.
questions.explanation: No sooner had sb. done...than... 为固定搭配，意为“刚……就……”，no sooner 置句首引起部分倒装；注意与 hardly/scarcely...when 相区别。句意：我们刚谈完话就听见有人敲门。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Because of the unexpected changes, they postponed _____ us an answer.
questions.explanation: postpone 后接动名词作宾语：postpone giving us an answer“推迟给我们答复”，不接不定式。句意：由于意外变动，他们推迟了给我们答复。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He didn’t allow ____ in his room, actually he did not allow his family ____ at all.
questions.explanation: allow 有两种结构：allow doing sth.（动名词作宾语）与 allow sb. to do sth.（不定式作宾补）。第一空后无逻辑宾语用 smoking，第二空有宾语 his family 用 to smoke。句意：他不允许在房间里吸烟，实际上他根本不允许家人吸烟。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Can you have your report ____ tomorrow?
questions.explanation: have sth. done 表示“使某物被做”，宾语 your report 与 finish 为被动关系，用过去分词 finished 作宾语补足语。句意：你能设法让报告明天完成吗？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: From what is mentioned above we can draw a conclusion ____ electric energy can be turned into light energy.
questions.explanation: conclusion 为抽象名词，其后 that 引导同位语从句解释结论的具体内容，that 只起连接作用不作成分且不可省略；从句 electric energy can be turned into light energy 结构完整。句意：由上述内容我们可以得出结论：电能可以转化为光能。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The judge required that each witness ____his name in ink.
questions.explanation: require 意为“要求”，其宾语从句用虚拟语气，谓语为 (should) + 动词原形，should 省略后用原形 sign。句意：法官要求每位证人用墨水签下自己的名字。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She was trying ____ by the teacher in class.
questions.explanation: try to do sth. 表示“设法做某事”，avoid 后接动名词；she 与 question 为被动关系（被老师提问），用 being questioned，故选 to avoid being questioned。句意：课堂上她尽量不被老师提问。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The winter vacation ____ over, he got down to his work again.
questions.explanation: 逗号前后无连词，前半部分为独立主格结构 The winter vacation being over（名词 + being + 形容词），作时间/原因状语；若用 was 则两个句子无法连接。句意：寒假结束了，他又开始专心工作。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Young people often feel an urge to try ____ before the age set by law.
questions.explanation: try doing sth. 表示“尝试做某事”（试验性地做），try to do sth. 表示“努力设法做某事”；法定年龄前“尝试吸烟”用 try smoking。句意：年轻人常在法定年龄之前有尝试吸烟的冲动。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: -------Why didn’t you ask Peter and Jim for help ? ------Peter is ____ helpful than Jim.
questions.explanation: no more...than 表示“和……一样都不”（两者均否定），语境正是解释为什么不找两人帮忙：皮特和吉姆一样都不乐于助人；not more...than 表示“不比……更”（两者都肯定），与语境不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ is a term for the partial or complete inability to hear.
questions.explanation: 句子缺少主语，用名词 Deafness（耳聋）直接作主语，与谓语 is a term for 构成完整句子；There is deafness / It is deafness 会造成双谓语，Deafness that 结构残缺。句意：Deafness（耳聋）是形容部分或完全丧失听力的术语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: All flights ____ because of the snowstorm, we decided to take the train instead.
questions.explanation: 逗号前后无连词，前半部分为独立主格结构；flights 与 cancel 为被动关系，且航班取消发生在 decided 之前，用完成被动式 having been canceled。句意：由于暴风雪所有航班都取消了，我们决定改乘火车。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The atmosphere is as much a part of the earth as ____ its soil and the water of its lakes, rivers and oceans.
questions.explanation: as 引导比较状语从句，从句主语 its soil and the water（复数含义）较长，用倒装语序 are its soil and the water，be 动词与复数主语一致；do/has 与表语 a part of the earth 不搭配。句意：大气和土壤、江河湖海的水一样，都是地球的一部分。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Sometimes we are asked ____ we think the likely result of an action will be.
questions.explanation: asked 后的宾语从句中 will be 后缺表语，须用连接代词 what 充当表语；if/whether 只表“是否”、that 不作成分，均无法填补空缺。句意：有时我们被问到，我们认为一个行动可能的结果会是什么。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was not such a good dinner ____ she had promised us.
questions.explanation: 先行词 dinner 前有 such，按规则 as 引导限制性定语从句须与 such/the same 搭配，构成 such...as，as 在从句中作 had promised 的宾语。句意：这顿晚饭不如她向我们许诺的那样好。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Could you tell me how many ____ in the Russian alphabet?
questions.explanation: 宾语从句必须用陈述句语序：tell me how many letters there are；疑问式语序 are there 只用于直接疑问句。句意：你能告诉我俄语字母表里有多少个字母吗？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The teacher tells William that he ____ work hard next year.
questions.explanation: 时间状语 next year 表将来，“将必须努力”用 will have to do；had better（最好）没有 has 形式，would/had rather 意为“宁愿”，均不合句意。句意：老师告诉威廉明年他必须努力学习。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He will come to see us when he ____ .
questions.explanation: when 引导时间状语从句，遵循“主将从现”规则：主句 will come 用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时 arrives。句意：他一到就来看我们。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We demanded a guarantee ____ no similar incidents would occur again.
questions.explanation: guarantee 为抽象名词，其后 that 引导同位语从句说明保证的内容“不再发生类似事件”，that 不作从句成分；从句结构完整，which/why/if 均不合适。句意：我们要求保证不再发生类似事件。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is hard work ____ the grass green at this time of the year.
questions.explanation: It 为形式主语，真正主语是动名词短语 keeping the grass green（It is hard work doing sth.）；谓语已有 is，不能再选 keeps。句意：每年这个时候让草保持绿色是件费力的活。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The nuclear family in China usually ____ two parents, father and mother , and one child.
questions.explanation: consist of“由……组成”用主动形式，无被动无进行；be made up of 才表被动（is make up of 拼写错误），is consisted of 中 consist 不用被动式。句意：中国的核心家庭通常由父母双亲和独生子女组成。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is better that he ____ prepared for his interview.
questions.explanation: It is better that... 主语从句表示“建议”，谓语用 (should) + 动词原形，should 省略后为 be prepared。句意：最好让他为面试做好准备。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is a shame ____ able to give him any advice.
questions.explanation: 不定式的否定式将 not 置于不定式之前：not to have been；have been 表示“没能给他建议”发生在谓语 is a shame 之前。句意：很遗憾当时没能给他一些建议。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The examination has been cancelled. You ____ all that revision, after all.
questions.explanation: needn't have done 表示“本没必要做某事却做了”：考试已取消，之前的复习白做了；didn't need to do 表示“没必要做（实际上也没做）”，与已复习的事实不符。句意：考试取消了，你本来不必做那些复习的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Little ____ a year ago that I would be studying here today in Britain.
questions.explanation: 否定意义的词 Little 位于句首，句子须部分倒装，助动词 did 提到主语之前：Little did I think...；正常语序 I thought 不符合倒装规则。句意：一年前我根本没想到今天会在这里的英国学习。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Nobody came to see me while I was out, ____ ?
questions.explanation: 陈述部分主语为否定代词 nobody，按“前否后肯”附加问句用肯定式；nobody 这类不定代词在附加问句中用 they 指代。句意：我不在家时没有人来看过我，是吗？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They suggested us ____ our luck at the casino.
questions.explanation: suggest 后接动名词作宾语，不接不定式；us 为动名词 trying 的逻辑主语，故 suggested us trying our luck。句意：他们建议我们去赌场碰碰运气。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ the stress of examinations is over, we can all relax.
questions.explanation: Now that 意为“既然”，引导原因状语从句，表示既成事实的原因：既然考试压力已过去，大家都可以放松了；While 表时间/让步，Even though 表让步，For 表补充原因但一般不置句首。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It would be wrong ____ that factor.
questions.explanation: 不定式的否定式为 not to do，not 放在 to 之前：not to consider that factor“不考虑那个因素”；to not consider、to consider not 均语序错误。句意：不考虑那个因素是错误的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He never hesitates to make ____ criticism ____ is considered helpful to others.
questions.explanation: criticism 前用 such，后接 as 引导定语从句（such...as），as 在从句中作主语（as is considered helpful）；such...that 中 that 引导结果状语从句且不作成分，而从句缺主语，故不合。句意：他总是毫不犹豫地提出那些被认为对他人有益的批评。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The policy ____ made, the next problem was how to carry it out.
questions.explanation: 逗号前后无连词，前半部分为独立主格结构；policy 与 make 为被动关系，且“制定政策”发生在“执行问题出现”之前，用完成被动式 having been made。句意：政策既已制定，下一个问题就是如何执行。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Not until ____ himself seriously ill.
options: he had completed the task did he find
had he completed the task did he .
he completed the task had he found
did he completed the task he had found
questions.explanation: Not until 位于句首时，until 引导的从句保持陈述语序，主句部分倒装：Not until he had completed the task did he find himself seriously ill；B/C/D 项从句与主句的语序分配错误。句意：直到完成任务后，他才发现自己病得很重。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: After the dictation, we went on ____ some sentences.
questions.explanation: go on to do sth. 表示“接着做另一件事”：听写结束后接着翻译句子；go on doing sth. 表示“继续做同一件事”，与 After the dictation 语境不符。句意：听写之后，我们接着翻译了一些句子。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I was trying to read the directions ____ and absurd.
questions.explanation: which 引导定语从句修饰复数先行词 the directions，从句谓语用复数 were；confusing 意为“令人困惑的”修饰事物，confused 意为“（人）感到困惑的”。句意：我当时正试着读那些既令人费解又荒唐的说明。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: This research is important ____ it confirms the existence of a relationship between aggression and the use of alcohol.
questions.explanation: in that 为固定连词短语，引导原因状语从句，意为“在于、因为”，说明“重要”的具体方面；so that 表目的/结果，provided that 表条件，but that 意为“要不是”。句意：这项研究很重要，因为它证实了攻击性与饮酒之间存在关系。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You can arrive in Beijing earlier for the meeting ____ you don’t mind taking the night train.
questions.explanation: provided (that) 引导条件状语从句，意为“假如、只要”：假如你不介意坐夜车，就能早点到北京开会；unless 意为“除非”，用在此处双重否定逻辑不通，though 表让步，until 表时间。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Scarcely had they settled themselves in their seats in the theatre ____ the curtain went up.
questions.explanation: Scarcely had sb. done...when... 为固定搭配，意为“刚……就……”，scarcely 置句首引起部分倒装；注意与 No sooner...than 相区别。句意：他们在剧院刚坐定，幕就拉开了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: In 1921 Einstein won the Nobel prize, and was honored in Germany until the rise of Nazism ____ he was driven from Germany because he was a Jew.
questions.explanation: when 在此引导非限制性定语从句，先行词为时间 the rise of Nazism，when 在从句中作时间状语，相当于 and then；so that 引导状语从句需完整主句结构且语义不合。句意：1921年爱因斯坦获诺贝尔奖，在德国一直受尊崇，直到纳粹主义兴起，当时他因是犹太人而被逐出德国。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The senior librarian at the circulation desk promised to get the book for me ____ she could remember who last borrowed it.
questions.explanation: if only 引导条件状语从句，意为“只要”：只要她能想起这本书最后是谁借走的，就能把书取来；ever since 表“自从”，much as/even though 表“尽管”，均不合句意。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Britain’s press is unusual ____ it is divided into two very different types of newspaper: the quality press and the popular press.
questions.explanation: in that 为固定连词，引导原因状语从句，意为“在于、因为”，说明“不寻常”的具体原因；in what/in which/in how 中连接词须在从句中作成分，而从句结构完整。句意：英国报业的独特之处在于它分为截然不同的两类报纸：高档报和通俗报。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There is a delicate balance of nature ____ many square miles of ocean and vegetation and clean air are needed to maintain a relatively few human beings.
questions.explanation: which 指代先行词 a delicate balance of nature，从句中需要介词 in（in this balance“在这一平衡中”），故用 in which；what 不能引导定语从句，with which 介词搭配不合句意。句意：自然界存在微妙的平衡：为维持相对较少的人类，需要许多平方英里的海洋、植被和洁净空气。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ from the tenth floor when the policeman pointed his pistol at him.
questions.explanation: 表示方位的副词 Down 位于句首表示强调，句子完全倒装：Down jumped the burglar（副词 + 谓语 + 主语）；主语 the burglar 是名词而非人称代词，必须倒装，B 项 Jumped down 语序错误。句意：警察用枪指着他时，窃贼从十楼跳了下去。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ regular training in nursing, she could hardly cope with the work at first.
questions.explanation: 分词的否定式将 Not 置于最前面；“没受过护理培训”发生在“难以胜任工作”之前，用完成式，故选 Not having received。句意：由于没有受过正规护理培训，起初她几乎无法胜任这项工作。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: So badly ____ in the car accident that he had to stay in hospital for a few months.
questions.explanation: So + 副词（badly）位于句首，句子部分倒装，be 动词提前：So badly was he injured that...；he 与 injure 为被动关系，须用被动语态 was injured。句意：他在车祸中伤得很重，不得不住院几个月。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The country’s chief exports are coal, cars and cottons goods, cars ____ the most important of these.
questions.explanation: 逗号后无连词，cars being the most important of these 为独立主格结构（名词 + being + 表语），对主句作附加说明；若用 are/have been 则与前面主句无法连接。句意：该国主要出口煤炭、汽车和棉织品，其中汽车最为重要。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was recommended that passengers ____ smoke during the flight.
questions.explanation: recommend 意为“建议”，其主语从句用虚拟语气 (should) + 动词原形，否定式为 (should) not smoke，should 省略后只剩 not。句意：建议乘客在飞行途中不要吸烟。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “ She must be in the dormitory now.” “No, she ____ be there. I saw her in the classroom a minute ago.”
questions.explanation: 对现在的否定推测用 can't“不可能”（must 表肯定推测，其否定推测形式是 can't 而不是 mustn't）；一分钟前还看见她在教室，故“不可能”在宿舍。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Only take such clothes ____ really needed.
questions.explanation: such...as 引导定语从句，as 指代先行词 clothes 在从句中作主语，谓语用被动 are needed（一般现在时与祈使句语境一致）；as they are 中 they 与 as 重复，as were 时态与语境不符。句意：只带那些真正需要的衣服。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ you were busy, I wouldn’t have bothered you with my questions.
questions.explanation: 主句 wouldn't have bothered 表与过去事实相反的虚拟，从句须用过去完成时；从句含 had 时可省略 if 并将 had 提至句首构成虚拟倒装：Had I realized...。句意：要是我当时意识到你很忙，就不会用我的问题打扰你了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ is often the case with a new idea, much preliminary activity and optimistic discussion produced no concrete proposals.
questions.explanation: As 引导非限制性定语从句，指代整个主句内容，意为“正如”，as is often the case（正如常见情况那样）为固定表达，从句可置于句首；that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，It/This 无法构成从句。句意：正如新想法常见的情况一样，大量的前期活动和乐观讨论并未产生具体方案。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ your timely advice, I would never have known how to go about the work.
questions.explanation: 主句 would never have known 表与过去事实相反的虚拟；But for（要不是）介词短语引出含蓄条件，相当于 If it had not been for your timely advice。句意：要不是你及时的忠告，我永远不会知道该怎样着手这项工作。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We can assign the task to ____ is capable and trustworthy.
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后接宾语从句，从句中缺主语，须用 whoever（= anyone who）充当从句主语；whomever/whom 为宾格，从句不缺宾语。句意：我们可以把这项任务交给任何有能力且值得信赖的人。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He noticed the helicopter hovering over the field. Then to his astonishment, he saw a rope ladder ____ out and three men climbing down it.
questions.explanation: see sth. being done 表示“看见某物正在被做”；ladder 与 throw 为被动关系，且“正被抛下”与 three men climbing down 同时进行，用 being thrown 作宾语补足语。句意：他注意到直升机在田地上空盘旋，随后令他吃惊的是，他看到一架绳梯正被抛下来，三个人顺着爬下来。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He resented ____ to wait. He expected the minister ____ him at once.
questions.explanation: resent 后接动名词，he 与 ask 为被动关系用 being asked；expect sb. to do sth. 接不定式作宾语补足语，故第二空填 to see。句意：他怨恨被迫等候，他本指望部长立刻接见他。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was not until midnight ____ the snowcapped peak.
questions.explanation: It was not until midnight that... 为强调句型（强调时间状语 not until midnight），that 后接正常陈述语序且不再用否定：that they sighted；强调句 that 后不用倒装，C/D 项倒装错误。句意：直到午夜他们才看到白雪皑皑的山峰。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He prefers ____
options: to write his letters rather than dictating them
to write his letters rather than dictate them
writing his letters rather than dictate them
writing his letters rather than have dictated them
questions.explanation: prefer to do sth. rather than do sth. 为固定结构，rather than 后接动词原形 dictate；其余选项 rather than 后接 -ing 或完成式不合结构。句意：他宁愿自己写信也不愿口述让人记录。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You and I could hardly understand, ____ ?
questions.explanation: 陈述部分含否定副词 hardly，按“前否后肯”附加问句用肯定式；主语 You and I 对应 we，故用 could we。句意：你和我都几乎听不懂，是吗？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He is not under arrest, ____ any restriction on him.
questions.explanation: 前句为否定句，后句以 nor 位于句首表示“也不”，并引起部分倒装（助动词 have 提前）：nor have the police placed any restriction on him；nor 后不倒装（C 项）错误。句意：他没有被捕，警方也没有对他施加任何限制。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You won’t get a loan ____ you can offer some security.
questions.explanation: unless 引导条件状语从句，意为“除非”：除非你能提供担保，否则你贷不到款，与主句否定 won't get 逻辑吻合；lest/in case 意为“以免、以防”，other than 意为“除了”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ time, he’ll make a first-class tennis player.
questions.explanation: Given time 意为“如果给他时间”，过去分词短语作条件状语；he 与 give 为被动关系（被给予时间），用过去分词 Given，相当于 If he is given time。句意：假以时日，他会成为一流的网球选手。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: This company has introduced a policy ____ pay rises are related to performance at work.
questions.explanation: 先行词 policy 表示抽象“场合/情况”，定语从句 pay rises are related to performance 结构完整，须用关系副词 where（= in which）；which/what 须在从句中作成分，从句完整故排除。句意：这家公司出台了一项政策：加薪与工作表现挂钩。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He wasn’t asked to take on the chairmanship of the society, ____ insufficiently popular with all members.
questions.explanation: 逗号后无连词，用分词短语作原因状语；he 与 consider 为被动关系（被认为不够受欢迎），用 being considered；was considered 会构成第二个谓语，与主句无法连接。句意：他没有被要求担任协会主席，因为大家认为他在成员中不够受欢迎。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I’m not sure which restaurant ____ ?
questions.explanation: 疑问词 + 不定式结构 which restaurant to eat at 中，eat 为不及物动词，“在餐馆吃”须保留介词 at，which restaurant 是 at 的逻辑宾语。句意：我不确定去哪家餐馆吃饭。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There was nothing they could do ____.
questions.explanation: but/except 前若有实义动词 do（could do nothing），其后接不带 to 的动词原形：do nothing but wait；except waiting 因前有 do 不能用 -ing 形式。句意：他们毫无办法，只能等待。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: His only desire is ____ in good health.
questions.explanation: 表语为不定式复合结构 for his family to be in good health，for 引出不定式的逻辑主语 his family；his family to be 缺介词 for，不合逻辑主语的引出方式。句意：他唯一的愿望是家人身体健康。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ with the size of the whole earth, the highest mountain does not seem high at all.
questions.explanation: mountain 与 compare 为被动关系（被拿来与地球相比），从句省略主语和 be 后用过去分词：When (it is) compared with...；While comparing/Comparing 为主动关系，逻辑错误。句意：与整个地球的大小相比，最高的山也显得一点也不高。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Night ____ , we hurried home.
questions.explanation: 逗号前后无连词，Night falling 为独立主格结构（名词 + 现在分词，night 与 fall 为主动关系），作时间状语；fallen 表完成，与“夜正降临”不合。句意：夜幕降临，我们匆匆赶回家。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They appear____ in the accident.
questions.explanation: appear 后接不定式作谓语的一部分；受伤发生在 appear 之前且为被动关系，用完成被动式 to have been injured。句意：他们好像在事故中受了伤。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “ The photographer thought he was supposed to arrive after the guests.” “ But I mean ____ early.”
questions.explanation: mean for sb. to do sth. 意为“打算让某人做某事”，for 引出不定式的逻辑主语 him；him coming 缺 for，he would come 不能作 mean 的宾语。句意：可我是打算让他早点来的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He believes that a computer does only what thinking humans have planned____ .
questions.explanation: plan to have sth. do 中，have 后接复合宾语：宾语 it（computer）后用省 to 的动词原形 do（computer 与 do 为主动关系）；to have it done 意为“让（别人）把它做完”，不合句意。句意：他认为计算机只会做会思考的人类已计划让它做的事。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I ____ come yesterday, but I couldn’t.
questions.explanation: be to have done 表示“原计划/本打算做某事（但实际未做）”，I was to have come yesterday“我原打算昨天来的”，与 but I couldn't 呼应；must/have to 后接动词原形，ought 后须接 to come，均不合。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There is no point ____ to persuade him to do anything.
questions.explanation: There is no point (in) doing sth. 为固定句型，动名词前可加介词 in，故选 in trying；point 后不接 to do/of doing。句意：劝他做任何事都是没有意义的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Please have your doctor ____ that report.
questions.explanation: have sb. do sth. 表示“让某人做某事”，宾语 doctor 后接省略 to 的动词原形 sign（主动执行）；signed 表“使报告被签”，此处强调让医生去签。句意：请让你的医生在那份报告上签字。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ mainly for the invention of the telephone, Alexander Craham Bell devoted his life to helping the deaf.
