questions.explanation: Bell 与 remember 为被动关系（因发明电话而被铭记），用过去分词 remembered；Though remembered 相当于 Though he was remembered，作让步状语；to remember 表目的不合，While remembering 主动关系错误。句意：贝尔虽主要因发明电话而被铭记，他却把毕生献给了帮助聋人。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ work means moving a body through a distance by a force.
questions.explanation: 主语为动名词短语 Doing work（做功），泛指一般行为用 doing，谓语 means 用单数与之呼应；Having done 完成式、Being done 被动式均不合“做功”这一抽象概念。句意：做功就是用力使物体移动一段距离。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ waiting for Jane, he headed home.
questions.explanation: be fed up with 为固定短语“对……厌烦”，he 与 fed up 是“感到厌烦”的状态关系，作状语时省略 be，用过去分词 Fed up with 开头；feed up with 无此被动搭配。句意：等简等烦了，他径直回家了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I had intended ____ him while he was living at Aberdeen.
questions.explanation: intend 后接不定式作宾语：had intended to visit；had intended（过去完成时）本身已表示“原本打算（而未做成）”，不必再用完成式 to have visited。句意：他住在阿伯丁的时候，我本打算去看他的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Do you feel like ____ out or would you rather ____ dinner at home?
questions.explanation: feel like 后接动名词：feel like going out；would rather 后接动词原形：would rather have dinner。故选 going---have。句意：你想出去还是宁愿在家吃饭？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The boy came running into the room, ____ .
options: his face was dirty and his clothes torn
his face dirty and his clothes torn
his face was dirty and his clothes were torn
his face dirty and his clothes were torn
questions.explanation: 逗号后无连词不能再出现谓语动词，应用独立主格结构'名词+形容词/过去分词'：his face dirty and his clothes torn；A、C 含完整谓语构成两个无连接的分句，D 前后结构不一致。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I prefer the egg ____.
questions.explanation: prefer+宾语+过去分词表示'喜欢某物处于……状态'，egg 与 boil 是被动关系（蛋被煮过），用过去分词 boiled 作补语；to boil/boiling/boil 均为主动形式，不合逻辑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ in this light, the matter is not as serious as people generally suppose.
questions.explanation: 句首状语的逻辑主语是主句主语 the matter，它与 see 是被动关系（事情被看待），用过去分词 Seen 作状语；Seeing 表主动，to see 表目的，均不合逻辑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The lack of a thorough grasp of the situation ____ matters to a speedy conclusion.
options: makes difficulty for them to bring
makes it difficult for them to bring
questions.explanation: make it difficult for sb to do sth 为固定结构，it 作形式宾语，真正的宾语是后面的不定式短语；A、B、C 缺形式宾语 it，不能用 them 或 difficulty 直接承接不定式。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He knew that with him ____ her, she could succeed.
questions.explanation: with 复合结构（with+宾语+补语）中，him 与 help 是主动关系，表示伴随状态，用现在分词 helping 作补语；helped 表被动，不合逻辑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: John is a good student, ____ his best subject.
questions.explanation: 只有 English being his best subject 构成合法的独立主格结构（名词+现在分词），作补充说明；A、C、D 均不能构成独立主格。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ left before the deadline, it doesn’t seem likely that John will accomplish the job.
options: It is such a short time
questions.explanation: with 复合结构 with+宾语+补语：With such a short time left（还剩这么短的时间），left 为过去分词作补语；C 误用 so（so 修饰须说 so short a time），such+a+adj+n 才是正确语序。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He lay on a straw mat with his ____.
options: closed eyes and his mouth open
eyes closed and his open mouth
closed eyes and open his mouth
eyes closed and his mouth open
questions.explanation: with 复合结构中，eyes 与 close 是被动关系用过去分词 closed，mouth 后接形容词 open 表状态：eyes closed and his mouth open；A、C 语序混乱，B 中 his open mouth 结构不合。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They sat there with the door ____.
questions.explanation: with 复合结构中 open 是形容词作补语，表示'门开着'的状态；opening 表主动进行，opened 强调动作本身，均不如形容词 open 表状态贴切。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: English ____, we should do our best to have a good command of it.
questions.explanation: 独立主格'名词+现在分词'：English being a useful tool 表原因；was 是谓语动词会割裂句子，to be 不定式不作原因状语，having been 完成式不合状态性描述。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: With a book ____ , the teacher entered the room.
questions.explanation: with 复合结构的补语可以是介词短语：with a book in one hand（手里拿着一本书）；B、C、D 均非介词短语，且 C、D 是谓语动词，语法错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Class ____, we went out.
questions.explanation: 独立主格'名词+形容词'：Class over（课结束了）作状语；B、C、D 是谓语动词形式，逗号后不能出现第二个谓语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: With a lot of power ____ into it, laser（激光）beam is powerful enough to drill hard material.
questions.explanation: with 复合结构中 power 与 pack 是被动关系（能量被注入），用过去分词 packed；packing 表主动，to pack 表将来，packs 是谓语动词，均错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He entered the room, his face ____ with pain.
questions.explanation: 独立主格'名词+形容词'：his face pale with pain 作伴随状语；was pale 使逗号后出现第二个谓语，B、C 形式错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: In vain ____ to get in touch with the Embassy.
questions.explanation: In vain（徒劳）等否定意义副词位于句首须部分倒装，助动词 did 提前：In vain did they try...；A、B 语序错误，D 形式错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The accident ____ downtown yesterday resulted from the driver’s carelessness.
questions.explanation: happen 是不及物动词无被动语态，过去分词不能作后置定语（B 错），现在分词表进行又与 yesterday 矛盾（A 错）；事故与主句同在过去，无需过去完成时（C 错），用一般过去时定语从句 which happened。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A kilometer is somewhat ____ a mile, but is ____ a li.
options: more shorter than, more longer than
shorter than, twice as long as
more short than, twice more long than
as short as, twice longer than
questions.explanation: 比较级直接加 than：shorter than（没有 more shorter 的说法）；倍数表达用'倍数+as+原级+as'：twice as long as；A、C 比较级形式错误，D 的 as short as 与句意矛盾。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is absurd that women ____ be paid less than men for doing the same work.
questions.explanation: It is+形容词（absurd 荒谬的）+that 主语从句表'奇怪/重要'等意义时，从句谓语用 (should)+动词原形，本句保留 should：should be paid；are to/ought（缺 to）/would 均不构成该虚拟结构。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Half way across the room, a pistol in his hand, _____.
questions.explanation: 表示地点的状语（Half way across the room）位于句首且主语是名词时用完全倒装：谓语 stood 提到主语 a man 之前；B、D 未倒装，C 是部分倒装，不用于地点状语前置。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: In reorganizing the curriculum of Mt. Holyke College in the 1800’s, Elizabeth Mead laid the foundation ____ the modern college rests.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the foundation 在定语从句中作介词宾语（rest on 固定搭配'建立在……之上'），介词 on 提前构成 on which；in which 介词不搭配，on it 不能引导从句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She looked around _____ in search of something.
questions.explanation: as if 引导方式状语从句，所述与现在事实相反时谓语用虚拟语气：as if she were in search of something（仿佛在找东西，实际并非如此）；A 缺谓语动词，when 表时间与句意不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She loved to ____ from school.
questions.explanation: watch sb doing sth 为固定搭配，表示'观看某人做某事'，watch 可直接接宾语；glance/look 是不及物动词，不能直接接 the children。全句译：她喜欢看孩子们放学回家。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was ____ that the man treated the child.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。强调句检验：去掉 It was...that 后句子须完整，只有 A 成立：The man treated the child viciously（副词修饰动词）；B、C、D 代入后 treat the child 后接形容词或名词均不成立。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Eastern meadowlarks（东方野山雀）abound in places ____ but eat harmful insects rather than grain.
questions.explanation: 先行词 places 在定语从句中作地点状语，用关系副词 where，从句用陈述语序 where land is cultivated；D 语序错误（缺主语），A、B 是完整句子不能作定语从句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Advertising is distinguished from other forms of the communication ____ the advertiser pays for the message to be delivered.
questions.explanation: in that 为固定连词结构，引导原因状语从句，意为'因为/就在于'，具体说明区别所在；in which 需要先行词，in order that 表目的，均不合句意。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There are two small rooms in the beach house, ____ serves as a kitchen.
questions.explanation: 两者之中'较小的一个'用比较级 the smaller；非限制性定语从句用 of which 引导：the smaller of which serves as a kitchen；C、D 中的 them 不能引导从句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mr. Jones said that he would be punctual for the appointment, ____ he were late.
questions.explanation: but what if...意为'但是如果……怎么办'，what if 后接句子（此处用虚拟 were）；so that 表目的/结果不合，how about/what about 后须接名词或动名词。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The mother didn’t know who ____ for the broken glass.
questions.explanation: be to blame 为固定搭配，意为'应受责备'，主动形式表被动意义；主句 said 决定从句用过去时 was to blame。全句译：母亲不知道该由谁为打碎的杯子受责备。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I have no doubt ____ he will overcome his difficulties.
questions.explanation: doubt 后接同位语从句：肯定句中 doubt 后用 whether/if，否定句（no doubt）中用 that；本句 have no doubt 表否定意义，故用 that。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I wish to shake hands with you, ___ ?
questions.explanation: I wish...句型的反意疑问句固定用 may I?，是反意疑问句的特殊用法，不遵循'前肯后否'的一般规则。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I think that they would meet you at the party, ____ ?
questions.explanation: 主句以 I think 开头且带宾语从句时，附加问句与从句的主谓保持一致：从句 they would meet you 对应 wouldn't they。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ we have finished the course, we shall take the new one.
questions.explanation: now that 意为'既然'，引导原因状语从句，表示双方已知的理由；since that 结构错误，that/by now 不能引导状语从句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We could go to a concert ____ you’d prefer to visit a museum.
questions.explanation: unless 意为'除非（如果不）'，引导条件状语从句：除非你更想去参观博物馆，否则我们就去听音乐会；if 使句意相反，because/since 表原因不合逻辑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He didn’t believe what I said, ____ annoyed me very much.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句（有逗号）中，which 指代前面整个主句'他不相信我的话'这件事，并在从句中作主语；that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，it/what 无连接作用。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She got to the station ____ the train had left
questions.explanation: only to do 作结果状语，表示'出乎意料的结果'，且 she 与 tell 是被动关系（被告知），用 only to be told；was told 是谓语会使句子出现两个谓语，to tell 缺被动与意外意味。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A hibernating animal needs hardly any food all through the winter, ____ ?
questions.explanation: hardly（几乎不）已含否定意义，附加问句用肯定；need 后接宾语 any food 且随主语变位（needs），是实义动词，附加问句借助动词 does：does it。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The brilliance of his satires was ____ make even his victims laugh.
questions.explanation: be such as to do 为固定结构，意为'（好/坏）到……的程度以至于'，such 指代前面表语所述性质，as to do 作结果状语；so 不能单独作表语接 as to，so that 须引导从句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She promised ____ late again.
questions.explanation: promise (sb) to do sth 中不定式的否定词 never/not 须放在 to 之前：promised (me) never to be late again；A、C 用 being 形式错误，B 的 never 位置错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We’d rather you ____ the account tomorrow.
questions.explanation: would rather+从句表示'宁愿某人做某事'时，从句谓语用一般过去式构成虚拟语气（指现在或将来）：We'd rather you settled...。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There ‘s no water in the bottle, ____
questions.explanation: there be 句型的附加问句仍用 be 动词；前句 no water 表否定，附加问句用肯定 is there；has 与本句谓语动词不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is going to rain, ____ the barometer（气压计） is falling.
questions.explanation: for 作并列连词表推断性理由，为前面的判断提供依据：气压计下降正是推断'天要下雨'的依据；because/since/as 表直接原因，此处表推断依据应用 for。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: That ____ the case, we have to make some changes in our plan.
questions.explanation: 独立主格'代词+现在分词'：That being the case（情况既然如此）作原因状语；is/was/has been 是谓语动词，会使逗号后出现第二个分句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We won’t encourage him to do that ____ he is in good health.
questions.explanation: even if 引导让步状语从句，表假设性让步'即使'：即使他身体健康，我们也不鼓励他去做那件事；in case 表'以防'，when 表时间，均不合逻辑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The Great Wall is the place ____ almost all tourists would like to visit when they come to China.
questions.explanation: visit 是及物动词，定语从句缺宾语，先行词 the place 在从句中作 visit 的宾语，用关系代词 which；where/of which/in which 要求从句成分完整作状语，此处从句缺宾语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He insisted on doing ____ good to others.
questions.explanation: what 引导宾语从句（作 doing 的宾语）并在从句中作主语，he thought 为插入语：what he thought was good to others；A 中 it 多余，C、D 结构错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Paul was lying on the lawn, his hands ____ under his head.
questions.explanation: 独立主格'名词+过去分词'：his hands crossed（双手交叉着），hands 与 cross 是被动关系；were crossing/were crossed 是谓语动词会造成双谓语，crossing 表主动不合逻辑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Seldom ____ him fly into such a rage since I knew him.
questions.explanation: 否定副词 seldom 位于句首须部分倒装；since I knew him（自从认识他以来）要求主句用现在完成时，故为 have I seen；C 的过去完成时不与该 since 从句搭配。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I regret ____ you that I can’t go to Hangzhou for a visit Sunday with you because I’ve caught a bad cold.
questions.explanation: regret to do sth 表示'遗憾地要做某事'（常与 tell/inform/say 连用，动作尚未发生）；regret doing 表'后悔已做过某事'。本句是'遗憾地通知你'，用 to tell。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I’d prefer him ____ the key under the mat.
questions.explanation: prefer sb to do sth 为固定结构，不定式 to leave 作宾语补足语；leave/leaving/left 均不符合该结构。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I didn’t like myself ____ in that way.
questions.explanation: like sb to do sth 表示'喜欢/希望某人做某事'，myself 与 praise 是被动关系，用不定式被动式 to be praised；praised/be praised 缺 to，完成式 to have been praised 表动作已先发生，不合语境。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: No one was absent from the meeting, ____ ?
questions.explanation: no one 表否定，附加问句用肯定；指人的不定代词 no one 在附加问句中用 they 代替，故为 were they。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The cake has too much sugar in it, but ____ it’s OK.
questions.explanation: other than that 意为'除此之外'，but other than that it's OK 即'除糖多之外还不错'；none other than 意为'不是别人，正是'，语义不合，B、C 结构错误。全句译：这蛋糕糖放得太多，但除此之外还不错。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The boss ordered that the goods ____ delivered at once.
questions.explanation: order（命令）后的宾语从句用虚拟语气 (should)+动词原形，被动式为 (should) be done：the goods (should) be delivered at once，故选 be。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We did hold a meeting yesterday, but you ____ , so we did not inform you.
questions.explanation: 过去'没必要做某事而实际上没做'用 didn't need to do（need 为实义动词）；needn't have done 表'本没必要做却做了'，与'没有通知你（你确实没参加）'的事实矛盾。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She waited at the gate, her hands ____ before her.
questions.explanation: 独立主格'名词+过去分词'：her hands folded（双手交叉着）表状态，hands 与 fold 是被动关系；folding 表主动不合逻辑，C、D 是谓语动词形式，均错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They ____ stepped out the house ____ it collapsed.
questions.explanation: no sooner...than 为固定关联词，表'刚……就……'，主句用过去完成时 had no sooner done，than 引导的从句用一般过去时；not sooner 搭配错误，when/until 不能与 no sooner 搭配。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Tom is ____ as Sam.
questions.explanation: as...as 结构中间夹名词时语序为'as+形容词+a/an+名词+as'：as efficient a worker as Sam；其他选项语序均错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You needn’t speak so loudly, ____ ?
questions.explanation: needn't 后接动词原形 speak，说明 need 是情态动词，附加问句沿用 need；前句否定，用肯定 need you；don't you/do you 按 do 助动词处理，不合。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: His father had promised to buy him a computer ____ he behaved himself.
questions.explanation: provided (that) 意为'只要/如果'，引导条件状语从句：只要他表现好，父亲答应给他买电脑；in case 表'以防'，while/after 语义不合。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: In the lecture ____ he will tell us something about modern English usage.
questions.explanation: 不定式 to follow 作后置定语表将来：the lecture to follow（接下来的那次讲座）；following 须作前置定语（the following lecture），followed 表被动不合逻辑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She often has bad colds in winter, ____ ?
questions.explanation: has bad colds 中 has 是实义动词（患感冒），附加问句借助动词 does；前句肯定，用否定 doesn't she；has she/hasn't she 把 has 当助动词，错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: After we made the improvement, there were only ____ as before.
questions.explanation: 倍数表达语序固定：倍数+as many+复数名词+as，one-tenth as many defective products as before（次品只有原来的十分之一），倍数 one-tenth 须置于最前。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The weather may not be fine tomorrow, in ____ case we’ll have to put the trip off.
questions.explanation: in which case 构成非限制性定语从句，which 指代前面整个主句（明天天气可能不好）这种情况，介词 in 与名词 case 固定搭配，意为'若是那样的话'。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is not until 1997 ____ their sovereign rights over Hong Kong.
options: did the Chinese people resume（恢复）
that did the Chinese people resume
questions.explanation: It is not until...that... 为强调句型（强调 not until 短语），that 后用陈述语序和正常时态：that the Chinese people resumed...；A、D 倒装错误，B 缺 that 不构成强调句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You don’t have to worry ____ we are here.
questions.explanation: while 引导时间状语从句，此处意为'只要/在……期间'：只要我们在这儿，你就不必担心；until 逻辑相反，even if/though 表让步不合句意。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Henry Food’s introduction of the assembly line vastly reduced the time it took ______ a car.
questions.explanation: It takes/took+时间+to do sth 为固定句型，to make a car 是真正主语（it 作形式主语）：the time it took to make a car；making/for making/while making 均不符合该句型。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We preferred ____ the meeting rather than ____ it without adequate preparation.
questions.explanation: prefer to do sth rather than (to) do sth 为固定结构，rather than 后接动词原形：preferred to cancel... rather than hold...。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ , many people still vote against the use of the death penalty.
questions.explanation: however 引导让步状语从句时须紧跟所修饰的形容词/副词，再接主语和谓语：However inexcusable some crimes are（无论有些罪多么不可原谅）；A、B、D 语序错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Weather ____, we’ll go for an outing.
questions.explanation: 独立主格'名词+现在分词'：Weather permitting（天气许可的话），weather 与 permit 是主动关系；permitted 表被动，being permitted 强调正在进行的被动，均不合逻辑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He regrets ____ my advice.
questions.explanation: regret doing 表'后悔已做过某事'，'没听劝'发生在'后悔'之前，用完成式 having done；非谓语的否定词 not 置于最前：not having taken。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: What would happen supposing he ____ here?
questions.explanation: supposing (that) 引导条件状语从句，主句 What would happen 表对将来的虚拟假设，从句谓语用一般过去式，be 动词一律用 were。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He hates you ____ him early in the morning.
questions.explanation: hate sb doing sth 表示'讨厌某人做某事'，you 是动名词 phoning 的逻辑主语；hate 后不接'宾语+动词原形'，完成式 to have phoned/having phoned 与一般性讨厌的语境不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She confessed to _____the money.
questions.explanation: confess to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词；'拿钱'发生在'承认'之前，用完成式 having taken。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We all went to the movie, he ____ behind.
questions.explanation: 独立主格'代词+现在分词'：he staying behind（他留在后面）作伴随状语；代词 he 后不能接谓语动词，故 A、B、C 错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ with air, a life jacket will keep a person afloat.
questions.explanation: when+过去分词相当于状语从句的省略 When (it is) filled with air，life jacket 与 fill 是被动关系（被充气）；filling 表主动不合逻辑，It is filled 是完整句子缺连词。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They used to have porridge and buns for breakfast, ____ ?
questions.explanation: used to do（过去常常）的附加问句固定用 didn't：didn't they；used they 形式不合，don't/do they 时态错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The teachers whispered ____ they should disturb the students.
questions.explanation: in case 引导目的状语从句意为'以免/唯恐'，从句可用 should+动词原形：in case they should disturb the students；in order that 表'为了'，与句意相反。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The kids dare not walk on the ice. Neither ____ to skate on it.
questions.explanation: neither 位于句首表'……也不'，须部分倒装；dare 后接 to skate，说明 dare 是实义动词，须借助动词 do 构成倒装：Neither do they dare to skate on it。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was when their house had been buried in the snow ____ some idea about the seriousness of the situation.
questions.explanation: It was...that... 强调句型，强调 when 引导的时间状语从句，that 后用陈述语序：that they had some idea...；B、C、D 倒装或结构错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was unusual for there ____ so few students in the classroom.
questions.explanation: It is+adj+for there to be... 为固定结构，是 there be 句型的动词不定式形式：for there to be so few students；be/being/are 均不符合该结构。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He was awakened by someone ____ at the door.
questions.explanation: someone 与 tap 是主动关系且动作正在进行，用现在分词 tapping 作后置定语（= who was tapping at the door）；tapped 表被动，to tap 表将来，均不合语境。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ snobbish people ____ you described are to be found everywhere.
questions.explanation: as 引导限制性定语从句必须与 such/the same 搭配：Such snobbish people as you described（如你描述的那种势利的人）；so 不与 as 搭配修饰名词，like 不是关系词。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: His parents never intended ____ together with him though they hoped to see him often.
questions.explanation: intend 后可接 to do 或 doing 作宾语，选项中只有 living 可行；live 缺 to，to have lived 完成式与 to be living 进行式均与'打算'的语义不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There used to be a children’s palace before 1990, ____ ?
questions.explanation: There used to be 的附加问句固定用 didn't there；was there/wasn't there 把 used 当 be 动词处理，错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The leaders were seen ____ in the hall but they didn’t make known the problems ____ .
questions.explanation: 感官动词的被动式后接现在分词表动作正在进行：The leaders were seen assembling；problems 与 discuss 是被动关系，用过去分词 discussed 作后置定语（所讨论的问题）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: But for the traffic jam, we ___ earlier.
questions.explanation: But for（要不是）引导含蓄虚拟条件，与过去事实相反（昨天确实堵车了），主句用 should/would have done：should have arrived earlier。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Suddenly we felt the atmosphere ____ tense.
questions.explanation: feel sb/sth do sth：感官动词后接不带 to 的不定式作宾补：felt the atmosphere grow tense；grow 表'变得'，不及物动词无被动，grown 不合。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The directors have a meeting every Friday, ____ there is nothing to discuss.
questions.explanation: unless 意为'除非'，引导条件状语从句：除非没有要讨论的事，董事们每周五都开会；if 使句意相反，for/because 表原因不合逻辑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The plan ____ read, a heated discussion began.
questions.explanation: 独立主格'名词+having been done'：The plan having been read（计划宣读完毕），动作先于主句发生且 plan 与 read 是被动关系；A、B、D 是谓语动词，会与主句谓语冲突。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ a machine, she met with a lot of difficulties at first.
questions.explanation: 分词作原因状语：she 与 handle 是主动关系，'从未操作过'先于'遇到困难'发生，用完成式 having done，否定词 never 置于最前：Having never handled a machine。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: In the room ____ with three legs and a few broken chairs.
options: could only be found a table
could only a table be found
a table could only be found
only could be a table found
questions.explanation: 地点状语 In the room 位于句首用完全倒装，整个谓语 could only be found 提到主语 a table 之前；B 是部分倒装语序，C 未倒装，D 语序混乱。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It’s no use ____ that you don’t understand their dialect.
questions.explanation: It's no use doing sth 为固定句型，动名词 pretending 作真正主语，it 作形式主语；pretended/pretend/to pretend 均不符合该句型。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Up ____ into the air when the ten-second countdown was over.
questions.explanation: 副词 up（表方向）位于句首且主语是名词时用完全倒装：shot the rocket（谓语提前到主语前）；火箭升空是主动动作，不能用被动 was shot。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She couldn’t bear ____ fun of like that.
questions.explanation: bear doing sth：she 与 make fun of 是被动关系（被取笑），用动名词被动式 being made fun of；making 表主动，being making 形式错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It’s Sunday today. You needn’t ____ so early this morning.
questions.explanation: needn't have done 表'本没必要做（却做了）'：今天是周日，今天早晨本不必起这么早（实际却起了）；to get up/getting up/got up 均不符合 needn't have done 结构。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I didn’t attend yesterday’s meeting, for I ____ it.
questions.explanation: 过去'没必要做而实际上没做'用 didn't need to do（need 为实义动词）；needn't have attended 表'本没必要参加却参加了'，与'我没有出席会议'的事实矛盾。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: With the curtains____ , the room was dark.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。with 复合结构中补语不能是谓语动词，were drawn 使 with 后变成句子，错误；curtains 与 draw 是被动关系（窗帘被拉上），用过去分词 drawn 表状态。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The doctors must have spared no pains （全力以赴）to treat the patient, ____ he has recovered.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。for 作并列连词表推断性理由：'病人康复了'正是推断'医生们一定全力以赴'的依据，故用 for；but 表转折，而痊愈恰好印证医生的尽力，并无转折关系。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: This may have preserved the elephant from being wiped out as well as other animals ____ in Africa.
questions.explanation: other animals 与 hunt 是被动关系（动物被猎杀），用过去分词 hunted 作后置定语（= that are hunted in Africa）；that hunted 表主动错误，are hunted 是谓语会与主句冲突。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: How can I ever concentrate if you ____ continually ____ me with silly question?
questions.explanation: continually（不断地）与现在进行时连用，表示说话人不满的反复发生的动作：you are continually interrupting me；完成时/过去进行时无此'抱怨'语气。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: When you have finished with that video tape, don’t forget to put it in my drawer, ____ ?
questions.explanation: 祈使句（无论肯定或否定）的附加问句用 will you：don't forget to put it in my drawer, will you?。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The physicist has made a discovery, ____ of grate importance to the progress of science and technology.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句 which 指代先行词 a discovery 并在从句中作主语，I think 为插入语：which (I think) is of great importance；A 语序错误，that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，D 中 it 多余。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____, he can now only watch it on TV at home.
options: Obtaining not a ticket for the match
Not obtaining a ticket for the match
Not having obtained a ticket for the match
Not obtained a ticket for the match
questions.explanation: he 与 obtain 是主动关系，'没弄到票'先于'只能在家看电视'，用完成式 having done，否定词 Not 置于句首：Not having obtained a ticket...。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ he needed money for a new car, he decided not to borrow it from the bank.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。让步状语从句可倒装：把强调的副词提前+though+主谓：Much though he needed money（尽管他很需要钱）；Much as if 无此结构，As much/Though much 语序错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: His strong sense of humour was ____ make everyone in the room burst out laughing.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。be such as to do 为固定结构，意为'（达到）如此……的程度以至于'：His strong sense of humour was such as to make everyone burst out laughing；so 不能单独作表语接 as to，so that/such that 须引导完整从句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The three men tried many times to sneak across the border into the neighbouring country, ____ by the police each time.
questions.explanation: only to do 作结果状语，表示'出乎意料（多是不幸）的结果'，与 capture 是被动关系：only to be captured；had been captured 是谓语，会造成双谓语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Fat cannot change into muscle ____ muscle changes into fat.
questions.explanation: not...any more than 为固定结构，意为'……正如同……一样不……'：脂肪不能变成肌肉，正如肌肉不能变成脂肪；no more than 意为'仅仅'，no less than 意为'多达'，语义不合。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is not so much the language ____ the cultural background that makes the book difficult to understand.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。not so much...as... 为固定结构，意为'与其说……不如说……'：与其说这本书难懂是因为语言，不如说是因为文化背景；nor/but/like 均不能构成该搭配。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There ought to be less anxiety over the perceived risk of mountain climbing than ____ in the public mind today.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。than 引导比较状语从句时可作关系代词充当从句主语，指代 anxiety（不可数），谓语用单数 exists：less anxiety...than exists in the public mind today；existing 是非谓语，不能作谓语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He is ____ as a “bellyacher”----he’s always complaining about something.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。what 引导表语从句并在从句中作主语：He is what is known as a 'bellyacher'（他就是人们所谓的'爱发牢骚的人'）；who/which 不能引导无先行词的表语从句，whom 只作宾语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____, he always tries his best to complete it on time.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。however 引导让步状语从句须紧跟其修饰的形容词/副词：However hard the task is（无论任务多么艰巨）；though 的倒装形式应为 Hard though the task is，C 语序错误，D 缺谓语 is。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Much as ____, I couldn’t lend him the money because I simply didn’t have that much spare cash.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。Much as 引导让步状语从句（much 提前），从句用 would have liked to（to 后省略 lend him the money）表示过去想做而未能实现的愿望；B 缺后续成分，C 结构无意义，D 用 should 表'本应该'与'本想做'的愿望语义不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You must be hungry, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。must 表推测'一定'时，附加问句不用 mustn't，而根据 must 后的动词选相应助动词：You must be hungry, aren't you?。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “Let’s order some now, ___?”mother suggests.
questions.explanation: Let's 开头的祈使句附加问句固定用 shall we；let us（不带's）开头才用 will you，其余选项均不合。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You’d better come tomorrow, ___ ?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。had better 的附加问句固定用 hadn't：You'd better come tomorrow, hadn't you?；didn't you 与 had better 的助动词不对应。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We had to wait a long time to get our visas, ____ ?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。had to 表'不得不'，附加问句借助动词 did：didn't we；don't we 时态错误，couldn't we/shouldn't we 助动词不对应。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Not everyone likes everyone else, ____ ?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。前句 not everyone 含否定意义，附加问句用肯定；everyone 等不定代词作主语时附加问句用 they 指代，故为 do they。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Nothing he did was wrong, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。nothing 表否定，附加问句用肯定；nothing 指物且为单数概念，附加问句用 it：was it；he did 是修饰 nothing 的定语从句，不影响主语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “We ‘d better hurry if we’re going to the play.” “But it won’t begin until eight thirty, ____?”
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。前句 it won't begin 为否定，按'前否后肯'附加问句用肯定 will it；won't it 与前句同为否定，错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Come here a moment, ____?
questions.explanation: 祈使句的附加问句表请求用 will you：Come here a moment, will you?。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I don’t suppose he cares, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。I don't suppose 后接宾语从句时发生否定转移，附加问与从句一致且前否后肯：he cares → does he? doesn't he 仍是前否后否，错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He never used to swim in winter, ____?
questions.explanation: never 表否定，前否后肯；used to 的疑问与否定借助 did，故附加问为 did he?

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There has not been a great response to the sale, ____?
questions.explanation: there be 句型的附加问仍用 there：陈述部分 has not been（现在完成时否定），前否后肯用 has there?

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She ought to go by plane, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。ought to 的附加问用 shouldn't（或 oughtn't）：She ought to go…, shouldn't she? wouldn't she 与陈述部分的 ought to 不呼应。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Arthur daren’t call you a fool, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。daren't 中 dare 是情态动词，前否后肯，附加问沿用 dare：dare he? would he 与 dare 不呼应。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: let me go, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。Let me 开头的祈使句表请求，附加问用 will you? shan't I 错误，只有 Let's 才用 shall we。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Let’s put an end to it, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。Let's 开头的祈使句，附加问固定用 shall we? will you 用于 Let us 句型，两者混淆。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Let us put an end to it , ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。Let us（请求对方允许我们做，不含对方在内）的附加问用 will you? shall we 只用于 Let's。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They must have stayed at home last night, ____?
questions.explanation: must have done 对过去动作作推测且有明确时间状语 last night 时，附加问用 didn't + 主语：didn't they?

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We never dared to ask him question, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。dare 后接带 to 的不定式（dared to ask）时是实义动词，否定借助 did；never 表否定前否后肯，附加问用 did we? dared we 误把实义动词当情态动词。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: No one is interested in that, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。no one 表否定前否后肯，附加问中 no one 习惯用 they 指代且谓语用复数：are they? is he 不符合惯例。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I don’t think you’ll be angry with me, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。I don't think 后接宾语从句发生否定转移，附加问与从句一致且前否后肯：you'll be angry → will you? aren't you 与从句 will 不呼应。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I’m late, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。I'm 开头的句子附加问习惯用 aren't I?（am not I 不成立）；am I 是前肯后肯，错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I wish to go home now, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。I wish to do sth 表达愿望或请求时，附加问固定用 may I? wish I 结构错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “I can’t believe what I see, ____?”
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。陈述部分 I can't believe… 含否定，前否后肯，附加问沿用情态动词 can 并面向听话人：can you?（你能相信吗）will you 与 can 不呼应。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You ‘d rather work than play, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。You'd rather 中 'd rather = would rather，前肯后否用 wouldn't you? mustn't you 与 would 不呼应。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Learning how to repair motors takes a long time, ____?
questions.explanation: 动名词短语 Learning how to repair motors 作主语，谓语用单数 takes，前肯后否用 doesn't it（it 指代这件事）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Few people know him, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。few 含否定意义，前否后肯；people 为复数，附加问用 do they? do you 主语错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You’d like to give us lectures, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。You'd like 中 'd = would，前肯后否用 wouldn't you? didn't you 误把 would 当成 had。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He has his hair cut every month, ___?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。has his hair cut 是 have sth done 使役结构，have 为实义动词，附加问借助 do：doesn't he? hasn't he 误把 have 当助动词。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You have a TV set, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。have 表“拥有”时附加问可用 haven't you 或 don't you；陈述部分为现在时，didn't you 时态错误，故选 haven't you。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Don’t forget to phone me, ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。否定祈使句 Don't… 的附加问固定用 will you? won't you 用于肯定祈使句表邀请。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A television series teaches handicapped children ____ can and should think about career development.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。teach 可接宾语后再接 that 引导的宾语从句：teaches children that they can and should think…，that 无词义不作成分；both 单用在此不成立，who they 使从句成分重复。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is not such a pencil ____ I used yesterday.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。先行词 pencil 被 such 修饰时关系词用 as，构成 such…as 结构，as 在从句中作 used 的宾语；which 不能与 such 搭配。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They are not so willing ____ this picture hung in the corridor.
questions.explanation: not so…as 为原级比较，as 后接比较对象 we（主格），再接不定式 to have…hung 表示“像我们一样愿意让这幅画挂在走廊里”，we 后省略了 are。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The way a junior college ____ depends on whether it is a public or private institution.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。the way 后接定语从句用 that/in which 或省略引导词：the way (that) a junior college is organized and financed；being organized 缺谓语无法构成从句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ , work songs often exhibit the song culture of a people in a fundamental form.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。主句完整，前面需要地点状语从句 Where they occur（在它们出现的地方）；单个分词 Occurring 置于句首语义不通，Where do they occur 为疑问语序错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I have little doubt about his competence; ____ he is well-qualified.
questions.explanation: 分号前后是递进关系“我对他的能力几乎没有怀疑；而且他完全胜任”，用 moreover（而且）；although/yet 表转折，because 表原因，均不合逻辑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The publishers will send you a specimen copy of their new books ____ .
questions.explanation: when requested 是状语从句的省略形式（= when they are requested），主将从现要求从句用一般现在时；A 项从句误用 will，B 项 requested 后多余宾语 it，C 项 it 与复数 books 指代不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: John would rather ____ a day off than worked yesterday week（八天前）.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。would rather have done…than did… 表示“过去宁愿做某事而实际未做”，与过去事实相反的虚拟；时间状语 yesterday week（八天前）也指过去，故用 have taken。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Captain Henry, ____ ,crept slowly through the underbrush.
options: attempting to not encounter the enemy
not involving himself in the enemy
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。主语 Captain Henry 与 try 为主动关系，用现在分词短语 trying to avoid the enemy 作伴随状语；attempting to not encounter 为分裂式否定不定式，不规范，A、D 语义或搭配不当。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: When Joyce was told the whole story, she ceased ____ in the film.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。cease doing sth 表示“停止做某事”，“不再对电影感兴趣”即停止“感兴趣”这一状态：ceased being interested in the film；ceased no interest 语义不通，A、C 缺正确非谓语形式。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Human facial expression differ from those of animals in the degree ___ they can be deliberately controlled and modified.
questions.explanation: 先行词 degree 与从句构成 to the degree（在……程度上），介词 to 提前与 which 连用引导定语从句：to which they can be deliberately controlled。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The ____ capacity of the stadium has been enlarged.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。seating capacity 为固定搭配，意为“（场馆的）容座量”；sitting/seated/seat 均不能与 capacity 搭配。全句：体育场的容客量已经扩大。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A comet（彗星）is distinguished from other bodies in the solar system ____.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。be distinguished from…by… 意为“凭借……与……相区别”，by 引出区分依据 its appearance；is its appearance 会造成双谓语。全句：彗星凭借其外观与太阳系其他天体相区别。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A sneeze cannot be performed voluntarily, ____ be easily suppressed.
questions.explanation: 前句为否定句，后句用 nor 置于句首表“也不”，引起部分倒装：nor can it be easily suppressed（nor + 情态动词 + 主语）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Time is running out. ____?
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。had better 后接动词原形：Hadn't we better get started?（get started 即 get + started 表“开始动身”）；got 与接原形的要求不符，Haven't we better 结构错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I beg ____ tomorrow’s meeting.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。请求别人免除自己出席应用被动不定式 to be excused from attending（excuse sb from doing 的被动形式）；to excuse 主动语态表示自己免除自己，逻辑错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I am sure Mary has been here and ____ .
options: has done what was required of her
did what has been required of her
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。what 引导宾语从句并在从句中作主语：“要求她做的事”为 what was required of her（require sth of sb 的被动式）；与 has been here 并列的谓语须保持现在完成时 has done。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ____ as much as one-fourth of all timber harvested is not used.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。It is estimated that… 为固定句型，it 作形式主语，真正主语是后面的 that 从句，表客观估计“据估计……”；They are estimated 主语错误，The estimate 缺谓语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Commercial banks make most of their income from interest ____ on loans and investment in stocks and bonds.
questions.explanation: interest 与 earn 为被动关系（利息是“被赚取”的），用过去分词 earned 作后置定语，相当于 interest which is earned on loans。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Little Marie did not go to the party. I understand that she was unhappy ____.
options: yet she would not be able to go
that was not able to go
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。unhappy 后接 that 从句说明原因：she was unhappy that she could not go（因没能去成而不高兴）；yet 连接语义不通，that was not able to go 缺主语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He desired nothing but ____.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。but 表“除……之外”时后接不定式作宾语：desired nothing but to succeed（渴望的只有成功）；succeeded 为过去式不合结构。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Home economists recommend ____ in large quantities.
options: buying basic items of the food
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。recommend 后接动名词作宾语（recommend doing sth），排除 A/D；C 项 basic food items（基本食品）搭配自然，B 项 the food 的定冠词无指代对象。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I am interested in _____ he has made.
questions.explanation: all 与 what 从句连用须通过 all of（all what 为错误结构）；what 引导名词性从句作介词 in 的宾语并在从句中作 made 的宾语，plan 表泛指用复数 plans。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The phone would ring twice______.
questions.explanation: every 后接“基数词 + 复数名词”表示“每……”：every five minutes 每五分钟；B 项语序错误，C 项 minute 应用复数，each 不用于此结构。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _____ has ever happened.
questions.explanation: such 前有 no 等限定词时用“no such + 单数名词”结构且不加冠词（such 置于 no 之后）；A 项多了冠词 a，D 项复数 things 与谓语 has 单数不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is not _____ to see that your pupils study their lessons.
questions.explanation: whole 须置于冠词或物主代词之后：your whole business；all 则置于其前（all your business），B、C、D 语序均错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We have _____ this year than last year.
questions.explanation: more 修饰可数名词复数时前面用 many：many more apples（多得多的苹果）；much more 只修饰不可数名词，C 项 apple 应用复数。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He sat in the car with a policeman on _____ of him.
questions.explanation: 警察在他两侧中的一侧，用 either side（either 指两者中的任何一个，接单数名词）；both sides 表“两边都有警察”与 with a policeman 单数矛盾；every 用于三者以上。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _____ you have!
questions.explanation: 感叹部分是名词短语（strange ideas）用 What 引导：What strange ideas you have! How 后接形容词或副词，不能直接修饰名词。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Most workmen are paid by _____.
questions.explanation: 表示“按……计酬/计量”用 by the + 单位名词：by the week 按周计酬，the 不可省；a week/every week/each week 均无此用法。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There is always _____ being held in the village.
questions.explanation: “some + 单数名词 + or other”为固定结构，表示“某个（不知是哪个）……”；meeting 用单数，C/D 项 the other 特指两者中的另一个，不合语境。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Those of us who wear glasses should have ____ eyes examined at regular intervals.
questions.explanation: 主语 those of us 中的 us 决定物主代词用 our：those of us…our eyes（我们中戴眼镜的人应定期检查眼睛）；their/your 与 us 矛盾。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Those of us who work in that medical plant should have _____ lungs X-rayed regularly.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。those of us 应配 our（those of us…our；those of them…their）：have our lungs X-rayed；their 与 us 矛盾。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He never rested until he had repaid_____.
questions.explanation: whole 直接置于冠词之后修饰名词：the whole sum（全部款项）；whole of 后必须接“the + 名词”，B、C 项 sum 前缺冠词，均错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _____ were full of light.
questions.explanation: all 置于 the 之前修饰复数名词：all the rooms；whole 须放在 the 之后且一般修饰单数整体（the whole room），A、C 结构不成立。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _____ like being criticized.
questions.explanation: 部分否定用 not many（没有许多人）；no 不能与 many/some 直接连用，A、D 结构错误，B 项 not some 搭配不存在。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The journalist was very pleased when the chairman allowed him to ask _____.
questions.explanation: 数词与 other 连用时的语序为“数词 + other + 复数名词”：three other questions（再问三个问题）；other 不能置于数词前，the other three questions 特指“剩下的那三个”，与语境不合。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I can relax myself, for I’ve got _____ holiday.
questions.explanation: another 后可接“数词 + 复数名词”表“再、又”：another three days（再有三天的假期）；more 表“再”须说 three more days（B 语序错误），three other days 无“追加”义。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Where is _____ dictionary of Cathy’s?
questions.explanation: “of Cathy's”为双重所有格，其前可用 that/this/a 等限定词，习惯上不用 the：that dictionary of Cathy's（凯西的那本词典）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He isn’t the man _____ was coming.
questions.explanation: 定语从句中插入 we thought，真正的从句主语是关系代词（was coming 缺主语），指人作主语用 who；whom 只能作宾语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Whom did you say _____ donate several paintings to the new museum?
questions.explanation: Whom 是 ask 的宾语被提前提问，did you say 为插入语；ask sb to do sth 需带 to 的不定式，故 we should ask to donate 正确；A 项缺 to，C、D 结构错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mr. Smith is a man _____.
questions.explanation: 定语从句含插入语 I believe，关系代词作 is trustworthy 的主语，指人用 who；whom 不能作主语，D 项 believe to trustworthy 结构错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The boy that we thought _____, after all.
questions.explanation: that we thought was ready 中 we thought 为插入语，that 作从句主语与 was ready 构成主谓关系；主句谓语是 is not（ready），after all 置于句末；A 项 that 重复。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The easiest way to get the money, _____, was to try kidnapping.
questions.explanation: we thought 为插入语（= we thought that the easiest way… was to try kidnapping），用逗号与主句隔开；which we thought 中 which 在 thought 后无成分可充当。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I’ve been waiting _____ for this opportunity.
questions.explanation: 肯定句中表示“很长时间”用 for a long time；long 和 for long 作副词多用于否定句、疑问句（如 Have you waited long?），for long time 缺冠词。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “ The old house belongs to the Greens.” “ _____ living in it now, is there?”
questions.explanation: 答句附加问用 is there，说明陈述部分是 there be 句型且含否定词：There's nobody living in it now, is there?（nobody 表否定，前否后肯）；A、D 的否定附加问与之矛盾，C 缺谓语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I _____ force in your argument.
questions.explanation: fail to do sth 为固定搭配，后接不定式，排除 C；否定意义动词 see 后用 any 不用 some，排除 B。全句：我看不出你的论点有什么说服力。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is very cloudy. ______ it is going to rain soon.
questions.explanation: Perhaps 是副词，可单独修饰整句表推测“或许要下雨了”；May 是情态动词须接动词原形，不能接句子；Sure/Certain 是形容词，须与 be 连用。全句：天很阴，或许很快就要下雨了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You are _______ able to do it than I am.
questions.explanation: able 的比较级为 more able，与 than 呼应：You are more able to do it than I am；much/rather 不能与 able 构成比较级，better 是 good/well 的比较级。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The living buried the dead, while the healthy supported _______.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。“the + 形容词/过去分词”表一类人：the wounded 伤员，与 the living/the dead/the healthy 平行；ill 一般只作表语，the ill 不规范，sick 前缺 the。全句：活着的人埋葬死者，健康的人照顾伤员。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mother gets up ______ than any other one in my family.
questions.explanation: 比较级可用 far/much/even/still 等副词修饰：far earlier 早得多；more earlier 双重比较级错误，farther 本身是比较级，不能再修饰 earlier。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: His wife could swim ______ his daughter, because they were both beginners.
questions.explanation: no better than 表示“和……一样不好”（都不擅长），与 both beginners 呼应；as well as 表“一样好”与初学者身份矛盾，no sooner than 表“一……就……”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It’s _______ to go for a walk on a summer evening.
questions.explanation: good and + 形容词是口语固定强调结构，意为“非常”，中间不能再插入 very 等副词，故 good and nice 正确而 A、B 不对。全句：夏日的傍晚出去散步非常惬意。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: This book is not good, but that one is _______ better.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误。rather 可修饰比较级：rather better（好得多），与 but 的转折语境呼应；a lot of 只修饰名词（应为 a lot better），hardly better“几乎不见得好”与转折句意矛盾。全句：这本书不好，但那本要好得多。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mrs. London has _______ that she is unable to get a decent job.
questions.explanation: so + little/much + 不可数名词 + that… 为结果状语从句：so little education that she is unable to…；education 不可数不能用 such a，a so/a such 语序错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Staying in hotel costs _______ renting a room in a dormitory for a week.
questions.explanation: 倍数置于比较结构最前面：twice as much as（是……的两倍）；as much twice as 语序错误，twice more than 不是规范表达。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He told me that he would go to meet me at the station; he didn’t _______.
questions.explanation: though 可置于句末作副词，表“不过，然而”（he didn't though 他并没来）；although 无此用法；either 用于否定句句末表“也”，as well 用于肯定句表“也”。全句：他告诉我他会去车站接我；不过他并没有来。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ seen the lion in the zoo.
options: Almost every one of us has
Every one of almost us has
Every one of us almost has
questions.explanation: everyone 是代词，不能接 of 短语，须用 every one of us；almost 应紧放在所修饰的 every one of us 之前；主语为单数，谓语用 has。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If negotiations for the new trade agreement take_______, critical food shortages will develop in several countries.
questions.explanation: much too + 形容词/副词表示“实在太……”：take much too long（拖得太久）；too much 修饰不可数名词或动词，不能修饰形容词 long。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We fear no death, _______ difficulties.
questions.explanation: still less（更不用说）用于否定句之后引出程度更进的否定：不怕死，更不怕困难；no less than 表“多达/不亚于”，as well as 表“以及”，still more 用于肯定句递进。全句：我们不怕死，更不怕困难。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The science of medicine, _______ progress has been very rapid lately made, is perhaps the most important of all the sciences.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the science of medicine 与 progress 构成 progress in medicine（在医学方面的进步），介词 in 提前与 which 连用引导非限制性定语从句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The modern machine proved _______ in heart surgery.
questions.explanation: 修饰形容词 valuable 须用副词 highly（highly valuable 极有价值）；high 是形容词不能修饰形容词，且副词应位于形容词之前。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He is _______ to our concert.
questions.explanation: more than + 形容词为固定表达，意为“非常、极其”：more than pleased to come（非常乐意来），more than 不可拆开或移位。全句：他非常乐意来参加我们的音乐会。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The cost of this car is _______ much for me.
questions.explanation: much too 用来加强语气，修饰 much（too much 太多、太贵）：is much too much for me（贵得根本承受不起）；too much for sb 为固定表达，so/very much 不能与 for me 搭配表“负担不起”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was surprising to see so high a bridge over_______.
questions.explanation: so + 形容词 + a/an + 单数名词：so small a river（如此小的一条河）；such 结构应为 such a small river，a so small/a such small 语序错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ to take the course deserve to succeed.
questions.explanation: enough 修饰形容词时必须后置：brave enough；Students brave enough to take the course 中形容词短语作后置定语，A、B、D 中 enough 位置均错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Half the joke is the exaggeration; ______ is that this is not exaggeration at all.
questions.explanation: 前文 half the joke，两者中的另一个用 the other half（另一半）；another 表三者以上的泛指，the rest 指“其余全部”，与 half 对应不精确。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The wheels of the old wagon are nearly ______ those of a modern car.
questions.explanation: 倍数 + the size of 为固定倍数表达：three times the size of（是……的三倍大），size 用单数并加 the；B、C、D 中 size 单复数或冠词使用错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Whether or not the new plan will yield any positive results _______ to be seen.
questions.explanation: Whether or not 引导的主语从句作主语，谓语用第三人称单数：remains to be seen（尚待分晓）；remain 无被动形式，is remained 错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They bought a big bed, which took up _______ of the space.
questions.explanation: 分数表达：分子用基数词，分母用序数词，分子大于 1 时分母加 s：two-thirds 三分之二；two-third、second-third、two-three 均错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: How did he make his decision_______ ?
questions.explanation: in the first place 为固定短语，意为“首先、当初”：How did he make his decision in the first place? in first、as first、first thing 均非规范搭配。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Scientists hope to send an expedition to Mars during_______.
questions.explanation: 表示年代用 the + 整十年份 + s：the 2020s（21世纪20年代）；2020s 缺定冠词 the，the 2020 指单一年份，2020's 不是规范年代写法。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Although Bob had certainly not been sickly as a boy, in recent years he ______.
options: has been sick all the time
questions.explanation: in recent years 是现在完成时的标志，谓语用 has been sick all the time；A、B 为一般过去时与时间状语不符，D 过去完成时缺少过去参照点。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ The Atlantic Ocean crosses the equator, the trade winds causes a flow of water to the west.
questions.explanation: 需要地点状语从句连接两个分句：Where the Atlantic Ocean crosses the equator（在大西洋穿过赤道的地方）；And/That/At 无法引导从句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Even the best drivers can have an accident _______ are tired and driving conditions are bad.
questions.explanation: if 引导条件状语从句，从句 tired 前缺主语，用 if they（指代 drivers）；in case of 后接名词短语不能接从句，if you 与主句主语 drivers 人称不一致。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The majority of people asked to name the most common bird in England _______ probably choose the House Sparrow.
questions.explanation: 空后是动词原形 choose，四个选项中只有 will 能接动词原形构成一般将来时（be 动词后不能直接跟原形）：The majority of people…will probably choose…

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Could you please tell me where _______ ?
options: can I find the student store
questions.explanation: where 引导宾语从句必须用陈述句语序：the student store is；A、D 为疑问语序，C 结构错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Because the family is poor, the children have ______ clothes.
questions.explanation: clothes 为复数名词，用 few/a few 修饰；家里穷“几乎没有衣服”表否定用 few；a little/little 只修饰不可数名词。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Everyone admires her ______.
options: because of her kindness and she is gentle
because of both her kindness and her gentleness
both because of her kindness and her gentleness
because of her kindness and she is gentle
questions.explanation: both…and 必须连接结构对等的成分：because of both her kindness and her gentleness（并列两个名词短语）；C 项 both 提到 because of 之前使并列成分不对等。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: By arriving early, they _______ to get good tickets.
questions.explanation: 表示过去经过努力成功做成某事须用 was/were able to do（不能只用 could 表一次具体成功）；obtained/got 后不接 to get，succeed 须接 in doing。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Platinum _______ in existence.
options: it is one of the heaviest materials
as one of the heaviest materials that is
one of the heaviest materials, it is
is one of the heaviest materials
questions.explanation: one of the + 形容词最高级 + 复数名词：Platinum is one of the heaviest materials in existence（铂是现存最重的材料之一）；其余选项缺谓语或结构重复。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______, he would not have studied at Harvard.
options: If it had not been for the scholarship
questions.explanation: 主句 would not have studied 表与过去事实相反，if 从句须用 had done：If it had not been for the scholarship（要不是有奖学金）；A、D 为现在虚拟形式，C 语义不合。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ to blame for the many troubles you have encountered.
options: It is not I who am
It is not I that is
It is not me who am
I am not the person who am
questions.explanation: It is…who 强调主语时，who 从句的谓语与被强调的代词保持一致：It is not I who am to blame（不是我要受责备）；B、C 项 that/who 后用 is 与 I 不一致，D 结构错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: More than ten million copies of George Orwell’s novel _______ in English alone since it was first published in 1949.
questions.explanation: since it was first published in 1949 表动作从过去持续至今，用现在完成时；copies 与 sell 为被动关系，故用 have been sold；have sold 为主动，不合逻辑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The old man invested all his money _______ a chicken farm and got rich.
questions.explanation: invest…in… 为固定搭配“把……投资于……”：invested all his money in a chicken farm；on/into/at 均不与 invest 搭配。全句：老人把所有的钱都投资到养鸡场并发了财。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: My younger brother couldn’t help _______ when his toy car fell into the river.
questions.explanation: can't help doing sth 为固定搭配“禁不住做某事”：couldn't help crying；A 项 can't help but 结构中 but 后须接动词原形，B、C 搭配错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I wish that I _______ the concert last night.
questions.explanation: wish 后的宾语从句用虚拟语气，last night 表与过去事实相反，从句用 had attended；A 项 could 无完成式，D 项 attended 为陈述语气。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: An explosion is really a sudden increase in volume _______.
options: causing its burning to be rapid
questions.explanation: increase 与 cause 为被动关系（骤增是由急速燃烧引起的），用过去分词短语 caused by rapid burning 作后置定语；A、B 造成谓语重复，C 项 causing 表主动关系错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ the surface of metal, but also weakens it.
questions.explanation: not only 位于句首连接两个分句时，前一分句须部分倒装：Not only does rust corrode…, but also (it) weakens it；B 项未倒装不能与 but also 呼应，C、D 结构无法衔接。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______, Alexander Graham Bell was still a young man.
questions.explanation: 主句完整，前面需时间状语从句：When he invented the telephone（发明电话时他还是个年轻人）；A、B、C 都是独立分句，与主句之间缺少连词。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Liberals tend to favour _______ do conservatives.
questions.explanation: 比较结构为 more immediate social change than do conservatives（支持比保守党人更直接的社会变革），than 后从句可倒装；A 项 more than 连读意为“不仅仅”，其余选项比较对象错位、语序混乱。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: With general acceptance of photography as an artistic medium, _______ museums today house collections of fine photographs.
questions.explanation: most 直接修饰复数名词表“大多数”：most museums；the most 用于最高级，most of 后须接 the + 名词（most of the museums），单独 the most of 错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The doctor is feeling the little girl’s pulse. He says it _______ normal.
questions.explanation: feel 作系动词表“摸起来、感觉起来”的状态，不用进行时也不用被动语态：it feels normal；is feeling 误把状态当动作，is felt 误用被动。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mary is ______ than Alice.
questions.explanation: 比较级修饰单数可数名词时冠词置于比较级之前：a more experienced teacher；more experienced a teacher 语序错误，其余选项结构混乱。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The first doll _______ say “mama” was invented in 1830.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the first doll 被序数词修饰，关系词用 that；从句 say 前缺主语与情态动词：that could say “mama”；A 项 it 重复主语，B、C 结构错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The grape is ______ cultivated plants.
options: the one is the oldest of
questions.explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词：The grape is one of the oldest cultivated plants（葡萄是最古老的栽培植物之一）；B 项 the oldest one 与复数 plants 矛盾，C、D 结构错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Neon is said to be inert _______ does not react easily with other substances.
questions.explanation: because 引导原因状语从句，从句主语 it 指代 neon：because it does not react easily；because of 后只能接名词短语，B、D 结构不完整。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Gloves _______ since prehistoric time for protection, for ornamentation, and as an indication of social status.
questions.explanation: since prehistoric time 表从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时；gloves 与 wear 为被动关系：have been worn；D 项 have been wearing 为主动且不合逻辑，A、C 时态不符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ in cracks of rocks, it expands and causes the rocks to split.
questions.explanation: 主句 it expands and causes... 已完整，空格处需引导词构成从句；When water freezes in cracks of rocks 为 when 引导的时间状语从句，it 指代 water。C 会造成逗号连接两个独立句，B/D 语序混乱，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Like a magazine, a newspaper has a content guide that indicates _______ located.
questions.explanation: indicates 后接宾语从句，从句缺地点状语用 where 引导，且宾语从句必须用陈述语序（each feature is located）；D 为疑问语序，B/C 结构不完整，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They fulfilled the task in _______ it took us.
questions.explanation: 分数（倍数）修饰名词的固定结构为“分数 + the + 名词”（类比 twice the size），three-fourths the time 意为“所用时间的四分之三”；it took us 是省略关系词的定语从句，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: His explanation made the problem _______ more complicated.
questions.explanation: make + 宾语 + 形容词（宾补）结构，even 是比较级修饰语，even more complicated 意为“甚至更加复杂”；B/D 的 to be/be 与 make 搭配错误，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “I’m not going to buy that book,” “_______. It’s too expensive.”
questions.explanation: 前句 I'm not going... 含 be 动词 am 且为否定，表示“我也不”要用 neither + be/助动词 + 主语的部分倒装；A 的 don't 与前句的 am 不匹配，B 为肯定句结构，故选 Neither am I，选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The chief foods eaten in a country depends largely on _______ best in its climate and soil.
questions.explanation: depend on 后接宾语从句，从句缺主语用连接代词 what 引导（what grows best...），宾语从句须用陈述语序；D 为疑问语序，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Desert animals _______ a means of retaining moisture in such a hot, dry climate if they are to survive.
questions.explanation: 空格处是句子唯一谓语，needing/to need/needed 均为非谓语形式不能充当谓语；主语 Desert animals 为复数，陈述一般性事实用一般现在时 need，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Resin is a substance that ______ in water.
questions.explanation: that 定语从句修饰 a substance，从句缺谓语；树脂不溶于水是客观事实，用一般现在时，主语为第三人称单数，故 does not dissolve，选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: All living organisms constantly absorb carbon 14 ______ their existence.
questions.explanation: throughout their existence 意为“在其整个一生中”，throughout 表“贯穿整个期间”；out/about/around 均无此义。翻译：所有生物在其一生中都不断吸收碳14。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: In blank verse _______ of ten syllables, five of which are accented.
questions.explanation: 句子缺主语和谓语；each 修饰单数名词作主语时谓语用单数，each line consists of ten syllables 结构完整；A/D 语序混乱，B 缺主语，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ all rainwater falling from a cloud reaches the ground; some of it is lost through evaporation.
questions.explanation: not all... 表部分否定，“并非所有雨水都到达地面”，与后半句 some of it is lost（部分蒸发损失）呼应；none 表全部否定且须与 of 连用，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I don’t like _______ bills but when I do get them I like ______ them promptly.
questions.explanation: like doing 表一般性、习惯性的好恶（不喜欢收到账单这种常态），like to do 表具体某次的意愿（想及时付清），故第一空 getting、第二空 to pay，选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Home is home, ______ ever so homely.
questions.explanation: be it ever so homely 为 be 型虚拟语气的让步倒装，动词原形 be 提至句首，相当于 though it may be ever so homely（无论它多么简陋）；A/B/D 均无此结构，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Anderson was disappointed when he found out they had gone to the test-site ______ him.
questions.explanation: without him 意为“没有带上他”，即他们去考场时没带 Anderson，所以他失望；except/but 表“除……之外”语义不符，expect 是动词“期待”。翻译：Anderson 发现他们没带上他就去了考场，感到非常失望。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “Would you rather watch TV or go for a walk?” ______ the TV program is good this afternoon, I need the exercise more.”
questions.explanation: 空后是完整句子，需要连词；Even though 引导让步状语从句“尽管……”，Despite/In spite of 只能接名词短语，No matter how 须接形容词或副词，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The skyscraper, ______, is an architectural form that originated in the United States.
options: of which a tall commercial structure
questions.explanation: 主语 The skyscraper 与谓语 is 之间插入名词短语 a tall commercial structure 作同位语，补充说明主语；A 会使句子出现两个谓语，C/D 结构不通，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Writing pens are made in ______ of shapes, sizes, and colours.
questions.explanation: 多项修饰语的排序为“冠词 + 副词 + 形容词 + 名词”：an almost endless variety of shapes...（种类几乎无穷多样）；只有 C 语序正确，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Using many symbols makes ______ to put a large amount of information on a single map.
questions.explanation: make it possible to do... 中 it 作形式宾语，真正的宾语是不定式 to put a large amount of information...；A 缺形式宾语 it，C/D 结构错误，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: In general, the simple plants appeared on the Earth before those_______.
questions.explanation: those 指代复数 plants，后接比较级短语 more complicated in structure 作后置定语，即“结构上更复杂的那些植物”；A/C 为完整句子不能作后置修饰，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Pluto, the outermost planet of the solar system, ______ photographically in March 1930.
questions.explanation: 句子缺谓语，in March 1930 是过去时间点，Pluto（冥王星）与 discover 为被动关系，用一般过去时的被动语态 was discovered，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ as much as one-fourth of all timber harvested is not used.
questions.explanation: It is estimated that... 为固定句型，it 作形式主语，that 引导真正的主语从句“据估计……”；A/B/C 均无法与 that 从句构成完整主谓结构，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ irritating effect on humans, the use of phenol as general antiseptic has been largely discontinued.
questions.explanation: 空后 irritating effect 为名词短语，需用介词短语 because of its（因为它的刺激作用）作原因状语；since 引导原因从句须接完整句子。翻译：由于苯酚对人体有刺激性，它作为通用防腐剂的用法已基本停止。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A historical novel may do more than mirror history, ______ future events.
questions.explanation: 逗号后应填与前面 may do 并列、共用主语的谓语 may even influence；A 会造成逗号连接两个独立句（无连词），B 分词形式不能与之并列，D 的 that 从句无着落，故选 C。翻译：历史小说不仅能反映历史，甚至还能影响未来的事件。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: My transistor radio isn’t working. It ______.
questions.explanation: need doing 为主动形式表被动意义，相当于 need to be done；主语 It 为第三人称单数，谓语用 needs repairing，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A person’s attention is attracted ______ by the intensity of different signals as by their context, significance, and information content.
questions.explanation: not so much...as... 为固定比较结构，“与其说……不如说……”；空后已有 as，故空格处应为 not so much，选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ are fed into a tape recorder, they magnetize the particles on the tape in varying patterns.
questions.explanation: 主句 they magnetize the particles... 完整，空格需连词构成 When electric waves are fed into a tape recorder 时间状语从句；because of 只接名词短语，C 造成逗号拼接，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ dog was the first animal to be domesticated is generally agreed upon by authorities in the field.
questions.explanation: 整句缺主语，That the dog was the first animal to be domesticated 为 that 引导的主语从句（that 不可省略），is generally agreed upon 为主句谓语，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: An increase in a nation’s money supply, without an accompanying increase in economic activity, _______ result in higher prices.
questions.explanation: tend to do sth 为固定搭配，后接 result in 需补 to，A 缺 to，B 多 the，C 为非谓语使句子缺谓语；will tend to result in 正确。翻译：一国货币供应量若在缺乏相应经济活动增长的情况下增加，往往会推高物价。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ the size or nature of a business is, its main goal is to earn a profit.
questions.explanation: Whatever the size or nature of a business is 为 whatever 引导的让步状语从句，“无论企业规模或性质如何”；B/C/D 均不能引导此让步从句，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: X-rays are able to pass through objects and thus make _______ details that are otherwise impossible to observe.
questions.explanation: make + 宾语 + 形容词（宾补）结构，宾语为 details，补语用形容词 visible“使这些细节可见”；B visibly 为副词不能作宾补，A 的 it 与后置的 details 语义重复，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Orchestral instruments _______ under the following types: String, woodwind, brass and percussion.
questions.explanation: instruments 与 group（归类）为被动关系，句子缺谓语，用含情态动词的被动语态 can be grouped“可以被归为”，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: People’s expectations of a higher standard of living increase _______.
options: since conditions in their improving community
as conditions in their community improve
questions.explanation: as 引导时间状语从句“随着社区条件改善”；A/C 缺连词造成逗号拼接，B 的 since 从句缺谓语，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Gold has been highly prized throughout the ages due chiefly to ______.
questions.explanation: due to 后须接名词短语，its scarcity（它的稀缺性）符合；A 为完整句子不能作介词宾语。翻译：黄金自古以来备受珍视，主要因为它十分稀缺。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ you are free tonight, why not drop in and play chess with me?
questions.explanation: Since 引导原因状语从句，表“既然你今晚有空”，语气自然；for 一般不置于句首，because 语气过强，even if 表让步不合逻辑，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: In computer programming, this model is _______ any of the others we have in the department.
questions.explanation: superior to 为固定比较搭配（拉丁语源比较级不用 than，也不能与 as...as 连用），副词 obviously 修饰 superior，D 的 obvious 为形容词错误。翻译：在计算机编程方面，这个型号明显优于本系现有的其他任何型号。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Uniform acceleration occurs _______ the rate of change remains the same over successive and equal intervals of time.
questions.explanation: 空后为完整从句，需连词 if 引导条件状语从句，即“（在）变化率在连续相等的时间间隔内保持不变（的情况下）发生匀加速”；according to/with/under 只能接名词短语，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The worldwide race to develop an affordable synthetic fuel has so far consumed billions and ______ few results.
questions.explanation: so far 是现在完成时的标志；has consumed billions and yielded few results 为两个并列谓语共用助动词 has，故选 yielded，选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ one time, Manchester, New Hampshire, was the home of the most productive cotton mills in the world.
questions.explanation: at one time 为固定介词搭配，意为“曾经，一度”。翻译：曾经，新罕布什尔州的曼彻斯特坐落着世界上生产力最强的棉纺织厂。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Over a very large number of trials, the probability of an event’s _______ is equal to the probability that it will not occur.
questions.explanation: 介词 of 后接动名词，且动名词的逻辑主语 an event 用所有格形式：an event's occurring“事件发生的”概率，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ millions of galaxies exist in the vast space outside the Milky Way.
questions.explanation: It is estimated that... 固定句型，it 作形式主语，that 引导真正的主语从句“据估计银河系外的浩瀚太空中存在数百万个星系”，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The edible mushroom _______ a cushionlike, moist cap that is light brown or darkish red.
questions.explanation: 句子缺谓语动词，which having/to have 均为非谓语形式；客观描述食用蘑菇的特征用一般现在时 has，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: My children are looking forward to _______ a trip to Guilin next month.
questions.explanation: look forward to 中 to 为介词，后接动名词：looking forward to making a trip“盼望进行一次旅行”，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I had hoped Mr. Smith ______ me an early reply.
questions.explanation: had hoped 表示过去的愿望（实际未实现），that 前是过去时、从句表将要发生的事，用过去将来时 would give，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ as 2500 B.C., the Egyptians used mirrors made of highly polished metal.
questions.explanation: as early as + 时间 为固定结构，“早在公元前2500年”。翻译：早在公元前2500年，埃及人就已使用高抛光金属制成的镜子。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: In 1938, when Benny Goodman’s orchestra presented a concert at the prestigious Carnegie Hall, _______ was clear that jazz had last been fully accepted.
questions.explanation: it was clear that... 中 it 作形式主语，that 从句为真正主语“爵士乐终于被完全接受已显而易见”；there/which/and 均不能构成此结构，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Like other women ______ in the field of medicine, Sara Mayo found the beginning years difficult.
questions.explanation: 先行词 other women 指人，从句缺主语，用 who pioneered 作从句主语；A 中 they 与 who 重复，D 的 pioneered 不及物不能直接作后置定语，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Scientists think _______ helps some trees to conserve water in the winter.
questions.explanation: think 后接 that 引导的宾语从句，从句主语为动名词短语（that）losing leaves（落叶），谓语 helps：“落叶有助于某些树木在冬天保存水分”，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Because the saxophone is an excellent solo instrument, ______ in some important orchestral works.
questions.explanation: because 从句之后主句缺主谓；it is featured“它（萨克斯管）在……中被作为特色乐器使用”为被动语态，D 语序错误，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Variables such as individual and corporate behaviour ______ nearly impossible for economists to forecast economic trends with precision.
questions.explanation: make it + adj. + for sb. to do 结构，it 作形式宾语，真正宾语为不定式 to forecast...；主语 Variables 为复数，谓语用 make，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Thomas Jefferson’s achievements as an architect rival his contributions ______ a politician.
questions.explanation: his contributions as a politician“他作为政治家的贡献”，as 表“作为”；such/more/than 与句意不符。翻译：作为建筑师，托马斯·杰斐逊的成就堪与他的政治贡献相媲美。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The gas tank was only ______ when we started.
questions.explanation: 分数 + 形容词表状态：one-fourth full“四分之一满”；B one-fourth as full 意为“只有（参照物的）四分之一满”，缺比较对象，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ people depend to such a great extent on forest, every effort must be made to preserve trees and wildlife.
questions.explanation: Since 引导原因状语从句“既然人们在如此大的程度上依赖森林”，后接完整从句；that/which 无因果义，how 不引导状语从句，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ is one of the most useful and fascinating division of human knowledge is widely accepted.
questions.explanation: That mathematics is one of the most useful and fascinating divisions... 为 that 引导的主语从句（that 不可省略），is widely accepted 为主句谓语；D 缺引导词会形成两个句子，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Recent estimates show that ______ more than two million birdwatchers in the United States.
questions.explanation: that 引导的宾语从句必须用陈述语序；there are more than two million birdwatchers 为 there be 存在句型，B 为疑问语序，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Primary batteries or cells are ______, once discharged, are discharged.
questions.explanation: 表语为 those（指代 batteries）+ that 引导的定语从句，that 在从句中作主语；单用 those 或 that 均无法连接从句，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The higher the standard of living and the greater the national wealth, the ______.
options: greater number of paper is used
greater amount of paper is used
greater the number of paper used
greater the amount of paper used
questions.explanation: “the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...”结构，后半应为 the greater the amount of paper used；paper 不可数须用 amount 而非 number，D 语序正确，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It seemed that there are good economic and ecological reasons for sources of energy_______ nuclear power.
questions.explanation: other than 意为“除……之外/不同于”，sources of energy other than nuclear power“核能以外的能源”；different/alike/dissimilar 与 with 的搭配均错误。翻译：似乎有充分的经济和生态方面的理由支持开发核能以外的能源。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If only I _______ the book on the reading list before I attended the lecture.
questions.explanation: If only 后接虚拟语气，before I attended the lecture 表明与过去事实相反，从句用 had done，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We can see a lot of people doing morning exercises in the parks even ______ a cold morning.
questions.explanation: 具体某一天的早晨用介词 on：even on a cold morning“甚至在寒冷的早晨”；in 接月份年份，at 接时刻。翻译：即使在寒冷的早晨，我们也能看到许多人正在公园里晨练。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Experiments in the photography of moving objects ______ in both the United States and Europe well before 1900.
questions.explanation: well before 1900 表示在过去的某时之前，用过去完成时；experiments 与 conduct 为被动关系，故 had been conducted，选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Annie Jump Cannon, _______, discovered so many stars that she was called “the census taker of the sky.”
questions.explanation: 主语 Annie Jump Cannon 与谓语 discovered 之间插入名词短语 a leading astronomer 作同位语；C 会造成双谓语，A/B 结构不完整，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Hot objects emit _______ do cold objects.
questions.explanation: 比较结构 more infrared rays than（do cold objects），more 修饰名词短语 infrared rays 作 emit 的宾语，比较从句倒装 do cold objects；A/C 语序错误，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: All gases and most liquids and solids expand when _______.
questions.explanation: when heated = when they are heated：当状语从句主语与主句一致且为被动关系时，省略“主语 + be”只保留过去分词，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Futurism, _______ early twentieth-century movement in art, rejected all traditions and attempted to glorify contemporary life by emphasizing the machine and motion.
questions.explanation: Futurism 与谓语 rejected 之间插入同位语 an early twentieth-century movement（元音音素前用 an）；B 会造成双谓语，C/D 结构错误，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ time and labour, cartoonists generally draw the hands of their characters with only three fingers and a thumb.
questions.explanation: 句首表目的用不定式：To save time and labour“为了省时省力”，作目的状语；Saved/Saves 为谓语形式不能作状语，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He told me only part of the story, _______.
questions.explanation: and that was that 为固定表达，意为“就是这样，仅此而已”。翻译：他只给我讲了故事的一部分，就这样。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Their walking-tour through Lapland never came _______ .
questions.explanation: come off 意为“举行，实现”，never came off“从未成行”；come on 上演/快点，come out 出版，come round 苏醒/来访，均不合句意。翻译：他们徒步穿越拉普兰的旅行从未成行。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ companies were closed down owing to the economic depression.
questions.explanation: both 与指示代词连用时的语序为 both + these/those + 复数名词：Both these companies“这两家公司”，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Noah Webster’s Dictionary was _______ published in 1828 and has been extremely influential in American Language usage ever since then.
questions.explanation: first 作副词修饰 published：was first published in 1828“首次出版于1828年”；the first to be 意为“第一个被……”不合句意，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I beg _______ tomorrow’s meeting.
questions.explanation: be excused from doing sth 为固定搭配，介词 from 后接动名词：to be excused from attending“获准免于参加”；B 应为 attending，故选 C。翻译：我请求获准免于出席明天的会议。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Wood furniture does not depreciate in value ______ properly handled and protected.
questions.explanation: if properly handled = if it is properly handled：条件状语从句主语与主句一致且含被动意义时省略“主语 + be”，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: An Olympic marathon is 26 miles and 385 yards, approximately ______ from Marathon to Athens.
questions.explanation: approximately the distance from Marathon to Athens 为名词短语作同位语，补充说明 26 miles and 385 yards；A/B/C 结构错误，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The _______ of the new hospital _______ as good as or better than _______ of the old hospital.
questions.explanation: facilities（设施）为复数名词，谓语用 are；比较句中 those 替代复数名词 the facilities，that 只替代单数名词，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: From the distance could ______ the sleepy little village with its closely clustered adobe houses and red, clay tile roofs.
questions.explanation: 地点状语 From the distance 提至句首且主语为较长名词短语，构成完全倒装；主语 village 与 see 为被动关系：could be seen the sleepy little village“可以望见那座沉睡的小村庄”，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Equal pay for equal work ______ a standard which the women’s movement has attempted to enact into law.
questions.explanation: 句子缺谓语，主语 Equal pay for equal work 视为单一概念用单数 is；it is/which is 结构多余，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Only five of the seven stars in the constellation Pleiades ______ the naked human eyes.
questions.explanation: 主语 Only five of the seven stars 为复数概念，谓语用 are；副词 clearly 置于形容词 visible 之前，故 are clearly visible to，选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Because only three percent of their state is forested, people in Nebraska ______ great interest in planting trees.
questions.explanation: show interest in doing sth 为固定搭配；主语 people 复数，traditionally 与现在完成时 have traditionally shown 搭配表示“历来”；A 多出主语 they。翻译：由于该州只有百分之三的土地有森林覆盖，内布拉斯加州人对植树历来表现出浓厚兴趣。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Functioning as a filter for liquids, the kidneys _______ separating waste water from the body.
questions.explanation: 句子缺谓语，be responsible for doing 为固定搭配“负责……”；being responsible for 为非谓语形式不能作谓语，故选 C。翻译：作为液体的过滤器，肾脏负责将废水从体内分离出去。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Among the fiercest of all animals______, which has been known to defend itself successfully even against wolves and bears.
questions.explanation: 表语 Among the fiercest of all animals 提至句首，主语 the wolverine 后置，构成完全倒装：is the wolverine“所有动物中最凶猛的之一是貂熊”，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Highly introverted and intelligent, ______ of great philosophical and poetical elegance.
questions.explanation: 句首形容词短语 Highly introverted and intelligent 的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致且应为人，故主语须是 Emily Dickson：Emily Dickson wrote poems...；以 poems 为主语则修饰对象矛盾，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ an illness is detected is the main determinant as to whether it can be cured.
questions.explanation: How early an illness is detected 为连接副词 how 引导的主语从句（how early 修饰 is detected），is the main determinant 为主句谓语，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ of a nucleus and at least one electron.
questions.explanation: consist of“由……组成”为固定搭配且只用主动语态（不说 is consisted of）；句子缺谓语，Atoms consist of...；A/C/D 均不能构成完整谓语。翻译：原子由一个原子核和至少一个电子组成。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: According to some historians, American social trends ______ in 30-year cycle of liberalism and conservatism.
questions.explanation: 句子缺谓语，主语 trends 为复数，陈述客观规律用一般现在时 run；does run 用于第三人称单数，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ actually not classified as a tree but a grass.
questions.explanation: 句子缺谓语，the bamboo 与 classify 为被动关系：The bamboo is (actually not) classified as a tree but a grass，一般现在时被动语态，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The writing of Noah Porter, ______ from 1871 to 1886, clearly reflected his Puritan ancestry.
options: as president of Yale he served
he served as the president of Yale
who served as the president of Yale
questions.explanation: 逗号后为非限制性定语从句修饰人 Noah Porter，从句缺主语用 who：who served as the president of Yale“曾任耶鲁大学校长”，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Though it has since evolved into a powerful international body, the United Nations ______ those nations allied against Germany during World War II.
questions.explanation: 句子缺谓语动词；refer to“指的是”，语序应为 originally referred simply to those nations；D 的 it 与主语重复，B/C 为非谓语或语序错误，故选 A。翻译：联合国最初仅指二战期间联合对抗德国的那些国家。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: When ______ in 1947, it ranked with the vacuum tube as one of the great inventions in electronics.
options: the first invention of the transistor
questions.explanation: when 引导的时间状语从句需完整主谓：the transistor was first invented“晶体管首次被发明”（被动语态）；A 语序混乱，B/D 为名词短语，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The speed of super-conduction is related, in part, to the temperature ______ the conducting materials are cooled.
questions.explanation: be cooled to some temperature“被冷却到某一温度”，介词 to 与先行词 the temperature 搭配并前置：the temperature to which the conducting materials are cooled，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The United States cut diplomatic relations with Cuba at the beginning of 1961, ______ a period of isolation for the island nation.
