questions.explanation: which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前句整件事（1961年断交），usher in“开启”：which ushered in a period of isolation“开启了该岛国被孤立的时期”，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: As most of the province is too rugged or _______ , Nova Scotia is able to devote less than five percent of its total land area to agriculture.
options: has soils which are too thin or infertile
soils are too thin or infertile
which has too thin or infertile soils
questions.explanation: or 连接的成分须与 is too rugged 平行，应为完整谓语 has soils which are too thin or infertile（与主句共用主语 most of the province）；C 缺连词另起主谓，故选 A。翻译：由于该省大部分地区过于崎岖，或土壤过于浅薄贫瘠，新斯科舍省只能将不到百分之五的土地用于农业。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: By counting the blood cells, medical technicians can estimate the degree ________.
options: a disease which the body is resisting
which is the body resisting a disease
to which the body is resisting a disease
by which a body resists a disease
questions.explanation: to some degree“在某种程度上”为固定搭配，degree 后接 to which 引导的定语从句：the degree to which the body is resisting a disease“身体抵抗疾病的程度”，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The variegated corn ______ during Thanksgiving is called Indian corn.
questions.explanation: that 引导限制性定语从句并在从句中作主语：that decorates American tables“装饰美国人餐桌的（玉米）”；A 中 which 与 decorates 的主宾关系颠倒，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Cloud forms are usually classified according to ______ .
options: which they appear from the ground
questions.explanation: according to 后接名词短语：their appearance from the ground“它们从地面看的外观”；C 为完整句子不能作介词宾语。翻译：云的形态通常根据其从地面看的外观来分类。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Menopause, ______ a woman’s reproductive life, is genetically determined, though good nutrition and health habits can delay its onset.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句修饰 Menopause：which signals the end of a woman's reproductive life“它标志着女性生育期的结束”，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Racoons, ______ their food in water, do not actually wash it.
questions.explanation: although 引导让步状语从句插入：尽管浣熊可能把食物浸入水中，却并非真的在洗；A/B 缺连词形成逗号拼接，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Hubert Humphrey,______, achieved statewide prominence long before his election to the United States Senate.
options: who was a mayor of Minneapolis
he was a mayor of Minneapolis
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句 who was a mayor of Minneapolis 插入主语与谓语之间，补充说明其曾任明尼阿波利斯市市长；A 的 the Minneapolis 冠词错误，C 的 he 与主语重复，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Surprisingly, the invention of the telephone, ______, was not followed immediately by its adoption and adaptation for military use.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句 which occurred in 1876 修饰 the invention of the telephone；A 中 which 从句里 it 多余，B/C 结构错误，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The tomato, ______, is biologically classified as a fruit.
options: it is sold as a vegetable
as it is sold as vegetable
questions.explanation: though sold as a vegetable = though it is sold as a vegetable：让步状语从句主语与主句一致且为被动意义时省略“主语 + be”；B 语序错误，C 缺连词，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The mass “removal” of Native American to reservations in the period following the Civil War was intended to serve the interests of frontier settlers, gold miners, and ______.
questions.explanation: 与 frontier settlers、gold miners 并列应保持结构平行且简洁，railroad builders（名词 + 名词复数，“铁路修建者”）最对称；C/D 结构冗长，A 非指人。翻译：内战后把印第安人大规模“迁往”保留地，是为了服务于边疆定居者、淘金者和铁路修建者的利益。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: On July 4, 1776, ______ the signing of the Declaration of Independence, a committee was set up to design an official seal for the newly created government of the United States.
options: It was within a few hours of
questions.explanation: within a few hours of the signing“在签署后的几小时内”，介词短语作时间状语；A 的 it 多余，D 的 that 多余，故选 C。翻译：1776年7月4日，在《独立宣言》签署后的几小时内，一个委员会成立，为新生的美国政府设计正式国玺。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ are nearly always released from the most conspicuous parts of the blossom.
options: It is when the sweet scents of flowers
questions.explanation: 句子缺主语，The sweet scents of flowers（花香）作主语与谓语 are released 搭配；A 的 that 多余，B/C 结构不完整，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mechanical power transmission refers to ______ through and among machines by means of mechanical devices, such as pulleys or gears.
questions.explanation: refer to 后接名词短语：the transfer of power“动力的传递”；B 为动词短语、D 为分词短语，均不符合介词 to 后接名词的要求，故选 C。翻译：机械动力传动指借助皮带轮、齿轮等机械装置在机器内部及机器之间传递动力。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The North Central region suffers from tornadoes in summer and ______.
questions.explanation: and 连接的成分须与 tornadoes in summer 平行对称：blizzards in winter；C winter blizzards 与前文语序不平行，故选 A。翻译：美国中北部地区夏季遭受龙卷风、冬季遭受暴风雪侵袭。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The winds off Lake Michigan keep Chicago cooler in the summer, ______ the city’s winters more severe.
questions.explanation: 前句说夏季更凉爽（益处），后句说冬季更严酷（不利），语义转折兼递进用 but they also make；A/B/C 语序与时态混乱，故选 D。翻译：来自密歇根湖的风使芝加哥夏季更凉爽，但它们也使该市的冬季更加严酷。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ states, Massachusetts has one of the highest populations per square mile.
questions.explanation: Though one of the smaller states = Though it is one of the smaller states：让步状语从句省略主语和 be；“尽管属于较小的州之一，其每平方英里人口密度却位居前列”，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ in literature, William Faulkner was recognized for his best work long after it had already been written.
questions.explanation: As often happens“正如经常发生的那样”，as 引导方式（比较）状语从句；A 的 it 指代不明，C/D 语序错误，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ ginseng, one must carefully regulate the roots’ exposure to sunlight and humidity.
questions.explanation: When drying ginseng = When one is drying ginseng：时间状语从句省略主语和 be（主语 one 与主句一致，主动关系用现在分词），故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: By the time _______, Ernest Hemingway had decided he wished to be a fiction writer.
options: he was in his early twenties
questions.explanation: By the time 后须接完整从句（主语 he + 谓语 was）；主句 had decided 为过去完成时，表示“过去的过去”，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ the state of local deer populations, the four most important characteristics are herd size, average age per animal, individual health, and reproductive rate.
questions.explanation: 介词 in + 动名词作状语：In evaluating the state of local deer populations“在评估当地鹿群状况时”，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: In most areas _______, it is regarded as superior to other materials for the construction of monuments.
questions.explanation: where stone is available 为修饰 areas 的定语从句，where 在从句中作地点状语“在石材可得的地区”；B 语序错误，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If raw silk yarn ______ to be workable, it must first be soaked in an oil-based emulsion for about eight hours.
questions.explanation: be to do 表“按需要/计划将要发生”（若要变得柔韧可用）；enough 修饰形容词须后置：pliant enough。is to become pliant enough 符合，故选 B。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: During the 1980s, a record of 20 percent of all American children at some point _______ the federally defined poverty level.
questions.explanation: During the 1980s 为明确的过去时间段，at some point 表过去某时，用一般过去时 lived below；live 不及物无被动语态，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: By the age of three, children _______ nearly all the phonemes of their native language.
questions.explanation: 陈述普遍规律用一般现在时：By the age of three, children acquire...（主语 children 复数）；B had acquired 需要过去叙事语境，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Even before the feat was actually accomplished on July 20, 1969, most American citizens had believed that the United States would ______ a manned spacecraft on the surface of the Moon.
questions.explanation: succeed in doing sth 为固定搭配，would 后接动词原形：would succeed in landing“能成功实现登月”；success 为名词，A/B/C 搭配均错误。翻译：早在1969年7月20日真正实现之前，大多数美国公民就已相信美国能把载人飞船送上月球表面。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Once an outbreak of a deadly virus occurs, public health workers ______ its spread.
questions.explanation: Once 引导条件状语从句（主将从现），从句 occurs 为一般现在时，主句缺谓语：public health workers track its spread，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: When _______, its molecules re-combine such that it expands in volume.
questions.explanation: 主句主语为 its molecules（it 指水），when 引导的时间状语从句需完整主谓且不能省略主语：water freezes；B/C/D 均非完整从句，故选 A。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: One of the most effective ways to detect the presence of disease in the body is by ______ the blood.
questions.explanation: 介词 by 后接动名词：by testing the blood“通过验血”，故选 D。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ prior to hibernation, because fat---when oxidized---supplies both the energy and the water the animal needs to survive.
options: The store of large amounts fat by bears
Bears’ store of large amounts of fat
Bears store large amounts of fat
Bears storing large amounts of fat
questions.explanation: 句子缺完整主谓结构：Bears store large amounts of fat（熊在冬眠前储存大量脂肪），一般现在时陈述习性；A 结构混乱缺 of，B/D 缺谓语，故选 C。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Either increased labor costs or commodity prices can directly ______ the rate of inflation.
questions.explanation: raise 为及物动词“提高”，可直接接宾语 the rate of inflation；rise“上升”、arise“出现”均为不及物动词不能接宾语。翻译：劳动力成本的增加或商品价格的上涨都会直接影响通货膨胀率。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Jim Thorpe, born to a poor family on an Oklahoma Indian reservation, _______ to become the most famous athlete of the early 20th century.
questions.explanation: grow up“长大、成长”为不及物动词短语，不能用于被动语态；叙述过去的经历用一般过去时 grew up，故选 B。翻译：吉姆·索普出生于俄克拉荷马州一个印第安保留地的贫苦家庭，后来成长为20世纪初最著名的运动员。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Research by automobile manufacturers has shown that the key to long engine life _______ in the frequent changing of engine oil.
questions.explanation: 主语 the key 为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语用单数形式；lie in 意为“在于”，lay 为及物动词“放置”，不合句意，故选 lies。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Because of the depth at which the ship sank, it is considered unfeasible ______ the Titanic from the floor of the Atlantic Ocean.
questions.explanation: it 作形式主语，真正主语用不定式 to attempt...；raise 为及物动词“打捞、使升起”，rise 为不及物动词，故 to attempt to raise 正确。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A substance’s critical temperature is the degree of heat above which the substance ______ as a gas.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can 后须接动词原形，only 紧跟在 can 之后；exist 为不及物动词，无被动形式，排除 be existed 类结构，故 can only exist 正确。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Excluding automobile and work-related accidents, the leading causes of non-fatal accidents _______.
questions.explanation: 主语 the leading causes 为复数，谓语用原形 involve（涉及），主动语态，故 involve stairs and ramps 正确。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The film Casablanca _______ the list of movies requested most frequently by viewers of movies shown on television.
questions.explanation: 主语 The film 为第三人称单数，top 在此作动词“位居……之首”，一般现在时谓语用 tops。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Almost one-third of all Americans ______ some form of recognized psychiatric disorder at some time in their lives.
questions.explanation: at some time in their lives 表示到现在为止的经历，用现在完成时主动语态 have experienced；experience 此处为及物动词“经历”，are experienced 意为“有经验的”，不合句意。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: When housework and ______, wives average 71 hours per week, compared to 56 hours for husband.
questions.explanation: 主语为并列的 housework and outside employment（复数概念），且与 combine 为被动关系“被合计在一起”，故用 are combined。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Most of North and South Dakota would still be prairie if they ______ in their natural state.
questions.explanation: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，从句用 had done，且主语与 leave 为被动关系，故用 had been left。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ during the course of people’s lives are far more important than genetic inheritance in determining the level of well-being they achieve in their old age.
questions.explanation: 句中谓语是 are，缺少主语，须用名词短语作主语；Experiences occurring during... 中现在分词 occurring 作后置定语修饰 Experiences。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: perhaps the most important use of the science of statistics is ______ probability.
questions.explanation: is 后接不定式 to determine 作表语，说明“（统计学的）用途是测定概率”；determine 原形不能作表语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Frank Simonds, a reporter in the early 1900, _______ the journalistic style currently used by many political analysts.
questions.explanation: be credited with doing sth 意为“被认为是做出某事的人（某成果归功于某人）”，with 后须接动名词 developing。翻译：弗兰克·西蒙兹是20世纪初的一名记者，如今许多政治分析家使用的新闻写作风格被认为是由他开创的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The telephone, perhaps more than any other invention, has played a significant role in _______ modern communication.
questions.explanation: play a role in 后接名词性成分作宾语，the transforming of modern communication 为名词化动名词结构（相当于 transforming modern communication）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ many other domestic insects, the original habitat of the silverfish remains unknown.
questions.explanation: as 引导非限制性定语从句指代整个主句，as is the case with... 为固定表达，意为“正如……的情况一样”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: High in carbohydrates and ______, mangos are an excellent source of nourishment.
questions.explanation: High in carbohydrates 与 low in fat 为并列的形容词短语（be high/low in sth 富含/缺乏），共同作状语，故选 low in fat。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A compound is made up of only one kind of molecule just as an element is ______.
options: of one kind of atom made up
made up of only one kind of atom
questions.explanation: be made up of 意为“由……构成”，与前面 A compound is made up of... 平行，承前省略后须补全为 made up of only one kind of atom。翻译：化合物仅由一种分子构成，正如元素仅由一种原子构成一样。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______, unlike writers of poetry or literary fiction, must follow strict guidelines in the way they format their writing.
questions.explanation: 空格作主语，须与 unlike 后的 writers of poetry or literary fiction 构成同类平行的名词短语，故用 Writers of academic articles；B 项 those 与 writers 比较对象不对应，C、D 不能充当 must follow 的主语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Volcanic eruptions such as that of Mount St. Helena in 1980 are called explosive because they happen suddenly and ______.
questions.explanation: and 连接两个并列的副词修饰 happen：happen suddenly and violently，故用副词 violently。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The size of ocean waves is determined by _______, the length of time it blows, and the distance it travels across the open water.
questions.explanation: 与后文 the length of time it blows、the distance it travels 平行，须用“the + 名词 + of”结构 the speed of the wind。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ fifty states, California is the most important for a presidential candidate to win because of its large share of electoral votes.
questions.explanation: Of all the fifty states 表示比较范围“在全部五十个州之中”，与最高级 the most important 连用。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: An atomic clock is the _______ chronometer available to scientists.
questions.explanation: 表示“科学家可用的最精确的计时器”，用最高级 the most precise 修饰名词 chronometer；precisely 为副词不能修饰名词。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: No single person played a greater role in shaping American public education _______ the education philosopher John Dewey.
questions.explanation: 比较级 greater 须由 than 引出比较对象；than did John Dewey 中 did 替代 played a greater role 并构成倒装。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Poor sanitation has always been ______ causes of infectious disease.
questions.explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，表示“最……的……之一”：one of the greatest causes。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The use of make-up may well be as _______ as human civilization.
questions.explanation: as...as 为原级比较结构，中间用形容词原形 old：as old as human civilization。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The assembly lines of Henry Ford became _______ models of 20th century industrial production.
questions.explanation: models 为复数名词，须用 one of the most influential + 复数名词，表示“20世纪最具影响力的……之一”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Numerous studies have shown that _______ the teacher’s expectation, the greater the achievement of the student.
questions.explanation: “the + 比较级…，the + 比较级…”表示“越……越……”，与后文 the greater the achievement 对应，用 the higher。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ the Pleistocene ear, widespread continental ice sheets repeatedly covered large areas in the northern hemisphere.
questions.explanation: 空格后为名词短语 the Pleistocene era，须用介词 during“在……期间”；prior 须与 to 连用，while/when 须接从句。翻译：在更新世时期，广阔的大陆冰盖反复覆盖了北半球的大片地区。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ the 1970’s, a new theoretical model called “system theory” contributed to breakthroughs in psychology, biology, and physics.
questions.explanation: 年代前用介词 in：in the 1970's 表示“在20世纪70年代”；at 用于具体时刻点。翻译：在20世纪70年代，一种被称为“系统论”的新理论模型推动了心理学、生物学和物理学的突破。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: As the number of mid-nineteenth century immigrants who settled in New York increased, _______ the incidence of tuberculosis.
questions.explanation: “As..., so did...”结构：so + 助动词 + 主语，表示“结核病的发病率也是如此（随之增加）”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ agricultural states, Wisconsin is the greatest producer of dairy products.
questions.explanation: Of all agricultural states 表示比较范围，与最高级 the greatest producer 搭配使用。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Steel is so widely used in industrial manufacturing ______ for many years its production was a primary indicator of the state of the economy.
questions.explanation: so widely used 中的 so 与 that 构成 so...that 结果状语从句，“如此……以至于”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ other than turkey is an acceptable main dish to serve on Thanksgiving for the vast majority of American families.
questions.explanation: 空格须为可作主语的否定代词：Nothing other than turkey 意为“除了火鸡没有别的”；None 须与 of 连用，No 为限定词不能单独作主语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Not until the 1930’s did the varieties of corn that we now know come to be grown _______ they are today.
questions.explanation: as they are today 为 as 引导的方式状语从句，“像今天这样（被种植）”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Although arsenic is one of the most deadly of the commonly known poisons, ______ is also one of the most difficult to obtain.
questions.explanation: Although 从句之后须接完整主句，用 it 指代 arsenic 作主句主语；若选 which/what 则全句缺少主句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The Sioux Indians of the plains were pushed farther and farther westward until they were confined to a reservation in _______ is now South Dakota.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后接宾语从句，从句____ is now South Dakota 缺主语，须用 what（相当于 the place that）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Swamp willows flourish as far north as southern Canada and can be found _______ marshland provides a suitable environment.
questions.explanation: wherever 引导地点状语从句，“凡是沼泽地能提供适宜环境的地方都能找到它们”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ many states claim to be important in determining who a political party’s candidates for president will be, none but New Hampshire has proven crucial.
questions.explanation: 前后为让步关系“尽管许多州都自称很重要，但只有新罕布什尔州被证明是关键的”，用 Although 引导让步状语从句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: After centuries of cultivation, roses can be found _______ of hues.
questions.explanation: in a diversity of hues 意为“色调多样”，incredible 以元音音素开头冠词用 an，且形容词置于冠词之后：in an incredible diversity of hues。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Processing great personal popularity, but ______, Ulysses S. Grant has been judged by historians as one of America’s most incompetent presidents.
questions.explanation: little political skill 与 great personal popularity 并列，共同由句首分词（拥有……）支配，并列部分承前省略分词，只需名词短语；B 项 with 与分词结构不平行。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The formation of tornadoes, ______, seems to require moist warm air at low levels and cool dry air at upper levels.
questions.explanation: 空格为插入成分，相当于 which is not well understood even today，过去分词短语 even today not well understood 作非限制性定语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: By measuring from several locations the intervals between the tremors of an earthquake, geologists can _______.
options: identify the origin of its point
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can 后须接动词原形，宾语 its point of origin 紧跟其后：can identify its point of origin（确定震源位置）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: In North America, small game refers to those animals and birds which can be hunted for sport during _______.
options: the year specified with a season
a specified season of the year
questions.explanation: during 后接名词短语，语序为“冠词 + 形容词 + 名词 + of 短语”：a specified season of the year“一年中规定的季节”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Only when it has been inactive for tens of thousands of years_______ be truly considered to be extinct.
questions.explanation: Only + 状语从句位于句首时，主句须部分倒装：can a volcano be truly considered...。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: As the deer population increased in the Midwest, ______ the tick population that carried lyme disease.
questions.explanation: “As..., so did...”结构：so + 助动词 + 主语，表示“携带莱姆病的蜱虫种群也同样增加了”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: In order for a seed to germinate it is necessary that there be sufficient warmth, _______ and a constant supply of oxygen.
questions.explanation: 与 sufficient warmth、a constant supply of oxygen 并列作 there be 句型的主语，须用“形容词 + 名词”结构 adequate moisture。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Let us get out quickly. It is no good _______ time.
questions.explanation: It is no good doing sth 为固定句型，动名词 wasting 作真正主语，it 作形式主语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: No sooner had we finished the conversation ______ we heard a knock at the door.
questions.explanation: No sooner had + 主语 + done...than... 为固定时间状语结构，“刚……就……”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If John _______ to work hard, he would succeed.
questions.explanation: 与将来（或现在）事实相反的虚拟条件句：If + 主语 + were to do，主句用 would succeed，故选 were。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The road is quiet. There ______ traffic even in the daytime.
questions.explanation: traffic 为不可数名词，修饰用 much 而不用 few/many，故 there isn't much traffic。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I ______ work last week, but I changed my mind.
questions.explanation: was/were to have done 表示“过去本打算做某事而实际未做”，与 but I changed my mind 相符，故 was to have started。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: A series of meetings _______ about the best way to market the new product.
questions.explanation: a series of + 复数名词作主语时，谓语与 a series（单数）保持一致；meetings 与 hold 为被动关系，故 was held。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I couldn’t find _______, and so I took this one.
questions.explanation: enough 修饰形容词须后置：large enough；冠词 + 形容词 + 名词的语序为 a large enough coat。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He was ______ to speak the truth.
questions.explanation: too much of a + 单数名词意为“太是个……”，即 too much of a coward“太胆小了”；so much a coward 不合此结构。翻译：他太胆小了，不敢说出真相。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Only in recent years have people begun to realize that wild dogs, kept within bounds, often do _______.
questions.explanation: do more good than harm 为固定表达“利大于弊”。翻译：直到近年来人们才开始认识到，只要加以约束，野狗往往是利大于弊的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Since British Railways introduced its new intercity express, many businessmen have taken _______ by train.
questions.explanation: take to doing sth 中的 to 为介词，后接动名词，意为“开始喜欢上/养成做某事的习惯”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There was no man ______ admired him.
questions.explanation: but 在此作关系代词，相当于 that...not：no man but admired him = 没有人不敬佩他（双重否定表人人敬佩）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He is considering _______ your offer.
questions.explanation: consider 后须接动名词作宾语：consider doing sth“考虑做某事”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The committee members resented ______.
options: the president that he did not tell them about the meeting
the president not to inform them of the meeting
the president’s not informing them of the meeting
that the president had failed informing themselves of the meeting
questions.explanation: resent 后接动名词作宾语，动名词的否定式为 not doing；有生命的逻辑主语用所有格 the president's。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Professor David regretted _______ his student for the mistake.
questions.explanation: regret to do 表“遗憾要去做（未做）”，regret doing/having done 表“后悔已做过”；动作先于谓语发生，用 having blamed 更明确。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: When I saw him, he was ______ asleep.
questions.explanation: asleep 为表语形容词，不能用 very 修饰，习惯搭配 fast/sound asleep 表示“睡得沉”。翻译：我见到他时，他正睡得香。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: His English teacher recommends that he ______ regular degree program.
questions.explanation: recommend 后的宾语从句用虚拟语气（should）+ 动词原形，should 省略，故用 begin。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The key to his success was his determination ______ what seemed impossible.
questions.explanation: determination 后接不定式作定语：determination to do sth“做某事的决心”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It’s good ______ you to come and help us.
questions.explanation: It's good/kind of sb to do sth：说明人的品质时用 of 作不定式的逻辑主语；good 此处夸赞“你”乐于助人，故用 of。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mary ______ shopping on Sunday because the streets are full of people
questions.explanation: be opposed to doing sth 为固定搭配，to 为介词后接动名词 shopping；is strongly opposed 亦为正确的系表结构。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Staying in a hotel costs ______ renting a room in a dormitory for a week.
questions.explanation: 倍数须置于 as...as 结构之前：twice as much as（是……的两倍）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The armed guard Parker, whom Mrs. Lincoln had requested and ______ to stand outside the presidential box was mysteriously absent from his post at the time the murderer made his fatal entry.
questions.explanation: and 连接两个并列的定语从句：whom Mrs. Lincoln had requested 和 whose duty was to stand...，whose 表所属，译为“他的职责是”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You can get the best result _______ you carry out the experiment under normal conditions.
questions.explanation: only if“只有当……才”，表唯一条件；if only“要是……就好了”用于虚拟，even if 表让步，as if 表方式，均不合句意。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ left the baby alone at home?
questions.explanation: How come 后接陈述语序的句子，意为“怎么会……？”：How come they left the baby alone at home? 翻译：他们怎么会把婴儿独自留在家里？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ helping those who are unwilling to help themselves.
questions.explanation: What's the point of doing sth 为固定句型“做某事有什么意义”，of 后接动名词 helping。翻译：帮助那些不愿自救的人有什么意义呢？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I have read ______, but none of Shakespeare’s.
questions.explanation: some of + 限定词 + 名词构成部分代词结构：some of Shaw's plays；Shaw's some plays 语序错误，none of Shakespeare's 与之呼应。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: However much ______, it will be worth it.
questions.explanation: However much 引导让步状语从句，从句须用陈述语序：the watch costs（不倒装，也不用 will）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Many people have _______ they think they have.
questions.explanation: 比较级结构 more ability than（比他们自己认为的更有能力），more 修饰名词 ability。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I have classes ______ day, Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.
questions.explanation: every other day 意为“每隔一天”，与 Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays（每周一、三、五上课）相符。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It is surprising that he ______ so miserable.
questions.explanation: It is surprising that... 后的主语从句用虚拟语气（should）+ 动词原形，should 省略，故用 feel。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Not one in one hundred children exposed to the disease ______ likely to develop it.
questions.explanation: 主语中心词 Not one（一百个孩子中没有一个）为单数概念，谓语用 is likely。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Billy said that ______ it was the dullness of his summer job that encouraged him to continue his education.
questions.explanation: more than anything 意为“比什么都（重要的是）”，作插入语强调其后的 it was...that... 强调句。翻译：比利说，比什么都重要的是，正是暑期工作的枯燥促使他继续学业。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Lillian D. Wald, public health nurse and ______, was born in Cincinnati, Ohio in 1867.
questions.explanation: 与 public health nurse 并列作同位语，须用名词短语 social reformer“社会改革家”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: To achieve these goals, efforts should be made to enhance, ______, the change of attitudes towards women’s performance in scientific field.
questions.explanation: where necessary 为地点状语从句的省略形式（= where it is necessary），意为“在必要之处/必要时”，作插入语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ the large amount of time devoted to listening every day, most college students do not listen effectively.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误：空格后为名词短语 the large amount of time，须用让步介词 Despite“尽管”，即“尽管每天花大量时间练习听，多数大学生听的效率并不高”；Moreover/Furthermore/Nevertheless 均为副词，不能直接接名词短语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Those students do not like to read novels, _______ text books.
questions.explanation: much less 用于否定句之后，意为“更不用说”，加强否定。翻译：那些学生不喜欢读小说，更不用说教科书了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Some bacteria _______ extremely harmful, but _______ are regularly used in producing cheeses, crackers and many other foods.
questions.explanation: bacteria 为复数名词，谓语用 are；some...others... 表示“一些……另一些……”，泛指其余部分、范围不明确。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Studies show that students with high self-esteem have _______ ratings from both themselves and their teachers in their speech than students with low self-esteem.
questions.explanation: than 引出比较对象 students with low self-esteem，故用比较级 higher ratings。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The director of this organization must know how to manage money, to sell his products, ______ the stockholders.
questions.explanation: 与 to manage money、to sell his products 并列，须用 and to satisfy 构成三个并列的不定式。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If we continue to argue over minor points, we won’t get _______ near a solution.
questions.explanation: 否定句中须用 any- 复合代词：won't get anywhere near a solution“离解决方案还很远”；somewhere 用于肯定句。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Some historians believe that John Jay could have played ______ in America’s history as James Madison.
questions.explanation: as...as 结构之间有单数可数名词时用“as + 形容词 + a/an + 名词 + as”：as important a role as James Madison。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Time is running out. _______?
questions.explanation: had better 后接动词原形，其否定反问式为 Hadn't we better get started?（我们最好马上开始，好不好？）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Paper money printed by banks must be exchanged for metal money ______ demand.
questions.explanation: on demand 为固定搭配，意为“一经要求（即可兑换）”。翻译：银行印制的纸币必须一经要求即可兑换为金属货币。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Mr. Johnson is _____ to our party.
questions.explanation: more than + 形容词表程度“非常”，more than pleased“非常高兴”，to come 作状语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The Smithsonian Institution preserves more than sixty-five million items of scientific, historical, or artistic interest, _______ winning the popular title “attic of the nation.”
questions.explanation: thus 为副词表结果，后接现在分词短语 thus winning... 作结果状语，“因此赢得了……的美称”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The ______ kept me awake for some time last night.
questions.explanation: fireworks 为以 -s 结尾的复数名词，其所有格在 s 后只加撇号：fireworks'；此处指烟花发出的阵阵声响，用复数 noises。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Few of the gold seekers who flocked to California were experienced miners, _______ that they had to be.
questions.explanation: 前句含否定意义的 Few，后句用 but neither did they feel...（neither + 助动词 + 主语），表示“他们也不觉得必须如此”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Sitting opposite my sister and me in the subway ______ who walked alongside us and tried to pinch us on Fifth Avenue.
questions.explanation: 分词短语（表语）Sitting opposite... 前置，主语 the same men who... 较长，构成完全倒装：were the same men；主语为名词才倒装，代词 they 须用正常语序。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ all behaviour is learned behaviour is a basic assumption of social scientists.
questions.explanation: 从句完整且作全句主语，须用 that 引导主语从句且 that 不可省略：That nearly all behaviour is learned behaviour is...。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ the giant panda belonged to the bear or racoon families was a matter of zoological contention for years.
questions.explanation: Whether...or... 引导主语从句，表示“大熊猫究竟属于熊科还是浣熊科”，whether 表“是否”且可与 or 连用。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ prohibited in many countries.
options: The hunting of certain rare animals is
Hunting of certain rare animals are
The hunting of certain rare animals are
questions.explanation: 动名词短语（The）hunting of certain rare animals 作主语，谓语用单数 is。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______, there were no grounds to justify your complaints.
questions.explanation: Such being the case 为独立主格结构（名词 + 分词）作状语，意为“情况既然如此”；A、B、D 均为完整句子，会与主句构成逗号连接错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: John would rather ______ a day off than worked last Sunday.
questions.explanation: would rather have done（than done）表示对过去情况的虚拟，“本宁愿休一天假（而实际没休）”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The second-hand car Patrick bought was almost new; _______, it was in excellent condition.
questions.explanation: besides 意为“此外、而且”，表递进；nevertheless/however 表转折，与句意不符。翻译：帕特里克买的这辆二手车几乎全新；此外，车况极佳。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Coal, though ______ than either oil or gas, is still a finite resource.
options: the much more energy abundant source
a much more abundant energy source
questions.explanation: though 引导省略式让步从句（= though it is...），中心词为 a...source，much 加强比较级：a much more abundant energy source。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: William told his wife ______.
questions.explanation: have sth done 表示“使某物被做”，宾补用过去分词；shine 作及物动词“擦亮”时过去分词为 shined（shone 是不及物“发光”的过去分词）。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Fred’s yearly income since he changed professions has ______.
options: just about gone up three times
questions.explanation: triple 意为“（使）增至三倍”，nearly tripled 即“几乎增至原来的三倍”；grow by three times 意为“增长了三倍”（变为四倍），不合常理。翻译：自改行以来，弗雷德的年收入几乎增至原来的三倍。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Traffic in that city is congested ten times _______.
questions.explanation: 倍数 ten times + as...as 比较拥堵程度，badly 为程度副词修饰 congested；London's worst 名词所有格指“伦敦最拥堵时的路况”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ the most versatile of the common metals, lead was widely valued and used in ancient times.
questions.explanation: 空格后为名词短语 the most versatile of the common metals，用介词 among“在……之中”作状语。翻译：铅是常见金属中用途最广的一种，在古代就备受重视并被广泛使用。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Having been served lunch, _______.
options: the problem was continued to be discussed by the members of the committee
the committee members continued their discussion of the problem
the problem was discussed by the members of the committee
a discussion of the problem was made by the members of the committee
questions.explanation: Having been served lunch 的逻辑主语须与主句主语一致，“用餐的人”是委员会成员，故选 the committee members continued...；the problem 不可能“被招待午饭”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Max _______ be fishing from the boat in the lake than sitting at his desk in the office.
questions.explanation: would rather do...than do... 为固定句型“宁愿……而不愿……”。翻译：马克斯宁愿在湖上的船里钓鱼，也不愿坐在办公室的办公桌前。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: His father prefers that he _______ a different university.
questions.explanation: prefer 后的宾语从句用虚拟语气（should）+ 动词原形，should 省略，故用 attend。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He has been given _______ over the department.
questions.explanation: authority 表“权力、职权”时为不可数名词，不加冠词：give sb authority over...“给某人管理……的权力”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Her plays are so difficult to understand that even the critics find difficulty _______.
questions.explanation: find difficulty (in) doing sth 为固定结构，介词 in 省略后直接接动名词 explaining。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The _______ garden is Mr Peterborough’s pride.
questions.explanation: 形容词排序规则：old-fashioned（新旧）→ sunken（状态形状）→ rose（类别，名词作定语最靠近中心词），即 the old-fashioned sunken rose garden。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: While attempting to reach his home before the storm, _______.
options: the bicycle of John broke down
it happened that John’s bike broke down
John had an accident on his bicycle
questions.explanation: While attempting to reach his home 的逻辑主语须与主句主语一致，“赶在暴风雨前回家”的是 John，故选 John had an accident...。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ the new school, he began to make friends more easily.
questions.explanation: After entering the new school（进入新学校之后）作时间状语，与 began to make friends more easily 的渐进变化相符；Upon/On entering 强调“一……就”，与句意不合。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We are wondering ______ he would solve the problem if this method failed.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句缺方式状语，how else 意为“还能用什么别的办法”：wondering how else he would solve the problem。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Provided that you _______ with us, the police would not prosecute you.
questions.explanation: provided that（= if）引导与现在/将来事实相反的虚拟条件句，从句用过去式 co-operated，主句用 would not prosecute。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ was not incorporated as a city until almost two centuries, in 1834.
questions.explanation: 原答案有误：全句主语应是城市 Brooklyn，Settled by the Dutch 为过去分词短语作定语（= which was settled by the Dutch），即“由荷兰人定居的布鲁克林直到1834年才建市”；B 项主语为 The Dutch，不能“被建市”。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Most substances contract when they freeze so that the density of a substance’s solid is _______ of its liquid.
options: the density is higher than that
questions.explanation: 比较结构：固体的密度高于其液体的密度，higher than the density of its liquid，higher 作表语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Nature not only gave the Middle Atlantic region fine harbours, ______ a first-class system of inland waterways.
questions.explanation: not only...but (also) 连接两个并列谓语：gave...和 endowed it with...。翻译：大自然不仅赋予中部大西洋地区优良的港口，还赋予它一流的内陆水道系统。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The local government decreed that the new laws _______ effect the following month.
questions.explanation: decree（下令、命令）后的宾语从句用虚拟语气（should）+ 动词原形，take effect 意为“生效”，故用 take。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I have little doubt about his competence; _______ he is well-qualified for the job.
questions.explanation: moreover 意为“而且、此外”，表递进；although/yet/because 与前句“毫不怀疑”的顺承语义不符。翻译：我毫不怀疑他的能力；而且他完全有资格胜任这份工作。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The instructor advised the students ______ in writing the term paper.
questions.explanation: advise sb on sth 为固定搭配，介词 on 表“就……方面”；the procedures to follow 中不定式 to follow 作后置定语“要遵循的步骤”。翻译：指导老师就学期论文写作应遵循的步骤向学生提出了建议。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They are not so willing ______ this picture hung in the corridor.
questions.explanation: not so...as 为原级比较，比较从句承前省略后补全为 as we (are willing) to have，故选 as we to have。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Alexander Graham Bell once told his family that he would rather be remembered as a teacher of the deaf than as the inventor of _______.
questions.explanation: the + 单数名词特指“电话”这一发明物：the inventor of the telephone。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: In 1890 there were many American cities and towns where part of a day’s school instruction was conducted in languages _______ English.
questions.explanation: other than 意为'除……之外（不同于）'，languages other than English 即'英语以外的语言'；except 侧重把某物排除在外，except for 指整体中的细节例外，均不合'用其他语言教学'的语境。句意：1890 年美国许多城镇的部分日常教学是用英语以外的语言进行的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: According to a recent poll, 61 percent of American high school students have admitted to ______ at exams at least once.
questions.explanation: admit to 中 to 为介词，后须接动名词；'学生'与 cheat（作弊）为主动关系，且 cheat at exams（考试作弊）中 cheat 作不及物动词用，故填 cheating。句意：据最近一项民调，61% 的美国高中生承认至少作过一次弊。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: None of the women will admit that ______ broke the cup.
questions.explanation: None（没有一个）指每个个体都不承认，从句主语应用单数代词 she 与之呼应；they 与 all of them 表复数，与 none 的否定含义逻辑矛盾。句意：没有一个妇女会承认是她打碎了杯子。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The committee has met and _______.
options: it has been reached a decision
questions.explanation: 前半句 The committee has met 把委员会视为整体用单数，and 后的并列谓语须保持一致，用 it has reached a decision；B 项 reach a decision 不能用于被动，C 项时态与代词均不一致。句意：委员会已开过会并做出了决定。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I’m sorry I have ______ dictionary. You ‘d better go to the library.
questions.explanation: such 须置于冠词之前构成 such a dictionary，其否定式为 not such a dictionary（= no such dictionary）；no such 后直接接单数名词不加 a，not a such 语序错误。句意：对不起，我没有这样的词典，你最好去图书馆。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Few of us thought that the problem was worth _______.
questions.explanation: be worth doing sth 为固定用法，后接动名词的主动形式表被动意义（值得被讨论=值得讨论），不用被动式。句意：我们中几乎没人认为这个问题值得讨论。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ absurd was his manner that everyone stared at him.
questions.explanation: so + 形容词 + be 动词 + 主语 + that 从句表'如此……以致'，so 置于句首时须部分倒装（was 提到主语 his manner 之前）；Such 后须接名词短语，与 absurd（形容词）不搭。句意：他的举止如此荒唐，以致人人都盯着他看。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I usually take sandwiches for my lunch, but _______ and then I go to a cafe.
questions.explanation: now and then 为固定短语，意为'偶尔，有时'，与 usually（通常吃三明治）形成对照。句意：我午餐通常吃三明治，但偶尔会去咖啡馆。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The girl is made _______ her homework right after she comes from school.
questions.explanation: make sb do sth 作宾补时省略 to，但变为被动语态后主补须还原 to，即 be made to do sth。句意：这个女孩一放学回家就得做作业。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Jean did not have time to go to the concert last night because she was busy for her examination _______.
questions.explanation: be busy (in) doing sth 为固定结构，意为'忙于做某事'，in 可省略，故填 preparing；prepare for her examination 即备考。句意：简昨晚没时间去听音乐会，因为她正忙着准备考试。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She had her finger _______ when she was paper cutting.
questions.explanation: have sth done 表示'使/让某物被……'，finger 与 cut（切伤）之间为被动关系，宾补用过去分词；cut 的过去分词与原形同形。句意：她剪纸时割伤了手指。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: This kind of mowing machine differs from the other ______ it is more powerful.
questions.explanation: in that 为固定搭配的复合连词，引导原因状语从句，意为'因为，在于'，常用于 differ from... in that... 说明不同之处；now that 既然、so that 以便、on condition that 只要，均不合。句意：这种割草机与另一种的不同之处在于它马力更大。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We could not even look at the sun, for otherwise we _______.
questions.explanation: otherwise（否则）是含蓄虚拟条件的标志：前句'我们连太阳都不能看'表明与现在事实相反，须用'情态动词 + 动词原形'；'我们'与 blind（弄瞎）为被动关系，故用 should be blinded。句意：我们甚至不能直视太阳，否则眼睛会被灼瞎。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The committee _______ among themselves for four hours.
questions.explanation: among themselves 表明委员会成员被视为若干个体，谓语用复数 have；for four hours 表示动作从过去持续到现在，用现在完成进行时 have been arguing。句意：委员会成员们已经争论了四个小时。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______, he decided not to give up.
questions.explanation: as/though 引导让步状语从句时须把表语提前构成倒装：Tired though/as he was；although 引导的从句不倒装，故 A 错，B 把主语和 was 倒装属错误倒装。句意：尽管很累，他还是决定不放弃。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______, we decided not to disturb him.
questions.explanation: 此处 as 引导原因状语从句，As he was tired（因为他累了）用陈述语序：我们决定不去打扰他，因为他累了；A、B 为让步倒装'尽管累'，与本题考查 as 表原因的意图不符。句意：因为他累了，我们决定不去打扰他。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______ in traffic accident that she had to be sent to the hospital at once.
questions.explanation: so + 形容词 + be 动词 + 主语 + that... 中 so 置于句首须部分倒装：So seriously injured was Rosa；injured 作表语，副词 seriously 紧贴修饰它，D 项未倒装，C 项 seriously 与 injured 语序割裂。句意：罗萨在车祸中伤得如此严重，以致必须立即送医院。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Because of the cold weather, they _______ through the night in the camp.
questions.explanation: keep + 宾语 + doing 表示'使某物保持某种状态'，宾补用现在分词，即 kept the fire burning（让火一直烧着）。句意：由于天气寒冷，他们在营地让火整夜烧着。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Many people are reported _______ in the natural disaster.
questions.explanation: be reported 后接不定式作主语补足语；遇难（被夺去生命）发生在报道之前须用完成式，且 people 与 kill 之间为被动关系，故用 to have been killed。句意：据报道，许多人在这次自然灾害中丧生。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If the whole surgery _______ beforehand carefully, there would have been a better result.
questions.explanation: 主句 would have been 表明是与过去事实相反的 if 虚拟条件句，从句须用过去完成时；手术与 plan（规划）之间为被动关系，用 had been planned。句意：如果整个手术事先被仔细规划，结果本会更好。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Jane has said little so far, responding only briefly when _______.
questions.explanation: when 引导的状语从句省略主语和 be 后，'简'与 speak to（对……说话）之间为被动关系，用过去分词 spoken，且 speak to 的介词 to 不可省，故 when spoken to。句意：到目前为止简说得很少，只在别人跟她搭话时简单回应。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ to finish quickly.
questions.explanation: not every 表示部分否定'并非每一个'，every 后接单数名词，谓语动词用三单形式 wants；no every 不是合法搭配。句意：并非每个工人都想快点干完活。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: All games _______ because of the rainstorm, many students could do nothing but study in the classroom.
questions.explanation: 逗号后 many students could... 是完整句子，故前半部分须为独立主格结构而非谓语动词；取消发生在主句动作之前且 games 与 cancel 之间为被动关系，用 having been cancelled。句意：暴雨取消了所有比赛，许多学生只能待在教室里学习。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: By the time you get back, great changes ______ in this area.
questions.explanation: by the time + 一般现在时表将来时间点，到那时为止将已完成，主句用将来完成时 will have taken place；take place 为不及物短语，没有被动形式。句意：等你回来的时候，这个地区将已发生巨大变化。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The boy ______ now, for the light in his room is still on.
questions.explanation: must 表肯定推测'一定'；时间标志 now 表明动作正在进行，故用 must be studying（一定正在学习）；must have studied 表对过去的推测，与 now 矛盾。句意：那个男孩现在一定在学习，因为他房间的灯还亮着。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ she was living in Paris that she met her husband Terry.
questions.explanation: It was...that... 为强调句型，此处强调时间状语 while she was living in Paris；去掉框架后'When she was living in Paris she met her husband'仍为完整句子。句意：正是在巴黎居住期间，她遇到了丈夫特里。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Technical school prepare their students for the application of practical skills they learn in class _______ their work.
questions.explanation: application 的固定搭配为 application of A to B（把 A 应用到 B 上），'课堂所学技能在他们工作中的应用'须用 to。句意：技术学校让学生做好准备，把课堂上学到的实用技能应用到工作中去。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: John isn’t a diligent student, for it is the third time he has been late. ______?
questions.explanation: 反义疑问句遵循'前肯后否'：陈述部分 it is the third time... 为肯定结构且主语是 it，附加问句用 isn't it；he has been late 是修饰 time 的从句，不参与附加问句。句意：约翰不是个勤奋的学生，这已是他第三次迟到了，不是吗？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: With all the work on hand, he ______ to the cinema last night.
questions.explanation: shouldn't have done 表示'本不该做某事却做了'，含责备语气；手头还有全部工作，昨晚却去看了电影，正合此意。句意：手头还有那么多工作，他昨晚本不该去看电影的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I don’t doubt _______ she will learn a lot during her stay in China.
questions.explanation: doubt 用于否定句 don't doubt 后接 that 引导的宾语从句（肯定句才用 whether/if）；从句 she will learn a lot 结构完整，that 仅起连接作用不作成分。句意：我毫不怀疑她在中国逗留期间会学到很多东西。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The teacher recommended that Jack _______ math or physics of English because he was quick at numbers.
questions.explanation: recommend（建议）后的宾语从句须用虚拟语气，谓语用'(should) + 动词原形'，should 可省略，故填 study。句意：老师建议杰克学数学或物理而不学英语，因为他擅长数字。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Only by making wise use of land ______ to find a solution to the problem of hunger and famine.
questions.explanation: only + 状语（by making wise use of land）位于句首时须部分倒装，助动词提到主语之前；空后 to find 需与 be able 搭配，故选 will we be able。句意：只有合理利用土地，我们才能找到解决饥饿问题的办法。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Nobody _______ anymore to say, the meeting was closed.
questions.explanation: 逗号后 the meeting was closed 是完整句子，前半部分须用独立主格结构：Nobody 为逻辑主语，与 have 之间为主动关系，用现在分词 having。句意：没有人再有话要说了，会议宣布结束。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: One and a half years ______ passed.
questions.explanation: 表示时间、距离、价格等的复数名词作主语时被视为一个整体，谓语用单数；'一年半'是整体时间概念，故用 has passed。句意：一年半已经过去了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: “Does professor O’hare live near the downtown area?” “No, he lives _______.”
questions.explanation: live out in the suburbs 为惯用表达，意为'住在远郊'；suburb 表'郊区'惯用复数 the suburbs 并带定冠词。句意：'奥黑尔教授住在市中心附近吗？''不，他住在远郊。'

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: As a kind-hearted gentleman, my uncle’s only fault seemed to be ______ he was too careless.
questions.explanation: seemed to be 后接表语从句，从句 he was too careless 结构完整不缺成分，故用只起连接作用的 that；what/why/where 均须在从句中充当成分。句意：作为一位好心人，我叔叔唯一的缺点似乎是他太粗心。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Maragret spent all the evening talking about her latest book ______ none of us had ever heard.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 hear of（听说）中的介词 of 须随关系代词提前，构成'介词 + which'引导定语从句：book of which none of us had ever heard（= none of us had ever heard of the book）。句意：玛格丽特整晚都在谈论她的新书，而我们谁都没听说过这本书。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: No one can avoid _______ by advertisements which can be seen everywhere.
questions.explanation: avoid 后固定接动名词作宾语，不接不定式；no one 与 influence（影响）之间为被动关系，用动名词被动式 being influenced。句意：没有人能避免受到无处不在的广告的影响。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I think life is generally healthier in the country and I like _______ to nature.
questions.explanation: close 在此为形容词，be close to nature 意为'亲近大自然'；closed 意为'关闭的'，与句意不符；like 后接动名词表习惯喜好，用 being close。句意：我觉得乡村生活总体上更健康，我喜欢亲近大自然。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Go through this door, _______ you will find the man waiting for you there.
questions.explanation: '祈使句 + and + 陈述句'表示'那么就会……'的顺承结果；若用 or 则表示'否则'会出现不理想的结果。句意：穿过这扇门，你就会发现正在等你的人。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: ______, they had to speed up.
questions.explanation: 逗号后 they had to speed up 为完整句子，句首不能再出现完整谓语，须用独立主格结构 Time being limited（逻辑主语 + being + 表语）作原因状语。句意：由于时间有限，他们不得不加快速度。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______, he would surely urge us to put away our prejudice and avoid his own tragic error of putting all his eggs in one basket.
questions.explanation: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句（他今天已不在人世），从句含 were 时可省略 if 并把 were 提至句首构成倒装：Were he alive today = If he were alive today；主句 would surely urge 与之呼应。句意：如果他今天还活着，他一定会敦促我们摒弃偏见，避免他自己犯过的孤注一掷的悲剧性错误。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If we ______ the bus, we ______ the concert in the theatre now.
options: hadn’t missed… would have been enjoying
questions.explanation: 错综时间虚拟条件句'各司其职'：从句指过去用 hadn't missed；主句有时间标志 now 指现在，用 would be enjoying（此刻正在欣赏），不用 would have been enjoying（指过去进行）。句意：如果我们没有错过那班公交车，现在正在剧院里欣赏音乐会呢。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The investigation, ______ will soon be published, was made by Professor Smith.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句中表所属关系'调查的结果'须用 whose：whose results will soon be published，whose + 名词在从句中作主语；at which/on which 无法与 results 构成所属关系。句意：这项即将公布结果的调查是由史密斯教授进行的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: They overcame all the difficulties and fulfilled the plan ten days ahead of schedule, _______ was something we had not expected.
questions.explanation: 逗号后的非限制性定语从句指代前面整个主句的内容（提前完成计划这件事），关系代词用 which；that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，this/it 无连接作用。句意：他们克服了一切困难，提前十天完成计划，这是我们始料未及的。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It was in 1777 _______ Vermont, threatened with invasion, declared itself an independent commonwealth.
questions.explanation: 强调句型 It is/was + 被强调部分 + that...：去掉 It was...that 后，'In 1777 Vermont declared itself an independent commonwealth' 仍为完整句子，故用 that 而非 when。句意：正是在 1777 年，面临入侵威胁的佛蒙特宣布自己为独立共同体。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ a professor of physics at Massachusetts Institute Of Technology, Edward Charles Pickering established the first physics laboratory in the United States.
questions.explanation: while 后可接名词性省略结构（= while he was a professor of physics）作时间状语；being 首字母未大写不符句首要求，Although 引出让步逻辑不通，He was 则造成逗号误连两个完整句子。句意：在担任麻省理工学院物理学教授期间，爱德华·查尔斯·皮克林建立了美国第一个物理实验室。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He didn’t _______ and he failed the examination.
questions.explanation: enough 修饰形容词或副词时须后置：work hard enough（工作得够努力）；enough 修饰名词时才前置，故 hard enough work 语序错误。句意：他学习不够努力，所以考试没及格。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: As fuel prices rose, bus companies raised their fares, and _______ .
questions.explanation: 'so + 助动词 + 主语'表示前句内容同样适用于另一主语，意为'航空公司也是如此'，须部分倒装：so did the airlines；so the airlines did 语序错误，nor 用于否定句的承接。句意：随着燃油价格上涨，公交公司提高了票价，航空公司也是如此。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ mainly for the invention of the telephone, Alexander Graham Bell devoted his life to helping the deaf.
questions.explanation: 主语 Bell 与 remember 之间为被动关系（他'被'铭记），状语从句省略 he was 后用过去分词 remembered；Though 表让步：尽管主要以发明电话而闻名，他却毕生致力于帮助聋人。句意：尽管贝尔主要因发明电话而被世人铭记，他却把一生献给了帮助聋人的事业。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: If Dorothy had not been badly hurt in a car accident, _______ in last month’s marathon race.
questions.explanation: 从句 had not been 表明是与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，主句须用 would/could/might + have done；'上个月的马拉松'证实是过去的事，故 she would have participated。句意：如果多萝西没有在车祸中受重伤，她本会参加上个月的马拉松比赛。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: The team really looks good tonight because the coach had them ______ every night this week.
questions.explanation: have sb do sth 表示'让某人做某事'，宾补用省略 to 的动词原形：had them practise（每晚让他们训练）。句意：这支队伍今晚看起来状态很好，因为教练本周每晚都让他们训练。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ it is you’ve found, you must give it back to the person it belongs to.
questions.explanation: Whatever（无论什么）引导让步状语从句，相当于 no matter what；从句中 you've found 缺宾语须用连接代词，兼表'无论'只能用 Whatever。句意：无论你捡到了什么，都必须把它归还给失主。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Consumers should do _______ than simply complain about the poor quality of goods.
questions.explanation: far 可修饰比较级，do far more than simply complain 意为'所做的远不止单纯抱怨'；less 与'应该做得更多'的句意相反。句意：消费者应当做的远不止单纯抱怨商品质量差。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Beth _______ California in 1981 and _______ in Texas ever since.
questions.explanation: in 1981 为确定的过去时间点，用一般过去时 left；ever since（从那以后一直）是现在完成时的标志，用 has worked。句意：贝丝 1981 年离开加利福尼亚，此后一直在得克萨斯工作。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Frank had worked for two years to be a carpenter, but found his progress _______ ?
questions.explanation: -ing 形容词修饰物表'令人……'，-ed 形容词修饰人表'感到……'；progress（进步）是事物，应用 unsatisfactory（令人不满意的）和 discouraging（令人泄气的），dissatisfied/unsatisfied 只能说明人感到不满。句意：弗兰克为当木工学了两年，却发现自己的进步不尽如人意、令人泄气。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I was surprised to find his article on such an _______ topic so _______.
questions.explanation: 修饰物表'令人……'用 -ing 形容词：话题令人兴奋用 exciting，文章令人乏味用 boring；excited/bored 只能说明人的感受。句意：我很惊讶地发现，他这篇关于如此有趣话题的文章竟如此乏味。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: To be honest, I don’t like _______.
questions.explanation: like 后接动名词作宾语；'我'与 make fun of（取笑）之间为被动关系，用动名词被动式 being made fun of（被取笑）。句意：说实话，我不喜欢被人取笑。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: John suggested _______ anything about it until they found out more facts.
questions.explanation: suggest 后固定接动名词作宾语（不接不定式），否定式为 not doing，即 suggested not saying anything（建议不要说）。句意：约翰建议在他们查明更多事实之前不要发表任何意见。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I have been sitting in my seat for at least two hours, waiting _______.
questions.explanation: wait for sb/sth to do sth 为固定结构，'等待火车启动'即 wait for the train to start。句意：我在座位上已经坐了至少两个小时，等着火车出发。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I could not help but _______.
questions.explanation: can't help but do sth 为固定结构，意为'不禁/忍不住做某事'，but 前含实义动词 help 时后接动词原形（对比：can't help doing）。句意：我忍不住大笑起来。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Every means ______ but without much result.
questions.explanation: means（手段）单复数同形，被 every 修饰时视为单数，谓语用 has；means 与 try 之间为被动关系（方法'被'尝试），用 has been tried。句意：各种方法都试过了，但收效甚微。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He speaks English as if he _______ a native speaker.
questions.explanation: as if 引导方式状语从句，所述情况与事实相反（他并不是母语者），须用虚拟语气；与现在事实相反时 be 动词一律用 were。句意：他英语说得就好像是母语人士一样。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ time, he’ll make a first-class tennis player.
questions.explanation: '他'与 give（给予）之间为被动关系，用过去分词 Given time 作条件状语，相当于 If he is given time（如果给他时间）。句意：假以时日，他会成为一流的网球选手。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Her parents insisted that she _______ until she finished her degree.
questions.explanation: insist 表示'坚持要求'时，宾语从句用虚拟语气，谓语为'(should) + 动词原形'，故填 stay。句意：她父母坚持要求她读到完成学业为止。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You’d rather work than play, _______ you?
questions.explanation: You'd rather 中 'd = would，反义疑问句'前肯后否'须与 would 对应：wouldn't you；had better 才对应 hadn't you。句意：你宁愿工作而不愿玩，对吗？

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Look, what have you done! You ______ have been more careful.
questions.explanation: should have done 表示'本应该做而未做'，带责备口吻；你闯了祸，本应该更小心些才对。句意：瞧你干的好事！你本该更小心一些。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He lent me a few books, but _______ of them are easy to read.
questions.explanation: a few books 泛指几本书（三者及以上），'都不'用 none of them；neither 仅用于两者之间的否定。句意：他借给我几本书，但没有一本容易读。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I find the quality of your products greatly _______.
questions.explanation: find + 宾语 + 过去分词作宾补；quality 与 improve（提高）之间为被动关系（质量'被'提高），故用 improved。句意：我发现你们产品的质量有了很大提高。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I wish I _______ English fluently.
questions.explanation: wish 后的宾语从句须用虚拟语气；表示现在难以实现的愿望（希望自己会说流利英语）用 could speak，符合'wish + would/could do'表将来没把握愿望的用法。句意：但愿我能流利地说英语。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: We are leaving at six in the morning, and hope to _______ most of the journey by lunchtime.
questions.explanation: by lunchtime 表将来某个时间点之前完成，须用完成式；hope to have done 中不定式的完成式表示'到午饭时将已完成大部分行程'。句意：我们早上六点出发，希望到午饭时间已完成大部分旅程。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: It’s better to avoid _______ downtown during the rush hour.
questions.explanation: avoid 后固定接动名词作宾语，avoid driving（避免开车）；动作与主句同时发生，无需完成式。句意：最好避免在高峰时段开车进城。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: He remembered _______ in this school when he was ten years old.
questions.explanation: remember doing sth 表示'记得曾做过某事'（remember to do 表记得要去做，与'十岁时'的过去语境不符）；'他'与 teach 之间为被动关系（被教导），用动名词被动式 being taught。句意：他记得十岁时在这所学校念书的情形。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Jack’s parents wouldn’t agree to buy him the same computer _______ his classmate had, _______ made him very sad.
questions.explanation: 先行词被 the same 修饰时关系词用 as（the same...as 固定搭配）；第二空为非限制性定语从句指代前面整个主句，用 which，that 不能引导非限制性定语从句。句意：杰克的父母不肯给他买和同学一样的电脑，这让他很难过。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: Not until ______ to wok, _______ how much time I had wasted.
options: did I begin…I began to realize
questions.explanation: Not until 位于句首时，until 从句保持正常语序（I began to work），主句须部分倒装（did I realize）；两个分句不能同时倒装。句意：直到开始工作，我才意识到自己浪费了多少时间。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: You ______ him at the party last night. I saw him off at the airport yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测'不可能已经……'；昨天下午我去机场给他送行了，所以昨晚聚会上不可能见到他。句意：你昨晚不可能在聚会上见到他，昨天下午我去机场给他送行了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I prefer _______ a term paper _______ an examination.
questions.explanation: prefer doing A to doing B 为固定搭配（宁愿做 A 而不愿做 B），to 为介词，前后须保持动名词平行：writing a term paper to taking an examination。句意：我宁愿写学期论文，也不愿参加考试。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I can’t stand _______ as a child.
questions.explanation: can't stand 后接动名词作宾语；'我'与 treat（对待）之间为被动关系，用动名词被动式 being treated。句意：我无法忍受小时候被那样对待。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: There was so much noise that the speaker couldn’t make himself _______.
questions.explanation: make + 宾语 + 过去分词作宾补；himself 与 hear 之间为被动关系（使自己'被'听到），故 make himself heard。句意：噪声太大，演讲者无法让别人听见自己讲话。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: My transistor radio is out of wok. It needs _______.
questions.explanation: need 后接动名词的主动形式表被动意义：need repairing = need to be repaired（需要被修理）；need to repair 则意为'需要去修理（别的东西）'，主语须是人。句意：我的晶体管收音机坏了，需要修理了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: _______ I can’t understand is _______ he wants to change his mind.
questions.explanation: 第一空引导主语从句，understand 缺宾语，须用 what；第二空表语从句结构完整，用连接副词 why 表原因——不理解的是'他为什么'想改变主意。句意：我不能理解的是他为什么想改变主意。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: She worked late into the night, _______ a long speech for her boss.
questions.explanation: 逗号前已有谓语 worked，一山不容二虎，空格处用非谓语：prepare 的动作与 worked 同时进行作伴随状语，'她'与 prepare 为主动关系，用现在分词 preparing。句意：她工作到深夜，为老板准备一篇长篇演讲稿。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: My watch is nowhere to be found. I _______ it when I was on the bus.
questions.explanation: must have done 表示对过去情况的肯定推测'一定做过某事'；表已无处可寻，推断在公交车上一定弄丢了。句意：我的手表怎么也找不到了，我一定是在公交车上把它弄丢了。

questions.part: 第二部分 语法与结构
questions.stem: I usually walk _______ the river bank over there, but today I feel tired and won’t walk _______ far. ---
questions.explanation: walk as far as the river bank 意为'一直走到河岸'；that far 中的 that 作副词修饰 far，意为'那么远'（= so far），won't walk that far 即'走不了那么远'。句意：我通常走到那边河岸，但今天觉得累，走不了那么远了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Literature must consist of words, ________ music must consist of sounds.
questions.explanation: just as 引导方式状语从句，意为'正如'：文学必须由文字构成，正如音乐必须由声音构成；even though 表让步、so that 表结果、ever since 表自那时起，均不合逻辑。句意：文学必须由文字构成，正如音乐必须由声音构成一样。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: When workers are organized in trade unions, employers find it hard to lay them ________.
questions.explanation: lay off 意为'解雇'；工人被组织进工会后，雇主就很难解雇他们了。lay aside 搁置、lay out 布置、lay down 放下，均不合句意。句意：当工人们被组织到工会里后，雇主发现很难解雇他们。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Their different attitudes to the difficulties ________ different results.
questions.explanation: lead to 意为'导致'：他们对困难的不同态度导致了不同的结果；arrived at 到达/得出结论、caused by 由……引起（方向不对）、turned out 结果是，均不合。句意：他们对待困难的不同态度导致了不同的结果。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If you travel through the villages in the small local buses, you will swiftly come into close ________ with the local people.
questions.explanation: come into (close) contact with 为固定搭配，意为'与……（密切）接触'；carriage 马车/车厢、choice 选择、circuit 电路/巡回，均不搭配。句意：如果你乘坐当地的小巴士穿行于乡村，你会很快与当地人密切接触。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: In ________ of speed, safety and price, the high-speed railway system is perhaps the world’s model railway.
questions.explanation: in terms of 为固定短语，意为'就……而言，在……方面'：就速度、安全和价格而言；in case of 万一、in need of 需要、in search of 寻找，均不合句意。句意：就速度、安全和价格而言，这套高铁系统堪称世界典范铁路。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Applicants for the Olympic volunteers must be able to ________ excellent services to meet the demands of the Games.
questions.explanation: contribute 意为'贡献，提供'，contribute excellent services 即'提供优质服务'；apply 申请/应用、make 制造、use 使用，均不能与 services 如此搭配表达'提供'之义。句意：奥运志愿者申请者必须能够提供优质服务，以满足奥运会的需求。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is reported that the floods have left about ________ people homeless.
questions.explanation: hundred/thousand/million 等与具体数字连用时用单数形式：two thousand people；只有泛指'数以千计'（thousands of）时才加 s。句意：据报道，洪水已使大约两千人无家可归。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Many young couples do not take marriage ________ and they get married and divorced easily.
questions.explanation: take sth seriously 为固定搭配，意为'认真对待某事'；eagerly 渴望地、highly 高度地、severely 严重地，均不与 take 搭配。句意：许多年轻夫妇不认真对待婚姻，轻易地结婚又离婚。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Many people believe that ________ one has, ________ one is, but actually it is not true.
options: the more money; the more happy
the less money; the more happy
questions.explanation: 'the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...'表示'越……越……'：钱越多越幸福；happy 的比较级是 happier（直接加 -er），不能说 the more happy。句意：许多人相信钱越多就越幸福，但实际上并非如此。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Mr. Wang is getting too old for football. He decides to ________ tennis instead.
questions.explanation: take up 意为'开始从事（某项爱好/活动）'：改打网球；take in 收留/理解、take for 把……误认为、take over 接管，均不合。句意：王先生踢足球年纪太大了，他决定改打网球。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is not always reliable to make a conclusion on the ________ of the first impression.
questions.explanation: on the basis of 为固定搭配，意为'在……的基础上/根据'；basic 是形容词，base 指具体的基础/基地，basement 指地下室。句意：仅凭第一印象下结论并不总是可靠的。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She tries her best to ________ the changes in fashion.
questions.explanation: keep up with 意为'跟上，不落后于'：跟上时尚的变化；put off 推迟、come up with 想出（主意）、go by（时间）流逝，均不合。句意：她尽力跟上时尚的变化。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The road to the island only appears when the tide has ________.
questions.explanation: recede 意为'（潮水）退去'：潮水退去后通往小岛的路才会出现；sprinkle 洒、tilt 倾斜、diminish 减少（程度/数量），均不合。句意：只有当潮水退去时，通往小岛的那条路才会出现。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The improvements in technology have ______ the prices of computer considerably in recent months.
questions.explanation: bring down 意为'降低（价格/水平）'：技术进步大幅降低了电脑价格；bring back 带回/使想起、bring on 引起、bring up 抚养/提出，均不合。句意：近几个月来，技术上的进步已使电脑价格大幅下降。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: As the manager’s private secretary, Helen has easy ______ to all his correspondence.
questions.explanation: have (easy) access to 为固定搭配，意为'可以（方便地）使用/接触'；approach 途径/方法、accent 口音、response 回答，均不合。句意：作为经理的私人秘书，海伦可以方便地查阅他的所有信函。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The editor asked his journalists not to ______ any details in their reports of the accident.
questions.explanation: leave out 意为'遗漏，省去'：不要在事故报道中遗漏任何细节；leave for 出发前往、leave off 停止、leave on 让（灯）一直开着，均不合。句意：编辑要求记者们在事故报道中不要遗漏任何细节。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Had I had a little more money on me, I could have bought ______ more postcards.
questions.explanation: postcards 为可数名词复数，表肯定含义'再多买几张'用 a few：a few more + 复数名词；a little 只修饰不可数名词。句首 Had I had 为省略 if 的虚拟倒装。句意：如果我身上再多带一点钱，就能多买几张明信片了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Oh no! We have no gas. Robert ______ to fill the tank.
questions.explanation: must have done 表示对过去情况的肯定推测'一定是……了'：发现没油了，推断罗伯特一定是忘了加油；could/might have done 表推测时把握较小，should have done 表责备而非推测。句意：哦不！我们的油没有了，罗伯特一定是忘了加油。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We can see from the map that Japan lies ______ the east of China, ______ the east of Asia and faces the Pacific ______ the east.
questions.explanation: 方位介词规则：in 表'在范围内部'（日本在亚洲东部 in the east of Asia），to 表'在范围外部、不接壤'（日本位于中国以东 to the east of China），on 表'毗邻接壤'（日本东面濒临太平洋 on the east）。句意：从地图上可以看出，日本位于中国以东、亚洲东部，东临太平洋。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The “Chinese Dream” is ______ dream to improve people’s well-being and ______ dream of harmony, peace and development.
questions.explanation: 两处均为泛指'一个……的梦'，首次提及、非特指，用不定冠词 a：a dream to improve... 和 a dream of harmony...。句意：'中国梦'是一个改善民生的梦，也是一个和谐、和平与发展的梦。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: You have to do those exercises ______ you want to perform poorly in the exam tomorrow.
questions.explanation: unless（= if...not）引导条件状语从句：'除非你想在明天的考试中表现糟糕，否则就必须做这些练习'；若用 if，句意变成'想考砸就得做练习'，逻辑矛盾。句意：除非你想在明天的考试中表现糟糕，否则你就必须做这些练习。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It’s too late to go out. ______, it’s going to rain.
questions.explanation: Besides 意为'而且，此外'，用于补充理由：太晚了不能出去，而且天要下雨了；Otherwise 否则、However 然而、Therefore 因此，均不合逻辑。句意：太晚了不能出去了，况且天又要下雨。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Many students thought about the third question for quite a while and had great difficulty answering it. Obviously, it was ______ all.
questions.explanation: 'of all' 提示在所有题目中比较，用最高级 the most confusing of all；confusing 修饰物表'令人困惑的'，confused 修饰人表'感到困惑的'。句意：许多学生对第三道题思考了很久且答题困难重重——显然，它是所有题中最令人困惑的。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: You don’t have the right to blame me ______ being late, for I was busy typing your business invitations.
questions.explanation: blame sb for (doing) sth 为固定搭配，意为'因某事责备某人'：因为我迟到而责备我；blame sth on sb 则是'把某事归咎于某人'，介词用法不同。句意：你没有权利因为我迟到而责备我，因为我当时正忙着打你的商务请柬。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: There is a warning at the bottom of the form that applicants are requested to hand in their forms ______ person.
questions.explanation: in person 为固定短语，意为'亲自'：申请者须亲自提交表格。句意：表格底部有一条警示：申请者须亲自提交表格。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I followed her ______ but I still couldn’t work out how to use the sewing machine.
questions.explanation: instructions 意为'操作说明，指导'，follow her instructions 即按照她说的操作；descriptions 描述、introductions 介绍、comments 评论，均不合'指导如何使用缝纫机'的语境。句意：我照她说的做了，但还是弄不明白这台缝纫机怎么用。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: As National Day is round the corner, Shanghai is ______ a festive atmosphere.
questions.explanation: be bathed in 意为'沉浸在……之中'，be bathed in a festive atmosphere 即'沉浸在节日气氛中'；looked on 旁观、involved in 卷入、surrounded with 被实体包围，均不与 atmosphere 搭配。句意：国庆节临近，上海沉浸在节日的气氛中。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: As each black creature ______ and flapped away into the graying sky, she watched it, tears in her eyes.
questions.explanation: flutter 意为'（翅膀）拍动，振翅'，与后面的 flapped away（拍翅飞走）呼应；feature 以……为特色、fuss 忙乱/小题大做、ferry 摆渡/运送，均不合。句意：每当一只黑色的小生灵振翅飞向渐暗的天空时，她都含泪望着它。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The couple have tried hard to save their troubled marriage ______ their children.
options: for the sake of 为了
questions.explanation: for the sake of 意为'为了……（的利益）'：这对夫妇努力挽救出现裂痕的婚姻是为了孩子；in contrast to 与……对比、rather than 而不是、regardless of 不顾，均不合句意。句意：这对夫妇为了孩子，一直在努力挽救他们出现裂痕的婚姻。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: There seemed to be no ______ to their financial problem.
questions.explanation: solution to sth 为固定搭配，意为'……的解决办法'：他们的财务问题似乎没有解决办法；method 常与 of/for 搭配，function 功能、decision 决定，均不与 to 搭配。句意：他们的财务问题似乎没有任何解决办法。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: There was nothing we could do ________ wait at that moment.
questions.explanation: do nothing but do sth 为固定结构，but 表'除了'，前面有实义动词 do 时其后接动词原形：nothing we could do but wait；besides 表'除……之外还有'后接 doing，rather than/in spite of 均不与此结构搭配。句意：那一刻，我们除了等待别无他法。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Some companies have introduced flexible working time with less emphasis on pressure ________.
questions.explanation: with less emphasis on pressure and more (emphasis) on efficiency 构成平行结构，more 后须保留介词 on 与前面 less emphasis on pressure 对应；B 缺 on，C、D 用 than 不能与 less emphasis on 形成正确平行。句意：一些公司实行弹性工作时间，较少强调压力，更多强调效率。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Steven ________ my letter; otherwise he would have replied before now.
questions.explanation: couldn't have done 表示对过去的否定推测'不可能已经……'；otherwise（否则他现在之前就会回复了）表明他实际上没有收到信。句意：史蒂文不可能收到我的信，否则他早就回信了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We must ________ that the experiment is controlled as rigidly as possible.
questions.explanation: ensure（= make sure）后可直接接 that 从句，意为'确保'；assure 须以人作宾语（assure sb that...），secure 获得/使牢固，issue 发布，均不合。句意：我们必须确保实验受到尽可能严格的控制。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I need to move to a larger apartment. Do you know of any ________ one in this neighborhood?
questions.explanation: vacant 意为'（房屋、座位、职位等）未被占用的、空着的'，vacant apartment 指无人居住、可租住的空房；empty 强调内部空无一物，bare 强调裸露无覆盖，blank 强调（纸面）空白，均不合语境。句意：我需要搬进一套更大的公寓，你知道这附近有没有空着的吗？

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Religion has a great ________ on man's thought.
questions.explanation: have a great influence on 为固定搭配，意为'对……有重大影响'；affect 是动词词性不符，efficiency 效率、affection 喜爱，均不合。句意：宗教对人的思想有重大影响。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The children are getting more and more excited when Christmas is ________ near.
questions.explanation: draw near 为固定搭配，意为“临近、接近”，Christmas is drawing near 圣诞节临近；joining（加入）、taking（拿取）、operating（操作）均不与 near 搭配。译：圣诞节临近，孩子们变得越来越兴奋。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Many companies provide their employees ________ free lunch during the weekdays.
questions.explanation: provide sb. with sth. 为固定搭配“给某人提供某物”（也可说 provide sth. for sb.），空格在 employees 之后须用 with；by/to/for 均不构成此搭配。译：许多公司在工作日为员工提供免费午餐。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The work seemed easy at first, but it ________ to be quite difficult.
questions.explanation: turn out (to be) 意为“结果是、原来是”，工作起初看似容易但结果很难；broke out（战争等）爆发，worked out 算出/解决，set out 出发，均不合句意。译：这项工作起初看起来很容易，但结果却相当困难。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I got a splitting headache. It kept me ________ the whole night.
questions.explanation: keep + 宾语 + 形容词表示“使某人保持某状态”，awake 为形容词“醒着的”，kept me awake 使我整夜睡不着；waken/awaken 是动词，aware“意识到的”不合句意。译：我头痛欲裂，一整晚都没睡着。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She pretended ________ indifferent but her facial expression betrayed her.
questions.explanation: 考查非谓语之不定式作宾语：pretend 后接不定式，pretend to do sth. “假装做某事”，不接动名词；故“假装显得冷漠”用 pretended to be indifferent。故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —How far is it from your home to the post office? —It's about a ________ walk.
questions.explanation: 数词考点：连字符构成的复合形容词中名词只能用单数，a two-mile walk = two miles' walk；B 缺连字符且与冠词 a 矛盾，A、D 所有格形式错误。故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Although Rosemary had suffered from a serious illness for years, she lost ________ of her enthusiasm for life.
questions.explanation: 代词考点：Although 表让步——尽管久病，热情却丝毫未减，lose none of... “一点也没失去”；neither 限指两者，all“全部失去”与让步逻辑矛盾。故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Frank used to be ________ strong. But now he's down to his last tooth.
questions.explanation: 考查 more than 的程度用法：more than + 形容词意为“非常、极其”，Frank 过去非常强壮，与 but 后“现在只剩最后一颗牙”形成转折；too much 不直接修饰形容词原级，far from“远非”和 less than“不太”均与转折语义矛盾。故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —Be careful not to drop the Tang Dynasty vase. —Yes, we can't be ________.
questions.explanation: can't be too + 形容词为固定结构“再……也不为过”，can't be too careful“越小心越好”；very careful 无法与 can't 搭出此意，C、D 语义不通。译：——小心别把唐代花瓶摔了。——是的，我们再怎么小心也不为过。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Read this story, ________ you will realize that not everything can be bought with money.
questions.explanation: 祈使句标志：句首为祈使句 Read this story；框架规则：祈使句 + and + 一般将来时，表示“做……就会有好结果”，or 则引出“否则”的不理想结果，but/so 不用于此结构。故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —John, when shall we meet again, Thursday or Friday? —________. I'll be off to London then.
questions.explanation: 代词考点：问句在 Thursday or Friday 两者中选择，后句“那时我要去伦敦”说明两天都去不了；框架规则：neither 表示“两者都不”，none 用于三者及以上，either/both 与句意相反。故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Sean has formed the habit of jogging ________ the tree-lined avenue for two hours every day.
questions.explanation: along 意为“沿着”，jog along the tree-lined avenue 沿林荫道慢跑；between“在（两者）之间”，below“在下方”，with 不合语义。译：Sean 已养成每天沿林荫道慢跑两小时的习惯。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: In order to find _______ a better job, he decided to study _______ second foreign language.
questions.explanation: 冠词考点：第一空泛指“一份更好的工作”用 a（a better job）；第二空按框架规则 a + 序数词表示“再一、又一”，study a second foreign language 即“再学一门外语”。故选 B（a; a）。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —What a nice fire you have in your fireplace! —During the winter I like my house _______.
questions.explanation: 形容词副词考点：like + 宾语 + 宾语补足语结构中，说明 my house 的状态“又暖和又舒适”，作补语须用形容词原级 warm and comfortable，不用副词。故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is Allen’s first time to speak to the public, but I am sure he will get _______ his nervousness.
questions.explanation: get over 意为“克服（紧张、困难等）”，get over his nervousness 克服紧张情绪；get away 逃脱，get off 下车，get through 完成/接通。译：这是 Allen 第一次当众讲话，但我相信他能克服紧张。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: A new system of quality control was _______ to overcome the shortcomings in the firm’s products.
questions.explanation: introduce 意为“引进、采用”，a new system of quality control was introduced 引入新的质量管理体系；invested 投资，informed 通知，instructed 指示。译：公司引入了新的质量管理体系来克服产品的缺陷。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: This is a demanding task—but I see it as the real challenge we need to _______.
questions.explanation: face 意为“面对”，face the challenge 直面挑战；solve“解决”惯接 problem 而非 challenge，reply“回复”须接 to，detect“察觉”。译：这是一项要求很高的任务——但我把它看作我们真正需要面对的挑战。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She wants to study abroad so she has to _______ some money every month to prepare for that.
questions.explanation: set aside 意为“留出、攒（钱）”；set up 建立，set about 着手做，set out 出发/陈述。译：她想出国留学，所以每个月都得存一些钱做准备。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: John had planned to leave but he decided to stay in the hotel for _______ two days because of the heavy rain.
questions.explanation: 代词考点：another + 数词 + 复数名词表示“再、又（若干个）”，another two days 又两天；other 单独修饰名词前须有限定词，the other 指两者中的另一个，others 是代词不能直接作定语。故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Parents should cooperate with teachers and _______ themselves in their children’s education.
questions.explanation: involve oneself in (doing) sth. 为固定搭配“使自己参与到……中”，与 cooperate with teachers 呼应；get/keep/find 均不接 themselves in 表“参与”。译：家长应当与老师配合，参与到孩子的教育之中。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She said that she would be here at seven o’ clock. But she didn’t _______ until eight.
questions.explanation: turn up 意为“出现、露面”，直到八点才露面；turn on 打开，turn out 结果是/生产，turn down 调低/拒绝。译：她说七点会到这里，但直到八点才露面。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He likes novels, _______ I like poetry.
questions.explanation: 状语从句考点：while 表对比“然而”，连接前后两种相反的喜好（他喜欢小说，我却喜欢诗歌）；because 表原因，although 表让步，so 表结果，均不合逻辑。故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The teacher is very _______ to the needs of her students and she can adapt her teaching very flexibly.
questions.explanation: be sensitive to 意为“对……敏感、体贴”，能敏锐察觉学生需求并灵活调整教学；significant 重要的，serious 严肃的，sincere 真诚的。译：这位老师对学生的需求非常敏感，能非常灵活地调整教学。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The husband gave his wife _______ every month in order to please her.
questions.explanation: 考查限定词（形容词性修饰语）排序：总括性限定词 all 须放在最前面，half 一般要放在冠词或物主代词之前，正确语序为 all + half + his + income（可理解为 all (of) half his income）；B、C、D 中 his 均插在 all 或 half 之前，不符合该规则。故选 A。（出自高考真题分类汇编·形容词和副词）

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Not long ago, a person who I know very well was _______ an accident.
questions.explanation: be involved in 意为“卷入、遭遇”，be involved in an accident 遭遇事故；related to 与……有关，included in 被包括在，subjected to 遭受（多接虐待、侮辱等对待）。译：不久前，我非常熟识的一个人遭遇了一场车祸。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is our _______ policy that we will achieve unity through peaceful means.
questions.explanation: consistent 意为“一贯的、始终如一的”，consistent policy 一贯的政策；considerate 体贴的，continual 时断时续的（反复发生），continuous 连续不断的。译：通过和平手段实现统一是我们的一贯政策。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Your grade in the eye test didn’t reach the required standard—_______, you failed.
questions.explanation: in other words 意为“换句话说”，前句“未达到规定标准”正是“你没及格”的换一种说法；in the end 最终，after all 毕竟，at the same time 同时。译：你的视力检测成绩没有达到规定标准——换句话说，你没有通过。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: People develop _______ preference for a particular style of learning at _______ early age and these preferences affect learning.
questions.explanation: 冠词考点：develop a preference for 为固定搭配，泛指“一种偏好”用 a；at an early age 为固定短语，early 以元音音素开头须用 an。故选 A（a; an）。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She finally decided to obtain a _______ from the bank in order to buy a house.
questions.explanation: loan 意为“贷款”，obtain a loan from the bank 从银行获得贷款；finance 金融/资金（不可数），capital 资本，profit 利润。译：为了买房，她最终决定从银行贷款。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The authority urged the rebellious party to _______ their arms and come back to the negotiating table.
questions.explanation: lay down one's arms 为固定搭配“放下武器”；lay over 中途停留，lay off 裁员，lay out 布置/展示。译：当局敦促叛乱一方放下武器，回到谈判桌上来。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The party had to be _______ because the host went down with a bad case of flu.
questions.explanation: call off 意为“取消（活动）”，聚会因主人患重流感而被取消；call in 召来，call on 号召/拜访，call up 打电话/征召。译：因为主人得了重流感，聚会不得不被取消。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Take your time and think the matter over before you _______ a conclusion.
questions.explanation: come to a conclusion 为固定搭配“得出结论”；sum up 概括（直接接宾语），take to 开始喜欢，use up 用完。译：慢慢来，在下结论之前把这件事仔细考虑一下。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Would you please _______ my web site just before I publish it?
questions.explanation: look through 意为“查看、审阅”，发布前帮忙审看网站；look out 小心，look upon 看待，look for 寻找。译：在我发布网站之前，你能帮忙审看一下吗？

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Dentists suggest brushing teeth at least twice a day to _______ them from decaying.
questions.explanation: protect...from (doing)... 为固定搭配“保护……免受……”，刷牙防止牙齿蛀坏；deny 否认，pretend 假装，differ 与……不同，均无此搭配。译：牙医建议每天至少刷两次牙，以防牙齿蛀坏。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______ of them knew anything about the plan because it was a closely-guarded secret.
questions.explanation: 代词考点：后文“严加保守的秘密”表明无人知晓，none of them knew anything“他们中没人知道”；no one 不与 of 短语连用，some/any 与句意矛盾。故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The kidney transplant operation was _______ complicated, so the operating team had to take special care to ensure its success.
questions.explanation: extremely 意为“极其”，与后文“手术团队必须格外小心”呼应，说明手术非常复杂；slightly 略微，nearly 几乎，probably 或许。译：这次肾移植手术极其复杂，手术团队必须格外小心以确保成功。
