questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Before the invention of refrigeration, the _______ of fish and meat must have been a problem.
questions.explanation: preservation 意为“保存、储存”，冰箱发明之前鱼和肉的保存是个难题；treatment 治疗/处理，maintenance 维护保养，presentation 展示。译：在冰箱发明之前，鱼和肉的储藏一定是个难题。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We are not sure if he will be able to _______ the shock of going bankrupt.
questions.explanation: get over 意为“克服、从（打击、震惊）中恢复过来”；get across 使人理解，get away 逃脱，get up 起床。译：我们不确定他是否能从破产的打击中恢复过来。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: You should have attended that lecture on durability testing of fibers; it really was most _______.
questions.explanation: stimulating 意为“有启发性的、使人振奋的”，建议去听说明讲座很精彩；irrelevant 无关的，sensitive 敏感的，secure 安全的。译：你本应该去听那场关于纤维耐久性测试的讲座；它确实非常启人心智。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Air pollution is obviously one of the major _______ of city life.
questions.explanation: disadvantage 意为“不利、弊端”，空气污染是城市生活的主要弊端之一；references 参考，definitions 定义，expressions 表达。译：空气污染显然是城市生活的主要弊端之一。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: As a Chinese proverb goes, a heavy snow _______ a good harvest year.
questions.explanation: promise 意为“预示、有……的希望”，瑞雪兆丰年即 a heavy snow promises a good harvest；dispose 处置（dispose of），expose 暴露，permit 允许。译：正如中国谚语所说，瑞雪兆丰年。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He has spent all his life working with mentally _______ people.
questions.explanation: mentally disabled 意为“智力障碍的”；diverged 分叉的，naked 裸体的，abolished 被废除的，均不能与 mentally 搭配。译：他一辈子都在和智力障碍人士打交道。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The moment seemed to _______ out endlessly, his gaze traveling across her face, her neck, her shoulder, returning to her eyes.
questions.explanation: stretch out 意为“延伸、拉长”，那一刻仿佛无限延续；expand 膨胀/扩大，skip 跳过，slip 滑落。译：那一刻似乎在无尽地延伸，他的目光掠过她的脸庞、脖颈、肩膀，又回到她的双眼。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Although the poem contains such pessimistic overtones and pathetic acceptance of fate, there is hope to be found in the last two lines which seem to be from _______ the rest.
questions.explanation: be set apart from 意为“与……截然不同、卓然独立”，最后两行透出的希望与其余部分的悲观基调形成反差；take apart 拆开，set aside 留出/搁置，fall apart 崩溃解体。译：尽管这首诗带有悲观的暗示和对命运的悲哀顺从，但在似乎与其余部分截然不同的最后两行中仍能找到希望。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I can't find the key to the door. I _______ have lost it on my way home.
questions.explanation: 情态动词标志：找不到钥匙的现状是对过去情况的推测；框架规则：情态动词 + have done 表对过去的推测，肯定推测用 must have done“一定做过”（must 仅用于肯定句），would/should 无此推测义。故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The Blacks are _______ people in the little town.
questions.explanation: 形容词副词考点：by far 用于加强最高级语气，须放在“the + 最高级”之前直接修饰名词短语，by far the richest people“遥遥领先的最富有的人”；much 不能修饰最高级，possible 语序错误。故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Tom can't speak Chinese, but Peter _______.
questions.explanation: 时态标志：前句 Tom can't speak 为一般现在时；框架规则：替代前面动词避免重复时助动词须与主语和时态保持一致，第三人称单数现在时用 does 代替 speaks Chinese；did 表过去，do 与主语不一致。故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: You can do it if you want to, but in my opinion it's not worth the _______ it involves.
questions.explanation: effort 意为“努力”，not worth the effort (that) it involves 不值得费那份劲，it involves 为定语从句；attempt 尝试，force 武力/力气，strength 体力。译：如果你想做你可以去做，但依我看这事不值得费那个劲。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: All those are matters _______ attention.
questions.explanation: 形容词副词考点：worthy 是形容词，后接名词须加 of，matters worthy of attention“值得关注的问题”作后置定语；B 缺 of，A、D 中 is/which is 与复数主语 matters 不一致。故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I don't like to _______ a room with a stranger.
questions.explanation: share sth. with sb. 为固定搭配“与某人共用/分享某物”；live/stay/sleep 均不与 with a room 搭配表“合住”。译：我不喜欢和陌生人合住一个房间。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The book tells us about the author's life _______ about writings.
questions.explanation: as well as 意为“也、和”，连接 the author's life 与 about writings 两个并列内容；also 是副词不能这样连接名词短语，as much as 表程度“与……一样多”，as well 为句尾副词。译：这本书既讲作者的生活，也讲他的作品。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She was so _______ in her job that she didn't hear anybody knocking at the door.
questions.explanation: be absorbed in 为固定搭配“全神贯注于”，与 so...that 呼应说明她太专注没听见敲门；attracted/drawn 须接 to，focused 须接 on。译：她工作得如此专注，以致没听见任何人敲门。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The new campus is _______ as the old one.
questions.explanation: 形容词副词考点：倍数表达“倍数 + as + 形容词原级 + as”，倍数必须放在 as...as 结构最前面，twice as big as the old one；其余选项倍数位置均错误。故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The students of this university complain about traffic noises which _______ them when they are having classes.
questions.explanation: disturb 意为“打扰、扰乱（安宁）”，噪音打搅学生上课；interrupt 指打断（说话、动作的连续性），interfere 为不及物动词须接 with/in，prevent 须接 from doing。译：这所大学的学生抱怨交通噪音打搅他们上课。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: This article _______ more attention to the problem of cultural interference in foreign language teaching and learning.
questions.explanation: call for 意为“呼吁、需要”，文章呼吁人们更多关注该问题；allow for 考虑到，care for 关心/照料，apply for 申请。译：这篇文章呼吁在外语教学与学习中更多地关注文化干扰问题。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: There are 10 _______ assistants in that _______ shop.
questions.explanation: 名词考点：man/woman 作定语修饰复数名词时须随之用复数，10 名女店员为 women assistants；框架规则：其他名词作定语用单数，故“鞋店”为 shoe shop。故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We have various summer camps for your holidays. You can choose _______ based on your own interests.
questions.explanation: 代词考点：various summer camps 为三者以上的多个对象，从中“任选一个”用 one（同类不同一）；either 用于两者，each 强调各个，it 指前文特指的同一个事物。故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —Could we stay here for the night? —Sorry. I have _______ to hold you all.
questions.explanation: 形容词副词考点：too/so/how 等副词修饰“形容词 + 单数可数名词”时须用“副词 + adj. + a/an + n.”语序，即 too small a room；a too small room 语序错误，such 应为 such a small room，very 不能用于此结构。故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: At a rough estimate, Nigeria is _______ Great Britain.
options: three times as the size of
questions.explanation: 形容词副词考点：倍数表达“倍数 + the size/length/width of”，three times the size of Great Britain“面积是英国的三倍”；A 缺 of，B、C 语序错误。故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: This training program can give you a lift at work, _______ increase your income by 40%.
questions.explanation: as well as 意为“而且、也”，连接 give you a lift 与 increase your income 两个并列谓语；so long as 只要，as soon as 一……就，so much as 多用于否定句。译：这个培训项目既能助你在职场上更进一步，还能使你的收入增加 40%。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Between the two generations, it is often not their age, _______ their education that causes misunderstanding.
questions.explanation: 强调句标志：It is...that 结构强调主语；框架规则：强调句中强调部分用 It is + 被强调成分 + that，此处 not...but...“不是……而是……”连接 age 与 education，强调的是 education。故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I'm sorry I didn't phone you, but I've been very busy _______ the past couple of weeks.
questions.explanation: over the past couple of weeks 意为“在过去几周里”，常与现在完成时连用；beyond 超出，among 在（三者以上）之中，with 表伴随。译：对不起没给你打电话，这几周以来我一直很忙。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Your story is perfect; I've never heard _______ before.
questions.explanation: 形容词副词考点：否定词 never + 比较级表达最高级含义，I've never heard a better one“我从未听过比这更好的”，泛指一个用 a better one；the better one 特指两者中较好的那一个。故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was raining heavily and little Mary felt cold, so she stood _______ to her mother.
questions.explanation: 形容词副词考点：close 与 closely 辨析——close 作副词表示具体距离“紧紧地、靠近地”，stood close to her mother 紧挨着妈妈站；closely 表抽象意义“密切地、仔细地”。故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —Hello, could I speak to Mr. Smith? —Sorry, wrong number. There isn't _______ Mr. Smith here.
questions.explanation: 冠词考点：a + 人名表示“某个叫……的人”，There isn't a Mr. Smith here“这儿没有一位叫史密斯的人”；the 特指双方已知的那个史密斯，不合语境。故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Because of the nuclear crisis caused by the earthquake in Japan, many people lined up to buy salt _______ seeking protection from radiation.
questions.explanation: in (the) hope of 意为“怀着……的希望”，人们排队买盐，希望借此寻求对辐射的防护；in search of 与 seeking 语义重复，in the face of 面对，in terms of 就……而言。译：由于日本地震引发的核危机，许多人排队买盐，希望以此寻求对辐射的防护。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If you are not satisfied with this pair, I will get you _______ one of the same size and color.
questions.explanation: 代词考点：another 泛指同类事物中的“另一个”，get you another one 再给您拿一双；other 须接名词，the other 特指两者中的另一个，more/less 不合句法。故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I think we should stop arguing and work together, if we want to get _______ near a solution to the problem.
questions.explanation: 考查 some/any 系列词的用法：get somewhere 意为“有所进展”，get somewhere near a solution 即“接近问题的解决办法”；anywhere 一般用于否定句和疑问句，nowhere、everywhere 与句意不符。故选 D。（2016 年广东专插本英语真题）

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I wanted to pay for the coffee, but I found that all I had was a couple of _______ coins.
questions.explanation: worthless 意为“不值钱的、无用的”，身上只有几枚不值钱的硬币付不了账；priceless/invaluable 均指“无价的、极珍贵的”，inexpensive 便宜的（仍是真钱）。译：我想付咖啡钱，却发现身上只有几枚不值钱的硬币。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: This place, originally a small town, has been _______ into a modern city.
questions.explanation: transform...into... 意为“使转变为”，小镇变成现代化城市；transport 运输，transfer 调动/转移，transmit 传送（信号、疾病）。译：这个地方原本是个小镇，如今已变成一座现代化城市。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: His application for the position was _______ by the employer because of his qualifications.
questions.explanation: be turned down 意为“被拒绝”，求职申请被雇主拒绝；turn out 结果是/生产，turn on 打开，turn up 出现/调大。译：他应聘该职位的申请被雇主拒绝了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The travelers _______ 300 miles a day by car when they were in Africa.
questions.explanation: cover 作及物动词可表示“行驶（一段路程）”，cover 300 miles a day 每天行驶 300 英里；pass 多指“经过”某地，take 花费时间（it takes...），bring 带来。译：旅行者在非洲时每天开车行驶 300 英里。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Environmentalists are doing everything within their power to _______ the impact of the oil spill.
questions.explanation: minimize 意为“把……降到最低限度”，竭力把漏油影响减到最小；reject 拒绝，belittle 轻视（主观贬低而非减少影响），reclaim 回收/开垦。译：环保主义者正竭尽所能将石油泄漏的影响降到最低。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: At the time of economic crisis, he could only earn a _______ of $2,000 per month.
questions.explanation: salary 指按月/年发放的薪水，earn a salary of $2,000 per month；wage 多指按周/日/时计付的工资，fee 服务费/酬金，pay 报酬（通常不可数，不与 a...of 连用）。译：经济危机时期，他每个月只能挣 2000 美元的薪水。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I would always _______ buying a good quality car rather than a cheap one.
questions.explanation: recommend doing sth. 意为“建议做某事”，recommend buying a good quality car；appreciate 感激/欣赏，approve 须接 of doing，introduce 介绍。译：我总是建议买一辆质量好的车而不是便宜车。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Many students signed up for the _______ race in the sports meeting to be held next week.
questions.explanation: 数词考点：连字符构成的复合形容词中名词只能用单数，an 800-meter-long race；B 连字符内用了复数，C、D 不构成复合形容词结构。故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I didn’t know anything about any of the books so my choice was quite _______.
questions.explanation: arbitrary 意为“随意的、任意的”，对这些书一无所知所以选择很随意；obvious/evident 明显的，fortunate 幸运的。译：我对这些书一无所知，所以我的选择相当随意。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: His aim was to _______ pride in being black and to inspire black Americans to campaign for equal rights.
questions.explanation: restore 意为“恢复、重塑”，restore pride 重拾（作为黑人的）自豪感；respond 回答，restrain 抑制，retreat 撤退。译：他的目标是重塑作为黑人的自豪感，并激励美国黑人投身争取平等权利的运动。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Mary worked here as a _______ secretary and ended up getting a full-time job with the company.
questions.explanation: temporary 意为“临时的”，temporary secretary 临时秘书，与结尾“获得全职工作”形成对照；pessimistic 悲观的，previous 以前的，cautious 谨慎的。译：Mary 起初在这里做临时秘书，最终在这家公司得到了一份全职工作。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: David is _______ animal fur, so he won’t visit anyone who has cats or dogs in the house.
questions.explanation: be allergic to 为固定搭配“对……过敏”，正因过敏才不去养猫狗的人家；curious about 好奇，satisfied with 满意，fond of 喜欢，均与后文矛盾。译：David 对动物毛皮过敏，所以他不去家里养猫或狗的人家做客。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The research lacks _______ evidence, and therefore, its conclusions are doubtful.
questions.explanation: solid 意为“可靠的、扎实的”，solid evidence 可靠的证据，与后文“结论可疑”呼应；fierce 凶猛的，severe 严重的，potential 潜在的。译：这项研究缺乏可靠的证据，因此它的结论令人怀疑。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: People found to their horror that two-thirds of the adult population in that area had _______ AIDS.
questions.explanation: contract 作及物动词意为“感染（疾病）”，had contracted AIDS 感染了艾滋病；contacted 与……联系（形近干扰），contrasted 对比，compacted 压实。译：人们惊恐地发现，该地区三分之二的成年人感染了艾滋病。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Though faced with many difficulties, he would not _______ online learning.
questions.explanation: give up 意为“放弃”，give up online learning 放弃在线学习；get through 完成/接通，get by 勉强过活（不直接接宾语），give in 屈服（不及物，须接 to）。译：尽管面临许多困难，他还是不愿放弃在线学习。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It suddenly occurred to me that we could _______ the police for help.
questions.explanation: ask sb. for sth. 为固定搭配“向某人寻求……”，ask the police for help 向警察求助；it occurred to sb. that... 某人突然想到；look/tell/meet 均不构成此搭配。译：我突然想到我们可以向警察求助。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I’d like to _______ a special seat for the concert of May 5.
questions.explanation: reserve 意为“预订（座位、房间）”，为音乐会订一个专座；preserve 保护/保存，conserve 节约（资源），serve 服务。译：我想为 5 月 5 日的音乐会预订一个专座。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The manager often requires us never to ________ till tomorrow what we can do today.
questions.explanation: put off 意为“推迟”，不要把今天能做的事拖到明天；come up 出现/走近，turn on 打开，give out 分发/发出。译：经理经常要求我们决不要把今天能做的事拖到明天去做。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Having heard so much about Mr. Smith, they were ________ to meet him.
questions.explanation: be eager to do 意为“渴望做某事”，久闻 Smith 先生大名所以渴望见到他；urgent 紧急的（多修饰事物），earnest 认真的，nice 友好的。译：听说了许多关于 Smith 先生的事，他们渴望见到他。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Only one little boy ________ the accident; everyone else was killed.
questions.explanation: survive 为及物动词，意为“从……中幸存”，survive the accident 在事故中幸存；submit 提交/屈服，suffer 遭受（常接 from），succeed 成功。译：只有一个小男孩在这场事故中幸存，其他人都遇难了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I don't know whether what he said is true, but I'll try to ________ it.
questions.explanation: confirm 意为“证实、确认”，不知真假所以设法证实；confine 限制，confess 坦白，conform 须接 to 表示“符合”。译：我不知道他说的是不是真的，但我会设法去证实。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: People in that district ________ use oil lamps, for there is no gas or electricity.
questions.explanation: 情态动词标志：for there is no gas or electricity 点明客观条件；框架规则：have to 表客观必要性“不得不”，must 表主观义务或命令，can/may 表能力或许可，均不合语境。故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: My brother likes eating very much but he isn't very ________ about the food he eats.
questions.explanation: be particular about 为固定搭配“对……讲究、挑剔”；special 特别的，peculiar 古怪的（be peculiar to 为……所特有），unusual 不寻常的。译：我兄弟很爱吃，但他对吃的东西并不挑剔。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Silence is required in this area while an important meeting is ________.
questions.explanation: be under way 为固定搭配“正在进行中”，重要会议进行期间该区域要求保持安静；under control 处于控制之下，in sight 在视野内，in danger 处于危险中。译：当一场重要会议进行时，该区域要求保持安静。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I must decline it because the conditions you offered are not ________.
questions.explanation: acceptable 意为“可接受的”，条件不可接受所以拒绝；capable 有能力的（修饰人），available 可获得的，comfortable 舒适的。译：我必须拒绝，因为你提出的条件是无法接受的。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is reported that 30 percent of the world population have no ________ to clean drinking water and health care.
questions.explanation: have (no) access to 为固定搭配“（没）有获得/使用……的机会”，have no access to clean drinking water 无法获得清洁饮用水；means 手段（by means of），approach 方法（an approach to sth.），channel 渠道。译：据报道，世界上 30% 的人口无法获得清洁的饮用水和医疗保健。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We're going to ________ the task that we haven't finished.
questions.explanation: carry on 意为“继续进行”，继续完成没做完的任务；take away 拿走，get onto 上（车）/开始谈论，keep off 避开。译：我们打算继续完成那项尚未完成的任务。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: There are three colors in the British flag, ________ red, white and blue.
questions.explanation: specifically 意为“具体地说、明确地”，引出对红、白、蓝三种颜色的具体列举；rarely 很少，really 真正地，naturally 自然地。译：英国国旗上有三种颜色，具体为红、白、蓝。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: One of the most important problems is how to ________ students' interest in learning English.
questions.explanation: arouse 为及物动词，意为“激起、唤起”，arouse students' interest 激发学生兴趣；rise 上升、arise 出现（均为不及物），rest 休息。译：最重要的问题之一是如何激发学生学习英语的兴趣。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Staying in a hotel costs ________ renting a room in an apartment for a week.
questions.explanation: 形容词副词考点：倍数表达“倍数 + as + much + as”，费用为不可数概念用 much，且倍数必须放最前：costs twice as much as renting...；more 不能用于 as...as 原级比较结构。故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Mary ________ her bag at the first sight by seeing its color.
questions.explanation: identify 意为“辨认出、识别”，凭颜色一眼认出自己的包；tell 须用 tell A from B 表“分辨”，know 知道，claim 声称/认领。译：玛丽一看颜色就认出了自己的包。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: What ________ to him is whether the job allows him to pursue his studies.
questions.explanation: matter 作不及物动词意为“要紧、有关系”，What matters to him is... “对他重要的是……”；happen 发生（语义不合），refer 提及（须接 to 且语义不符），apply 适用（须接 to）。译：对他来说，重要的是这份工作能否让他继续深造。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I know Mike is slow at understanding, but we should be patient ________ him.
questions.explanation: be patient with sb. 为固定搭配“对某人有耐心”；for/at/about 均不与人搭配表此义。译：我知道 Mike 反应比较慢，但我们应该对他有耐心。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: While she was in Paris, she developed a ________ for fine art.
questions.explanation: develop a taste for 为固定搭配“培养出对……的爱好/鉴赏力”；way 方式，relation 关系，habit 习惯，均不与 for fine art 搭配表“爱好”。译：在巴黎期间，她培养出了对美术的鉴赏爱好。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —Where's Peter? —He has ________ to Beijing. By the way, have you ever ________?
questions.explanation: 时态标志：Where's Peter 询问现在的下落，用现在完成时；框架规则：have gone to 表示“已去了某地（人未回来）”，have been to 表示“曾去过（已回来）”强调经历，与 ever 连用。故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: In fact, ________ one cause that leads to the problem.
questions.explanation: 主谓一致考点：cattle 是单复同形的集合名词，属于框架中“形式上单数、意义上复数”的名词，作主语时谓语用复数 are，且本身不能加 s；cattles 拼写错误。故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Her childhood dream became a ________ when she broke the 100-metre race world record.
questions.explanation: become a reality 意为“成为现实”；become a truth 不地道（惯用 come true），fact 客观事实，certainty 确定无疑的事。译：当她打破 100 米赛跑世界纪录时，童年的梦想变成了现实。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He has made a lot of films, but ________ good ones.
questions.explanation: 代词考点：but 表转折，后半句应为否定意义；框架规则：few 表否定“几乎没有”，修饰可数名词复数 good ones；some/many 与转折矛盾，any 用于否定或疑问句。故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The questionnaire takes ________ ten to fifteen minutes to complete and can be used along with the assessment interview.
questions.explanation: approximately 意为“大约”，与 ten to fifteen minutes 这一约数呼应；mainly 主要地，punctually 准时地，precisely 精确地（与区间矛盾）。译：完成这份问卷大约需要 10 到 15 分钟，并可与评估访谈配合使用。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: In order to support the big family, he worked so hard that ________ he made himself ill.
questions.explanation: eventually 意为“最终”，长期拼命工作最终累垮了身体；occasionally 偶尔，purposefully 有意地，normally 通常。译：为了养活一大家子人，他工作如此拼命，结果最终把自己累病了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: A man cannot smile like a child, ________ a child smiles with his eyes, while a man smiles with his lips alone.
questions.explanation: for 作并列连词表原因，补充说明“成人不能像孩子那样笑”的理由——孩子用眼睛笑而成人只用嘴唇；so/and/but 均不表原因。译：成人无法像孩子那样微笑，因为孩子是用眼睛笑的，而成人只用嘴唇笑。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Some people choose jobs for other reasons ________ money these days.
questions.explanation: besides 意为“除……之外（还有）”，other reasons 本身已把 money 排除在外，此处用 besides 表示“钱以外的其他原因”并列补充；except 表示“排除在外”，与 other reasons 语义矛盾。译：如今有些人选择工作是出于金钱以外的其他原因。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Take your time—it’s just ________ short distance from here to ________ restaurant.
questions.explanation: 冠词考点：第一空泛指“一段很短的距离”，a short distance；第二空特指双方都知道的那家餐馆用 the。故选 B（a; the）。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The child looked at me ________.
questions.explanation: 形容词副词考点：修饰动词短语 looked at 须用副词 strangely“奇怪地”；形容词 strange 不能修饰动词。故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He will come to understand your efforts sooner or later. It’s just a matter of ________.
questions.explanation: a matter of time 为固定表达“时间问题”，与 sooner or later（迟早）呼应；luck 运气，value 价值，fact 事实。译：他迟早会明白你的良苦用心，这只是个时间问题。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is important to have your eyes examined regularly to check for any sign of eye disease that may not have any ________.
questions.explanation: symptom 意为“症状”，定期检查眼睛以便发现可能没有任何症状的眼病；similarity 相似之处，sample 样品，shadow 影子。译：定期检查眼睛很重要，以便查出可能没有任何症状的眼部疾病迹象。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: As is known to all, ________ People’s Republic of China is ________ biggest developing country in the world.
questions.explanation: 冠词考点：由普通名词构成的专有名词前加 the，即 the People's Republic of China；形容词最高级 biggest 前也须加 the。故选 C（the; the）。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Tom’s room is in a terrible mess; everything seems ________ in it.
questions.explanation: out of order 意为“杂乱无序、状态不佳”，与前句 in a terrible mess 呼应；out of control 失控，out of date 过时，out of service 停止服务（多指设施）。译：Tom 的房间乱七八糟，里面的东西似乎都没个章法。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Many people prefer the bowls made of steel to the ________ made of plastic.
questions.explanation: 代词考点：替代前文复数名词 bowls 且为同类不同物，用 ones；it/them 指前文同一个（批）事物，one 替代单数名词。故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: During the afternoon Marilla kept the child busy with ________ tasks and watched over her with a keen eye when she did them.
questions.explanation: various 意为“各种各样的”，让孩子整个下午忙于各种活计；curious 好奇的（修饰人），anxious 焦急的，obvious 明显的。译：整个下午，Marilla 都让孩子忙着做各种各样的活儿，并在她做的时候密切留意着她。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I think you’d better hold your position and don’t ________ to their demands.
questions.explanation: give in (to sth.) 意为“让步、屈服”，不给他们的要求让步；give off 发出（气味、光），give up 放弃（不接 to），give away 赠送/泄露。译：我认为你最好坚守立场，不要向他们的要求让步。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: This box is ________ that one.
questions.explanation: 形容词副词考点：倍数表达“倍数 + as + 形容词原级 + as”，twice as heavy as that one“是那个箱子的两倍重”，倍数必须放在 as...as 结构最前面。故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She said it was important to ________ things correctly and in a businesslike manner.
questions.explanation: handle 意为“处理、应付”，handle things correctly and in a businesslike manner 即正确、有条理地处理事情；employ 意为雇佣/使用，remember 意为记住，reject 意为拒绝，均不合句意。句意：她说正确地、以干练的方式处理事情很重要。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Peter was ________ that there should be no misunderstanding on that point.
questions.explanation: be determined that... 意为“下定决心要……”，句意：彼得下定决心在那一点上不能有误会。devoted（devoted to）忠诚的，excited（excited about）兴奋的，frightened（frightened at/of）害怕的，搭配与语境均不符。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: No one likes him because his action doesn’t ________ his words.
questions.explanation: correspond with 意为“相符、一致”，action doesn't correspond with his words 即言行不一；agree on 意为在……上达成一致，communicate with 意为与……交流，consist of 意为由……组成，都没有“相符”之意。句意：没人喜欢他，因为他的行为与言语不一致。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He rarely goes to the cinema as his work ________ almost all his time.
questions.explanation: take up 意为“占用（时间、空间）”，工作占用了他几乎所有时间；take away 拿走，take over 接管，take in 吸收/欺骗，均不合句意。句意：他很少去看电影，因为工作几乎占用了他所有的时间。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Employees are ________ to join the company’s pension plan after a year’s service.
questions.explanation: be compelled to do 意为“被迫、被要求做某事”，句意：员工工作满一年后须加入公司的养老金计划。acquired（acquire）获得，responded 须与 to 搭配，regarded 须与 as 搭配，均不能接 to do 表此意。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She soon ________ the actor who had starred in the popular movie The Fast and the Furious.
questions.explanation: identify 意为“认出、识别”，她很快认出了那位主演热门电影的演员；specify 指定，realize 意识到，justify 证明……有理，均不合语境。句意：她很快认出了主演热门电影《速度与激情》的那位演员。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Mum, I’ve been studying English since 8 o’clock. ________ I go out and play with Tom for a while?
questions.explanation: can 用于疑问句表示请求或许可，孩子用否定问句 Can't I...? 委婉请求“难道我不能……吗”，与前面“我从 8 点一直学到现在”的铺垫呼应；wouldn't/won't 表意愿不符，May not 不是自然的疑问请求形式。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We collected hundreds of ________ in support of not allowing cars into the city center.
questions.explanation: signature 意为“签名”，collect hundreds of signatures 即征集数百个签名以支持禁止汽车进入市中心；awareness 为不可数名词不能与 hundreds of 连用，stationery 文具，statements 声明。句意：我们征集了数百个签名，支持不允许汽车进入市中心。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: All the traveling ________ are to be paid by the company if you travel on business.
questions.explanation: traveling expenses 是固定搭配，意为“差旅费”；charges 指服务收费，money 不可数，prices 指商品价格，均不构成此搭配。句意：如果你出差旅行，所有差旅费都由公司支付。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was the driver’s carelessness that ________ the traffic accident.
questions.explanation: result in 意为“导致、造成”（原因→结果），司机的粗心导致了交通事故；result from 意为“起因于”（结果→原因，方向相反），resulted at/resulted with 非固定搭配。句意：正是司机的粗心导致了这起交通事故。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: About ________ of the workers in that steel works are young people.
questions.explanation: 分数表达：分子用基数词、分母用序数词，分子大于 1 时分母加 s，故“五分之三”为 three-fifths；third-fifths 分子形式错误，three-fives/three-fifth 词形与词序错误。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The young man struggled to ________ where he was at the time the murder took place.
questions.explanation: recall 意为“回忆起”，年轻人努力回想凶案发生时自己在哪里；reflect 反思（reflect on），respond 回应（to），resolve 决定/解决。句意：这个年轻人努力回想凶案发生时他身在何处。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: A class is said rather vaguely to ________ group of persons sharing similar occupations and incomes, and as a consequence similar life-styles and beliefs.
questions.explanation: consist of 意为“由……组成”（主动形式表被动含义，无被动式），is said to consist of... 即“据说由……构成”；contrast with 与……对比，contribute in 非搭配（应为 contribute to），composed of 缺少系动词 be。句意：阶级被相当模糊地说成是由职业和收入相似、从而生活方式和观念也相似的一群人构成的。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Whether the buildings in this area should be pulled down has remained ________; people are still looking for other possible solutions.
questions.explanation: controversial 意为“有争议的”，该拆与否仍有争议，所以人们还在寻找其他解决办法，前后逻辑呼应；unchallenged 未受质疑的，relevant 相关的，contradictory 矛盾的。句意：这个地区的建筑是否应该拆除一直存有争议；人们仍在寻找其他可能的解决办法。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Interest is as ________ to learning as the ability to understand, even more so.
questions.explanation: be vital to 意为“对……至关重要”，兴趣和理解能力一样对学习至关重要，甚至更重要；available 可获得的，specific 具体的，similar 相似的（similar to）。句意：兴趣对学习和理解能力一样重要，甚至更重要。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Nowadays, there is a ________ increase in children’s creativity, for they’re greatly encouraged to develop their talents.
questions.explanation: sharp 意为“急剧的”，a sharp increase 急剧增长，与后文“孩子们受到大力鼓励发展才能”构成因果；slight 轻微的，natural 自然的，modest 适度的。句意：如今孩子们的创造力急剧增长，因为他们受到大力鼓励去发展自己的才能。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: At the sight of her long-lost friend, she could hardly ________ her tears.
questions.explanation: hold back 意为“抑制、忍住”，hold back her tears 忍住眼泪；give in 让步，turn back 返回，keep away from 远离，均不能与 tears 搭配。句意：一见到久别的朋友，她几乎忍不住眼泪。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Do you think shopping online will ________ take the place of shopping in stores?
questions.explanation: finally 意为“最终、终于”，你认为网上购物最终会取代实体店购物吗；especially 尤其是，frequently 频繁地，merely 仅仅。句意：你认为网上购物最终会取代实体店购物吗？

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Don’t turn off the computer before closing all programs, ________ you could have problems.
questions.explanation: 框架：祈使句 + or 连接一个不愉快或不理想的结果，or 相当于 otherwise“否则”；关掉所有程序前别关电脑，否则会出问题；and 连接好结果，but/so 无此结构含义。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I would like to stay in the small town due to its ________ weather.
questions.explanation: mild 意为“温和的（天气）”，mild weather 为惯用搭配；general 总体的，soft 柔软的（质地），gentle 温柔的（性格/动作）。句意：因为气候温和，我想留在这个小镇上。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: His anger was ________ that he stood there speechless.
questions.explanation: such 可作代词引导结果状语从句：His anger was such that... = 他的愤怒如此强烈以至于……，such 指“到这种程度”；so 后必须紧跟形容词/副词（so angry that），very 不与 that 连用，as 不表结果。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Jenny was looking for a seat when, luckily, a man ________ and left.
questions.explanation: get up 意为“站起来”，珍妮正在找座位时，幸运地有位男士起身离开；take up 占用/开始从事，shut up 闭嘴，set up 建立。句意：珍妮正在找座位，这时幸运地有一位男士起身离开了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Everything comes with a ________, that is, there’s no such thing as a free lunch in the world.
questions.explanation: price 意为“价格、代价”，everything comes with a price 万物皆有代价，与“世上没有免费午餐”呼应；prize 奖品，return 回报，revenue 收入。句意：万物皆有代价，也就是说世上没有免费的午餐。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The medicine works more ________ if you drink some hot water after taking it.
questions.explanation: effectively 意为“有效地”，修饰 works（起效），服药后喝点热水药效发挥得更好；costly 是形容词“昂贵的”不能修饰动词，strongly 强烈地，vividly 生动地。句意：服药后喝点热水，药效会发挥得更好。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Women often ________ about men’s absent mind when they are talking.
questions.explanation: complain about 意为“抱怨”，complain about men's absent mind 抱怨男人心不在焉；complete 完成，compare（with）比较，compete（with）竞争，均无此搭配含义。句意：聊天时女人们常常抱怨男人心不在焉。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The price was very reasonable; I would gladly have paid ________ he asked.
questions.explanation: 倍数表达框架：倍数放最前面 + as + 形容词/副词原级 + as；price 指价钱用 much，即 three times as much as he asked；A/C 倍数位置与词序错误，B 的 many 不能修饰不可数的价钱。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ did I feel they were being unreasonable.
questions.explanation: 框架：否定意义的词组位于句首时引起部分倒装；At no time（绝不）置于句首，故用 did I feel 的倒装语序；At a time 每次，At one time 曾经，For a time 暂时，均非否定词组，不能触发倒装。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The more he tried to please her, ________ she seemed to appreciate it.
questions.explanation: 框架比较结构“the more..., the more...”表示“越……越……”，前后都要在比较级前加 the；他越想讨好她，她似乎越不领情，故选 the less；less 缺 the，lesser 并非 little 的规则比较级。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: You can stay here ________ you keep quiet.
questions.explanation: as long as（= so long as）引导条件状语从句，意为“只要”；只要保持安静你就可以待在这里；unless 除非，in case 以防，in order 须与 that/to 连用。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The Smiths don’t usually like staying at ________ hotels, but last summer they spent a few days at a very nice hotel by ________ sea.
questions.explanation: 复数可数名词 hotels 表泛指用零冠词；by the sea 是固定搭配“在海边”，独一无二的具体地点由 the 限定。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Over the years my father had gradually ________ a collection of precious stamps.
questions.explanation: accumulate 意为“积累、积攒”，强调长时间逐渐累积，与 over the years 和 gradually 呼应；collect/gather 指一次性收集、聚集，absorb 吸收。句意：这些年来，父亲逐渐积攒了一批珍贵的邮票。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: “Would you like to go out for a picnic?” “Yes, it’s ________ day!”
questions.explanation: 句尾感叹号表明是感叹句，感叹部分是名词短语（a beautiful day），框架：修饰名词短语用 such，结构为 such + a/an + 形容词 + 单数可数名词，即 such a beautiful day；so 只能直接修饰形容词/副词，“so beautiful”缺名词句子不完整，“so a beautiful”语序错误。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: A smart appearance makes a ________ impression at an interview.
questions.explanation: favorable 意为“有利的、好感的”，得体的仪表在面试中留下好印象；favored 受优待的，favorite 最喜爱的，favoring 喜爱的（现在分词）。句意：得体的仪表会在面试中留下好印象。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I have no ________ to the plan, so long as it would not cost too much.
questions.explanation: have no objection to 意为“对……没有异议”，我对该计划没有异议，只要花费不太高；refusal 拒绝，comment（on）评论，idea（about）主意，均无“异议”义。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: All the ________ in the hospital will get a rise tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 框架：名词修饰名词作定语一般用单数，但 man/woman 例外——复合名词变复数时两部分都要变，woman doctor → women doctors；woman doctors、women doctor 只变一半，均为错误形式。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: On my desk is a photo that my father took of ________ when I was a baby.
questions.explanation: take a photo of sb 意为“给某人拍照”，介词 of 后接人称代词宾格，即 took of me；再由 when I was a baby 可知照片拍的是“我”婴儿时；his/mine 为物主代词，him 意为“他”不合语境。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I must be getting fat—I can ________ do my trousers up.
questions.explanation: hardly 意为“几乎不”，我一定是胖了——裤子几乎拉不上了，因果逻辑成立；fairly 相当地，nearly 几乎（肯定义），seldom 很少（频率副词）。句意：我一定是胖了——我几乎扣不上裤子了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I’d like to study law at university ________ my cousin prefers geography.
questions.explanation: while 连接两个并列对比的分句时意为“而、然而”：我想在大学学法律，而表哥更喜欢地理；though 表让步，as 表原因/当……时，for 表原因，均无对比含义。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Give money if you can, ________ many people who lost home in the earthquake will be able to live on.
questions.explanation: 框架：祈使句 + and 连接一个较好的结果，相当于“只要……就……”；能给钱就给些钱，（这样）许多在地震中失去家园的人就能活下去；or 连接的是坏结果，as/but 不符。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He invited me to a dance after the show ________ Christmas Eve.
questions.explanation: 时间介词中 on 用于具体某一天，Christmas Eve（圣诞前夜）为具体日子，用 on Christmas Eve；at 用于时间点，in 用于月份/年份/时间段，by 表截止。句意：演出结束后他邀请我在圣诞前夜去参加舞会。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Everybody was touched ________ words after they heard her moving story.
questions.explanation: beyond words 意为“难以言表”，beyond 表示“超出”；听完她感人的故事，大家感动得无以言表；without 意为没有，of/in 均无此搭配含义。句意：听完她感人的故事，大家都感动得难以言表。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: As we know, in many places in China, ________ car is ________ popular means of transportation.
questions.explanation: the + 单数可数名词可表示一类事物，the car 即“汽车这类交通工具”；means（方式）此处为可数名词，第一次泛提“一种流行的交通方式”用不定冠词 a。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The black people were against slavery and fought for their ________ bravely.
questions.explanation: 形容词性物主代词 their 后需接名词作宾语，freedom 意为“自由”；free 为形容词，freely 为副词，freeway 意为高速公路。句意：黑人反对奴隶制，为他们的自由英勇战斗。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Teachers have to constantly update their knowledge in order to maintain their professional ________.
questions.explanation: competence 意为“能力、胜任”，professional competence 即专业能力，教师须不断更新知识以保持专业胜任力；consequence 后果，independence 独立，intelligence 智力。句意：教师必须不断更新知识，以保持自己的专业能力。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ all the animals I’ve ever had, these two dogs are the most sensitive to the spoken word.
questions.explanation: of（或 among）+ all + 复数名词与最高级连用，表示“在所有……之中”，Of all the animals I've ever had, these two dogs are the most sensitive...；From/For/With 均不能引出最高级比较的范围。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: There are over 58,000 rocky objects in ________ space, about 900 of which could fall down onto ________ earth.
questions.explanation: space 泛指“太空”时用零冠词（in space）；earth 属于框架中“世上独一无二的事物”，须加 the，即 onto the earth。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The temperature is likely to go down next week. ________ , we will have to cancel the outdoor activities.
questions.explanation: In that case 意为“那样的话、既然如此”，承接上句“气温可能下降”；那样的话我们将不得不取消户外活动；in case 以防万一，in no case 决不（须倒装），in any case 无论如何。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He is totally ________ to other people’s attitudes.
questions.explanation: be indifferent to 意为“对……漠不关心”，他对别人的态度完全无所谓；unconcerned 常与 about/with 搭配，careless（in/with）粗心，bold 大胆，与 to 搭配且合句意的只有 indifferent。句意：他对别人的态度全然漠不关心。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The trouble is that he really likes doing it but he’s ________ to admit it.
questions.explanation: be ashamed to do 意为“羞于做某事”，他其实很喜欢做这件事，却不好意思承认；shameful 修饰事物“可耻的”，shamed 为过去式/过去分词，shaming 令人羞愧的；ashamed 是表语形容词，描述人的心理。句意：麻烦在于他确实喜欢做这件事，却羞于承认。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Mark plays ________ violin, while his brother prefers to play ________ baseball.
questions.explanation: 框架：西洋乐器（guitar、piano、violin 等）前加 the，球类运动前用零冠词；play the violin 拉小提琴，play baseball 打棒球。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: When he really does something wrong, he is willing to ________.
questions.explanation: apologize 意为“道歉”，真做错了事时他愿意道歉；apply 申请，relieve 缓解，relate 与……相关。句意：当他真的做错了事时，他愿意道歉。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Her great dream of becoming a writer has finally become a ________.
questions.explanation: reality 意为“现实”，become a reality 即“成为现实”，与 dream 呼应；practice 实践，event 事件，duty 职责。句意：她成为作家的远大梦想终于变成了现实。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The restaurant is busy on Sundays, so I’ll phone up today and ________ a table.
questions.explanation: reserve 意为“预订”，reserve a table 订位；preserve 保存/保护，observe 观察/遵守，deserve 应得。句意：这家餐馆星期天很忙，所以我今天就打电话预订一个位子。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Never waste anything, but ________ never waste time.
questions.explanation: above all 意为“最重要的是”，什么都别浪费，但最重要的是别浪费时间；after all 毕竟，all in all 总而言之，all over 到处/结束。句意：什么都不要浪费，但最重要的是绝不要浪费时间。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ of March is my sister’s birthday.
questions.explanation: 日期用序数词表达，框架明确序数词前通常加 the；“21 日”序数词为 twenty-first，故选 The twenty-first of March；The twenty-one 词形错误，Twenty-first/Twenty-one 缺定冠词不表特指日期。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Generally speaking, a business letter should be written in formal style ________ in a personal one.
questions.explanation: rather than 意为“而不是”，商务信函应采用正式文体而非私人信函文体；other than 除……之外/不同于，less than 少于，more than 多于。句意：一般来说，商务信函应使用正式文体而不是私人信函的文体来写。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He is so kind and easy-going that the kids go ________ him in a big way.
questions.explanation: go for sb 为非正式用法，意为“喜欢、被……吸引”，孩子们非常（in a big way）喜欢他；go to him 找他，go with him 陪同他去，go off him 不再喜欢（与语境相反）。句意：他如此善良随和，孩子们都非常喜欢他。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She seemed to be aware of the delicacy of the situation and she was taking great care not to say anything to ________ her companion.
questions.explanation: embarrass 意为“使尴尬”，她意识到局面微妙，小心翼翼不说任何使同伴尴尬的话；ignore 忽视，neglect 疏忽，charm 迷住，与“小心翼翼避免”的语境不合。句意：她似乎意识到局面微妙，因此小心翼翼，不说任何让她同伴尴尬的话。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: When I go out in the daytime I use the bike ________ the car if I can.
questions.explanation: rather than 意为“而不是”，白天出门时如果可以我就骑自行车而不是开汽车；regardless of 不管，in spite of 尽管，more than 多于。句意：白天外出时，如果可以我会骑自行车而不是开车。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The obvious unfairness of such poverty side by side with conspicuous affluence reminded them of their ________ parents back home.
questions.explanation: vulnerable 意为“脆弱的、易受伤害的”，赤贫与豪富并存的鲜明不公让他们想起家乡同样脆弱的父母；destructive 破坏性的，critical 批评的/关键的，sentimental 多愁善感的。句意：赤贫与显赫富有并存的明显不公，让他们想起了家乡脆弱无助的父母。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —Shall we invite Tim? —No, it’s too late to invite any more people. ________, he hates parties, you know.
questions.explanation: Besides 作副词意为“再者、而且”，用于补充另一个理由：太晚了不能再请人了，再说你也知道他讨厌聚会；Beside 是介词“在……旁边”，Except 意为除……之外，But 意为但是。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Surprisingly, the accident did very little ________ to either of the cars.
questions.explanation: do damage to 意为“对……造成损害”，出人意料，这次事故对两辆车都没造成多大损坏；danger 用于 be in danger，effect 用于 have an effect on，confusion 意为混乱。句意：出人意料，这次事故对两辆车都没造成什么损坏。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Writing a letter or reading a book may appear to be ________ activities in which individuals exercise personal skills.
questions.explanation: solitary 意为“独处的、单独进行的”，写信和读书看似是个人独自运用个人技能的活动，与 in which individuals exercise personal skills 呼应；scarce 稀缺的，sophisticated 复杂精密的，sincere 真诚的。句意：写信或读书看似是独自进行的活动，个人在其中运用自身技能。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He took her hand and felt the scar on her thumb, ________ of an accident with a kitchen knife in the early days of their marriage.
questions.explanation: legacy 意为“留下的痕迹、遗留物”，拇指上的疤痕是新婚初期一次厨房刀伤留下的印记；mode 方式，premise 前提，signature 签名。句意：他握住她的手，摸到她拇指上的疤痕——那是新婚初期被厨房用刀弄伤留下的印记。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If you ________ your children well, you will be proud of them.
questions.explanation: bring up 意为“抚养、养育”，如果你把孩子抚养得好，你会为他们骄傲；catch up 赶上，take up 占用/开始从事，grow up 长大（主语应是孩子本人）。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The old-fashioned chair in the living room has been ________ from my great grandmother.
questions.explanation: hand down 意为“把……传下来（代代相传）”，客厅里那把老式椅子是从曾祖母那里传下来的；hand over 移交，hand out 分发，hand in 上交。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Whenever we planned our vacations, our mother could always offer some ________ suggestions.
questions.explanation: practical 意为“实用的、切实可行的”，practical suggestions 实用的建议；careful 仔细的，effective 有效的，efficient 高效的。句意：每当计划度假时，母亲总能提出一些切实可行的建议。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: In those days, our ________ concern was to provide people who were stopped by the snowstorm with food.
questions.explanation: primary 意为“首要的”，primary concern 首要关注的事情，与后文“was to provide...food”这一头等大事呼应；normal 正常的，constant 持续不断的，permanent 永久的。句意：那些日子，我们首要关心的是给被暴风雪困住的人提供食物。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —What’s happened to Jack? —When climbing the hill, he was knocked unconscious by an ________ rolling stone.
questions.explanation: unexpected 意为“意外的”，杰克爬山时被一块意想不到的滚落的石头砸晕；untouched 未被触碰的，unfamiliar 不熟悉的，unbelievable 难以置信的。句意：——杰克怎么了？——爬山时他被一块意外滚落的石头砸昏了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Mary, I think I’ll have to turn to you because chemist is ________ physics.
options: a subject the same difficult as
questions.explanation: 框架：as...as 结构中夹有名词时用“as + 形容词 + a/an + 单数名词 + as”，即 as difficult a subject as physics；A 冠词位置错误，B 语序错误，D 的 the same difficult subject as 结构不规范。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I think the whole paper has to be rewritten; only the first few paragraphs may be ________.
questions.explanation: retain 意为“保留、留住”，整篇论文都得重写，只有开头几段可以保留；sustain 维持/支撑，contain 包含，maintain 维护/维持（秩序、设备等）。句意：我认为整篇论文都得重写，只有开头几段或许可以保留。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The boat ________, throwing the boys into the water.
questions.explanation: turn over 意为“翻倒、倾覆”，小船翻倒了，把男孩们甩进水里；turn on 打开，turn down 调低/拒绝，turn off 关掉。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is widely recognized that beauty ________ not only in appearance but also in heart.
questions.explanation: lie in 意为“在于”，美不仅在于外表，也在于心灵；take/sit/give 均不与 in 搭配表达“存在于”义。句意：人们普遍认为，美不仅在于外表，还在于内心。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Students with financial problems are troubled by high tuition ________.
questions.explanation: tuition fees 为固定搭配，意为“学费”；有经济困难的学生为高额学费所困；money 泛指金钱，costs 指成本/花费，prices 指商品价格。句意：有经济困难的学生为高额的学费所困扰。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Don’t touch that wire; it’s ________.
questions.explanation: live 作形容词（读作/laɪv/）意为“带电的”，live wire 即带电的电线，所以别碰那根电线；alive 活着的（表语形容词，指生物），living 活的，lively 活泼的。句意：别碰那根电线，它带电。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Reducing the size of classes in schools is a ________ aim in the near future.
questions.explanation: desirable 意为“可取的、值得实现的”，缩小学校班级规模是近期一个值得追求的目标；delightful 令人愉快的，dynamic 有活力的，deliberate 故意的。句意：缩小学校班级规模是近期一个理想的目标。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ can be good at something for 40 years if he doesn’t love it.
questions.explanation: nobody 为否定意义的不定代词，作主语谓语用单数：如果不热爱，没有人能把一件事做精 40 年；anybody/everybody/somebody 均为肯定指代，与条件 if he doesn't love it 矛盾。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She can’t speak Spanish so she felt a bit ________ among a group of Latin American visitors.
questions.explanation: out of place 意为“格格不入、局促不安”，她不会西班牙语，在一群拉美访客中感到不自在；out of order （设备）出故障，out of date 过时，out of sight 看不见。句意：她不会说西班牙语，所以在一群拉丁美洲访客中间感到有些不自在。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Dinner will be ready ________. Let’s go and wash our hands.
questions.explanation: right away 意为“立刻、马上”，晚饭马上就好，我们去洗手吧；not at all 一点也不，at least 至少，just now 刚才（与过去时连用）。句意：晚饭马上就好了，我们去洗手吧。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was hard work, but they ________ to it and got the job done.
questions.explanation: stick to 意为“坚持”，工作很辛苦，但他们坚持了下来并完成了任务；adjust to 适应，follow 无 follow to 搭配，continue to 后须接动词原形。句意：这活儿很辛苦，但他们坚持干下去，把工作完成了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Although buses are ________ to depart at a certain hour, they are often late.
questions.explanation: be scheduled to do 意为“定于（按时刻表）做某事”，公交车虽然定时发车，却常常晚点；be obligated to 多指人负有义务，requested 被要求，loaded 装载。句意：虽然公交车按规定时间发车，但它们经常晚点。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She grabbed me ________ and pulled me out of the taxi.
questions.explanation: 固定结构“动词 + sb + by the + 身体部位”（grab sb by the arm 抓住某人的手臂），该结构中身体部位前用定冠词 the 而不用物主代词；a arm 冠词与名词不匹配，an arm/the arm 缺介词 by。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: At our factory there are a few machines similar to ________ described in this magazine.
questions.explanation: 框架：those 用于比较中替代带后置修饰的复数名词，避免重复，同类不同一；machines similar to those described in this magazine 即类似这本杂志所描述的那些机器；them 不能带后置修饰语，ones 前需有修饰语，these 为近指代词不妥。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She devoted herself ________ to her research and it earned her a good reputation in her field.
questions.explanation: devote oneself entirely to 意为“全身心地投入”，她全身心投入研究，这为她赢得了领域内的好名声；strongly 强烈地，extremely 极其，freely 自由地。句意：她全身心地投入研究，这为她在自己的领域赢得了良好声誉。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Don’t defend him any more. It’s obvious that he ________ destroyed the fence of the garden even without apology.
questions.explanation: deliberately 意为“故意地”，别再为他辩护了，显然他是故意毁坏花园围栏的，连道歉都没有；accidentally 意外地，carelessly 粗心地，clumsily 笨拙地。句意：别再为他辩护了。很明显他是故意毁坏花园的围栏的，甚至都不道歉。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: This year’s fall in profits was not unexpected. ________, it is very disappointing.
questions.explanation: nevertheless（连接副词）意为“尽管如此、然而”，表达让步转折：今年利润下降虽在意料之中，但仍然非常令人失望；But 是并列连词，不能独立用于句号后接逗号，Otherwise 意为否则，However 表一般对照，此处“在意料之中却仍失望”的让步逻辑以 Nevertheless 最贴切。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Shirley, a real book lover, often brings home many books to read ________ the library.
questions.explanation: bring...from... 表示“从……带来”，雪莉常从图书馆借许多书带回家读；in/by/for 均不能表达来源。句意：雪莉是个真正的书迷，经常从图书馆带许多书回家读。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Referring to reading, we must have ________ patience to read a book so that we will have ________ deep understanding of it.
questions.explanation: patience 后接不定式 to read a book 作后置定语，特指“读书的耐心”，用 the patience to read...；understanding 受 deep 修饰时为“a deep understanding（of）”深刻的理解，用不定冠词 a。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It seems that living green is ________ easy and affordable. A small step makes a big difference.
questions.explanation: surprisingly 意为“出奇地、惊人地”，践行绿色生活似乎出奇地容易和便宜，呼应“一小步带来大改变”；exactly 确切地，fortunately 幸运地，hardly 几乎不。句意：践行绿色生活似乎出奇地容易又不贵。一小步就能带来大不同。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The new model costs twice ________ last year’s.
questions.explanation: 倍数表达框架：倍数放最前面 + as much as，即 costs twice as much as last year's（花费是去年的两倍）；twice more 不规范，many 不能修饰不可数的花费，单用 than 缺少 more。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: No one should enter the spot without the ________ of the police.
questions.explanation: the 与 of 之间需填名词，permission 意为“许可”（不可数），the permission of the police 即警方的许可；permit 作名词意为“许可证（文件）”，permitting 为动名词。句意：未经警方许可，任何人不得进入现场。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I haven’t seen Sara since she was a little girl, and she has changed beyond ________.
questions.explanation: beyond recognition 意为“变得认不出来”，自萨拉小时候起就没见过她，她变得让人认不出了；beyond hearing/strength/measure 均不与 change 构成固定搭配。句意：从萨拉小时候起我就没见过她，她已经变得让人认不出了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: As the world’s population continues to grow, the ________ of food becomes more and more of a concern.
questions.explanation: supply 意为“供应”，the supply of food 粮食供应，随世界人口持续增长，粮食供应日益令人担忧；worth 价值，package 包装，list 清单。句意：随着世界人口持续增长，粮食供应问题越来越令人担忧。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It’s dangerous. You ________ leave the room immediately! 二、语法部分
questions.explanation: 框架：shall 表示命令、警告、威胁、强制等，一般用于第二、三人称的陈述句中；语境危险，“You shall leave the room immediately!” 用 shall 表命令警告；will 表意愿，can 表能力，would 表委婉或过去将来。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: They didn’t go home ________ they had finished the task.
questions.explanation: not...until 为时间状语从句固定结构，意为“直到……才”：他们直到完成任务才回家；since 自从（与完成时连用），unless 除非，because 因为，均不符合 not...until 结构。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ he will enter the speech contest has not been decided yet.
questions.explanation: 句首主语从句表“是否”，框架：whether 引导主语从句表“是否”，不作成分且不可省略；if 引导主语从句不能置于句首，that 引导从句表既定事实、与“尚未决定”矛盾，which 无所指。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The old man ________ dead in the snow the next morning.
questions.explanation: the old man 是动词 find 的承受者（老人“被发现”死在雪地里），须用被动语态 was found；found 为主动形式，was finding 进行式不用于 find 这类状态义动词，had found 缺少“过去的过去”依据。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It's time that we ________ to take care of our own house.
questions.explanation: 框架：It's (high/about) time (that) sb. did sth. 或 sb. should do sth.（should 不可省略），意为“是时候该做某事了”；选项中没有 should，故选过去式 began。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Mr. Jones enjoys ________ his children out for long walks.
questions.explanation: enjoy 属于固定接动名词作宾语的动词：enjoy doing sth.，不接不定式；故 Mr. Jones enjoys taking his children out for long walks。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He ________ from college three years ago, but now he is the boss of a large business.
questions.explanation: 时间标志 three years ago（三年前）是明确的过去时间点，谓语用一般过去时 graduated；has graduated 现在完成时不能与 ago 连用，graduate/graduates 主语为第三人称单数且时态不符。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Henry waved to his sister, ________ was just getting off a bus.
questions.explanation: 逗号后为非限制性定语从句，框架：非限制性定语从句不能用 that；先行词 his sister 指人且在从句中作主语，关系代词用 who；which 指物，whose 后须接名词。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was not until the accident happened ________.
options: when my carelessness has been realized
questions.explanation: 框架：It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其他；It was not until... that... 是 not...until 结构的强调句型，即“直到事故发生我才意识到自己的粗心”，故选 that I realized my carelessness。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ the opportunity, everyone of us will be a success.
questions.explanation: “given + 名词”为固定表达，意为“如果得到……”；逻辑主语 we 与 give 之间是被动关系（我们被给予机会），故用过去分词 Given 作条件状语；Giving 表主动，与句意相悖。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ more careful, his ship would not have sunk.
options: If the captain would have been
questions.explanation: 框架：虚拟倒装“一省二提”，if 从句含 had/were/should 时省略 if 并将其提至句首；主句 would not have sunk 表明是对过去的虚拟，从句应为 if the captain had been，省 if 提 Had，即 Had the captain been more careful。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: By lip reading or watching the movements of the speaker's lips, a deaf person can actually see ________ the person at the other telephone is saying.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句中 is saying 缺宾语，框架：从句不完整、缺主宾表时选连接代词 what（= the thing(s) that），即“听见电话那头的人在说什么”；that 不作成分无词义，how/where 为连接副词，填补不了宾语空缺。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: All the while he was terrified by the fear ________ he had cancer of the stomach.
questions.explanation: 框架：同位语从句的标志是抽象名词 + 完整从句；fear 为抽象名词，从句 he had cancer of the stomach 结构完整，用 that 仅起连接作用说明 fear 的内容；which/what/where 均不符合。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Five days ________ enough for us to complete the assignment.
questions.explanation: 框架：表示时间、价格、距离等复数名词作主语被视为一个整体，谓语用单数；Five days（五天时间）为整体概念，系动词用 is，即 Five days is enough。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: All the things ________ , his proposal is of greater value than yours.
questions.explanation: 独立主格结构“名词 + 过去分词”：things 与 consider 为被动关系（事情被考虑），All the things considered 即“把所有情况都考虑在内”；considering 是介词“考虑到”不能带逻辑主语，to consider/consider 均不能构成独立主格。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ I accept the gift or refuse it is none of your business.
questions.explanation: 句首主语从句 whether...or... 意为“是……还是……”：我收下礼物还是拒绝它都不关你的事；if 引导主语从句不能置于句首，even if 即使，no matter when 无论何时，均不符。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: You ________ the difficulties after I explain the whole thing to you.
questions.explanation: 框架“主将从现”：after 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时 explain 表将来，主句用一般将来时 will see；will be seen 被动不合句意（你主动“看清”困难），will have seen 缺将来完成的时间依据，see 现在时与 after 从句搭配不当。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If I had a car of my own, I ________ it to Maria last week.
questions.explanation: 框架：错综时间虚拟“各司其职，各顾各的”；从句 If I had a car 表对现在的虚拟，主句时间标志 last week 指过去，故主句用 would have lent；如果我有自己的车，上周就会借给玛丽亚了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The government is believed ________ passing a law making it a crime to import any kind of weapon.
questions.explanation: sb is believed to do 为固定结构；government 是 consider 的执行者且“正在考虑”，用主动进行式 to be considering；to be considered 被动与句意相悖（政府是考虑方），considering/considered 不能直接接在 is believed 后。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: In the last few years, thousands of films ________ all over the world.
questions.explanation: 时间标志 In the last few years 对应现在完成时；films 与 produce 为被动关系（电影“被”拍摄出来），故用 have been produced；have produced 缺被动，are producing/are being produced 的现在进行与该时间标志不符。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She said that the doctor must have got stuck in a traffic jam, otherwise he ________ by then.
questions.explanation: 框架：含蓄条件句，otherwise（否则）暗含虚拟条件；by then 指过去某时之前，主句须用 would have arrived，即“否则他那时就该到了”（事实是没到）；would arrive/should arrive 时态不符，must have arrived 是推测而非虚拟结果。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: A ship was reported _______ off the east coast of Kenya in February, 2018.
questions.explanation: sb/sth is reported to do 为固定结构；袭击发生在 2018 年 2 月，先于“据报道”这一谓语动作，不定式用完成式；ship 与 attack 为被动关系（船“被”袭击），故用 to have been attacked。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______ a satisfactory respond, the young scientist decided to write again.
questions.explanation: 框架：分词动作先于主句动作发生用 having done，否定式将 not 置于其前，即 Not having received；这位年轻科学家是在“没收到满意答复”之后才“决定再写一次”；Receiving not/Having not received 的否定位置错误。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He hurried to the airport only _______ that the flight had just taken off.
questions.explanation: 框架：不定式作结果状语 only to do 表示“出乎意料的结果”；he 与 tell 为被动关系（他“被告知”），故用 to be told；他赶到机场却被告知航班刚刚起飞。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Mr. Smith insisted that the work _______ finished by the end of April.
questions.explanation: 框架：名词性从句中的虚拟——insist（坚决要求）后接的宾语从句谓语用“(should) + 动词原形”；work 与 finish 为被动关系，用 (should) be finished，故选 be；had been/was/were 均不符合虚拟要求。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If you stick to _______ the piano every day, you will become quite a good musician.
questions.explanation: 框架特别提示：stick to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词，即 stick to doing sth.（类似 be used to doing、look forward to doing）；stick to practice 及完成式、进行式均不符合。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He used _______ on the right in China, but he soon got used _______ on the left in England.
questions.explanation: 框架：used to do sth. 意为“过去常常做某事”；be/get used to doing sth. 意为“习惯于做某事”（to 为介词）；他在中国习惯靠右 used to drive，在英国很快习惯了靠左 got used to driving。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I have found some articles _______ the harmful effects of drinking.
questions.explanation: concerning 在此处是介词，意为“关于”，articles concerning the harmful effects of drinking 意为“关于饮酒有害影响的文章”。concerned 作定语需与 with/about 连用才能接宾语，being concerned 与 to concern 不符合语法。整句：我找到了一些关于饮酒有害影响的文章。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We left the meeting, there obviously _______ no point in staying.
questions.explanation: 逗号后无连词，不能再用谓语动词，需用独立主格结构作原因状语：there being no point in staying（there be 的分词形式 there being）。整句：我们离开了会场，显然再待下去已毫无意义。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Here _______ a pen, a few envelopes and some paper for you.
questions.explanation: Here 开头构成完全倒装，谓语动词与 be 后面的主语按就近原则保持一致：最近的主语 a pen 是单数，故用 is。整句：这儿有一支钢笔、几个信封和一些纸给你。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: No one _______ the building without the permission of the police.
questions.explanation: “be + to do”表示命令、规定或义务，“未经警方许可谁也不得离开大楼”正是这种用法；is leaving / will be leaving 表进行或安排，has left 表已完成，均不合句意。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Seldom _______ from my brother since we moved here.
questions.explanation: Seldom 等否定副词位于句首时句子要部分倒装，即助动词提到主语之前；since we moved here 提示谓语用现在完成时，故为 have we received。整句：自从搬到这儿后，我很少收到哥哥的来信。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The other day, Mum and I went to St. James’s Hospital, and they did lots and lots of tests on me, _______ are horrible and frightening.
questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，先行词是 tests（物），“most of + 关系代词”结构中指物只能用 which，that/what 不能用于介词后的非限制性定语从句，them 不是关系词。整句：前几天妈妈和我去了圣詹姆斯医院，他们给我做了许多检查，其中大多数都让人害怕。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He has made another wonderful discovery, _______ of great importance to science and man.
options: of which I think it is
questions.explanation: 逗号后为非限制性定语从句，which 指代 discovery 作从句主语，I think 是插入语，which is of great importance（be of + 名词表示“具有……”）；其余选项语序或结构错误。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______ I was trying to do is to persuade my brother to give up smoking.
questions.explanation: “____ I was trying to do”是主语从句，从句中 do 缺宾语，指物且充当成分的引导词只能用 what；that 引导名词性从句时不作成分。整句：我正在努力做的就是劝我哥哥戒烟。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The manager _______ a rise in salary for ages, but nothing has happened yet.
questions.explanation: for ages 与 but nothing has happened yet 表明“承诺加薪”从过去持续到现在且未结束，应用现在完成进行时 has been promising。整句：经理一直承诺要加薪，到现在还没有动静。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The fact has worried many scientists _______ the earth is becoming warmer and warmer these years.
questions.explanation: The fact 后接同位语从句解释其内容，从句 the earth is becoming warmer and warmer 结构完整、意义完整，用只起连接作用的 that；what/which 需在从句中作成分，though 表让步。整句：地球这些年正变得越来越暖这一事实使许多科学家担忧。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I could have called you yesterday, but I _______ your telephone number.
questions.explanation: 前句 could have called 表示“本来可以打电话”（与过去事实相反的虚拟），but 转折后陈述真实情况须用陈述语气：昨天没打电话是因为当时没有号码，用一般过去时 didn't have。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She studied hard at school when she was young, _______ contributed to her success in later life.
questions.explanation: 逗号后为非限制性定语从句，which 指代前面整个主句“她年轻时学习刻苦”这件事并在从句中作主语；that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，therefore 是副词不能引导从句。整句：她年轻时学习刻苦，这促成了她后来事业的成功。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______ is often the case, one third of the workers have over-fulfilled the production plan.
questions.explanation: as 引导非限制性定语从句指代整个主句，意为“正如”，As is often the case 是固定表达“正如常有的情况那样”；what 不能引导定语从句，this/that 不是关系词。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Since Dick was busy, he rarely had time to go to the cinema; _______.
questions.explanation: 前句 rarely 表否定，表示“Jane 也没时间”应用 nor + 助动词 + 主语的倒装结构 nor did Jane；so 倒装只用于肯定句，did too 与 didn't as well 不能呼应否定句。整句：既然 Dick 很忙，他很少有时间去看电影，Jane 也是如此。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The May Day Holiday _______ over, we must now get down to work.
questions.explanation: 逗号前没有连词，不能选谓语动词，The May Day Holiday being over 是独立主格结构（名词 + being + 表语）作原因状语。整句：五一假期结束了，我们现在必须着手工作。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He was very sorry _______ her at the airport.
questions.explanation: 不定式的否定式是 not + to do；机场没接到她发生在 was sorry 之前，应用不定式完成式，故为 not to have met。整句：他非常后悔没能在机场接到她。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The news _______ the Chinese football team had won the match excited all of us.
questions.explanation: The news 后是同位语从句，从句 the Chinese football team had won the match 结构完整，用只起连接作用的 that；which/what 需在从句中作成分，as 不用于此。整句：中国足球队获胜的消息使我们大家非常激动。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: There is a nice-looking car there. Peter wonders _______.
questions.explanation: wonders 后是宾语从句，必须用陈述语序，排除 B、D；belong to 的宾语指人用 whom，A 项 it belongs to who 语序错误。整句：那儿有一辆漂亮的车，Peter 想知道它是谁的。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The manager of the company insisted that all the staff members _______ the new safety rules.
questions.explanation: insist 表“坚决要求”时其宾语从句要用虚拟语气“（should +）动词原形”，should 可省略，故用 observe。整句：公司经理坚决要求全体员工遵守新的安全规定。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Not until yesterday _______ any idea of what a guided rocket is like.
questions.explanation: Not until 位于句首时主句要部分倒装；yesterday 表明是一般过去时，借助动词 did 构成 did I have。整句：直到昨天我才对导弹是什么样子有一点概念。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______ breaks the law will be punished sooner or later.
questions.explanation: “____ breaks the law”是主语从句且缺主语，whoever（= anyone who）既引导从句又充当从句主语；who 引导名词性从句表疑问“谁”，anyone/someone 不能引导从句。整句：无论谁触犯法律，迟早都会受到惩罚。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I think it's high time we _______ strict measures to stop pollution.
questions.explanation: “It's (high) time that sb. did sth”是固定虚拟结构，意为“是时候该做某事了”，从句谓语用过去式，故用 took。整句：我认为现在是我们采取严格措施制止污染的时候了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______ last Friday, he would have got to Paris.
questions.explanation: 主句 would have got 表明是与过去事实相反的虚拟；从句含 had 时可省略 if 并将 had 提到句首构成虚拟倒装，即 Had he left last Friday（= If he had left）。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: When you have finished with that videotape, don't forget to put it in my drawer, _______?
questions.explanation: 祈使句（包括否定祈使句 Don't...）的反义疑问句用 will you；let's 开头的祈使句才用 shall we。整句：你看完那盘录像带后，别忘了把它放进我的抽屉，好吗？

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: In the road accident the other day three people _______, including the driver.
questions.explanation: the other day 是过去时间标志，three people 与 kill 是被动关系（人被撞死），故用一般过去时的被动语态 were killed；A、D 为主动语态，C 时态错误。整句：前几天那起车祸中有三人丧生，包括司机。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Jim's job is to keep his boss _______ of the latest development of that product in Europe.
questions.explanation: “keep + 宾语 + 过去分词”表示宾语与分词之间的被动关系，keep sb informed of sth 意为“让某人随时了解某事”，boss 与 inform 是被动关系。整句：Jim 的工作是让老板随时了解该产品在欧洲的最新进展。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Young _______ he is, he has proved to be an able salesman.
questions.explanation: as 引导让步状语从句时需倒装，把表语形容词提到 as 之前，Young as he is = Although he is young；that/which/who 无此用法。整句：虽然他很年轻，但他已被证明是一名能干的推销员。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______ the Water Cube, we were then taken to see the Bird's Nest.
questions.explanation: then 及被动语态 were taken 表明“参观水立方”发生在主句动作之前，分词动作先于谓语动词用完成式 having done，逻辑主语 we 与 visit 为主动关系。整句：参观完水立方之后，我们接着被带去参观鸟巢。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The young man _______ visited our school this morning is Maria's brother.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the young man 指人，从句 visited our school 缺主语，关系代词用 who；which 指物，whose 表所属后须接名词，what 不能引导定语从句。整句：今天上午来我们学校参观的那个年轻人是 Maria 的哥哥。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I'm awfully tired and can't go any farther, Ted. Let's have a rest, _______?
questions.explanation: Let's 开头的祈使句，其反义疑问句固定用 shall we；will you 用于 let's 以外的祈使句。整句：Ted，我太累了走不动了，我们休息一下好吗？

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It's no use _______ for a doctor. It's too late already.
questions.explanation: “It's no use doing sth”是固定句型，意为“做某事没有用”，动名词 sending 作真正主语，it 作形式主语。整句：去请医生已经没用了，太晚了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I know you're planning to travel this summer, but do you know ________?
options: how much cost it will be
questions.explanation: know 后是宾语从句，必须用陈述语序（主语 it 在谓语之前），排除 A、B、D；travel this summer 提示用将来时 will cost。整句：我知道你计划今年夏天去旅行，但你知道要花多少钱吗？

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Childish ________ she may be, she is kind and friendly.
questions.explanation: as 引导让步状语从句需倒装，把表语 Childish 提到 as 之前，Childish as she may be = Although she may be childish；although/if/however 均无此倒装结构。整句：尽管她可能有点孩子气，但她善良友好。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Tony was very unhappy for ________ to the party.
questions.explanation: 动名词的否定式为 not + doing；“被邀请”用被动，且邀请发生在 was unhappy 之前，用完成被动式 having been invited，故为 not having been invited。整句：Tony 因没有被邀请参加聚会而非常不高兴。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Is this the factory ________ you visited the other day?
questions.explanation: visited 是及物动词，从句缺宾语，应选关系代词；先行词 the factory 指物，用 that（或 which）；where 是关系副词，要求从句结构完整，不符。整句：这是你前几天参观的那家工厂吗？

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: There is only one thing ________ I can do.
questions.explanation: 先行词 thing 前有 the only 修饰时，关系代词只能用 that，不能用 which；what 不能引导定语从句，all 不是关系词。整句：我只有一件事可做。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Mary ________ like to surf the Internet. She often spends hours on line.
questions.explanation: 强调谓语动词时在动词前加助动词 do/does/did；句子为一般现在时且主语 Mary 是第三人称单数，故用 does，does like 意为“确实喜欢”。整句：Mary 确实喜欢上网，她经常一上网就几个小时。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Hard as they try, these birds have ________ small wings that they can not fly.
questions.explanation: “so + 形容词 + that”引导结果状语从句，wings 前的 small 是形容词，故用 so；such 后须接名词短语（such small wings）。整句：尽管这些鸟努力尝试，但它们的翅膀太小，以至于不能飞。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Not until I began to work did I realize how much time I ________.
questions.explanation: “浪费”发生在“意识到”（过去 realized）之前，属于“过去的过去”，应用过去完成时 had wasted。整句：直到开始工作我才意识到自己浪费了多少时间。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was the training that he had as a young man ________ made him such a good engineer.
questions.explanation: 本句是强调句 It was + 被强调部分 + that...，被强调部分是 the training（其后 that he had as a young man 是定语从句）；去掉强调结构后 the training made him a good engineer 仍成立，故强调部分后用 that。整句：正是年轻时接受的训练使他成为一名如此优秀的工程师。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: European football is played in 80 countries, ________ it the most popular sport in the world.
questions.explanation: 句中已有谓语 is played，逗号后用非谓语；making it the most popular sport 是现在分词短语作结果状语，逻辑主语 European football 与 make 为主动关系。整句：欧式足球在 80 个国家开展，这使它成为世界上最受欢迎的运动。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The professor acts as if he ________ a king of a great kingdom.
questions.explanation: as if 引导的方式状语从句表示与现在事实相反的情况时用虚拟语气，be 动词一律用 were，故选 were。整句：这位教授的举止好像他是一个大帝国的国王。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We have to get the road repaired ________.
options: no matter how much does it cost
no matter how much costs it
no matter how much it costs
no matter it costs how much
questions.explanation: no matter how 引导让步状语从句，从句内必须用陈述语序（主语 it 在谓语 costs 之前），故为 no matter how much it costs；A、B、D 语序错误。整句：无论花多少钱，我们都得把这条路修好。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If she ________ some information, she could have answered the questions.
questions.explanation: 主句 could have answered 表明是与过去事实相反的虚拟，从句应用 had done；she 与 give 是被动关系（被给予信息），故用 had been given。整句：如果她当时得到一些信息，她本可以回答这些问题。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: John, together with some of American soldiers who ________ sent to Iraq ________ killed in a bomb explosion.
questions.explanation: 第一空 who 指代复数的 soldiers，从句谓语用 were sent；第二空主语 John 后的 together with... 是附加成分，谓语遵循就远原则与 John 保持一致，用 was killed。整句：John 和一些被派往伊拉克的美军士兵一起在炸弹爆炸中丧生。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We expressed our hope ________ they could come to visit Shanghai sometime next year.
questions.explanation: hope 后是同位语从句，从句 they could come to visit Shanghai 完整，用只起连接作用的 that；whether/if 表“是否”，what 需作成分，均不符。整句：我们表示希望他们明年某个时候能来上海参观。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The number of people invited ________ fifty, but a number of them ________ absent for different reasons.
questions.explanation: “the number of + 复数名词”意为“……的数量”，谓语用单数 was；“a number of + 复数名词”意为“许多”，谓语用复数 were。整句：受邀人数是五十人，但其中许多人因不同原因缺席。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Nobody but Jane ________ the secret.
questions.explanation: 主语 Nobody 后的 but Jane 是附加成分，谓语遵循就远原则与 Nobody 保持一致用单数 knows；know 是主动关系，不选被动 is known。整句：除了 Jane 没人知道这个秘密。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The new policy, ________ is about the tax reduction, is to be carried out next month.
questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，先行词 policy 指物，非限制性定语从句不能用 that，只能用 which；what 不引导定语从句，it 不能引导从句。整句：这项关于减税的新政策将于下个月实施。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —By the way, when did you get your living room ________? —Last Sunday.
questions.explanation: “get + 宾语 + 过去分词”表示“使某物被……”，living room 与 paint 是被动关系，故用 painted。整句：——顺便问一下，你什么时候粉刷的客厅？——上周日。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I'm sorry I have made so many mistakes. I wish I ________.
questions.explanation: wish 后的宾语从句用虚拟语气；“已经犯了这么多错”表示与过去事实相反的愿望，用 had done 的否定式，故选 hadn't（= hadn't made）。整句：对不起我犯了这么多错误，真希望我没犯过。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Mary is said ________ abroad, but I don't know what country she studied in.
questions.explanation: “sb. is said to do”结构中，studied 表明“留学”发生在 is said 之前，不定式要用完成式 to have done，故为 to have studied。整句：据说 Mary 曾在国外留学，但我不知道她在哪个国家学习。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Evidence came up ________ specific speech sounds are recognized by babies as young as 6 months old.
questions.explanation: Evidence 后是同位语从句（被 came up 隔开），从句 specific speech sounds are recognized... 结构完整，用 that 引导；what/which 需在从句中作成分，whose 表所属。整句：有证据表明，只有 6 个月大的婴儿就能识别特定的语音。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ when she started complaining.
questions.explanation: “hardly had sb. done... when...”是固定结构，意为“刚……就……”，hardly 引导的部分用过去完成时且部分倒装，when 后接一般过去时；no sooner 须与 than 搭配，B、D 结构不符。整句：他刚到，她就开始抱怨了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I am considering ________ to the Yellow Mountain. Do you consider it a good idea ________ there?
questions.explanation: consider 表示“考虑”时后接动名词 consider doing；consider it a good idea to do 中 it 作形式宾语，真正的宾语是不定式 to go。故第一空用 going，第二空用 to go。整句：我正在考虑去黄山，你觉得去那儿是个好主意吗？

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: This is the best novel that I ________ in this field.
questions.explanation: 最高级 the best novel 隐含“到目前为止”的比较范围，强调对现在的影响，谓语用现在完成时；主语是 I，故为 have read。整句：这是我在这个领域读过的最好的小说。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I don't think lunch is a good time to get together; ________.
questions.explanation: 前句是否定句，表示“晚餐也不合适”应用 nor/neither + 助动词 + 主语的倒装结构 nor is dinner；so 倒装只用于肯定句，其余选项结构错误。整句：我认为午饭时间不适合聚会，晚餐时间也不合适。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Obviously they didn't see the significance of the plan. That's ________ the problem was.
questions.explanation: That's 后是表语从句，从句 the problem was 缺表语，where（意为“问题所在之处”）充当表语补足句子；why 引导时从句须结构完整，不合。整句：显然他们没看到这个计划的重要性，那就是问题所在。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: What ________ news it is!
questions.explanation: news 是不可数名词，感叹句用“What + (形容词) + 不可数名词”结构，不加冠词 a/an，故为 What interesting news it is! 整句：多么有趣的消息啊！

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If ________，the experiment will be successful.
questions.explanation: if 引导的条件状语从句中，当主从句主语一致且从句谓语含 be 时可省略“主语 + be”，完整形式为 If (it is) done carefully；experiment 与 do 是被动关系，故用过去分词 done carefully。整句：如果操作仔细，实验将会成功。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Child ________ he is, he knows a lot about scientific knowledge.
questions.explanation: as 引导让步状语从句需倒装，将名词 Child（不带冠词）提到 as 之前，Child as he is = Although he is a child；although/even though 引导让步从句不倒装，even 不是连词。整句：虽然他还是个孩子，但他懂得很多科学知识。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: This student managed to pass the difficult exam, ________ surprised all of us.
questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，which 指代整个主句“这个学生通过了难度很大的考试”这件事并在从句中作主语；that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，it/what 不能引导从句。整句：这个学生成功通过了这次难度很大的考试，这让我们都很惊讶。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: There are many kinds of steel, each ________ its special uses in industry.
questions.explanation: 逗号后没有连词和谓语，“each having its special uses”是独立主格结构（each + 现在分词）作补充说明；has/had/will have 是谓语动词，不能与主句直接相连。整句：钢有许多种类，每种在工业上都有其特殊用途。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I wish you ________ him my telephone number, but you did.
questions.explanation: but you did 表明“你把号码给他了”是过去事实，wish 后从句表示与过去事实相反的愿望应用 had done 的否定式 hadn't given；A 项 didn't given 形式错误。整句：真希望你没把我的电话号码给他，但你还是给了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: My sister, as well as her classmates who ________ late for class, ________ criticized by Mr. Hunt.
questions.explanation: 第一空 who 指代复数的 classmates，从句谓语用 were late；第二空主语 My sister 后的 as well as... 是附加成分，谓语遵循就远原则与 My sister 保持一致用 was criticized。整句：我妹妹和那些上课迟到的同学一起被 Hunt 先生批评了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The results of the examination ________ that you have all made great ________.
questions.explanation: 主语 The results 是复数，谓语用 show；progress 意为“进步”时是不可数名词，没有复数形式，固定搭配为 make great progress。整句：考试结果表明你们都取得了很大进步。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: No matter how ________，it's impossible that he has never lost money.
questions.explanation: no matter how 引导让步状语从句，“how + 形容词 + a/an + 单数名词 + 主谓”是固定语序，即 how smart a businessman is；其余选项语序错误。整句：无论这个商人多么精明，他从没亏过钱是不可能的。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Not a single song ________ at yesterday's party.
questions.explanation: 否定意义的 Not a single song 位于句首，句子要部分倒装，即助动词 did 提到主语 she 之前构成 did she sing；A、D 为陈述语序，B 项 sang she 倒装形式错误。整句：昨天的晚会上她一首歌都没唱。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —David has made great progress recently. —__________, and ____________.
options: So he has; so you have
So he has; so have you
So has he; so have you
So has he; so you have
questions.explanation: “so + 主语 + 助动词”表示“确实如此”（前后同一主语，不倒装），David 进步了，回答用 So he has；“so + 助动词 + 主语”表示“某人也一样”（前后主语不同，倒装），指对方用 so have you。整句：——David 最近进步很大。——确实如此，你也一样。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I was walking along the road ____________ suddenly someone patted me on the shoulder from behind.
questions.explanation: “be doing... when...”是固定结构，when 意为“这时（突然）”，表示正在进行的动作被突然发生的事打断；immediately/the moment 表“一……就”，while 不接瞬间动作。整句：我正沿着路走着，这时突然有人从背后拍了拍我的肩膀。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —There is little milk in the milk bag, ____________? —I’ll get you a new bag.
questions.explanation: little 表否定意义，前句为否定句，后句应用肯定形式；there be 句型的反义疑问部分与 be 动词一致，用 is there。整句：——牛奶袋里没多少牛奶了，是吗？——我给你买袋新的。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The carpet has so many stains on it that it needs ____________.
questions.explanation: need 后接动名词或不定式均可表被动含义：need doing = need to be done；选项中只有 to be replaced 是正确的被动不定式形式，being replace 形式错误。整句：这块地毯上有太多污渍，需要更换了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I sent him the package yesterday. He ____________ it by now.
questions.explanation: 昨天寄出包裹、by now 表明是对已发生情况的推测，“might have done”表示“可能已经做了某事”，故用 might have received；received/will receive/receives 无推测含义。整句：我昨天给他寄了包裹，他现在可能已经收到了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I don’t think she has gone to Beijing, ____________?
questions.explanation: I think + 宾语从句的反义疑问句按否定转移处理，从句视为否定（don't think she has gone），前否后肯；疑问部分主语与从句主语 she 一致，故为 has she。整句：我认为她还没去北京，是吗？

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If he ____________ here yesterday, he would have seen his old friend.
questions.explanation: 主句 would have seen 表明是与过去事实相反的虚拟，从句应用 had done，yesterday 印证过去时间，故为 had come。整句：如果他昨天来了，他就会见到他的老朋友了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I won’t call you ____________ something unexpected happens.
questions.explanation: unless 意为“除非”，引导条件状语从句，主将从现，“除非发生意外，否则我不会打电话”，符合句意逻辑；whether/because/while 均不合逻辑。整句：除非发生意外情况，否则我不会给你打电话。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I wonder whether the soldier is one of those who ____________ abroad to keep peace.
questions.explanation: “one of those who...”中 who 的先行词 those 是复数，从句谓语用复数；soldiers 与 send 是被动关系（被派往国外），故用 have been sent。整句：我想知道这名士兵是否是那些被派往国外维和的人员之一。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: When Jenny came to my place, I ____________ breakfast with James.
questions.explanation: when Jenny came 是一般过去时的时间状语从句，“吃早餐”在 Jenny 到来时正在进行，应用过去进行时 was having。整句：Jenny 来我家时，我正在和 James 吃早餐。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ____________, you will never convince him.
questions.explanation: however 引导让步状语从句时须按“however + 形容词/副词 + 主谓”排列，即 However long you argue（= No matter how long you argue）；其余选项语序错误。整句：无论你争论多久，你都无法说服他。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ____________ I in your position, I would not accept the job.
questions.explanation: 这是与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句，主句 would not accept 印证虚拟；从句含 were 时可省略 if 并把 were 提到句首构成倒装：Were I in your position（= If I were in your position）。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He was ill. That’s ____________ he was sent to the hospital.
questions.explanation: That's 后是表语从句，前句“他病了”是原因，后句“被送医院”是结果，用 why 引导（这就是他为何被送医院）；because 因果倒置，what/that 不合句意。整句：他病了，那就是他被送去医院的原因。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The news ____________ we are having a holiday is not true.
questions.explanation: The news 后是同位语从句，从句 we are having a holiday 结构完整，用只起连接作用的 that；what/when 需在从句中作成分，which 不引导同位语从句。整句：我们要度假的消息不是真的。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He hurried out of the room ____________ the meeting was over.
questions.explanation: the moment 意为“一……就……”，可作连词引导时间状语从句；a moment ago/after a minute 是时间短语，不能引导从句。整句：会议一结束他就匆匆出了房间。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Would you mind ____________ me some bread on your way home?
questions.explanation: mind 后固定接动名词作宾语，would you mind doing sth 表示“你介意做某事吗”，故用 buying。整句：你回家路上介意帮我买些面包吗？

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Neither Bill nor his parents ____________ at home.
questions.explanation: neither...nor 连接并列主语时，谓语遵循就近原则与最近的主语 his parents（复数）保持一致，故用 are。整句：Bill 和他父母都不在家。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The issue needs ________ twice.
questions.explanation: need 后接动名词主动形式表被动含义（need doing = need to be done），issue 与 think 是被动关系，故用 thinking。整句：这个问题需要再三考虑。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We ________ our lives if the policeman had not helped us.
questions.explanation: if 从句用 had not helped 表明是与过去事实相反的虚拟，主句应用“would/should/could/might + have done”，故为 would have lost。整句：如果警察没有帮我们，我们就没命了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: My brother is an actor. He ________ in several films so far.
questions.explanation: so far 意为“到目前为止”，是现在完成时的标志，主语 He 是第三人称单数，故用 has appeared。整句：我哥哥是一名演员，到目前为止他已在好几部电影中出演过。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Professor Lee’s book will show you ________ can be used in other context.
questions.explanation: show you 后是宾语从句，其中 what you have observed 是主语从句充当 can be used 的主语，how 表方式修饰整个从句，即 show you how what you have observed can be used；其余搭配均不成立。整句：Lee 教授的书会告诉你如何把你观察到的用于其他语境。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I know of a place ________ we can swim.
questions.explanation: 先行词 a place 表地点，从句 we can swim 结构完整，缺少地点状语，故用关系副词 where；when 表时间，who/what 不符。整句：我知道一个可以游泳的地方。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I, ________ your good friend, will try my best to help you out.
questions.explanation: who 引导非限制性定语从句指代 I，关系代词作从句主语时谓语动词与先行词保持人称和数的一致，I 是第一人称单数，故用 who am your good friend。整句：我，作为你的好朋友，会尽力帮你摆脱困境。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: His knowledge of language and international business ________ him in his work.
questions.explanation: 主语的核心词是不可数名词 knowledge，“of language and international business”是后置定语，谓语与 knowledge 保持一致用单数 helps。整句：他的语言和国际商务知识在工作中帮助了他。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Never ________ these people are living in such poor conditions.
questions.explanation: 否定副词 Never 位于句首，句子要部分倒装，即情态动词 could 提到主语 I 之前构成 could I imagine；A、C 为陈述语序，D 项否定形式不合。整句：我从来想不到这些人生活得如此贫困。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ the English examination I would have gone to the concert last night.
questions.explanation: 主句 would have gone 表明是与过去事实相反的虚拟；“But for + 名词”（要不是……）是含蓄虚拟条件，相当于 If it hadn't been for the English examination，故选 But for。整句：要不是英语考试，昨晚我就去听音乐会了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The size of audience, ________ we had expected, was well over two thousand.
questions.explanation: as 引导非限制性定语从句指代整个主句，意为“正如”，as we had expected（正如我们所预料的那样）可置于句中；that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，who/whom 指人。整句：正如我们所预料的，观众人数远远超过两千。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —Is that the small town you often refer to? —Right, just the one ________ I used to work for years.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the one 指代 small town，从句 I used to work for years 结构完整，缺少地点状语，用关系副词 where；that/which 需在从句中作成分，不符。整句：——那是你经常提到的小镇吗？——对，就是我曾经工作多年的那个地方。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: In order to find the missing child, villagers ________ all they can over the past five hours.
questions.explanation: over the past five hours 是现在完成（进行）时的标志，all they can 表明寻找动作从过去持续到现在仍在进行，故用现在完成进行时 have been doing。整句：为了找到失踪的孩子，在过去五个小时里村民们一直在竭尽所能。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If she ________ here next Monday, I would tell her about the matter.
questions.explanation: 主句 would tell 表明是与将来事实相反的虚拟，从句用“should/were to + do”，next Monday 印证将来时间，故为 were to be。整句：如果她下周一来这里，我会告诉她这件事。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He has made a discovery, ________ of great importance to the progress of science and technology.
options: of which I think it is
questions.explanation: 逗号后为非限制性定语从句，which 指代 discovery 作从句主语，I think 为插入语，which is of great importance 用“be of + 名词”表示“具有重要性”；其余选项语序或结构错误。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Several novels by Mo Yan ________ into English so far.
questions.explanation: so far 是现在完成时的标志，novels 与 translate 是被动关系（小说被翻译），故用现在完成时的被动语态 have been translated。整句：莫言的几部小说到目前为止已被译成英文。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is imagination ________ makes the world colorful, full of vigor and vitality.
