questions.explanation: 去掉 It is...that 后 Imagination makes the world colorful 仍成立，故为强调句“It is + 被强调部分 + that...”，强调主语 imagination 用 that；what 不能用于强调句。整句：正是想象力使世界多彩，充满生机与活力。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —Does Jane still pursue her dream of becoming a movie star? —I’m afraid not. She is said ________ the stage already as she got married.
questions.explanation: “sb. is said to do”结构中，already 及 as she got married 表明“离开舞台”发生在 is said 之前，不定式用完成式；she 与 leave 是主动关系，故为 to have left。整句：——Jane 还在追求当电影明星的梦想吗？——恐怕没有了，据说她结婚后已经告别舞台了。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He made the proposal that we ________ a role play at the English evening.
questions.explanation: proposal（建议）后接同位语从句，从句谓语用“（should +）动词原形”的虚拟形式，should 可省略，故用 have。整句：他提议我们在英语晚会上表演一个角色扮演节目。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: They are all for your proposal that the discussion ________.
questions.explanation: proposal 后的 that 从句是同位语从句，谓语用“（should +）be done”的虚拟形式，discussion 与 put off 是被动关系，故为 be put off。整句：他们都支持你推迟讨论的提议。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is highly desirable that a new manager ________ for this company.
questions.explanation: “It is desirable that...”中主语从句用虚拟语气“（should +）动词原形”，manager 与 appoint 是被动关系，故用（should）be appointed，即 be appointed。整句：为这家公司任命一位新经理是非常理想的。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Our class monitor suggested ________ a discussion of the subject.
questions.explanation: suggest 表示“建议”时若接 that 从句用虚拟语气，但此处直接接动名词作宾语：suggest doing sth（建议做某事），故用 having。整句：我们班长建议就这个主题进行一次讨论。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: When father was young, he ________ from morning till night.
questions.explanation: “make sb do”变被动语态时不定式要还原 to，即 sb. be made to do，故为 was made to work。整句：父亲年轻时从早到晚被迫干活。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Without your help, we ________ so much.
questions.explanation: “Without + 名词”是含蓄虚拟条件（相当于 If you hadn't helped us），表示与过去事实相反，主句用 wouldn't have done，故为 wouldn't have achieved。整句：没有你的帮助，我们是不会取得这么大成就的。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He used to go to school by bus, ________?
questions.explanation: “used to do”的反义疑问句习惯用 didn't + 主语，故为 didn't he；used he 非规范用法，doesn't he 时态不符。整句：他过去常乘公交车上学，是吗？

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: John puts up his hand ________ the teacher asks a question.
questions.explanation: every time 意为“每次”，可作连词引导时间状语从句；in time（及时）/some time（一段时间）/at times（有时）是副词性短语，不能引导从句。整句：每次老师提问，John 都举手。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The moment ________ Leo will never forget is ________ Mr. Green gave him a lot of valuable advice on how to improve his writing.
questions.explanation: 第一空先行词 The moment 在定语从句 Leo will never forget 中作 forget 的宾语，用 that；第二空 is 后是表语从句，表示“……的时候”用 when。整句：Leo 永远不会忘记的那一刻，是 Green 先生就如何提高写作给了他许多宝贵建议的时候。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ you say, I am sure that the young man is innocent.
questions.explanation: Whatever you say（无论你说什么）引导让步状语从句，whatever 在从句中作 say 的宾语；whoever 指人，however 修饰形容词/副词，均不符。整句：无论你说什么，我确信这个年轻人是无辜的。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Only in my thirties ________ a purpose in life.
questions.explanation: “Only + 状语”（in my thirties）位于句首，句子要部分倒装；叙述过去的事用一般过去时，借助动词 did 构成 did I find。整句：直到三十多岁我才找到人生的目标。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ his telephone number, she didn't know how to get in touch with him.
questions.explanation: 句中已有谓语 didn't know，逗号前用非谓语作原因状语；she 与 forget 是主动关系，“不记得号码”与“不知道怎么联系”同时存在，用现在分词一般式 Forgetting（= Because she forgot）。整句：由于忘了他的电话号码，她不知道怎么和他联系。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: These are the pictures of the hotel ________ we held our annual meetings.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the hotel 表地点，从句 we held our annual meetings 结构完整，缺少地点状语，用关系副词 where；which/that 需在从句中作成分，when 表时间。整句：这些就是我们召开年度会议的那家酒店的照片。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Jason made sharp comments on Mary's idea, but he didn't mean ________ her.
questions.explanation: mean to do 表示“打算做某事”（mean doing 则意为“意味着”）；he 是“伤害”动作的发出者，为主动关系，故用 to hurt。整句：Jason 对 Mary 的想法提出了尖锐的批评，但他并不想伤害她。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: These apple trees, ________ I planted three years ago, have not borne any fruit.
questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，planted 缺宾语，先行词 trees 指物，只能用 which；that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，when/what 不符。整句：这些三年前我种下的苹果树还没结过果。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Don't remind me of that awful day; I ________ such a fool of myself.
questions.explanation: that awful day 指过去的具体某天，“出洋相”是过去发生的动作，用一般过去时 made。整句：别再提醒我那个糟糕的日子了，那天我出了个大洋相。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The relationship between parents and their children ________ a strong influence on the character of the children.
questions.explanation: 主语 The relationship 是单数名词，“between parents and their children”是后置定语，谓语用第三人称单数 has，have a strong influence on 表示“对……有强烈影响”。整句：父母与子女之间的关系对孩子的性格有强烈影响。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Only by telling the truth ________ win the trust and support of your friends.
questions.explanation: “Only + 介词短语”（by telling the truth）位于句首，句子要部分倒装；表示“才能”用情态动词 can，构成 can you win。整句：只有讲真话，你才能赢得朋友的信任和支持。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If it had not rained yesterday, they ________ work on time.
questions.explanation: 从句 If it had not rained yesterday 中 yesterday 是过去标志，谓语用 had done，是与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句；主句应用 would/should/could/might + have done，故选 would have finished。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: My teacher recommended that I ________ as careful as possible when I took an exam.
questions.explanation: recommend 意为“建议”，其后宾语从句要用虚拟语气，谓语为 (should)+动词原形，should 可省略，故选 be。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Was ________ that I saw last night at the concert?
questions.explanation: 这是强调句的一般疑问式 Was it + 被强调部分 + that...？本句强调宾语 you，补全为 Was it you that I saw last night at the concert?，故选 it you。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: This is the dictionary you 're looking for, ________?
questions.explanation: 陈述句主语是指示代词 this/that 时，反义疑问部分用 it 代替；前句 This is... 为肯定，后用否定 isn't it，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Teenagers ________ their health because they play computer games too much.
questions.explanation: because 从句 they play computer games too much 用一般现在时表明是现阶段持续的习惯，由此造成的损害正在进行，主句应用现在进行时 are damaging。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Children ________ are not active or ________ diet is high in fact will gain weight quickly.
questions.explanation: 第一空先行词 Children 指人且从句缺主语，用 who；第二空后接名词 diet，表示“……的饮食”，用 whose，故选 who; whose。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I'd rather you ________ make any comment on the issue for the time being.
questions.explanation: would rather 后接从句表愿望时用虚拟语气：表示现在或将来的愿望，从句谓语用一般过去式，故选 didn't。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: By the time you have finished this book, your meal ________ cold.
questions.explanation: By the time + 现在时从句表示将来时间，主句应用将来时态；等你看完这本书时饭菜将变凉，故选 will get。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The new factory ________ by the end of this month.
questions.explanation: by the end of this month 是 by + 将来时间的标志，应用将来完成时 will have done；factory 与 complete 是被动关系，故选 will have been completed。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I just wonder ________ that makes him so excited.
questions.explanation: 这是强调句的特殊疑问式嵌入 wonder 之后的宾语从句：what it is that makes him so excited，疑问词 what 提前后用陈述语序 it is...that，故选 what it is。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Under no circumstances ________ the party.
questions.explanation: Under no circumstances（决不）是否定意义的介词短语位于句首，句子要部分倒装，把情态动词 shall 提到主语 we 之前：shall we cancel，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The man ________ for his frankness will make a speech at the meeting.
questions.explanation: the man 与 know 是被动关系（be known for... 因……而闻名），用过去分词 known 作后置定语，故选 known。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Even though they ________ side by side for twenty years, the two neighbors are not on good terms.
questions.explanation: for twenty years 表示持续时间段，且主句 are not on good terms 表明动作延续到现在，应用现在完成进行时 have been living；live 是不及物动词，不能用被动形式。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The cost of living in Glasgow is among the lowest in Britain, ________ the quality of life is probably one of the highest.
questions.explanation: 前句说格拉斯哥生活成本最低，后句说生活质量可能最高，前后是对比关系，while 表“然而”用于对比，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: After the guests left, she spent half an hour ________ the sitting-room.
questions.explanation: spend + 时间 + (in) doing sth 是固定结构，介词 in 后接动名词，故选 clearing。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: His family ________ very large and the whole family ________ watching TV.
questions.explanation: family 作主语时，指整体（家庭规模大）谓语用单数 is；指成员（全家人在看电视）谓语用复数 are，故选 is; are。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ , the old man had a sharp ear for even the slightest sound.
questions.explanation: as 引导让步状语从句时需倒装，把表语形容词提到句首：Blind as he was = Though he was blind（虽是盲人），故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The summer vacation ________ over, they then got down to their work again.
questions.explanation: 逗号后 they got down to... 已有谓语，逗号前无连词，不能用谓语动词，应用独立主格结构 The summer vacation being over（假期结束了），故选 being。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He failed in his exam, ________ proves that he hadn't worked hard enough.
questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，先行词是前面整个句子（He failed in his exam），指物且在从句中作主语只能用 which，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Having the highest marks in his class, ________.
options: he was offered a scholarship by the English Department
the English Department offered him a scholarship
a scholarship was offered by the English Department
a scholarship was offered to him by the English Department
questions.explanation: 现在分词 Having the highest marks 的逻辑主语必须与句子主语一致，“获得全班最高分”的应是 he；B/C/D 的主语是 the English Department 或 a scholarship，构成悬垂分词，故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He insisted that he ________ an opportunity to explain his case.
questions.explanation: insist 表示“坚决要求”时，宾语从句用 (should)+动词原形的虚拟语气；he 与 give 是被动关系（他被给予机会），故选 be given。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Never before that night ________ the extent of my own power.
questions.explanation: Never 否定词位于句首，句子部分倒装；before that night 指过去时间点之前，即“过去的过去”，应用过去完成时，故选 had I felt。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ is known to all, too much stress can cause disease.
questions.explanation: As is known to all（众所周知）中 as 引导非限制性定语从句，指代后面整个主句，译为“正如”，故选 As。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was not until he came back ________ I left the office.
questions.explanation: It was not until...that... 是强调句型强调 not until 状语，去掉 It was...that 后句子仍完整，必须用 that 连接，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Only when he finished his homework ________ that he had made a mistake.
questions.explanation: Only + when 引导的状语从句位于句首，主句要部分倒装，把助动词 did 提到主语前：did he realize，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If it ________ rain tomorrow, we'll have the party outside.
questions.explanation: if 条件状语从句遵循“主将从现”：主句 we'll have the party outside 用一般将来时，从句 tomorrow 的动作用一般现在时 doesn't rain，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is required that students ________ at least two clubs in the university.
questions.explanation: It is required that... 中 required 表示“要求”，主语从句要用虚拟语气，谓语为 (should)+动词原形，故选 attend。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: They would regret for ________ a vote to a man of vision.
questions.explanation: 动名词的否定式是把 not 放在 doing 之前，即 not giving；C 项 having not given 语序错误，D 项不定式不对，故选 not giving。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ you realize your trouble with English learning, you can take some effective steps.
questions.explanation: Now that 意为“既然”，引导原因状语从句：既然你意识到了英语学习的困难，就可以采取有效措施，故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ that the pilot couldn't fly through it.
questions.explanation: so + 形容词 + that 结果状语从句中，so + adj 位于句首时主句要倒装，be 动词提到主语前：So severe was the storm that...，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is the third time I ________ to the Palace Museum, and I still think it is marvelous.
questions.explanation: It is the + 序数词 + time 后的从句用现在完成时；have been to 表示“去过”（去了已回来），have gone to 表示“去了还没回来”，故选 have been。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: In my mind, ________ that famous university will be the only way to become a world-class writer.
questions.explanation: 句子缺主语，“上那所名校”这一行为作主语应用动名词短语 attending that famous university，动名词作主语谓语用单数，故选 attending。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If they hadn't spent all the money on the stocks, their life ________ so miserable at the moment.
questions.explanation: 这是错综时间虚拟条件句：从句 If they hadn't spent... 是与过去事实相反，主句有 at the moment（现在）标志，应对应现在虚拟 would not be，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The dish ________ terrible! I don't like it at all.
questions.explanation: taste 在此是系动词，后接形容词作表语表示状态，只能用主动形式，没有被动语态（is tasted 错误）；由 I don't like it 可知是现在的情况，故选 tastes。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ many times, she still couldn't understand it.
questions.explanation: she 与 tell 是被动关系，且“被告知”发生在 couldn't understand 之前，应用 having been done 形式作状语，故选 Having been told。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ of the three sisters you choose to marry, you will have a good wife.
questions.explanation: Whichever of the three sisters = no matter which，引导让步状语从句，表示“无论选三姐妹中的哪一个”，故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He ________ somebody creeping into the house through the open window last night.
questions.explanation: last night 是一般过去时的标志；see 是感知动词，表示“看见”的瞬间动作不用进行时，故选 saw。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We ________ our breakfast when an old man came to the door.
questions.explanation: “刚吃完早饭”发生在 when an old man came（过去动作）之前，即“过去的过去”，应用过去完成时 had just had，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ he will come is doubtful.
questions.explanation: 空格引导主语从句且从句不缺成分，表“是否”要用 whether；if 不能引导位于句首的主语从句，故选 Whether。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Look, here ________ the famous pop singer.
questions.explanation: here 位于句首且主语 the famous pop singer 是名词，句子完全倒装：here + 谓语 + 主语；Look 提示动作正在发生，主语为单数，故选 comes。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Let’s go on a picnic this weekend, ________?
questions.explanation: Let's 开头的祈使句，反义疑问部分固定用 shall we，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Pointing to the house on ________ roof grew lots of bush, the old man told me that was ________ I would stay.
questions.explanation: 第一空先行词 the house 与 roof 是所属关系（房子的屋顶），介词 on 提前用 on whose roof；第二空 that was 后表语从句不缺成分且指地点，用 where（我将住的地方），故选 whose; where。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Well, Tom, I have nothing secret to tell you. ________ you want me to say?
questions.explanation: 这是强调句的特殊疑问式：What is it that you want me to say?（你到底想让我说什么？），疑问词 what 提前，后接陈述语序 it is...that，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Is there a connection between ________ you eat and maintaining good health?
questions.explanation: 介词 between 后接宾语从句，从句中 eat 缺宾语，应用 what（that 只起连接作用不充当成分，且不用于介词后），故选 what。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I used to smoke, but I ________ anymore.
questions.explanation: used to smoke 表示过去常常吸烟，but 转折后 anymore 表示“现在不再”，应用一般现在时否定 don't，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Not until all the fish died in the river ________ how serious the pollution was.
questions.explanation: Not until + 时间状语从句位于句首，主句要部分倒装，把助动词 did 提到主语 the villagers 前：did the villagers realize，故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The murderer was brought in, with his hands ________ behind his back.
questions.explanation: with 复合结构中 his hands 与 tie 是被动关系（手被绑在背后），用过去分词 tied 作宾补，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ about it earlier, we could have warned people of the danger.
questions.explanation: 这是与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句省略 if 并把 had 提前构成的倒装：Had we known about it earlier = If we had known about it earlier，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I’d like to find someone ________ I can discuss such a problem.
questions.explanation: discuss sth with sb（与某人讨论某事），先行词 someone 指人，介词 with 提前后用 with whom，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was not until the accident happened ________.
options: when I became aware of my foolishness
that did I realize my foolishness
that I became aware of my foolishness
questions.explanation: It was not until...that... 强调句型中，that 后的从句用陈述语序，不倒装：that I became aware of my foolishness，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: As we know, physics ________ the science of energy.
questions.explanation: physics（物理学）是形式上复数、意义上单数的学科名词，作主语时谓语用单数；客观事实用一般现在时，故选 is。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was last night ________ I see the comet.
questions.explanation: It was last night that... 是强调句型，强调时间状语 last night，强调句连接词用 that，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I don’t think she has heard of him before, ________?
questions.explanation: I don't think + 宾语从句存在否定转移，反义疑问部分与从句一致；按“前否后肯”，从句主语 she 配助动词 has，用肯定 has she?，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The Rocky Mountains ________ we will soon be flying are very beautiful.
questions.explanation: fly over the mountains（飞越山脉），先行词 The Rocky Mountains 指物，介词 over 提到关系代词前用 over which，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: There are ten stories in this book, ________ are the most interesting ones.
questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，“其中的前四个”应用 the first four of which；them/those 不能引导从句，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Scientists estimate that about 530,000 other objects, too small to detect with radar, ________ the Earth too.
questions.explanation: 句意表示这些天体目前正围绕地球运转，是现阶段正在进行的动作，应用现在进行时 are circling；objects 与 circle 是主动关系，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Never before ________ seen any lady who can play tennis as well as Maria.
questions.explanation: Never before 否定词组位于句首，句子部分倒装；before 与现在完成时连用（句中无过去时间锚点，从句 can play 也是现在时态），用 has he seen，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Young people are redefining for themselves ________ it means to be a man or a woman.
questions.explanation: redefining 后接宾语从句，从句 means 缺宾语，应用 what 构成 what it means to be a man or a woman（做男人或女人意味着什么），故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It’s important for the figures ________ regularly.
questions.explanation: It's important for sb/sth to do 结构中，figures 与 update 是被动关系（数据被定期更新），应用不定式被动式 to be updated，故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The airport ________ next year will help promote tourism in this area.
questions.explanation: airport 与 complete 是被动关系，且 next year 表示将来建成，不定式 to be completed 作后置定语表“将要被建成的”；being completed 表正在进行，completed 表已完成，均不合句意，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We must begin testing this instrument, no matter ________ difficult it is.
questions.explanation: no matter how + 形容词/副词引导让步状语从句；difficult 是形容词，句中已有 no matter，只能搭配 how（however 不能与 no matter 连用），故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I need the job badly, as my money ________ out by the end of next month.
questions.explanation: by the end of next month 是 by + 将来时间的标志，应用将来完成时 will have run out（钱将已用完），故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: While being questioned on the court, the man denied ________ the old lady’s necklace.
questions.explanation: deny 后接动名词作宾语；“拿走项链”发生在 denied 之前，用 having taken 强调动作先于谓语，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: You should respect others’ opinions, and at the same time you should insist on ________ you believe is right.
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后接宾语从句，从句中 is right 缺主语，应用 what 兼作 believe 的宾语和 is right 的主语（坚持你认为正确的事），故选 what。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Only when she had accomplished the task ________ that she had made a mistake.
questions.explanation: Only + when 状语从句位于句首，主句部分倒装，把助动词 did 提到主语 she 前：did she realize，故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Look out! Don’t get too close to the house ________ roof is under repair.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the house 与 roof 是所属关系，“房子的屋顶”用 whose roof 作从句主语，故选 whose。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Each student ________ in the examination.
questions.explanation: each + 单数名词作主语，谓语动词用单数；fail（不及格）在此是不及物动词，没有被动语态，故选 has failed。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The secretary worked late into night, ________ a long speech for the president.
questions.explanation: 句中已有谓语 worked，逗号后应用现在分词 preparing 作伴随状语，表示与 worked 同时进行的动作，故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Tom is the only one of the students who ________ to Shanghai.
questions.explanation: the only one of + 复数名词后接定语从句时，从句谓语与 the only one 保持一致用单数；have been to 表示“去过”（已回来），故选 has been。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He ________ ill, so he couldn’t go to school yesterday.
questions.explanation: so 连接两个并列分句，第一个分句必须有谓语动词，不能用 being/having been；由 yesterday 和 couldn't 可知用一般过去时 was ill，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The only thing ________ I knew is ________ my brother said to me the other day.
questions.explanation: 第一空先行词 thing 被 the only 修饰，关系词只能用 that；第二空 is 后表语从句缺 said 的宾语，应用 what，故选 that; what。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ she loves her children, she was extremely strict with them.
questions.explanation: 前后是让步关系：尽管她爱孩子，却对他们极其严格。While 此处意为“尽管”，引导让步状语从句，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was ________ he arrived home ________ he realized that he had left his keys in the office.
questions.explanation: It was not until...that... 强调 not until 状语：直到他到家才意识到把钥匙落在了办公室，两空分别为 not until 和 that，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I find it hard to imagine a time when _______ to solve.
questions.explanation: when 引导定语从句修饰 a time，从句应用 there be 存在句的正常陈述语序：there will be no problems to solve，其他选项语序错误，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If only you _______ him what I said! Everything would have been all right.
questions.explanation: If only（要是……就好了）后用虚拟语气；由 Everything would have been all right 可知与过去事实相反，从句用 had not told，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: During the last three decades, the number of people participating in physical fitness programs _______ sharply.
questions.explanation: During the last three decades 是现在完成时的标志；the number of + 名词作主语意为“……的数量”，谓语用单数，故选 has increased。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______ for the timely investment from the general public, our company would not be so thriving as it is.
questions.explanation: 这是含蓄条件句的虚拟倒装：Had it not been for... = If it had not been for...（要不是……），投资发生在过去，与过去事实相反用 had it not been，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Not until a monkey is several years old _______ to exhibit signs of independence from its mother.
questions.explanation: Not until 状语位于句首，主句部分倒装，把助动词 does 提到主语 it 前：does it begin，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: That children admitted _______ the fire behind the store.
questions.explanation: admit 后接动名词作宾语；“纵火”发生在 admitted 之前，应用 having started 表示动作先于谓语动词，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: When we arrived at the airport, the plane _______.
questions.explanation: 飞机起飞发生在 we arrived（过去动作）之前，即“过去的过去”，应用过去完成时 had already taken off，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: A good dictionary is our best teacher. Not only _______ the meaning of words, but also teaches us how to use them.
questions.explanation: Not only 位于句首，句子部分倒装，把助动词 does 提到主语 it 前；后半句 but also teaches 提示前面动词是 give（给出词义），故选 does it give。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Only a knife and fork _______ on the table. There is nothing else.
questions.explanation: a knife and fork 指“一副刀叉”，并列主语指成双成对的成套物品时谓语用单数；由 There is nothing else 可知是现在情况，故选 is。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Weather _______, there will be an open air party with live music here this weekend.
questions.explanation: Weather permitting 是独立主格结构（= If weather permits），weather 与 permit 是主动关系用现在分词，作条件状语，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We are sure that _______ to do this face to face, he would express himself more easily.
questions.explanation: 与将来事实相反的虚拟条件句省略 if 后把 were 提前构成倒装：Were he to try = If he were to try，与主句 would express 呼应，故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —Have you been paid for the painting? —Yes, I remember _______ $60 for it.
questions.explanation: remember doing sth 表示“记得做过某事”；“我”是被人付钱，动名词用被动式 being paid，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The old man has two sons, _______ are lawyers.
questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，指人且作介词 of 的宾语用 both of whom；both of them 不能引导从句，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______ who she was, she said she was Mr. Johnson’s friend.
questions.explanation: she 与 ask 是被动关系（她被问及身份），应用过去分词 Asked 作状语，相当于 When she was asked who she was，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______ a postgraduate, I would at least master two foreign languages.
questions.explanation: Were I to become a postgraduate = If I were to become...，是与将来事实相反的虚拟条件句省略 if 并把 were 提前的倒装形式，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He was unhappy when he sold his guitar. After all, he _______ it for a very long time.
questions.explanation: “拥有吉他很久”发生在 sold（过去动作）之前，即“过去的过去”，应用过去完成时 had had，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Hurry up, kids! The school bus _______ for us!
questions.explanation: Hurry up! 提示校车“现在正在等”，应用现在进行时 is waiting，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: With the guide _______ the way, we set off on foot into the dark night.
questions.explanation: with 复合结构中 the guide 与 lead the way 是主动关系（向导带路），用现在分词 leading，故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: In the last few years thousands of films _______ all over the world.
questions.explanation: In the last few years 是现在完成时的标志；films 与 produce 是被动关系（电影被制作出来），应用 have been produced，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He has reached a point _______ he doesn't work for money.
questions.explanation: 先行词 point 表示抽象地点（境地），从句 he doesn't work for money 结构完整，应用关系副词 where 作地点状语，故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______ is not until everyone is seated _______ the lesson will begin.
questions.explanation: It is not until everyone is seated that the lesson will begin 是强调句型，强调 not until 状语，两空分别为 It 和 that，故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: To tell you the truth, he _______ come to see you the other day.
questions.explanation: 强调谓语动词时在动词前加助动词 do/does/did；the other day（前几天）表明是过去，故用 did come（确实来看过你），故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Only in this way _______ to make improvement in the operating system.
questions.explanation: Only + 介词短语 in this way 位于句首，主句部分倒装，把情态动词 can 提到主语 you 前：can you hope，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I don't like the way _______ you solve your problem.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the way 后的定语从句可用 that/in which 引导或省略关系词，不能用 which 或 when，故选 that。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If I mistake not, you used to cook your own food, _______?
questions.explanation: used to do（过去常常）的反义疑问部分用 didn't + 主语：you used to cook your own food, didn't you?，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______, he must be totally exhausted after a two-week trip by bus.
questions.explanation: as 引导让步状语从句需倒装，把表语 Strong 提前：Strong as he is = Though he is strong（虽然他很强壮），故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: How I wish that I _______ law when I was at college!
questions.explanation: wish 后的宾语从句用虚拟语气；when I was at college 表明与过去事实相反，从句谓语用 had done，故选 had learned。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: No sooner _______ than he realized that he should have remained silent.
questions.explanation: No sooner...than...（刚……就……）中 no sooner 位于句首要用过去完成时并倒装；the words 与 speak 是被动关系（话被说出），故选 had the words been spoken。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Not a single word _______ all morning.
questions.explanation: Not a single word 否定词位于句首，句子部分倒装，把助动词 did 提前：did he say；all morning 表明是过去，故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: A fence needs the support of three stakes, _______?
questions.explanation: 前句 needs 是实义动词的一般现在时，主语 a fence 是第三人称单数，反义疑问部分用 doesn't it，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Mother told the child _______ too late.
questions.explanation: tell sb (not) to do sth 是固定结构，不定式的否定式把 not 放在 to 前：not to get up，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Experiments in the photography of moving objects _______ in both the United States and Europe before 1990.
questions.explanation: before + 过去时间点 1990 表示“过去的过去”，应用过去完成时；experiments 与 conduct 是被动关系，故选 had been conducted。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Today, people live in a world _______ new technology is taking an increasing proportion in their lives.
questions.explanation: 先行词 world 表示地点，从句 new technology is taking an increasing proportion 结构完整，应用关系副词 where 作地点状语，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The ATMs enable bank customers to access their money 24 hours a day _______ ATMs are located.
questions.explanation: 句意为“无论 ATM 设在哪里都能 24 小时取钱”，wherever 引导地点状语从句；whenever 表时间不合句意，故选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The town ________ we visited last month is the one ________ the famous painter was born.
questions.explanation: 第一空从句 we visited last month 缺宾语，先行词 town 指物用 which；第二空从句 the famous painter was born 结构完整，用关系副词 where，故选 which; where。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If the work ________ by the end of this month is delayed, the construction company will be heavily fined.
questions.explanation: the work 与 complete 是被动关系，且 by the end of this month 表示将来才完成，不定式 to be completed 作后置定语，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Our teacher suggested that each of us ________ a study plan for the long summer vacation.
questions.explanation: suggest 表示“建议”时宾语从句用虚拟语气，谓语为 (should)+动词原形，故选 make。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He insisted on his name ________ in full.
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后接动名词；his name 与 write 是被动关系（名字被完整写下），应用 being written，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: “The key to ________ the medical problems at the root is health care reform,” said the minister.
questions.explanation: The key to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词作宾语：the key to solving the medical problems（解决医疗问题的关键），故选 solving。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I don’t know how to play bridge (桥牌) and ________.
questions.explanation: 前句是否定句，表示“我妻子也不会”用 neither + 助动词 + 主语的倒装结构：neither does my wife，故选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: You and I could hardly work together, ________?
questions.explanation: 前句有 hardly（几乎不）表否定，按“前否后肯”反义部分用肯定；主语 You and I 对应 we，故用 could we?，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He is the only one of the students who ________ abroad for three years.
questions.explanation: the only one of + 复数名词后的定语从句谓语与 the only one 一致用单数；“在国外三年”用 has been abroad，故选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is a custom in that country for men to remove their hats when a woman ________ the room.
questions.explanation: 主句 It is a custom... 说明的是一般习俗，when 引导的时间状语从句表示习惯性、经常性的动作用一般现在时，故选 enters。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If my brother lived here today, he would be surprised by what ________ here in the city.
questions.explanation: what 从句指“到现在为止城里已发生的变化”，应用现在完成时；happen 是不及物动词，没有被动语态，故选 has happened。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Not only I but also Jane and Mary ________ worn out after having one examination after another.
questions.explanation: not only...but also 连接两个并列主语时谓语遵循就近原则，与最近的主语 Jane and Mary（复数）一致，故选 are。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Tired ________ she was, there was no hope of her being able to sleep.
questions.explanation: 表语 Tired 提前构成让步倒装，though 引导让步状语从句可倒装：Tired though she was = Though she was tired（尽管她很累），故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The old man ________ since he came into the hospital.
options: has been taken good care of
questions.explanation: since + 一般过去时从句表明主句用现在完成时；the old man 与 take care of 是被动关系，被动式须保留介词 of：has been taken good care of，故选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ is often the case with a new idea, more conditions should be considered.
questions.explanation: 空格引导非限制性定语从句并指代整个主句，as 意为“正如”，固定搭配 as is often the case（正如常见的情况那样），且 as 引导的非限制性定语从句可位于句首；which 指代整句时只能放在主句之后，that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，故选 As。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Children ________ by their parents are allowed to enter the stadium.
questions.explanation: Children 与 accompany 是被动关系（孩子“被”父母陪同），作后置定语用过去分词 accompanied；accompanying 表主动，having accompanied 表主动且先发生，to accompany 表将来主动，均不合逻辑。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: At this time next week, we ________ the matter with our friends.
questions.explanation: at this time next week 是将来进行时的标志（到将来某刻动作正在进行），谓语用 will be doing，故选 will be discussing。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Do you know the man ________ just now?
questions.explanation: nod 是不及物动词，须搭配 nod to sb，介词 to 不能丢；关系代词在从句中作介词宾语且介词后置时可省略，故 the man I nodded to 正确；C 缺介词 to，D 中 to him 与关系代词重复，A 中介词后不能用 who。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: A series of measures ________, people in that area managed to survive the severe famine.
questions.explanation: 逗号后是完整句子，逗号前为独立主格结构作状语；measures 与 take 是被动关系且动作发生在主句 managed 之前，用 having been taken；若选 were/have been taken 则出现两个谓语，having taken 表主动不合逻辑。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The moon ________ around the earth.
questions.explanation: 月球绕地球转是客观真理，用一般现在时；主语 the moon 是第三人称单数，谓语加 s，选 moves。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is no use ________ over spilt milk.
questions.explanation: It is no use doing sth. 为固定句型，动名词作真正主语，it 作形式主语，故选 crying（覆水难收，哭也无用）。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Without electricity human life ________ quite different today.
questions.explanation: Without electricity 是含蓄条件（=if there were no electricity），与现在事实相反，主句用 would do；句末 today 表明是现在情况，would have been 表过去不符，选 would be。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Three hours ________ enough for us to finish this work.
questions.explanation: 表示时间、距离、金额等的复数名词作主语时被视为一个整体，谓语用单数，故 Three hours is enough，且句意需要系动词 be，选 is。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: What's the matter with you? You ________ so pale.
questions.explanation: look 作系动词表“看起来”的状态时不用于进行时，对话描述说话时的当前状态用一般现在时，选 look。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The doctor suggested he ________ a rest for 2 days.
questions.explanation: suggest 表“建议”时，宾语从句谓语用 (should)+动词原形 的虚拟语气，故选 should have。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I have no doubt ________ he will overcome all his difficulties.
questions.explanation: doubt 后接同位语从句：肯定句中用 whether/if，否定句或 no doubt（不怀疑）中用 that；本句 have no doubt 表确定判断，从句完整，选 that。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ we have all the materials ready, we should begin the new task at once.
questions.explanation: now that 意为“既然”，引导原因状语从句；Since that、Since now 不是规范连词，By now 是时间状语不能引导从句，故选 Now that。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was ten o'clock ________ he came back.
questions.explanation: 强调句型强调时间点须说 It was at ten o'clock that...（时间前加介词 at）；本句 ten o'clock 前无 at，It was ten o'clock 是主句，when 引导时间状语从句，选 when。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I was very tired. Otherwise, I ________ to the theatre with you.
questions.explanation: Otherwise（否则）暗示含蓄虚拟条件：因为我当时很累（实际没去），与过去事实相反，主句用 would have done，选 would have gone。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: My parents don't care ________ my pocket money goes, but one thing is for sure: the money spent must be worthwhile.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句中 goes 缺方式状语，表示“零花钱怎么花、花得值不值”用 how；why/when/where 与后文“花得必须值得”的语境不符，选 how。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The view ________ many scientists hold is ________ too much emission of carbon dioxide is destructive.
questions.explanation: 第一空：hold the view 搭配，view 后的定语从句缺 hold 的宾语，用 that；第二空：is 后是表语从句，从句不缺成分，that 仅起连接作用且不可省略，两空都选 that。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The traffic was very heavy, otherwise I ________ here 30 minutes ago.
questions.explanation: otherwise 暗示含蓄虚拟条件（若不是交通拥堵），30 minutes ago 表明与过去事实相反，主句用 would have done，选 would have been。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ difficulties we may come across, we will help one another to get them over.
questions.explanation: 空格修饰名词 difficulties 且引导让步状语从句，表示“无论遇到什么困难”用 whatever（=no matter what）；however 只修饰形容词/副词，whichever 表有范围内的“无论哪个”，选 Whatever。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was in the bookstore ________ I met your brother the other day.
questions.explanation: It was + in the bookstore（强调地点状语）+ that...，去掉 It was...that 后句子 I met your brother the other day 仍完整，是强调句型，只能用 that。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Not until he went through real hardship ________ the love we have for our families is important.
questions.explanation: 否定意义的 not until 从句置于句首，主句须部分倒装（助动词提前）；主句时态与 went 一致用一般过去时，即 did he realize，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was ________ he came back from Africa that year ________ he met the girl he would like to marry.
questions.explanation: 强调句型中强调 not until 结构的固定形式为 It was not until...that...（that 从句不倒装），故第一空填 not until，第二空填 that。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________, he couldn't earn enough to support the family.
questions.explanation: as 引导让步状语从句时须将表语/状语/动词提至 as 前，构成倒装：Hard as he worked = Though he worked hard；B、C 未倒装，D 中 did he work 语序错误，选 Hard as he worked。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: You've never told me why you didn't come to my birthday party, ________?
questions.explanation: 陈述部分 You've never told... 是现在完成时且含否定词 never，前否后肯，附加问句用肯定式 have you，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Lucy changed her major from physics to computer, ________.
options: with hopes to be able to locate employment more easily
hoping she can easily get a job
with the hope for the ability to find a better job
hoping to find a job more easily
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 Lucy 与 hope 是主动关系，用现在分词 hoping 作伴随状语，hope to do 为固定搭配；B 中主句为过去时，can 应用 could；A、C 中 with hopes to do / with the hope for 的搭配生硬累赘，故选 hoping to find a job more easily。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: That tree looked as if it ________ for a long time.
questions.explanation: as if 引导的从句所述与事实相反（那棵树很久没浇水了），用 had done 的虚拟形式；树是“被浇”的，需被动，即 hadn't been watered，选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Can you tell me ________?
questions.explanation: 宾语从句必须用陈述语序（主语 that gentleman + 系动词 is），A、D 是疑问语序，B 语序混乱；who 作从句表语且语序正确的是 who that gentleman is，选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Only in this way ________ progress in your English.
questions.explanation: only + 介词短语（in this way）位于句首，主句须部分倒装，情态动词提到主语前：can you make；A、C 未倒装，D 缺 be 动词（will you able to 不成立），选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It's a fine day. Let's go fishing, ________?
questions.explanation: Let's 开头的祈使句表建议，附加问句固定用 shall we，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The building ________ roof we can see is the Western Church.
questions.explanation: roof 与先行词 the building 是所属关系（大楼的屋顶），定语从句中表“……的”用 whose；its 不能引导从句，who's = who is 不合句意，选 whose。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The first software of Windows ________ by Bill Gates became very popular with computer lovers immediately.
questions.explanation: 句中已有谓语 became，空处作 software 的后置定语；software 与 make 是被动关系且动作已完成，用过去分词 made；was made / had been made 会造成一个句子出现两个谓语，选 made。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was after he got what he had desired ________ he realized it was not so important.
questions.explanation: 去掉 It was 和空格词后 he realized it was not so important 仍完整，且被强调部分是 after 引导的时间状语，是强调句型，只能用 that 连接。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She must have read the novel last week, ________?
questions.explanation: must have done 表对过去的推测，附加问句不用 must；句中有明确过去时间 last week，用 didn't + 主语，即 didn't she，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The weather ended up being very good, ________ was more than we could expect.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句缺主语且指代前面整个句子（天气变好这件事），用 which；that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，what 不引导定语从句，选 which。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It doesn't matter ________ you pay in cash or by credit card in this store.
questions.explanation: whether...or... 是固定搭配，引导主语从句表“是现金还是刷卡都行”；if 不能与 or not 直接连用且不宜引导句首主语从句，选 whether。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ with his report, the boss told John to write it all over again.
questions.explanation: be satisfied with 为固定搭配，逻辑主语 the boss 与 satisfied 是系表（被动意味）关系，作原因状语用 Not being satisfied；D 中 satisfying 意为“令人满意的”（主动），与 with 搭配矛盾，B、C 主动形式错误，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ more time, the scientists will be able to work out a good solution to the problem.
questions.explanation: scientists 与 give 是被动关系（科学家“被给予”更多时间），作条件状语用过去分词 Given（=If they were given more time），选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ got in the wheat than it began to rain heavily.
questions.explanation: no sooner 置于句首须部分倒装，且 No sooner...than（刚……就……）句型中主句用过去完成时，即 No sooner had they got...than...，选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: There is no doubt ________ he is a good employee, for he has all the qualities that the company needs.
questions.explanation: doubt 后接同位语从句：否定式 no doubt 表确定语气时用 that 引导，从句完整不缺成分；whether 表“是否”不合句意，选 that。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Do what you think is right, ________ they say.
questions.explanation: “无论他们说什么”，say 缺宾语，用 whatever 引导让步状语从句（=no matter what）；however 修饰形容词/副词，whenever/wherever 表时间/地点，选 whatever。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The Bunsen Burner is so named because it is thought ________ by Robert Bunsen.
questions.explanation: be thought to do 结构中，发明发生在“被认为”之前（历史上已发明）且 Bunsen Burner 与 invent 是被动关系，用不定式完成被动式 to have been invented，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Only years later ________ the truth about the matter.
questions.explanation: only + 时间状语（years later）位于句首，主句须部分倒装，助动词提前；动作发生在过去用一般过去时，即 did I learn，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: In the geography lesson, the teacher told the children that the earth ________ round like a ball.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句表述客观真理（地球是圆的），无论主句是什么时态，从句都用一般现在时，选 is。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The house ________ we used to live has been rebuilt.
questions.explanation: live 不及物，须搭配 live in the house，介词 in 提前后关系代词只能用 which（不能用 that），构成 in which we used to live，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Had Michael received six more votes in the last election, he ________ our chairman now.
questions.explanation: 从句 Had Michael received... 是与过去事实相反的虚拟倒装，但主句有时间标志 now，属错综时间虚拟条件句：从句谈过去、主句谈现在，主句用 would do，选 would be。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Don’t put off until tomorrow ________ should be done today.
questions.explanation: put off 缺宾语，what 引导宾语从句且在从句中作主语（should be done 缺主语）；that 无词义且不作成分，不能填补主语空缺，选 what。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: A survey of the opinions of students ________ that they also admit several hours of sitting in front of the computer ________ harmful for one’s health.
questions.explanation: 主语 A survey 是单数，谓语用 shows；several hours of sitting 表示一段时间被看作整体，谓语用单数 is，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I feel so excited! At this time tomorrow morning, I ________ to Shanghai.
questions.explanation: at this time tomorrow morning 是将来进行时的标志（将来某刻动作正在进行），用 will be doing，选 will be flying。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: When we gave the children ice cream, they immediately ceased ________.
questions.explanation: cease doing sth 表示“停止正在进行的动作”，孩子们一拿到冰淇淋就不再哭了，用动名词 crying，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: This was the last week of school and they ________ for their finals.
questions.explanation: 主句时态为过去（was），且“为期末考试复习”是当时（最后一周）正在进行的动作，用过去进行时 were preparing，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The car was stolen while ________ in a Paris street.
questions.explanation: while 后省略了 it was，car 与 park 是被动关系，描述“停放”的状态用过去分词 parked（=while it was parked）；being parked 强调“正在被停”不合常理，选 parked。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Sandy could do nothing but ________ to her teacher that she was wrong.
questions.explanation: but 前面有实义动词 do（could do nothing）时，but 后接省略 to 的不定式，即 do nothing but do sth，选 admit。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: All ________ you can do to comfort her is to listen to her story patiently.
questions.explanation: 先行词 all 是不定代词，定语从句只能用 that 引导，不能用 which/what，选 that。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: John’s never been to New York. ________.
questions.explanation: 前句为否定（never been），表示“Tom 也没去过”用 neither/nor + 助动词 + 主语的部分倒装结构，助动词与前句完成时一致用 has，即 Neither has Tom，选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The reason why they changed their mind ________ to us yet.
questions.explanation: reason 与 explain 是被动关系（原因“被解释”），yet 是现在完成时的标志，故用现在完成时被动语态 has not been explained，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Mr. Herpin is one of the foreign experts who ________ in China.
questions.explanation: 在 one of + 复数名词结构中，定语从句的先行词是复数名词 the foreign experts，who 指代复数概念，谓语用复数 are working，选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: No sooner ________ there than he fell ill.
questions.explanation: no sooner 置于句首须部分倒装，且 No sooner...than（刚……就……）中主句用过去完成时，即 No sooner had he arrived...than...，选 had he arrived。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Don't worry, the hard work you do now _______ later in life.
questions.explanation: now 与 later in life 表明动作发生在将来，努力“被回报”是被动关系，用一般将来时被动语态 will be repaid，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Much to the parents' comfort, their income is now double _______ it was ten years ago.
questions.explanation: double 后接宾语从句，从句 was 缺表语，用 what（=the amount that it was）；that 无词义不作成分，than 用于比较级结构，选 what。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We should consider the students' request _______ the school library provide more books on popular science.
questions.explanation: request 是抽象名词，其后 that 从句解释 request 的具体内容，为同位语从句，用 that 引导；从句谓语 provide 为原形，正体现 request 后 (should) do 的虚拟语气，选 that。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______ succeed in doing anything.
options: Only by working hard we can
By only working hard we can
Only by working hard can we
Only we can by working hard
questions.explanation: only + 介词短语（by working hard）位于句首，主句须部分倒装，情态动词 can 提到主语 we 前：Only by working hard can we succeed，选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: By the end of next month, you _______ here for three years.
questions.explanation: by the end of + 将来时间是将来完成时的标志，结构 will have done，表示到下月底为止将已满三年，选 will have studied。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was known to us all that Johnson had broken his promise _______ he would give each of us a small gift.
questions.explanation: promise 是抽象名词，其后 that 从句解释 promise 的内容（他承诺给我们每人一件小礼物），从句完整不缺成分，用 that 引导同位语从句，选 that。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: As a new graduate, he doesn't know _______ it takes to start a business here.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句中 takes 缺宾语，用 what（=the things that it takes to start a business）；how/when 只能作状语，which 需有选择范围，选 what。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Millions of Americans take vitamins and minerals, _______ that these pills can help to prevent serious illnesses.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 Americans 与 convince 是被动关系（人们“被说服”相信这些药片能防大病），作伴随状语用过去分词 convinced，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Thanks to the angle _______ he stood, he could see the sunset.
questions.explanation: stand at an angle（以某个角度站立）为固定搭配，介词 at 提前与先行词 angle 的关系代词连用，构成 at which he stood，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The young man cheated his friend of much money, _______ was disgraceful.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句缺主语且指代前面整个句子（骗钱这件事），用 which；that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，who 指人，it 不能连接从句，选 which。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Don't talk about such things of _______ you are not sure.
questions.explanation: be sure of sth 中介词 of 提前到关系代词之前，作介词宾语的关系代词只能用 which，构成 such things of which you are not sure；as 虽可与 such 搭配但不能紧跟介词，选 which。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We're talking about the piano and the pianist _______ were in the concert we attended last night.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the piano and the pianist 既有人又有物，关系代词只能用 that，且从句谓语 were 也印证先行词是复数，选 that。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: _______, he never seems able to do the work satisfactorily.
options: No matter how hard does he try
No matter he tries how hard
No matter how hard tries he
No matter how hard he tries
questions.explanation: no matter how 引导让步状语从句时，从句必须用陈述语序（he tries），不能倒装；A、C 中 does he try / tries he 均错误倒装，B 语序混乱，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It is believed that some illnesses are related to _______ was eaten.
questions.explanation: to 是介词，其后接宾语从句，从句 was eaten 缺主语，用 what（=the food that was eaten）；that 不作成分，it 不能引导从句，选 what。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I couldn't understand the lecture, and _______.
questions.explanation: 前句是否定（couldn't understand），表示“Sue 也听不懂”用 neither + 助动词 + 主语的部分倒装，助动词与 couldn't 对应，即 neither could Sue，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She's going to the photographer's _______.
questions.explanation: have sth done 表示“请人做某事/某物被……”，photograph 与 take 是被动关系，宾补用过去分词 taken，即 to have her photograph taken，选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I'm for the suggestion that a special board _______ to examine the problem.
questions.explanation: suggestion 后的同位语从句表“建议”的内容，谓语用 (should)+动词原形 的虚拟语气；board 与 set up 是被动关系，即 (should) be set up，选 be set up。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: This January will be very precious for us by which time we ________ reviewing Senior Book I.
questions.explanation: by which time 中 which time 指代 this January（将来时间），by + 将来时间是将来完成时的标志，用 will have done，选 will have finished。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Our game of basketball ________. We had been playing for about half an hour when it started to rain heavily.
questions.explanation: game 与 interrupt 是被动关系（比赛“被”大雨打断），叙述过去发生的事实用一般过去时被动语态 was interrupted；had been interrupted 表打断发生在过去动作之前，与语境不符，选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —Will you come to my office when you ________ your work? —Sure.
questions.explanation: when 引导的时间状语从句遵循“主将从现”：主句用将来（Will you come），从句用一般现在时 finish，选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: When you're learning to drive, ________ a good teacher makes a big difference.
questions.explanation: 句子缺主语，动名词短语 having a good teacher 作主语（谓语 makes 用第三人称单数印证）；动词原形 have 不能作主语，选 having。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She read the letter through before sending it, ________ for spelling mistakes.
questions.explanation: checking 与主句谓语 read 同时发生，作伴随状语用现在分词；having checked 表先于 read 完成，不合逻辑（是边读边查），选 checking。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: You ________ if you had had higher score in the examination.
questions.explanation: if 从句 had had 是与过去事实相反的虚拟条件，主句用 would have done，即 would have got scholarship，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I just wonder ________ that makes him so excited.
questions.explanation: wonder 后接宾语从句，其中含强调句的特殊疑问形式 What is it that...?，宾语从句中须改为陈述语序 what it is that...，makes 缺主语故疑问词用 what，选 what it is。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: She insisted that the seats in the theater ________ in advance to ensure a better view.
questions.explanation: insist 表“坚决要求”时，宾语从句用 (should)+动词原形 的虚拟语气；seats 与 book 是被动关系，即 (should) be booked，选 be booked。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The statue is believed ________ by a professional thief a couple of weeks ago.
questions.explanation: be believed to do 结构中，“偷”发生在 believe 之前（a couple of weeks ago 是过去时间）且 statue 与 steal 是被动关系，用不定式完成被动式 to have been stolen，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I don't think a warm winter always has a negative influence on our life, ________?
questions.explanation: I don't think + 宾语从句发生否定转移，附加问句与从句一致且前否后肯；从句主语 a warm winter 是第三人称单数、谓语 has，用 does it，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We're having a meeting in half an hour. The decision ________ at the meeting will influence the future of our company.
questions.explanation: 会议半小时后才开，决定“将要被作出”，作后置定语表将来被动用不定式被动式 to be made；being made 表正在进行，made 表已完成，均与语境不符，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ is known to us all is that the sun rises in the east.
questions.explanation: 第一个 is 之前是主语从句，从句缺主语，用 what（=the thing that is known to us all）；that 无词义不作成分，It 不能引导从句，选 What。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: You'd better read this novel by yourself, ________?
questions.explanation: You'd better = You had better，附加问句固定用 hadn't you（前肯后否），选 hadn't you。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I have no idea ________ she would pass the college entrance examination or not.
questions.explanation: idea 后接同位语从句表“是否”，whether 可与 or not 直接连用（whether...or not），if 则不能，故选 whether。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ how others react to the book you have just read creates an added pleasure.
questions.explanation: 句子缺主语，动名词短语 Hearing how... 作主语（谓语 creates 用第三人称单数印证）；Having heard 强调动作已完成，表一般性状态用动名词原形，选 Hearing。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: —Mr. Wang got the first prize in the singing competition last week. —Oh. That's what he ________ for years.
questions.explanation: 得奖发生在 last week，“期盼多年”发生在得奖之前，属“过去的过去”，用过去完成（进行）时 had been expecting，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Parents should take seriously their children’s requests for sunglasses ________ eye protection is necessary in sunny weather.
questions.explanation: 前后是因果关系：因为晴朗天气里护眼很有必要，所以父母应认真对待孩子要太阳镜的要求，用 because 引导原因状语从句，选 because。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Pop music is such an important part of society ________ it has even influenced our language.
questions.explanation: such + a/an + adj. + 名词 + that... 为结果状语从句固定结构（如此……以至于），从句完整且已有主语 it，选 that；as 用于 such...as 时须在从句中充当成分。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Unfortunately, when I got to her flat, she ________ , so we had only time for a few words.
questions.explanation: got 表明是过去，“她正要离开”是当时正在进行的动作，且后文“我们只来得及说了几句话”说明她还没走成，用过去进行时 was just leaving；had just left（已经走了）与“说了几句话”矛盾，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We don’t doubt ________ he can do a good job, concerning his experience.
questions.explanation: doubt 的宾语从句：否定句或疑问句中用 that，肯定句中用 whether/if；本句 We don't doubt 表“毫不怀疑”，语气确定，选 that。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He didn’t know ________ or go home.
questions.explanation: “疑问词 whether + 不定式”结构可作 know 的宾语，且 whether 能与 or 搭配（whether to wait or go home）；if 不能直接接不定式，选 whether to wait。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Many people favor ________ more nuclear power plants.
questions.explanation: favor 后接动名词作宾语（favor doing sth.），不接不定式，选 building。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: True friendship is like health, ________ is seldom known till it is lost.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句中，which 指代先行词 health，of which 构成 the value of which（它的价值）作从句主语；its value / the value of it 不能引导从句，which the value 语序错误，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The heavy storm yesterday set the record for the heaviest rainfall ________ in a single day.
questions.explanation: rainfall 与 measure 是被动关系（降雨量“被测量”），作后置定语用过去分词 measured，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The children ________ happily in the classroom when the teacher came in.
questions.explanation: when 引导的一般过去时从句（the teacher came in）表明过去某一时刻，主句动作当时正在进行，用过去进行时 were talking，选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ all behaviors are learned behaviors is a basic assumption of social scientists.
questions.explanation: 句子缺主语，that 引导主语从句（从句完整，that 仅起连接作用且不可省略）；Nearly 是副词不能引导从句，It is nearly 结构与 is 重复，选 That nearly。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It isn’t the first time that I ________ myself in an embarrassing situation.
questions.explanation: It is/was the first time that... 句型中，主句为现在时（isn't）时，that 从句用现在完成时，即 have found，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: This is the best novel ________ I have ever read.
questions.explanation: 先行词 novel 被形容词最高级 best 修饰，定语从句只能用 that 引导，不能用 which，选 that。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I’ve never been to Africa, but it is the place ________.
options: where I most want to visit
in which I most want to visit
that I want to visit it most
questions.explanation: visit 是及物动词，place 在从句中作 visit 的宾语，关系词 that/which 可省略，即 the place (that) I most want to visit；where/in which 要求从句缺状语（此处 visit 已有宾语，不成立），D 中 visit it 的 it 重复，选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The final examination will cover all ________ taught this term.
questions.explanation: 先行词 all 是不定代词，定语从句只能用 that；taught 与“所教内容”是被动关系，且本学期尚未结束（this term 到目前为止），用现在完成时被动 has been，即 all that has been taught，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: They always give their vacant seats to ________ comes first.
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后接宾语从句，从句 comes 缺主语，whoever（=anyone who）既引导从句又作从句主语；whom/whomever 是宾格不能作主语，选 whoever。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Each boy and each girl who ________ in finishing the task since May 1st will win 2000 dollars, if they could really make it.
questions.explanation: since May 1st 是现在完成时的标志；each...and each... 强调个体，谓语用单数，who 指代的 each boy and each girl 也是单数概念，故用 has persisted，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: After watching the movie about the Anti-Japanese War, people cannot help but ________ the heroes in the movie.
questions.explanation: cannot help but + 动词原形为固定搭配（情不自禁做某事），与 cannot help doing 同义，选 respect。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Have you checked all the CDs ________ to the mountainous area next week?
questions.explanation: next week 表明动作尚未发生，CDs 与 send 是被动关系，作后置定语表“将来被寄出”用不定式被动式 to be sent；sent 表已寄出，being sent 表正在寄，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The literature teacher saw a Hollywood movie and insisted his students ________ to see it.
questions.explanation: insist 表“坚决要求”时，宾语从句用 (should)+动词原形 的虚拟语气，故谓语用原形 go，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Having finished his homework, he went on ________ a novel written by Dickens.
questions.explanation: go on to do 表示“做完一件事接着做另一件事”，go on doing 表示“继续做同一件事”；作业已写完，接着开始读小说（新动作），用 to read，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Nearly a week passed before the girl was able to explain what ________ to her.
questions.explanation: explain（过去时）之前发生的事情属“过去的过去”，what 从句中用过去完成时 had happened，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The workers were made ________ day and night.
questions.explanation: make sb. do 在变为被动语态时须还原 to，即 be made to do sth，工人是“被迫”干活，用 to work，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I think it was high time they ________ to take you more seriously.
questions.explanation: It is/was (high) time that... 后的从句用虚拟语气，谓语用一般过去时（或 should do），真题中 did 形式居多，选 began。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: We should learn from those ________ are always ready to help others.
questions.explanation: those 指人，构成固定搭配 those who...（那些……的人），从句 are 缺主语故用 who；whom 是宾格不能作主语，选 who。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: All I can do now is nothing ________.
questions.explanation: but 前面有实义动词 do（All I can do）时，but 后接省略 to 的不定式，即 is nothing but wait，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: But for the favorable weather, we ________ in such a good harvest.
questions.explanation: But for（要不是）是含蓄虚拟条件：实际天气好、丰收已成事实，与过去事实相反，主句用 couldn't have done（不可能获得），选 couldn't have got。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I need one more stamp before my collection ________.
questions.explanation: before 引导时间状语从句遵循“主将从现”，从句用一般现在时；collection 与 complete 是被动关系（集册“被完成”），用 is completed，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: He is a man of great knowledge, ________ much can be learned.
questions.explanation: learn from sb.（向某人学到东西）为固定搭配，介词 from 提前与关系代词连用，构成 from whom much can be learned，选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: There seems to be no choice but ________ the offer.
questions.explanation: but 前面没有实义动词 do（此处是 there be 句型 + 名词 choice），but 后接带 to 的不定式，即 no choice but to do sth，选 to accept。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: By the time your plane lands tonight, I ________ at the airport for 3 hours.
questions.explanation: by the time + 现在时从句（lands tonight）表将来的截止时间点，谓语表示持续等待到那时且将持续满 3 小时，用将来完成（进行）时 will have been waiting，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The activity was delayed, ________ was exactly ________ we wanted.
questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，指代前面整个主句，框架规定非限制性定语从句不能用 that，指物作主语用 which；第二空是表语从句，从句缺 wanted 的宾语，用 what。故选 which; what，即 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: So little ________ with each other that the neighbors couldn't settle their difference.
questions.explanation: 标志是否定意义的词 little 位于句首（so little），按框架规则否定词置句首要部分倒装，把助动词 did 提到主语前，即 So little did they agree...，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: It was in 2017 ________ Donald Trump became president of the United States.
questions.explanation: It was 开头是强调句标志，强调时间状语 in 2017；验证方法：去掉 It was...that 后句子 Donald Trump became president in 2017 仍完整，故强调句固定用 that，选 A。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: ________ , everything would have been all right.
questions.explanation: 主句 everything would have been all right 表明是对过去事实的虚拟，从句应为 If he had been here；按框架"一省二提"规则，从句含 had 时可省略 if 并把 had 提到句首构成倒装，即 Had he been here，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I tore open the box only ________ that some papers were missing.
questions.explanation: only to do 是框架中不定式作结果状语的固定结构，表示出乎意料的结果：撕开盒子却发现少了几份文件；动词 discover 用不定式 to discover，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Either my parents or my elder brother ________ going to water the garden.
questions.explanation: either...or 连接两个并列主语时谓语遵循就近原则，与最近的主语 my elder brother（单数）保持一致，be going to 结构中用 is，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Can you imagine why ________?
questions.explanation: imagine 后是 why 引导的宾语从句，框架规定宾语从句必须用陈述语序（主谓结构），不能像疑问句那样把 did 提前，故排除 A、C；"the boy said that"语序正确且 said 有宾语 that，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The little girl showed the policeman the corner ________ she was knocked off her bike.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the corner 是地点，从句 she was knocked off her bike 主谓宾完整，不缺主宾，缺的是地点状语（在拐角处），按框架"从句完整选关系副词"用 where，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: The team overcame all the difficulties and completed the task three weeks ahead of time, ______ is something we had not expected.
questions.explanation: 逗号后的从句指代前面整个主句（球队提前三周完成任务）这件事，是非限制性定语从句；框架规定非限制性定语从句不能用 that，指物作主语用 which，选 B。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: If you had told me earlier, I ______ to meet you at the hotel.
questions.explanation: 从句 If you had told me earlier（had done）表明是对过去事实的虚拟，按框架 if 型虚拟规则，主句应用 would/should/could/might + have done，即 would have come，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Is this the house ______ Shakespeare was born?
questions.explanation: 先行词 the house，从句 Shakespeare was born 缺地点状语，还原为 be born in the house；that 不能紧跟介词之后，故用介词提前结构 in + which，选 C。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: I got to the office earlier that day, ______ the 7:30 train from Paddington.
questions.explanation: 赶上 7:30 的火车发生在"早到办公室"之前，分词动作先于主句动作发生，按框架用 having done 作原因状语，即 having caught the 7:30 train，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: You cannot accept an opinion ______ to you unless it is based on facts.
questions.explanation: opinion 与 offer 之间是被动关系（观点"被提供"给你），按框架逻辑主语与分词为被动关系用过去分词，offered to you 作后置定语修饰 an opinion，选 D。

questions.part: 第三部分 单选练习
questions.stem: Let’s go to see the new movie tonight, ______?
questions.explanation: Let's 开头的祈使句，按框架反义疑问部分固定用 shall we（表提议"我们去……好吗"），其余祈使句才用 will you，选 D。
